--!strict
-- VFXEffects.lua
-- Particle pooling, ring bursts, trails, and common VFX patterns

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local VFXEffects = {}
VFXEffects.__index = VFXEffects

local particlePool = {}
local MAX_PARTICLES = 100

local function getParticlePart(): Part
	for _, part in particlePool do
		if not part.Parent then
			return part
		end
	end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.one
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	table.insert(particlePool, part)
	return part
end

local function returnParticlePart(part: Part)
	if part.Parent then
		part.Parent = nil
	end
	part:ClearAllChildren()
end

-- Ring burst (expanding circle)
function VFXEffects.RingBurst(position: Vector3, color: Color3, startSize: number, endSize: number, duration: number, thickness: number?)
	local part = getParticlePart()
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace
	
	local ring = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	ring.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/ring_main.dds"
	ring.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	ring.LightEmission = 1
	ring.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(duration * 0.5, duration)
	ring.Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 0)
	ring.Size = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, startSize or 1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, endSize or 10),
	})
	ring.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, thickness and 0.1 or 0.3),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	ring.Rate = 0
	ring.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-180, 180)
	ring.Parent = part
	
	ring:Emit(1)
	Debris:AddItem(part, duration + 0.1)
	task.delay(duration + 0.1, function()
		returnParticlePart(part)
	end)
end

-- Radial burst (sparkles in all directions)
function VFXEffects.RadialBurst(position: Vector3, color: Color3, count: number, speedRange: NumberRange, lifetime: NumberRange, sizeRange: NumberRange)
	local part = getParticlePart()
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace
	
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 1
	emitter.Lifetime = lifetime
	emitter.Speed = speedRange
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, sizeRange.Min),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
	})
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = part
	
	emitter:Emit(count)
	Debris:AddItem(part, lifetime.Max + 0.1)
	task.delay(lifetime.Max + 0.1, function()
		returnParticlePart(part)
	end)
end

-- Directional burst (cone)
function VFXEffects.DirectionalBurst(position: Vector3, direction: Vector3, color: Color3, count: number, spread: number, speed: number, lifetime: number)
	local part = getParticlePart()
	part.Position = position
	part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + direction)
	part.Parent = workspace
	
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 1
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(lifetime * 0.5, lifetime)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(speed * 0.5, speed)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(spread, spread)
	emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
	})
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Drag = 2
	emitter.Parent = part
	
	emitter:Emit(count)
	Debris:AddItem(part, lifetime + 0.1)
	task.delay(lifetime + 0.1, function()
		returnParticlePart(part)
	end)
end

-- Trail between two points
function VFXEffects.Trail(from: Vector3, to: Vector3, color: Color3, width: number, duration: number)
	local part = getParticlePart()
	part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(from, to) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -(to - from).Magnitude / 2)
	part.Size = Vector3.new(width, width, (to - from).Magnitude)
	part.Parent = workspace
	
	local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
	trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	trail.LightEmission = 1
	trail.Lifetime = duration
	trail.MinLength = 0
	trail.MaxLength = (to - from).Magnitude + 2
	trail.WidthScale = NumberSequence.new(1)
	trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	
	local attachment0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment0.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, (to - from).Magnitude / 2)
	attachment0.Parent = part
	
	local attachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment1.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, -(to - from).Magnitude / 2)
	attachment1.Parent = part
	
	trail.Attachment0 = attachment0
	trail.Attachment1 = attachment1
	trail.Parent = part
	
	Debris:AddItem(part, duration + 0.1)
	task.delay(duration + 0.1, function()
		returnParticlePart(part)
	end)
end

-- Text pop (damage numbers, gold gain, etc.)
function VFXEffects.TextPop(position: Vector3, text: string, color: Color3, size: number, duration: number, offset: Vector3?)
	local part = getParticlePart()
	part.Position = position + (offset or Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
	part.Parent = workspace
	
	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 50)
	billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboard.Parent = part
	
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextSize = size
	label.TextColor3 = color
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	label.Parent = billboard
	
	-- Animate up and fade
	local tween = game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(part, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = part.Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-2, 2), 5, math.random(-2, 2))
	})
	tween:Play()
	
	local fadeTween = game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(label, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		TextTransparency = 1,
		TextStrokeTransparency = 1
	})
	fadeTween:Play()
	
	task.delay(duration, function()
		returnParticlePart(part)
	end)
end

-- Orbital particles around a point
function VFXEffects.OrbitalParticles(center: Vector3, color: Color3, count: number, radius: number, duration: number)
	local part = getParticlePart()
	part.Position = center
	part.Parent = workspace
	
	for i = 1, count do
		local angle = (i / count) * math.pi * 2
		local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
		attachment.Position = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * radius, 0, math.sin(angle) * radius)
		attachment.Parent = part
		
		local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
		emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
		emitter.LightEmission = 1
		emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(duration * 0.5, duration)
		emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 0)
		emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
		})
		emitter.Rate = 0
		emitter.Parent = attachment
		
		emitter:Emit(1)
	end
	
	-- Rotate the part for orbital motion
	local startTime = os.clock()
	local conn
	conn = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if os.clock() - startTime > duration then
			conn:Disconnect()
			returnParticlePart(part)
			return
		end
		part.CFrame = part.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, 2 * math.pi * 0.5 / 60, 0)
	end)
	
	task.delay(duration + 0.1, function()
		if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
		returnParticlePart(part)
	end)
end

-- Explosion with shockwave
function VFXEffects.Explosion(position: Vector3, color: Color3, scale: number)
	-- Shockwave ring
	VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, color, 1 * scale, 20 * scale, 0.4, 0.2)
	
	-- Core flash
	local part = getParticlePart()
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace
	
	local pointLight = Instance.new("PointLight")
	pointLight.Color = color
	pointLight.Range = 30 * scale
	pointLight.Brightness = 5
	pointLight.Parent = part
	
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(pointLight, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
		Brightness = 0,
		Range = 0
	}):Play()
	
	-- Debris burst
	VFXEffects.RadialBurst(position, color, 30, NumberRange.new(10, 30), NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.8), NumberRange.new(0.5, 2))
	
	Debris:AddItem(part, 0.5)
	task.delay(0.5, function()
		returnParticlePart(part)
	end)
end

-- Presets for game moments
VFXEffects.Presets = {
	BigClick = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.RadialBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0), 12, NumberRange.new(5, 15), NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.4), NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.5))
	end,
	
	LevelUp = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.OrbitalParticles(position, Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150), 12, 4, 1)
		VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150), 2, 15, 0.5)
	end,
	
	RareHatch = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 60), 1, 25, 0.6)
		VFXEffects.RadialBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 100), 30, NumberRange.new(10, 25), NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.8), NumberRange.new(0.8, 2))
		VFXEffects.OrbitalParticles(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 60), 16, 5, 1.5)
	end,
	
	LegendaryHatch = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.Explosion(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 100), 1.5)
		VFXEffects.OrbitalParticles(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 200), 24, 6, 2)
		task.wait(0.2)
		VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 1, 30, 0.5)
	end,
	
	LevelUp = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.OrbitalParticles(position, Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150), 12, 4, 1)
		VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150), 2, 15, 0.5)
	end,
	
	Rebirth = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.Explosion(position, Color3.fromRGB(100, 150, 255), 2)
		VFXEffects.OrbitalParticles(position, Color3.fromRGB(100, 150, 255), 32, 8, 3)
		for i = 1, 3 do
			task.wait(0.15)
			VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(100 + i * 30, 150 + i * 30, 255), 1, 40, 0.6)
		end
	end,
	
	EnemyDefeat = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.RadialBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100), 16, NumberRange.new(8, 20), NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5), NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.2))
		VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80), 1, 12, 0.4)
	end,
	
	BossDefeat = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.Explosion(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 60), 2)
		VFXEffects.OrbitalParticles(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 50), 24, 6, 2)
	end,
	
	TradeComplete = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.RadialBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 120), 15, NumberRange.new(5, 15), NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5), NumberRange.new(0.5, 1))
		VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150), 1, 10, 0.3)
	end,
	
	DailyClaim = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.RadialBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 80), 20, NumberRange.new(5, 12), NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.6), NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.2))
	end,
}

return VFXEffects

--!strict
-- NotificationSystem.lua
-- Centralized notification queue with deduplication, cross-server delivery, and UI

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local MessagingService = game:GetService("MessagingService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local NotificationSystem = {}
NotificationSystem.__index = NotificationSystem

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Configuration
local NOTIFICATION_TYPES = {
	EggReady = { priority = "High", channel = "Toast", sound = "Notification", icon = "rbxassetid://...", autoDismiss = 8 },
	TradeReceived = { priority = "High", channel = "Modal", sound = "Notification", icon = "rbxassetid://...", autoDismiss = false },
	TradeAccepted = { priority = "Medium", channel = "Toast", sound = "Notification", icon = "rbxassetid://...", autoDismiss = 6 },
	TradeDeclined = { priority = "Medium", channel = "Toast", sound = "Error", icon = "rbxassetid://...", autoDismiss = 6 },
	EventStarting = { priority = "High", channel = "Banner", sound = "Notification", icon = "rbxassetid://...", autoDismiss = 10 },
	EventActive = { priority = "High", channel = "Banner", sound = "Notification", icon = "rbxassetid://...", autoDismiss = false },
	PetNeedsCritical = { priority = "Medium", channel = "Toast", sound = "Warning", icon = "rbxassetid://...", autoDismiss = 8 },
	LeaderboardMilestone = { priority = "Medium", channel = "Toast", sound = "Notification", icon = "rbxassetid://...", autoDismiss = 8 },
	BuyOrderFilled = { priority = "Medium", channel = "Toast", sound = "Notification", icon = "rbxassetid://...", autoDismiss = 8 },
	SnipingAlert = { priority = "High", channel = "Banner", sound = "Alert", icon = "rbxassetid://...", autoDismiss = 12 },
	DailyRewardReady = { priority = "Low", channel = "Badge", sound = "Notification", icon = "rbxassetid://...", autoDismiss = false },
}

-- State
local notificationQueue = {}
local activeToasts = {}
local maxToasts = 3
local settings = {
	EggReady = true,
	TradeReceived = true,
	EventStarting = true,
	PetNeedsCritical = true,
	LeaderboardMilestone = true,
	BuyOrderFilled = true,
	SnipingAlert = true,
	DailyRewardReady = true,
	DoNotDisturb = false,
}

local pendingOffline = {}

-- GUI Setup
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "NotificationSystem"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.DisplayOrder = 200
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = playerGui

-- Toast Stack Container
local toastContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
toastContainer.Name = "ToastContainer"
toastContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 350, 1, -20)
toastContainer.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -10)
toastContainer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
toastContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
toastContainer.Parent = gui

local toastListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
toastListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
toastListLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
toastListLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
toastListLayout.Parent = toastContainer

-- Banner Container
local bannerContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
bannerContainer.Name = "BannerContainer"
bannerContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 80)
bannerContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 20)
bannerContainer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
bannerContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
bannerContainer.Parent = gui

-- Badge Container (on menu icons)
local badgeContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
badgeContainer.Name = "BadgeContainer"
badgeContainer.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
badgeContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
badgeContainer.Parent = gui

-- Deduplication cache
local recentNotifications = {}
local DEDUP_WINDOW = 30 -- seconds

-- Cross-server messaging
local MESSAGING_TOPIC = "NotificationSystem"

-- Initialize messaging subscription
local function initMessaging()
	if RunService:IsServer() then return end
	
	task.spawn(function()
		local success, err = pcall(function()
			MessagingService:SubscribeAsync(MESSAGING_TOPIC .. "_" .. player.UserId, function(message)
				local data = message.Data
				NotificationSystem._ReceiveFromServer(data)
			end)
		end)
		if not success then
			warn("NotificationSystem: Failed to subscribe to messaging:", err)
		end
	end)
end

-- Create toast UI
local function createToast(data)
	local template = Instance.new("Frame")
	template.Name = "Toast_" .. data.id
	template.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 70)
	template.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 26, 38)
	template.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
	template.BorderSizePixel = 0
	template.ClipsDescendants = true
	
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	corner.Parent = template
	
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
	stroke.Thickness = 1.5
	stroke.Transparency = 0.4
	stroke.Parent = template
	
	-- Icon
	local icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36)
	icon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 17)
	icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	icon.Image = data.icon or ""
	icon.Parent = template
	
	-- Title
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 24)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 8)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = data.title
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 14
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 245, 255)
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Parent = template
	
	-- Body
	local body = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 18)
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 32)
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Text = data.body
	body.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	body.TextSize = 12
	body.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 195, 220)
	body.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	body.TextWrapped = true
	body.Parent = template
	
	-- Progress bar for auto-dismiss
	if data.autoDismiss then
		local progress = Instance.new("Frame")
		progress.Name = "Progress"
		progress.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3)
		progress.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
		progress.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		progress.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 140, 220)
		progress.BorderSizePixel = 0
		progress.Parent = template
		
		local progressTween = game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(progress, TweenInfo.new(data.autoDismiss, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
		})
		progressTween:Play()
	end
	
	-- Close button
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 4)
	closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeBtn.Text = "✕"
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeBtn.TextSize = 12
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 165, 190)
	closeBtn.Parent = template
	
	closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		dismissToast(data.id)
	end)
	
	-- Swipe to dismiss
	local startX = 0
	template.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			startX = input.Position.X
		end
	end)
	
	template.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			local deltaX = input.Position.X - startX
			if deltaX > 80 then -- swiped right
				dismissToast(data.id)
			end
		end
	end)
	
	-- Entrance animation
	template.Position = UDim2.new(1, 400, 0, 0)
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(template, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	}):Play()
	
	return template
end

local function dismissToast(id: string)
	local toast = toastContainer:FindFirstChild("Toast_" .. id)
	if toast then
		game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(toast, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
			Position = UDim2.new(1, 400, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1
		}):Play()
		task.wait(0.2)
		toast:Destroy()
		activeToasts[id] = nil
	end
end

-- Banner creation
local function createBanner(data)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "Banner_" .. data.id
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 80)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 20, 30)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Parent = bannerContainer
	
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
	corner.Parent = frame
	
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80)
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Parent = frame
	
	-- Content similar to toast but wider
	local icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(48, 48)
	icon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 16)
	icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	icon.Image = data.icon or ""
	icon.Parent = frame
	
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 28)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 12)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = data.title
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 18
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Parent = frame
	
	local body = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 20)
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 40)
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Text = data.body
	body.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	body.TextSize = 14
	body.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 215, 235)
	body.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	body.Parent = frame
	
	-- Close button
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32)
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 24)
	closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 80)
	closeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	closeBtn.Text = "✕"
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeBtn.TextSize = 14
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	closeBtn.Parent = frame
	
	local closeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	closeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	closeCorner.Parent = closeBtn
	
	closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
		task.wait(0.2)
		frame:Destroy()
	end)
	
	-- Entrance
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -100)
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	}):Play()
	
	if data.autoDismiss then
		task.delay(data.autoDismiss, function()
			if frame.Parent then
				game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
				task.wait(0.3)
				frame:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end
end

-- Badge update
local function updateBadge(typeName, count)
	-- This would update badges on menu icons
	-- Implementation depends on your menu structure
end

-- Core send function
function NotificationSystem.Send(player, data)
	-- Server-side: publish to player's topic
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		local message = {
			id = game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false),
			type = data.type,
			title = data.title,
			body = data.body,
			icon = data.icon,
			sound = data.sound,
			actions = data.actions,
			autoDismiss = data.autoDismiss,
			priority = data.priority,
			timestamp = os.time(),
		}
		
		-- Check deduplication
		local dedupKey = data.type .. "_" .. (data.targetId or "")
		if recentNotifications[dedupKey] and os.time() - recentNotifications[dedupKey] < DEDUP_WINDOW then
			return -- Suppressed duplicate
		end
		recentNotifications[dedupKey] = os.time()
		
		-- Check settings
		if not settings[data.type] then return end
		if settings.DoNotDisturb then return end
		
		-- Publish
		MessagingService:PublishAsync(MESSAGING_TOPIC .. "_" .. player.UserId, message)
		return
	end
	
	-- Client-side: receive from server
	NotificationSystem._ReceiveFromServer(data)
end

function NotificationSystem._ReceiveFromServer(data)
	-- Check deduplication
	local dedupKey = data.type .. "_" .. (data.targetId or "")
	if recentNotifications[dedupKey] and os.time() - recentNotifications[dedupKey] < DEDUP_WINDOW then
		return
	end
	recentNotifications[dedupKey] = os.time()
	
	-- Check settings
	if not settings[data.type] then return end
	if settings.DoNotDisturb then return end
	
	-- Play sound
	if data.sound then
		local AudioEffects = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.AudioEffects)
		AudioEffects.PlayPreset(data.sound)
	end
	
	-- Create UI
	local typeConfig = NOTIFICATION_TYPES[data.type]
	local channel = data.channel or typeConfig.channel
	
	if channel == "Toast" then
		if #activeToasts >= maxToasts then
			-- Remove oldest
			local oldestId = next(activeToasts)
			if oldestId then dismissToast(oldestId) end
		end
		
		local toast = createToast(data)
		toast.Parent = toastContainer
		activeToasts[data.id] = toast
		
		if data.autoDismiss then
			task.delay(data.autoDismiss, function()
				dismissToast(data.id)
			end)
		end
		
	elseif channel == "Banner" then
		createBanner(data)
	elseif channel == "Modal" then
		-- Create modal dialog
		NotificationSystem._ShowModal(data)
	elseif channel == "Badge" then
		updateBadge(data.type, 1)
	end
end

function NotificationSystem._ShowModal(data)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "Modal_" .. data.id
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 250)
	frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 32)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Parent = gui
	
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
	corner.Parent = frame
	
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Parent = frame
	
	-- Darken background
	local overlay = Instance.new("Frame")
	overlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
	overlay.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex - 1
	overlay.Parent = gui
	
	-- Content
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 40)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = data.title
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 24
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	title.Parent = frame
	
	local body = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 80)
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 70)
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Text = data.body
	body.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	body.TextSize = 16
	body.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 215, 235)
	body.TextWrapped = true
	body.Parent = frame
	
	-- Action buttons
	if data.actions then
		for i, action in data.actions do
			local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
			btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 40)
			btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20 + (i - 1) * 170, 180)
			btn.BackgroundColor3 = i == 1 and Color3.fromRGB(55, 140, 220) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 70, 90)
			btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
			btn.Text = action.text
			btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			btn.TextSize = 14
			btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			btn.Parent = frame
			
			local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
			btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
			btnCorner.Parent = btn
			
			btn.Activated:Connect(function()
				if action.callback then action.callback() end
				overlay:Destroy()
				frame:Destroy()
			end)
		end
	end
	
	-- Close button
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32)
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 10)
	closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeBtn.Text = "✕"
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeBtn.TextSize = 18
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 165, 190)
	closeBtn.Parent = frame
	
	closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		overlay:Destroy()
		frame:Destroy()
	end)
	
	-- Entrance
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 250)
	}):Play()
end

-- Settings
function NotificationSystem.UpdateSettings(newSettings)
	for k, v in newSettings do
		settings[k] = v
	end
end

function NotificationSystem.GetSettings()
	return settings
end

-- Offline queue handling
function NotificationSystem.QueueOffline(playerId, data)
	if not pendingOffline[playerId] then
		pendingOffline[playerId] = {}
	end
	table.insert(pendingOffline[playerId], data)
end

function NotificationSystem.DeliverOffline(playerId)
	local queue = pendingOffline[playerId]
	if queue then
		for _, data in queue do
			NotificationSystem._ReceiveFromServer(data)
		end
		pendingOffline[playerId] = nil
	end
end

-- Initialize
initMessaging()

-- Cleanup old dedup entries periodically
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(60)
		local now = os.time()
		for key, timestamp in recentNotifications do
			if now - timestamp > DEDUP_WINDOW * 2 then
				recentNotifications[key] = nil
			end
		end
	end
end)

return NotificationSystem

--!strict
-- AuctionEngine.lua
-- Buy order matching, price history, sniping alerts

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local MessagingService = game:GetService("MessagingService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local AuctionEngine = {}
AuctionEngine.__index = AuctionEngine

-- DataStore keys
local DATASTORE_KEYS = {
	Listing = "Auction_Listing_",
	BuyOrder = "Auction_BuyOrder_",
	History = "Auction_History_",
	Watchlist = "Auction_Watchlist_",
}

-- In-memory caches
local activeListings = {}      -- [listingId] = listing
local activeBuyOrders = {}     -- [orderId] = order
local priceHistory = {}        -- [itemId][bucketKey] = {min, max, avg, volume}
local watchlists = {}          -- [playerId] = {itemId, ...}
local snipingThresholds = {}   -- [playerId][itemId] = threshold (0-1)

-- Messaging topics
local TOPICS = {
	ListingPosted = "Auction_ListingPosted",
	BuyOrderPlaced = "Auction_BuyOrderPlaced",
	BuyOrderFilled = "Auction_BuyOrderFilled",
	SnipingAlert = "Auction_SnipingAlert",
	HistoryUpdated = "Auction_HistoryUpdated",
}

-- ============================================
-- DATA MODELS
-- ============================================

export type Listing = {
	id: string,
	itemId: string,
	sellerId: number,
	price: number,
	quantity: number,
	listedAt: number,
	expiresAt: number,
	status: "active" | "filled" | "cancelled" | "expired",
}

export type BuyOrder = {
	id: string,
	itemId: string,
	buyerId: number,
	maxPrice: number,
	quantity: number,
	filled: number,
	placedAt: number,
	expiresAt: number,
	status: "open" | "partial" | "filled" | "cancelled" | "expired",
}

export type HistoryBucket = {
	minPrice: number,
	maxPrice: number,
	avgPrice: number,
	volume: number,
	timestamp: number,
}

-- ============================================
-- MATCHING ENGINE
-- ============================================

function AuctionEngine.MatchBuyOrders(listing: Listing): {filled: number, orders: {BuyOrder}}
	local matches = {}
	local remainingQty = listing.quantity
	
	-- Find compatible buy orders: same item, maxPrice >= listPrice, open/partial status
	local candidates = {}
	for _, order in activeBuyOrders do
		if order.itemId == listing.itemId
			and order.maxPrice >= listing.price
			and (order.status == "open" or order.status == "partial")
			and order.buyerId ~= listing.sellerId
			and os.time() < order.expiresAt then
			table.insert(candidates, order)
		end
	end
	
	-- Sort by price-time priority: highest maxPrice first, then earliest placed
	table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
		if a.maxPrice ~= b.maxPrice then
			return a.maxPrice > b.maxPrice
		end
		return a.placedAt < b.placedAt
	end)
	
	for _, order in candidates do
		if remainingQty <= 0 then break end
		
		local fillQty = math.min(remainingQty, order.quantity - order.filled)
		if fillQty <= 0 then continue end
		
		order.filled += fillQty
		remainingQty -= fillQty
		
		if order.filled >= order.quantity then
			order.status = "filled"
		else
			order.status = "partial"
		end
		
		table.insert(matches, {orderId = order.id, filledQty = fillQty, fillPrice = listing.price})
	end
	
	return {filled = listing.quantity - remainingQty, orders = matches}
end

-- ============================================
-- BUY ORDER MANAGEMENT
-- ============================================

function AuctionEngine.PlaceBuyOrder(buyerId: number, itemId: string, maxPrice: number, quantity: number, durationHours: number): (boolean, string?, string?)
	if maxPrice <= 0 or quantity <= 0 then
		return false, "Invalid price or quantity"
	end
	
	if durationHours < 1 or durationHours > 168 then -- max 1 week
		return false, "Duration must be 1-168 hours"
	end
	
	local orderId = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	local now = os.time()
	
	local order: BuyOrder = {
		id = orderId,
		itemId = itemId,
		buyerId = buyerId,
		maxPrice = maxPrice,
		quantity = quantity,
		filled = 0,
		placedAt = now,
		expiresAt = now + (durationHours * 3600),
		status = "open",
	}
	
	activeBuyOrders[orderId] = order
	
	-- Check for immediate matches against existing listings
	-- (In production, this would iterate active listings)
	
	-- Publish event
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.BuyOrderPlaced, {
			orderId = orderId,
			itemId = itemId,
			maxPrice = maxPrice,
			quantity = quantity,
			buyerId = buyerId,
		})
	end
	
	return true, orderId, nil
end

function AuctionEngine.CancelBuyOrder(buyerId: number, orderId: string): boolean
	local order = activeBuyOrders[orderId]
	if not order or order.buyerId ~= buyerId then return false end
	
	if order.status ~= "open" and order.status ~= "partial" then
		return false
	end
	
	order.status = "cancelled"
	activeBuyOrders[orderId] = nil
	return true
end

function AuctionEngine.GetPlayerBuyOrders(playerId: number): {BuyOrder}
	local result = {}
	for _, order in activeBuyOrders do
		if order.buyerId == playerId then
			table.insert(result, order)
		end
	end
	return result
end

-- ============================================
-- PRICE HISTORY
-- ============================================

local BUCKET_DURATIONS = {
	Hour = 3600,
	SixHour = 21600,
	Day = 86400,
	Week = 604800,
}

function AuctionEngine.GetBucketKey(bucketType: string, timestamp: number): string
	local duration = BUCKET_DURATIONS[bucketType] or BUCKET_DURATIONS.Hour
	return tostring(math.floor(timestamp / duration) * duration)
end

function AuctionEngine.RecordSale(itemId: string, price: number, quantity: number, timestamp: number?)
	timestamp = timestamp or os.time()
	
	for bucketType, duration in BUCKET_DURATIONS do
		local bucketKey = AuctionEngine.GetBucketKey(bucketType, timestamp)
		local key = itemId .. "_" .. bucketKey
		
		if not priceHistory[key] then
			priceHistory[key] = {
				minPrice = price,
				maxPrice = price,
				totalPrice = price * quantity,
				volume = quantity,
				count = 1,
				timestamp = timestamp,
			}
		else
			local bucket = priceHistory[key]
			bucket.minPrice = math.min(bucket.minPrice, price)
			bucket.maxPrice = math.max(bucket.maxPrice, price)
			bucket.totalPrice += price * quantity
			bucket.volume += quantity
			bucket.count += 1
		end
	end
end

function AuctionEngine.GetPriceHistory(itemId: string, bucketType: string, fromTimestamp: number, toTimestamp: number): {HistoryBucket}
	local results = {}
	local duration = BUCKET_DURATIONS[bucketType] or BUCKET_DURATIONS.Hour
	
	for bucketKey, data in priceHistory do
		if not string.find(bucketKey, itemId .. "_") then continue end
		if data.timestamp < fromTimestamp or data.timestamp > toTimestamp then continue end
		
		table.insert(results, {
			minPrice = data.minPrice,
			maxPrice = data.maxPrice,
			avgPrice = data.count > 0 and (data.totalPrice / data.volume) or 0,
			volume = data.volume,
			timestamp = data.timestamp,
		})
	end
	
	table.sort(results, function(a, b) return a.timestamp < b.timestamp end)
	return results
end

function AuctionEngine.GetMovingAverage(itemId: string, bucketType: string, periods: number): number
	local history = AuctionEngine.GetPriceHistory(itemId, bucketType, os.time() - periods * BUCKET_DURATIONS[bucketType], os.time())
	if #history == 0 then return 0 end
	
	local sum = 0
	for _, bucket in history do
		sum += bucket.avgPrice
	end
	return sum / #history
end

function AuctionEngine.GetCurrentPriceStats(itemId: string): {min: number, max: number, avg: number, volume: number, movingAvg7d: number}
	local now = os.time()
	local dayHistory = AuctionEngine.GetPriceHistory(itemId, "Day", now - 7 * 86400, now)
	
	if #dayHistory == 0 then
		return {min = 0, max = 0, avg = 0, volume = 0, movingAvg7d = 0}
	end
	
	local totalVolume = 0
	local weightedSum = 0
	local minPrice = math.huge
	local maxPrice = 0
	
	for _, bucket in dayHistory do
		minPrice = math.min(minPrice, bucket.minPrice)
		maxPrice = math.max(maxPrice, bucket.maxPrice)
		totalVolume += bucket.volume
		weightedSum += bucket.avgPrice * bucket.volume
	end
	
	return {
		min = minPrice == math.huge and 0 or minPrice,
		max = maxPrice,
		avg = totalVolume > 0 and (weightedSum / totalVolume) or 0,
		volume = totalVolume,
		movingAvg7d = totalVolume > 0 and (weightedSum / totalVolume) or 0,
	}
end

-- ============================================
-- SNIPING ALERTS
-- ============================================

function AuctionEngine.SetSnipingThreshold(playerId: number, itemId: string, threshold: number)
	-- threshold = discount percentage (0.15 = 15% below moving average)
	if not snipingThresholds[playerId] then snipingThresholds[playerId] = {} end
	snipingThresholds[playerId][itemId] = math.clamp(threshold, 0.01, 0.50)
end

function AuctionEngine.GetSnipingThresholds(playerId: number): {[string]: number}
	return snipingThresholds[playerId] or {}
end

function AuctionEngine.CheckSnipingAlert(listing: Listing): boolean
	local stats = AuctionEngine.GetCurrentPriceStats(listing.itemId)
	if stats.movingAvg7d == 0 then return false end
	
	local discount = 1 - (listing.price / stats.movingAvg7d)
	
	-- Check all players watching this item
	-- In practice, iterate watchlists or subscriptions
	return discount >= 0.15 -- default threshold
end

function AuctionEngine.TriggerSnipingAlert(listing: Listing, discount: number)
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.SnipingAlert, {
			itemId = listing.itemId,
			listingPrice = listing.price,
			movingAvg = AuctionEngine.GetCurrentPriceStats(listing.itemId).movingAvg7d,
			discount = discount,
			listingId = listing.id,
		})
	end
end

-- ============================================
-- WATCHLIST
-- ============================================

function AuctionEngine.AddToWatchlist(playerId: number, itemId: string)
	if not watchlists[playerId] then watchlists[playerId] = {} end
	if not table.find(watchlists[playerId], itemId) then
		table.insert(watchlists[playerId], itemId)
	end
end

function AuctionEngine.RemoveFromWatchlist(playerId: number, itemId: string)
	if watchlists[playerId] then
		local idx = table.find(watchlists[playerId], itemId)
		if idx then table.remove(watchlists[playerId], idx) end
	end
end

function AuctionEngine.GetWatchlist(playerId: number): {string}
	return watchlists[playerId] or {}
end

function AuctionEngine.GetWatchlistData(playerId: number): {{itemId: string, lowestAsk: number, avgPrice: number, volume24h: number, priceDelta24h: number}}
	local watchlist = watchlists[playerId] or {}
	local results = {}
	
	for _, itemId in watchlist do
		local stats = AuctionEngine.GetCurrentPriceStats(itemId)
		-- In production, fetch lowest ask from active listings
		table.insert(results, {
			itemId = itemId,
			lowestAsk = stats.min,
			avgPrice = stats.avg,
			volume24h = stats.volume,
			priceDelta24h = 0, -- would need previous day comparison
		})
	end
	
	return results
end

-- ============================================
-- LISTING MANAGEMENT (stubs for integration)
-- ============================================

function AuctionEngine.CreateListing(sellerId: number, itemId: string, price: number, quantity: number, durationHours: number): (boolean, string?)
	local listingId = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	local now = os.time()
	
	local listing: Listing = {
		id = listingId,
		itemId = itemId,
		sellerId = sellerId,
		price = price,
		quantity = quantity,
		listedAt = now,
		expiresAt = now + (durationHours * 3600),
		status = "active",
	}
	
	activeListings[listingId] = listing
	
	-- Check for matching buy orders
	local matches = AuctionEngine.MatchBuyOrders(listing)
	if matches.filled > 0 then
		-- Process fills
		for _, match in matches.orders do
			-- Record sale for history
			AuctionEngine.RecordSale(listing.itemId, match.fillPrice, match.filledQty)
			
			-- Notify buyer
			if RunService:IsServer() then
				MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.BuyOrderFilled, {
					orderId = match.orderId,
					itemId = listing.itemId,
					fillPrice = match.fillPrice,
					quantity = match.filledQty,
				})
			end
		end
	end
	
	-- Check sniping alerts
	if AuctionEngine.CheckSnipingAlert(listing) then
		local stats = AuctionEngine.GetCurrentPriceStats(listing.itemId)
		if stats.movingAvg7d > 0 then
			local discount = 1 - (listing.price / stats.movingAvg7d)
			AuctionEngine.TriggerSnipingAlert(listing, discount)
		end
	end
	
	-- Publish listing event
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.ListingPosted, {
			listingId = listingId,
			itemId = itemId,
			price = price,
			quantity = quantity,
			sellerId = sellerId,
		})
	end
	
	return true, listingId
end

function AuctionEngine.GetActiveListings(itemId: string?): {Listing}
	local results = {}
	for _, listing in activeListings do
		if listing.status == "active" and os.time() < listing.expiresAt then
			if not itemId or listing.itemId == itemId then
				table.insert(results, listing)
			end
		end
	end
	
	-- Sort by price ascending
	table.sort(results, function(a, b) return a.price < b.price end)
	return results
end

-- ============================================
-- BACKGROUND JOBS
-- ============================================

if RunService:IsServer() then
	-- Price history aggregation (every 5 minutes)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(300)
			
			-- Cleanup expired orders/listings
			local now = os.time()
			for id, order in activeBuyOrders do
				if now >= order.expiresAt then
					order.status = "expired"
					activeBuyOrders[id] = nil
				end
			end
			
			for id, listing in activeListings do
				if now >= listing.expiresAt then
					listing.status = "expired"
				end
			end
			
			-- Cleanup old price history (keep 90 days)
			local cutoff = os.time() - 90 * 86400
			for key, data in priceHistory do
				if data.timestamp < cutoff then
					priceHistory[key] = nil
				end
			end
			
			MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.HistoryUpdated, {timestamp = os.time()})
		end
	end)
end

return AuctionEngine

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local WorldEvents = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("WorldEvents")
local StateChanged = WorldEvents:WaitForChild("StateChanged")

local Service = {}
local state = {
	Active = false,
	Name = "",
	Description = "",
	EndsAt = 0,
	SpawnMultiplier = 1,
	SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 1,
	RewardMultiplier = 1,
	HealthMultiplier = 1,
	Cycle = 0,
	ObjectiveType = "",
	ObjectiveText = "",
	ObjectiveTarget = 0,
	ObjectiveProgress = 0,
	ObjectiveReward = 0,
	ObjectiveCompleted = false,
	ExclusivePet = "",
	ExclusiveEgg = "",
}
local participants = {}
local rewardedCycle = {}
local rewardCallback

local function snapshot()
	local copy = {}
	for key, value in pairs(state) do copy[key] = value end
	return copy
end

local function publish()
	for key, value in pairs(state) do WorldEvents:SetAttribute(key, value) end
	StateChanged:FireAllClients(snapshot())
end

local function setPlayerAttributes(player)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventActive", state.Active)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventName", state.Name)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventEndsAt", state.EndsAt)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventRewardMultiplier", state.RewardMultiplier)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventSpawnMultiplier", state.SpawnMultiplier)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveProgress", state.ObjectiveProgress)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveTarget", state.ObjectiveTarget)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveCompleted", state.ObjectiveCompleted)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventParticipant", participants[player.UserId] == state.Cycle)
end

function Service.SetRewardCallback(callback)
	rewardCallback = callback
end

function Service.GetState()
	return snapshot()
end

function Service.Start(config)
	state.Active = true
	state.Name = config.Name
	state.Description = config.Description
	state.EndsAt = os.time() + math.clamp(math.floor(config.Duration or 180), 30, 900)
	state.SpawnMultiplier = config.SpawnMultiplier or 1
	state.SpawnIntervalMultiplier = config.SpawnIntervalMultiplier or 1
	state.RewardMultiplier = config.RewardMultiplier or 1
	state.HealthMultiplier = config.HealthMultiplier or 1
	state.ObjectiveType = config.ObjectiveType or "DefeatEnemies"
	state.ObjectiveText = config.ObjectiveText or "Complete the shared objective."
	state.ObjectiveTarget = math.max(1, math.floor(config.ObjectiveTarget or 100))
	state.ObjectiveProgress = 0
	state.ObjectiveReward = math.max(0, math.floor(config.ObjectiveReward or 100))
	state.ObjectiveCompleted = false
	state.ExclusivePet = config.ExclusivePet or ""
	state.ExclusiveEgg = config.ExclusiveEgg or ""
	state.Cycle += 1
	participants = {}
	rewardedCycle = {}
	publish()
end

function Service.AddContribution(player, amount, contributionType)
	if not state.Active or state.ObjectiveCompleted or not player or not player.Parent then return false end
	if contributionType and contributionType ~= state.ObjectiveType then return false end
	local safeAmount = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0), 0, 25)
	if safeAmount <= 0 then return false end
	local before = state.ObjectiveProgress
	state.ObjectiveProgress = math.min(state.ObjectiveTarget, before + safeAmount)
	participants[player.UserId] = state.Cycle
	if state.ObjectiveProgress >= state.ObjectiveTarget then
		state.ObjectiveCompleted = true
	end
	setPlayerAttributes(player)
	publish()
	return state.ObjectiveProgress > before
end

local function rewardParticipants()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if participants[player.UserId] == state.Cycle and not rewardedCycle[player.UserId] then
			rewardedCycle[player.UserId] = true
			if rewardCallback then rewardCallback(player, state.ObjectiveReward, state.ExclusivePet, state.ExclusiveEgg) end
		end
	end
end

function Service.End()
	if not state.Active then return end
	local completed = state.ObjectiveCompleted or state.ObjectiveProgress >= state.ObjectiveTarget
	if completed then rewardParticipants() end
	state.Active = false
	state.Name = ""
	state.Description = completed and "Objective complete! Contributors received rewards." or "The event ended before the objective was completed."
	state.EndsAt = 0
	state.SpawnMultiplier = 1
	state.SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 1
	state.RewardMultiplier = 1
	state.HealthMultiplier = 1
	state.ObjectiveType = ""
	state.ObjectiveText = ""
	state.ObjectiveTarget = 0
	state.ObjectiveProgress = 0
	state.ObjectiveReward = 0
	state.ObjectiveCompleted = completed
	state.ExclusivePet = ""
	state.ExclusiveEgg = ""
	state.Cycle += 1
	publish()
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	task.defer(function()
		setPlayerAttributes(player)
		StateChanged:FireClient(player, snapshot())
	end)
end)

Service.Publish = publish
return Service

--!strict

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- SQUEEZE STUDIO
-- Roblox AI WebSync Plugin
-- Version: 6.0.0
--
-- MUST BE A REAL ROBLOX STUDIO PLUGIN SCRIPT.
--
-- Features:
--  • Toolbar button
--  • DockWidget
--  • Automatic connection
--  • HTTP permission test
--  • Script Injection / ScriptEditorService test
--  • Studio project information
--  • Script count
--  • Pending changes
--  • Sync All
--  • Script create/update/delete
--  • Instance create/update/delete
--  • Property changes
--  • ACK
--  • Verification
--  • Automatic reconnect
--  • Permission diagnostics
--
-- IMPORTANT:
-- Roblox permissions cannot be enabled programmatically.
-- The plugin can only trigger the required operation and
-- report that Studio is asking for permission.
----------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------
-- SERVICES
------------------------------------------------------------

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local ScriptEditorService = game:GetService("ScriptEditorService")
local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")

------------------------------------------------------------
-- CONFIG
------------------------------------------------------------

local CONFIG = {
	PLUGIN_NAME = "Squeeze",
	VERSION = "6.0.0",

	-- CHANGE THIS
	BACKEND_URL = "https://squeezeai.vercel.app/api/studio",

	-- Optional local bridge.
	-- Leave empty if you don't have one yet.
	LOCAL_BRIDGE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:32145",

	HEALTH_ENDPOINT = "/health",
	AUTO_CONNECT_ENDPOINT = "/auto-connect",
	HEARTBEAT_ENDPOINT = "/heartbeat",
	PULL_ENDPOINT = "/files/pull",
	ACK_ENDPOINT = "/ack",
	DISCONNECT_ENDPOINT = "/disconnect",
	SNAPSHOT_ENDPOINT = "/project/snapshot",

	HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL = 5,
	RECONNECT_INTERVAL = 5,
	PREVIEW_INTERVAL = 3,

	MAX_LOG_LINES = 300,

------------------------------------------------------------
-- TYPES
------------------------------------------------------------

type Change = {
	changeId: string?,
	eventId: string?,
	path: string?,
	source: string?,
	className: string?,

	operation: string?,
	version: number?,
	name: string?,

type Session = {
	token: string,
	sessionId: string,
	projectId: string,
	projectName: string,

	status: string,
	connected: boolean,

	lastHeartbeat: number,
	lastSync: number,

	pendingChanges: number,

type Permissions = {

	httpLocalBridge: boolean,
	scriptEditorRead: boolean,

	instanceWrite: boolean,
	changeHistory: boolean,

local syncLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

------------------------------------------------------------
-- ACTION BUTTONS
------------------------------------------------------------

local permissionsButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
permissionsButton.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 222)
permissionsButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -18, 0, 40)

Instance.new("UICorner", permissionsButton).CornerRadius =
	UDim.new(0, 8)

local syncButton = Instance.new("TextButton")

Instance.new("UICorner", syncButton).CornerRadius =

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PERMISSION PANEL
------------------------------------------------------------

local permissionPanel = Instance.new("Frame")

permissionPanel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 145)
permissionPanel.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.PANEL
permissionPanel.BorderSizePixel = 0
permissionPanel.Parent = root

Instance.new("UICorner", permissionPanel).CornerRadius =
	UDim.new(0, 10)

local permissionTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
permissionTitle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 9)
permissionTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 18)
permissionTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1

permissionTitle.TextColor3 = COLORS.MUTED
permissionTitle.TextSize = 10

local permissionText = Instance.new("TextLabel")

permissionText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -38)

permissionText.TextSize = 11
permissionText.Font = Enum.Font.Code
permissionText.TextWrapped = true
permissionText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
permissionText.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
permissionText.Parent = permissionPanel

------------------------------------------------------------
-- LOGS
------------------------------------------------------------

local logs = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
logs.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 431)
logs.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -443)
logs.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(17, 19, 23)
logs.BorderSizePixel = 0
logs.ScrollBarThickness = 5
logs.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
logs.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
logs.Parent = root

Instance.new("UICorner", logs).CornerRadius =
	UDim.new(0, 8)

local logLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
logLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 3)
logLayout.Parent = logs

local logPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
logPadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8)
logPadding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8)
logPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
logPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)
logPadding.Parent = logs

------------------------------------------------------------
-- LOG
------------------------------------------------------------

local function addLog(
	message: string,
	color: Color3?
)
	local count = 0

	for _, child in ipairs(logs:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
			count += 1
		end
	end

	if count >= CONFIG.MAX_LOG_LINES then
		for _, child in ipairs(logs:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
				child:Destroy()
				break
			end
		end
	end

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text =
		"[" .. os.date("%H:%M:%S") .. "] "
		.. message
	label.TextColor3 = color or COLORS.MUTED
	label.TextSize = 11
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.Parent = logs
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- STATUS
------------------------------------------------------------

local function setStatus(
	text: string,
	color: Color3
)
	session.status = text
	statusLabel.Text = "● " .. text
	statusLabel.TextColor3 = color
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- UI UPDATE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function updateUI()
	projectNameLabel.Text =
		session.projectName ~= ""
		and session.projectName
		or "Not connected"

	placeLabel.Text =
		"Place: "
		.. game.Name
		.. " / "
		.. tostring(game.PlaceId)

	local scriptCount = 0

	for _, object in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
			scriptCount += 1
		end
	end

	scriptsLabel.Text =
		"Scripts: "
		.. tostring(scriptCount)

	pendingLabel.Text =
		"Pending: "
		.. tostring(session.pendingChanges)

	if session.lastSync > 0 then
		syncLabel.Text =
			"Last sync: "
			.. os.date("%H:%M:%S")
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- HTTP REQUEST
------------------------------------------------------------

local function request(
	baseURL: string,
	method: string,
	endpoint: string,
	body: any?
): (boolean, any?)
	local url =
		baseURL
		.. endpoint

	local headers = {
		["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
		["X-Squeeze-Plugin"] = CONFIG.VERSION,
	}

	if session.token ~= "" then
		headers["Authorization"] =
			"Bearer " .. session.token
	end

	local encodedBody: string? = nil

	if body ~= nil then
		local encodeOK, encoded =
			pcall(function()
				return HttpService:JSONEncode(body)
			end)

		if not encodeOK then
			return false, {
				code = "JSON_ENCODE_FAILED",
				message = tostring(encoded),
			}
		end

		encodedBody = encoded
	end

	local requestOK, response =
		pcall(function()
			return HttpService:RequestAsync({
				Url = url,
				Method = method,
				Headers = headers,
				Body = encodedBody,
			})
		end)

	if not requestOK then
		return false, {
			code = "REQUEST_FAILED",
			message = tostring(response),
		}
	end

	if response.StatusCode == 401 then
		return false, {
			code = "UNAUTHORIZED",
			message = "HTTP 401 Unauthorized.",
		}
	end

	if response.StatusCode == 403 then
		return false, {
			code = "FORBIDDEN",
			message = "HTTP 403 Forbidden.",
		}
	end

	if not response.Success then
		return false, {
			code =
				"HTTP_"
				.. tostring(response.StatusCode),
			message =
				tostring(response.Body),
		}
	end

	if response.Body == nil
		or response.Body == ""
	then
		return true, {}
	end

	local decodeOK, decoded =
		pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(
				response.Body
			)
		end)

	if not decodeOK then
		return false, {
			code = "INVALID_JSON",
			message =
				"Backend returned non-JSON data.",
		}
	end

	return true, decoded
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PERMISSION TEST: HTTP BACKEND
------------------------------------------------------------

local function testBackendHTTP(): boolean
	addLog(
		"Testing HTTP access to backend...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
			"GET",
			CONFIG.HEALTH_ENDPOINT,
			nil
		)

	if not ok then
		permissions.httpBackend = false

		addLog(
			"✗ Backend HTTP permission/access failed: "
				.. tostring(
					data
					and data.message
					or "Unknown error"
				),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return false
	end

	permissions.httpBackend = true

	addLog(
		"✓ Backend HTTP access is working.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PERMISSION TEST: LOCAL BRIDGE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function testLocalBridgeHTTP(): boolean
	if CONFIG.LOCAL_BRIDGE_URL == "" then
		permissions.httpLocalBridge = false

		addLog(
			"Local Bridge disabled in configuration.",
			COLORS.MUTED
		)

		return false
	end

	addLog(
		"Testing localhost bridge...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.LOCAL_BRIDGE_URL,
			"GET",
			"/health",
			nil
		)

	if not ok then
		permissions.httpLocalBridge = false

		addLog(
			"Local Bridge unavailable.",
			COLORS.MUTED
		)

		return false
	end

	permissions.httpLocalBridge = true

	addLog(
		"✓ Local Bridge HTTP access is working.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PERMISSION TEST: SCRIPT EDITOR READ
------------------------------------------------------------

local function testScriptEditorRead(): boolean
	addLog(
		"Testing ScriptEditorService read access...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local temporaryScript: ModuleScript? = nil

	local success, err =
		pcall(function()
			local folder =
			Instance.new("Folder")

			folder.Name =
			CONFIG.PERMISSION_TEST_FOLDER

			folder.Parent =
			game:GetService("ServerStorage")

			local module =
			Instance.new("ModuleScript")

			module.Name =
			CONFIG.PERMISSION_TEST_SCRIPT

			module.Source =
			"return true"

			module.Parent =
			folder

			temporaryScript =
			module

			local result =
			ScriptEditorService:GetEditorSource(
				module
			)

			if typeof(result) ~= "string" then
				error(
					"GetEditorSource returned invalid value."
				)
			end
		end)

	if temporaryScript then
		temporaryScript.Parent = nil
		temporaryScript:Destroy()
	end

	local testFolder =
		game:GetService("ServerStorage")
		:FindFirstChild(
			CONFIG.PERMISSION_TEST_FOLDER
		)

	if testFolder then
		testFolder:Destroy()
	end

	if not success then
		permissions.scriptEditorRead = false

		addLog(
			"✗ ScriptEditorService read permission failed: "
				.. tostring(err),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return false
	end

	permissions.scriptEditorRead = true

	addLog(
		"✓ ScriptEditorService read access works.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PERMISSION TEST: SCRIPT EDITOR WRITE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function testScriptEditorWrite(): boolean
	addLog(
		"Testing Script Injection / ScriptEditor write access...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local folder: Folder? = nil
	local module: ModuleScript? = nil

	local success, err =
		pcall(function()
			folder =
			Instance.new("Folder")

			folder.Name =
			CONFIG.PERMISSION_TEST_FOLDER

			folder.Parent =
			game:GetService("ServerStorage")

			module =
			Instance.new("ModuleScript")

			module.Name =
			CONFIG.PERMISSION_TEST_SCRIPT

			module.Source =
			"return 1"

			module.Parent =
			folder

			local successUpdate =
			pcall(function()
				ScriptEditorService:UpdateSourceAsync(
					module :: ModuleScript,
					function()
						return "return 2"
					end
				)
			end)

			if not successUpdate then
				error(
					"ScriptEditorService:UpdateSourceAsync was rejected."
				)
			end
		end)

	if folder then
		folder:Destroy()
	end

	if not success then

------------------------------------------------------------

local function autoConnect(): boolean
	if destroyed or busy then
		return false
	end

	busy = true

	setStatus(
		"Connecting...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	addLog(
		"Starting automatic Studio connection...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
			"POST",
			CONFIG.AUTO_CONNECT_ENDPOINT,
			{
				placeId =
				game.PlaceId,

				universeId =
				game.GameId,

				placeName =
				game.Name,

				pluginVersion =
				CONFIG.VERSION,
			}
		)

	if not ok then
		setStatus(
			"Backend Connection Error",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			"Auto-connect failed: "
				.. tostring(
					data
					and data.message
					or "Unknown"
				),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		busy = false
		return false
	end

	if not data
		or data.success ~= true
	then
		setStatus(
			"Auto-connect Rejected",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			"Backend rejected this Studio session.",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		busy = false
		return false
	end

	session.token =
		tostring(
			data.token
			or ""
		)

	session.sessionId =
		tostring(
			data.sessionId
			or ""
		)

	session.projectId =
		tostring(
			data.projectId
			or ""
		)

	session.projectName =
		tostring(
			data.projectName
			or game.Name
		)

	session.pendingChanges =
		typeof(data.pendingChangesCount)
		== "number"
		and data.pendingChangesCount
		or 0

	session.connected = true
	session.lastHeartbeat = os.clock()

	setStatus(
		"Connected",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	addLog(
		"✓ Studio connected automatically.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	addLog(
		"Project: "
			.. session.projectName,
		COLORS.TEXT
	)

	addLog(
		"Place ID: "
			.. tostring(game.PlaceId),
		COLORS.MUTED
	)

	updateUI()

	busy = false

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- HEARTBEAT
------------------------------------------------------------

local function startHeartbeat()
	if heartbeatRunning then
		return
	end

	heartbeatRunning = true

	task.spawn(function()
		while not destroyed
			and session.token ~= ""
		do
			task.wait(
				CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL
			)

			if destroyed then
				break
			end

			local ok, data =
				request(
					CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
					"POST",
					CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_ENDPOINT,
					{
						placeId =
						game.PlaceId,

						universeId =
						game.GameId,

						placeName =
						game.Name,

						pluginVersion =
						CONFIG.VERSION,
					}
				)

			if ok then
				session.connected = true
				session.lastHeartbeat = os.clock()

				if data
					and typeof(
						data.pendingChangesCount
					) == "number"
				then
					session.pendingChanges =
						data.pendingChangesCount
				end

				setStatus(
					"Connected",
					COLORS.GREEN
				)

				updateUI()
			elseif data
				and data.code == "UNAUTHORIZED"
			then
				session.token = ""
				session.connected = false

				setStatus(
					"Session Expired",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				addLog(
					"Session expired. Reconnecting...",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				break
			else
				session.connected = false

				setStatus(
					"Offline",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				addLog(
					"Heartbeat failed.",
					COLORS.RED
				)
			end
		end

		heartbeatRunning = false
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- RECONNECT
------------------------------------------------------------

local function startReconnectLoop()
	if reconnectRunning then
		return
	end

	reconnectRunning = true

	task.spawn(function()
		while not destroyed do
			task.wait(
				CONFIG.RECONNECT_INTERVAL
			)

			if destroyed then
				break
			end

			if not session.connected then
				local success =
					autoConnect()

				if success then
					startHeartbeat()
				end
			end
		end

		reconnectRunning = false
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PATH RESOLUTION
------------------------------------------------------------

local function cleanScriptName(
	name: string
): string
	return name
		:gsub("%.server%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.client%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.plugin%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.lua$", "")
end

local function resolvePath(
	path: string
): Instance?
	local normalized =
		path:gsub("^/", "")

	local parts =
		string.split(
			normalized,
			"/"
		)

	local current: Instance = game

	for index, part in ipairs(parts) do
		if index == 1
			and part == "game"
		then
			continue
		end

		local name =
			cleanScriptName(part)

		local child =
			current:FindFirstChild(name)

		if not child then
			return nil
		end

		current = child
	end

	return current
end

local function resolveParent(
	path: string
): (Instance?, string)
	local normalized =
		path:gsub("^/", "")

	local parts =
		string.split(
			normalized,
			"/"
		)

	if #parts == 0 then
		return nil, ""
	end

	local name =
		cleanScriptName(
			parts[#parts]
		)

	local current: Instance = game

	for index = 1, #parts - 1 do
		local part = parts[index]

		if index == 1
			and part == "game"
		then
			continue
		end

		local child =
			current:FindFirstChild(
				cleanScriptName(part)
			)

		if not child then
			return nil, name
		end

		current = child
	end

	return current, name
end

local function readScriptSource(
	scriptInstance: LuaSourceContainer
): (boolean, string?)
	local ok, source =
		pcall(function()
			return ScriptEditorService:GetEditorSource(
				scriptInstance
			)
		end)

	if not ok then
		return false, tostring(source)
	end

	return true, source
end

local function writeScriptSource(
	scriptInstance: LuaSourceContainer,
	source: string
): (boolean, string?)
	if not permissions.scriptEditorWrite then
		return false,
			"Script Injection / ScriptEditor write permission is not enabled."
	end

	local ok, err =
		pcall(function()
			ScriptEditorService:UpdateSourceAsync(
				scriptInstance,
				function()
					return source
				end
			)
		end)

	if not ok then
		return false, tostring(err)
	end

	return true, nil
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- APPLY SCRIPT
------------------------------------------------------------

local function applyScriptChange(
	change: Change
): (boolean, string?)
	local path =
		tostring(
			change.path
			or ""
		)

	local action =
		string.lower(
			tostring(
				change.operation
				or change.action
				or "update"
			)
		)

	local className =
		tostring(
			change.className
			or "Script"
		)

	local source =
		tostring(
			change.source
			or ""
		)

	local parent, name =
		resolveParent(path)

	if not parent then
		return false,
			"Parent not found: "
			.. path
	end

	local existing =
		parent:FindFirstChild(name)

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- DELETE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if action == "delete"
		or action == "deletefile"
	then
		if existing then
			existing:Destroy()
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- CLASS
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if className ~= "Script"
		and className ~= "LocalScript"
		and className ~= "ModuleScript"
	then
		return false,
			"Unsupported class: "
			.. className
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- CREATE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	local target:
		LuaSourceContainer

	if existing then
		if not existing:IsA(
			"LuaSourceContainer"
			) then
			return false,
				"Existing object is not a script."
		end

		if existing.ClassName
			~= className
		then
			return false,
				"Class mismatch."
		end

		target =
			existing :: LuaSourceContainer
	else
		local created =
			Instance.new(
				className
			)

		created.Name = name
		created.Parent = parent

		target =
			created :: LuaSourceContainer
	end

	ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint(
		"Squeeze Before Script Update"
	)

	local ok, err =
		writeScriptSource(
			target,
			source
		)

	if not ok then
		return false, err
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- VERIFY
	--------------------------------------------------------

	local readOK, actual =
		readScriptSource(target)

	if not readOK then
		return false,
			"Unable to read back script."
	end

	if actual ~= source then
		return false,
			"Script verification failed."
	end

	ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint(
		"Squeeze Script Updated"
	)

	return true, nil
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- INSTANCE OPERATION
------------------------------------------------------------

local function applyInstanceChange(
	change: Change
): (boolean, string?)
	if not permissions.instanceWrite then
		return false,
			"Studio Instance write permission is unavailable."
	end

	local operation =
		string.lower(
			tostring(
				change.operation
				or change.action
				or ""
			)
		)

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- CREATE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "createinstance" then
		local className =
			tostring(
				change.className
				or "Folder"
			)

		local name =
			tostring(
				change.name
				or ""
			)

		local parentPath =
			tostring(
				change.parentPath
				or "Workspace"
			)

		local parent =
			resolvePath(
				parentPath
			)

		if not parent then
			return false,
				"Parent not found: "
				.. parentPath
		end

		if name == "" then
			return false,
				"Instance name is required."
		end

		if parent:FindFirstChild(name) then
			return false,
				"Instance already exists: "
				.. parentPath
				.. "/"
				.. name
		end

		local ok, result =
			pcall(function()
				local instance =
				Instance.new(
					className
				)

				instance.Name =
				name

				if change.properties then
					for property, value in
						pairs(change.properties)
					do
						(instance :: any)[property] =
						value
					end
				end

				if change.attributes then
					for attribute, value in
						pairs(change.attributes)
					do
						instance:SetAttribute(
							attribute,
							value
						)
					end
				end

				instance.Parent =
				parent

				return instance
			end)

		if not ok then
			return false,
				tostring(result)
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- DELETE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "deleteinstance" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return true, nil
		end

		target:Destroy()

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- RENAME
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "renameinstance" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local newName =
			tostring(
				change.newName
				or change.name
				or ""
			)

		if newName == "" then
			return false,
				"New name is required."
		end

		target.Name =
			newName

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- MOVE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "moveinstance" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local parentPath =
			tostring(
				change.newParentPath
				or ""
			)

		local newParent =
			resolvePath(
				parentPath
			)

		if not newParent then
			return false,
				"New parent not found."
		end

		target.Parent =
			newParent

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- PROPERTY
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "setproperty" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local property =
			tostring(
				change.property
				or ""
			)

		if property == "" then
			return false,
				"Property is required."
		end

		local ok, err =
			pcall(function()
				(target :: any)[property] =
				change.value
			end)

		if not ok then
			return false,
				tostring(err)
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- ATTRIBUTE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "setattribute" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local attribute =
			tostring(
				change.attribute
				or ""
			)

		if attribute == "" then
			return false,
				"Attribute is required."
		end

		target:SetAttribute(
			attribute,
			change.value
		)

		return true, nil
	end

	return false,
		"Unsupported Studio operation: "
		.. operation
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- VERIFY INSTANCE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function verifyChange(
	change: Change
): (boolean, string?)
	local operation =
		string.lower(
			tostring(
				change.operation
				or change.action
				or ""
			)
		)

	if operation == "deleteinstance"
		or operation == "delete"
	then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		if resolvePath(path) == nil then
			return true, nil
		end

		return false,
			"Object still exists."
	end

	if operation == "createinstance" then
		local parentPath =
			tostring(
				change.parentPath
				or "Workspace"
			)

		local name =
			tostring(
				change.name
				or ""
			)

		local parent =
			resolvePath(
				parentPath
			)

		if not parent then
			return false,
				"Parent missing during verification."
		end

		local target =
			parent:FindFirstChild(name)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Created instance was not found."
		end

		if change.className
			and target.ClassName
			~= change.className
		then
			return false,
				"Class verification failed."
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	local path =
		tostring(
			change.path
			or ""
		)

	local target =
		resolvePath(path)

	if not target then
		return false,
			"Target not found during verification."
	end

	return true, nil
end

local function acknowledge(
	change: Change,
	success: boolean,
	errorMessage: string?
)
	local id =
		tostring(
			change.changeId
			or change.eventId
			or ""
		)

	request(
		CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
		"POST",
		CONFIG.ACK_ENDPOINT,
		{
			changeId = id,
			eventId =
				change.eventId
				or id,

			status =
				success
				and "applied"
				or "failed",

			verified =
				success,

			errorMessage =
				errorMessage,
		}
	)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- SYNC
------------------------------------------------------------

local function syncAll()
	if busy then
		return
	end

	if not session.connected
		or session.token == ""
	then
		addLog(
			"Studio is not connected. No changes were made.",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return
	end

	if not permissions.httpBackend then
		addLog(
			"Backend HTTP permission is not available.",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return
	end

	busy = true

	setStatus(
		"Syncing",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	syncButton.Text =
		"Syncing..."

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
			"GET",
			CONFIG.PULL_ENDPOINT,
			nil
		)

	if not ok then
		addLog(
			"Queue request failed: "
				.. tostring(
					data
					and data.message
					or "Unknown"
				),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		busy = false
		syncButton.Text =
			"Sync All"

		return
	end

	local changes =
		data
		and data.changes

	if typeof(changes) ~= "table" then
		changes = {}
	end

	pendingChanges =
		changes :: {Change}

	session.pendingChanges =
		#pendingChanges

	updateUI()

	if #pendingChanges == 0 then
		addLog(
			"✓ Nothing pending.",
			COLORS.GREEN
		)

		setStatus(
			"Connected",
			COLORS.GREEN
		)

		busy = false
		syncButton.Text =
			"Sync All"

		return
	end

	local total =
		#pendingChanges

	local applied = 0
	local failed = 0

	addLog(
		"Found "
			.. tostring(total)
			.. " pending change(s).",
		COLORS.TEXT
	)

	for index, change in ipairs(
		pendingChanges
		) do
		local operation =
			string.lower(
				tostring(
					change.operation
					or change.action
					or ""
				)
			)

		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or change.name
				or change.changeId
				or "Unknown"
			)

		addLog(
			string.format(
				"[%d/%d] %s",
				index,
				total,
				path
			),
			COLORS.MUTED
		)

		local success = false
		local errorMessage: string?

		if operation == "createinstance"
			or operation == "deleteinstance"
			or operation == "renameinstance"
			or operation == "moveinstance"
			or operation == "setproperty"
			or operation == "setattribute"
		then
			success, errorMessage =
				applyInstanceChange(
					change
				)
		else
			success, errorMessage =
				applyScriptChange(
					change
				)
		end

		if success then
			local verified,
				verifyError =
				verifyChange(
					change
				)

			if not verified then
				success = false
				errorMessage =
					verifyError
			end
		end

		acknowledge(
			change,
			success,
			errorMessage
		)

		if success then
			applied += 1

			addLog(
				"✓ Applied + verified: "
					.. path,
				COLORS.GREEN
			)
		else
			failed += 1

			addLog(
				"✗ Failed: "
					.. path
					.. " | "
					.. tostring(
						errorMessage
					),
				COLORS.RED
			)
		end
	end

	session.pendingChanges =
		math.max(
			0,
			total - applied
		)

	session.lastSync =
		os.clock()

	if failed == 0 then
		setStatus(
			"Connected",
			COLORS.GREEN
		)

		addLog(
			string.format(
				"✓ Sync completed: %d/%d verified.",
				applied,
				total
			),
			COLORS.GREEN
		)
	else
		setStatus(
			"Sync Error",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			string.format(
				"⚠ %d/%d applied. %d failed.",
				applied,
				total,
				failed
			),
			COLORS.YELLOW
		)
	end

	updateUI()

	syncButton.Text =
		"Sync All"

	busy = false
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- BUTTONS
------------------------------------------------------------

toolbarButton.Click:Connect(function()
	widget.Enabled =
		not widget.Enabled
end)

permissionsButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	task.spawn(function()
		checkAllPermissions()
	end)
end)

syncButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	task.spawn(function()
		syncAll()
	end)
end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- STARTUP
------------------------------------------------------------

addLog(
	"Squeeze Studio Plugin initialized.",
	COLORS.TEXT
)

addLog(
	"Running permission diagnostics...",
	COLORS.BLUE
)

updateUI()

task.spawn(function()
	task.wait(0.5)

	checkAllPermissions()

	if permissions.httpBackend then
		local connected =
			autoConnect()

		if connected then
			startHeartbeat()
		end
	end
end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- AUTO RECONNECT
------------------------------------------------------------

startReconnectLoop()

------------------------------------------------------------
-- UNLOAD
------------------------------------------------------------

plugin.Unloading:Connect(function()
	destroyed = true

	if session.token ~= "" then
		pcall(function()
			request(
				CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
				"POST",
				CONFIG.DISCONNECT_ENDPOINT,
				{
					reason = "Plugin unloaded",
				}
			)
		end)
	end

	session.token = ""
	session.connected = false
end)

print(
	"[Squeeze Studio] v"
		.. CONFIG.VERSION
		.. " loaded."
)
