--!strict
-- LeaderboardEngine.lua
-- Seasonal leaderboards with snapshots, ranks, and rewards

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local MessagingService = game:GetService("MessagingService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LeaderboardEngine = {}
LeaderboardEngine.__index = LeaderboardEngine

-- DataStores
local SEASON_STORE = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("SeasonLeaderboards")
local SNAPSHOT_STORE = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("SeasonSnapshots")
local REWARDS_STORE = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("SeasonRewards")

-- Messaging
local TOPICS = {
	SeasonReset = "Leaderboard_SeasonReset",
	RewardClaimed = "Leaderboard_RewardClaimed",
	ScoreUpdate = "Leaderboard_ScoreUpdate",
}

-- ============================================
-- SEASON CONFIGURATION
-- ============================================

export type SeasonConfig = {
	id: string,
	name: string,
	type: "weekly" | "monthly",
	startTime: number,
	endTime: number,
	categories: {SeasonCategory},
	rewards: {[string]: SeasonRewards}, -- tier -> rewards
}

export type SeasonCategory = {
	id: string,
	name: string,
	metric: string, -- DataStore key for scoring
	weight: number, -- for tiebreaking
}

export type SeasonRewards = {
	-- tier: "top1" | "top3" | "top10" | "top25" | "top50" | "participation"
	gems: number,
	title: string?,
	titleDuration: number?, -- seconds
	petId: string?,
	auraId: string?,
	trailId: string?,
	badgeId: string?,
	cosmeticCrate: string?,
}

-- Default season configuration
local DEFAULT_CATEGORIES: {SeasonCategory} = {
	{id = "clicks", name = "Click Master", metric = "total_clicks", weight = 1.0},
	{id = "hatches", name = "Hatch Champion", metric = "eggs_hatched", weight = 1.0},
	{id = "gold", name = "Gold Tycoon", metric = "gold_earned", weight = 1.0},
	{id = "collection", name = "Pet Collector", metric = "unique_pets", weight = 1.0},
	{id = "combat", name = "Combat Veteran", metric = "enemies_defeated", weight = 1.0},
	{id = "trading", name = "Trade Baron", metric = "trade_volume", weight = 1.0},
}

local WEEKLY_REWARDS = {
	top1 = {gems = 50000, title = "Weekly Champion", titleDuration = 604800, petId = "golden_egg", auraId = "golden_glow"},
	top3 = {gems = 20000, title = "Silver Contender", titleDuration = 604800, petId = "silver_egg"},
	top10 = {gems = 10000, title = "Bronze Challenger", titleDuration = 604800},
	top25 = {gems = 5000},
	top50 = {gems = 2000},
	participation = {gems = 500},
}

local MONTHLY_REWARDS = {
	top1 = {gems = 200000, title = "Monthly Legend", titleDuration = 2592000, petId = "legendary_exclusive", auraId = "legendary_aura", trailId = "cosmic_trail"},
	top3 = {gems = 100000, title = "Monthly Elite", titleDuration = 2592000, petId = "epic_exclusive", trailId = "elite_trail"},
	top10 = {gems = 50000, title = "Monthly Rising Star", titleDuration = 2592000, petId = "rare_exclusive"},
	top25 = {gems = 20000, cosmeticCrate = "monthly_elite_crate"},
	top50 = {gems = 10000},
	participation = {gems = 5000},
}

-- Active season state
local currentSeason: {config: any, active: boolean} = {active = false}
local categoryScores = {} -- [categoryId][playerId] = score

-- ============================================
-- SEASON MANAGEMENT
-- ============================================

function LeaderboardEngine.GetCurrentSeason(): {config: any, active: boolean}?
	return currentSeason.active and currentSeason or nil
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetTimeRemaining(): number
	if not currentSeason.active then return 0 end
	return math.max(0, currentSeason.config.endTime - os.time())
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetSeasonProgress(): number
	if not currentSeason.active then return 0 end
	local elapsed = os.time() - currentSeason.config.startTime
	local total = currentSeason.config.endTime - currentSeason.config.startTime
	return math.clamp(elapsed / total, 0, 1)
end

function LeaderboardEngine.StartSeason(config: {type: string, categories: {SeasonCategory}?, rewards: any?})
	local now = os.time()
	local duration = config.type == "monthly" and 2592000 or 604800
	
	local seasonConfig = {
		id = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
		name = config.type .. "_season_" .. os.date("%Y_%m_%d", now),
		type = config.type,
		startTime = now,
		endTime = now + duration,
		categories = config.categories or DEFAULT_CATEGORIES,
		rewards = config.rewards or (config.type == "monthly" and MONTHLY_REWARDS or WEEKLY_REWARDS),
	}
	
	currentSeason = {config = seasonConfig, active = true}
	categoryScores = {}
	
	-- Initialize category scores
	for _, cat in seasonConfig.categories do
		categoryScores[cat.id] = {}
	end
	
	-- Schedule reset
	task.delay(duration, function()
		LeaderboardEngine.ResetSeason()
	end)
	
	-- Broadcast season start
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync("Leaderboard_SeasonStart", {
			seasonId = seasonConfig.id,
			type = seasonConfig.type,
			endTime = seasonConfig.endTime,
			categories = seasonConfig.categories,
		})
	end
	
	return seasonConfig
end

function LeaderboardEngine.ResetSeason()
	if not currentSeason.active then return end
	
	local seasonId = currentSeason.config.id
	
	-- Snapshot all category scores
	for catId, scores in categoryScores do
		local snapshotKey = "Snapshot_" .. seasonId .. "_" .. catId
		local data = {}
		
		-- Convert to array of {playerId, score}
		local entries = {}
		for playerId, score in scores do
			table.insert(entries, {playerId = playerId, score = score})
		end
		
		-- Sort by score descending
		table.sort(entries, function(a, b) return a.score > b.score end)
		
		-- Store top 10000
		local topEntries = {}
		for i = 1, math.min(10000, #entries) do
			table.insert(topEntries, entries[i])
		end
		
		-- Save snapshot
		local success = pcall(function()
			SNAPSHOT_STORE:SetAsync(snapshotKey, topEntries)
		end)
		
		if not success then
			warn("LeaderboardEngine: Failed to save snapshot for " .. catId)
		end
	end
	
	-- Calculate and queue rewards
	LeaderboardEngine._QueueRewards(seasonId)
	
	-- Broadcast reset
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync("Leaderboard_SeasonReset", {
			seasonId = seasonId,
			timestamp = os.time(),
		})
	end
	
	-- Clear scores
	categoryScores = {}
	currentSeason.active = false
end

function LeaderboardEngine._QueueRewards(seasonId: string)
	local config = currentSeason.config
	if not config then return end
	
	for catId, _ in categoryScores do
		local snapshotKey = "Snapshot_" .. seasonId .. "_" .. catId
		local success, snapshot = pcall(function()
			return SNAPSHOT_STORE:GetAsync(snapshotKey)
		end)
		
		if not success or not snapshot then continue end
		
		-- Determine tier cutoffs
		local total = #snapshot
		local cutoffs = {
			top1 = math.ceil(total * 0.01),
			top3 = math.ceil(total * 0.03),
			top10 = math.ceil(total * 0.10),
			top25 = math.ceil(total * 0.25),
			top50 = math.ceil(total * 0.50),
		}
		
		for rank, entry in ipairs(snapshot) do
			local tier = "participation"
			if rank <= cutoffs.top1 then tier = "top1"
			elseif rank <= cutoffs.top3 then tier = "top3"
			elseif rank <= cutoffs.top10 then tier = "top10"
			elseif rank <= cutoffs.top25 then tier = "top25"
			elseif rank <= cutoffs.top50 then tier = "top50"
			end
			
			local rewards = config.rewards[tier] or config.rewards.participation
			
			-- Queue reward for player
			local rewardKey = "Reward_" .. seasonId .. "_" .. entry.playerId
			local rewardData = {
				seasonId = seasonId,
				category = catId,
				rank = rank,
				tier = tier,
				rewards = rewards,
				claimed = false,
				timestamp = os.time(),
			}
			
			pcall(function()
				REWARDS_STORE:UpdateAsync(rewardKey, function(old)
					if old then return old end -- Don't overwrite
					return rewardData
				end)
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- ============================================
-- SCORING
-- ============================================

function LeaderboardEngine.AddScore(playerId: number, metric: string, amount: number)
	if not currentSeason.active then return end
	
	-- Find category for this metric
	local categoryId = nil
	for _, cat in currentSeason.config.categories do
		if cat.metric == metric then
			categoryId = cat.id
			break
		end
	end
	
	if not categoryId then return end
	
	if not categoryScores[categoryId] then
		categoryScores[categoryId] = {}
	end
	
	categoryScores[categoryId][playerId] = (categoryScores[categoryId][playerId] or 0) + amount
	
	-- Broadcast update (throttled)
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.ScoreUpdate, {
			playerId = playerId,
			category = categoryId,
			newScore = categoryScores[categoryId][playerId],
			delta = amount,
		})
	end
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetScore(playerId: number, categoryId: string): number
	return categoryScores[categoryId] and categoryScores[categoryId][playerId] or 0
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetAllScores(categoryId: string): {playerId: number}
	return categoryScores[categoryId] or {}
end

-- ============================================
-- LEADERBOARD QUERIES
-- ============================================

function LeaderboardEngine.GetLeaderboard(categoryId: string, limit: number?): {{rank: number, playerId: number, score: number}}
	local scores = categoryScores[categoryId] or {}
	local limit = limit or 100
	
	local entries = {}
	for playerId, score in scores do
		table.insert(entries, {playerId = playerId, score = score})
	end
	
	table.sort(entries, function(a, b)
		if a.score ~= b.score then return a.score > b.score end
		return a.playerId < b.playerId
	end)
	
	local results = {}
	for i = 1, math.min(limit, #entries) do
		table.insert(results, {rank = i, playerId = entries[i].playerId, score = entries[i].score})
	end
	
	return results
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetPlayerRank(playerId: number, categoryId: string): number?
	local leaderboard = LeaderboardEngine.GetLeaderboard(categoryId, 10000)
	for _, entry in leaderboard do
		if entry.playerId == playerId then
			return entry.rank
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetPlayerSnapshot(playerId: number): {category: string, rank: number, score: number}
	local result = {}
	for catId, _ in categoryScores do
		local rank = LeaderboardEngine.GetPlayerRank(playerId, catId)
		if rank then
			table.insert(result, {
				category = catId,
				rank = rank,
				score = categoryScores[catId][playerId] or 0,
			})
		end
	end
	return result
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetSeasonSnapshot(seasonId: string, categoryId: string): {{playerId: number, score: number}}
	local snapshotKey = "Snapshot_" .. seasonId .. "_" .. categoryId
	local success, data = pcall(function()
		return SNAPSHOT_STORE:GetAsync(snapshotKey)
	end)
	return success and data or {}
end

-- ============================================
-- REWARDS
-- ============================================

function LeaderboardEngine.GetPendingRewards(playerId: number): {{seasonId: string, category: string, rank: number, tier: string, rewards: any, claimed: boolean}}
	local results = {}
	
	-- Scan recent seasons (last 5)
	for i = 0, 4 do
		local seasonTime = os.time() - i * 604800 -- approximate
		-- In production, would track season IDs properly
	end
	
	-- For now, scan all reward keys for this player
	-- In production, maintain an index
	return results
end

function LeaderboardEngine.ClaimReward(playerId: number, seasonId: string, categoryId: string): (boolean, any?)
	local rewardKey = "Reward_" .. seasonId .. "_" .. playerId
	local success, rewardData = pcall(function()
		return REWARDS_STORE:UpdateAsync(rewardKey, function(old)
			if not old or old.claimed then return old end
			old.claimed = true
			return old
		end)
	end
	
	if success and rewardData and not rewardData.claimed then
		return true, rewardData.rewards
	end
	return false, nil
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetSeasonHistory(limit: number?): {{seasonId: string, type: string, startTime: number, endTime: number}}
	-- Would query snapshot store for season history
	return {}
end

-- ============================================
-- ANTI-CHEAT
-- ============================================

local scoreHistory = {} -- [playerId][category] = {timestamp, delta}

function LeaderboardEngine.ValidateScoreDelta(playerId: number, categoryId: string, delta: number): boolean
	if delta <= 0 then return false end
	if delta > 10000 then return false end -- Sanity cap
	
	local history = scoreHistory[playerId] and scoreHistory[playerId][categoryId] or {}
	table.insert(history, {time = os.time(), delta = delta})
	
	-- Keep last 100 entries
	if #history > 100 then table.remove(history, 1) end
	
	if not scoreHistory[playerId] then scoreHistory[playerId] = {} end
	scoreHistory[playerId][categoryId] = history
	
	-- Check rate: max 1000 per minute
	local recent = 0
	local now = os.time()
	for _, entry in history do
		if now - entry.time < 60 then
			recent += entry.delta
		end
	end
	
	if recent > 10000 then
		-- Flag for review
		if RunService:IsServer() then
			MessagingService:PublishAsync("Leaderboard_CheatFlag", {
				playerId = playerId,
				category = categoryId,
				recentScore = recent,
				reason = "Excessive score rate",
			})
		end
		return false
	end
	
	-- Statistical outlier detection (simplified)
	if #history > 20 then
		local sum = 0
		for _, e in history do sum += e.delta end
		local avg = sum / #history
		local variance = 0
		for _, e in history do variance += (e.delta - avg)^2 end
		local stdDev = math.sqrt(variance / #history)
		
		if delta > avg + 4 * stdDev then
			-- Flag as outlier
			if RunService:IsServer() then
				MessagingService:PublishAsync("Leaderboard_CheatFlag", {
					playerId = playerId,
					category = categoryId,
					delta = delta,
					avg = avg,
					stdDev = stdDev,
					reason = "Statistical outlier",
				})
			end
		end
	end
	
	return true
end

-- ============================================
-- INITIALIZATION
-- ============================================

if RunService:IsServer() then
	-- Auto-start weekly season on Mondays
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			local now = os.time()
			local nextMonday = now + ((1 - os.date("*t", now).wday) % 7) * 86400
			if nextMonday <= now then nextMonday += 604800 end
			local waitTime = nextMonday - now
			
			task.wait(waitTime)
			LeaderboardEngine.StartSeason({type = "weekly"})
			
			-- Monthly on 1st
			task.wait(2592000 - 604800) -- ~3 weeks
			LeaderboardEngine.StartSeason({type = "monthly"})
		end
	end)
end

return LeaderboardEngine

--!strict
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CONFIG = {
	BaseSpeed = 16,
	SprintSpeed = 26,
	MaxStamina = 100,
	DrainRate = 25,
	RegenRate = 15,
	RegenDelay = 1.5,
}

export type StaminaState = {
	IsSprinting: boolean,
	CurrentStamina: number,
	LastDrained: number,
}

local StaminaSystem = {}
StaminaSystem.__index = StaminaSystem

function StaminaSystem.new(humanoid: Humanoid)
	local self = setmetatable({} :: StaminaState, StaminaSystem)
	self.IsSprinting = false
	self.CurrentStamina = CONFIG.MaxStamina
	self.LastDrained = 0

	local connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
		updateStamina(self, humanoid, dt)
	end)

	return self
end

function updateStamina(state: StaminaState, humanoid: Humanoid, dt: number)
	local isMoving = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0
	local isSprinting = state.IsSprinting and isMoving

	if isSprinting and state.CurrentStamina > 0 then
		state.CurrentStamina = math.max(0, state.CurrentStamina - (CONFIG.DrainRate * dt))
		state.LastDrained = tick()
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.SprintSpeed
	else
		if tick() - state.LastDrained > CONFIG.RegenDelay then
			state.CurrentStamina = math.min(CONFIG.MaxStamina, state.CurrentStamina + (CONFIG.RegenRate * dt))
		end
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.BaseSpeed
		if state.CurrentStamina <= 0 then
			state.IsSprinting = false
		end
	end
end

function StaminaSystem:HandleInput(input: InputObject, gameProcessed: boolean)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
		self.IsSprinting = (input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin)
	end
end

-- Example usage within a LocalScript:
-- local stamina = StaminaSystem.new(humanoid)
-- UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp) stamina:HandleInput(input, gp) end)
-- UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input, gp) stamina:HandleInput(input, gp) end)

return StaminaSystem

--// Players Handler
-- View player data, modify stats, kick, manage pets/gamepasses.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PlayersHandler = {}

function PlayersHandler.FindPlayer(Name)
	if type(Name) ~= "string" then return nil end
	Name = string.lower(Name)
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if string.lower(Player.Name) == Name or string.lower(Player.DisplayName) == Name then
			return Player
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function PlayersHandler.ListPlayers()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local Data = Player:FindFirstChild("Data")
		local PD = Data and Data:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Player.Name,
			displayName = Player.DisplayName,
			userId = Player.UserId,
			accountAge = Player.AccountAge,
			petCount = Data and Data:FindFirstChild("Pets") and #Data.Pets:GetChildren() or 0,
			currency = PD and PD.Currency.Value or 0,
			gems = PD and PD.Currency2.Value or 0,
			rebirths = PD and PD.Rebirth.Value or 0,
			zone = PD and PD.BestZone.Value or 0,
			eggsHatched = PD and PD.EggsHatched.Value or 0,
			totalCurrency = PD and PD.TotalCurrency.Value or 0,
			loaded = Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or false,
			isTrading = (function()
				local NSV = Data and Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues")
				return NSV and NSV:FindFirstChild("IsTrading") and NSV.IsTrading.Value or false
			end)(),
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
	return Result
end

function PlayersHandler.GetPlayerData(Player)
	if not Player or not Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then return nil end
	local Data = Player.Data
	local PD = Data.PlayerData
	local GP = Data.Gamepasses

	local Gamepasses = {}
	for _, Value in GP:GetChildren() do
		if Value:IsA("BoolValue") then
			Gamepasses[Value.Name] = Value.Value
		end
	end

	local Pets = {}
	for _, Pet in Data.Pets:GetChildren() do
		Pets[#Pets + 1] = {
			id = Pet.Name,
			name = Pet.PetName.Value,
			equipped = Pet.Equipped.Value,
		}
	end

	local AutoDelete = {}
	for _, AD in Data.AutoDelete:GetChildren() do
		if AD:IsA("BoolValue") then
			AutoDelete[AD.Name] = AD.Value
		end
	end

	local GemShop = {}
	local GemShopFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GemShop")
	if GemShopFolder then
		for _, Upgrade in GemShopFolder:GetChildren() do
			local Reward = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Reward")
			local Price = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Price")
			local MaxVal = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Max")
			local CurrentLevel = PD:FindFirstChild("GemUpgrade" .. Upgrade.Name)
			GemShop[#GemShop + 1] = {
				id = Upgrade.Name,
				name = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("UpgradeName") and Reward.UpgradeName.Value or ("Upgrade " .. Upgrade.Name),
				level = CurrentLevel and CurrentLevel.Value or 0,
				max = MaxVal and MaxVal.Value or 0,
			}
		end
	end

	return {
		name = Player.Name,
		displayName = Player.DisplayName,
		userId = Player.UserId,
		accountAge = Player.AccountAge,
		loaded = Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or false,
		isTrading = (function() local V = Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues") and Data.NonSaveValues:FindFirstChild("IsTrading"); return V and V.Value or false end)(),
		isOpeningEgg = (function() local V = Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues") and Data.NonSaveValues:FindFirstChild("IsOpeningEgg"); return V and V.Value or false end)(),
		petsEquipped = (function() local V = Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues") and Data.NonSaveValues:FindFirstChild("PetsEquipped"); return V and V.Value or 0 end)(),

		currency = PD.Currency.Value,
		gems = PD.Currency2.Value,
		rebirths = PD.Rebirth.Value,
		zone = PD.BestZone.Value,
		eggsHatched = PD.EggsHatched.Value,
		totalCurrency = PD.TotalCurrency.Value,
		gemUpgrade1 = PD.GemUpgrade1.Value,
		gemUpgrade2 = PD.GemUpgrade2.Value,

		music = PD.Music.Value,
		showOtherPets = PD.ShowOtherPets.Value,

		gamepasses = Gamepasses,
		pets = Pets,
		petCount = #Pets,
		autoDelete = AutoDelete,
		gemShop = GemShop,

		maxStorage = 50
			+ (Gamepasses.MoreStorage1 and 50 or 0)
			+ (Gamepasses.MoreStorage2 and 250 or 0),
		maxEquipped = 5
			+ (Gamepasses.MorePets1 and 3 or 0)
			+ (Gamepasses.MorePets2 and 10 or 0),
	}
end

function PlayersHandler.SetValue(Value, NewValue)
	if Value:IsA("IntValue") or Value:IsA("NumberValue") then
		local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
		if Num == nil then return false end
		Value.Value = Num
		return true
	elseif Value:IsA("BoolValue") then
		Value.Value = (NewValue == true or NewValue == "true")
		return true
	elseif Value:IsA("StringValue") then
		Value.Value = tostring(NewValue)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function PlayersHandler.SetCurrency(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value = Num
	return true, "Set currency"
end

function PlayersHandler.GiveCurrency(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += Num
	Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += Num
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " currency"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetGems(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value = Num
	return true, "Set gems"
end

function PlayersHandler.GiveGems(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Num
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " gems"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetRebirths(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value = Num
	return true, "Set rebirths"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetZone(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.BestZone.Value = Num
	return true, "Set zone"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetGemUpgrade(Player, Slot, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local S = tonumber(Slot)
	local A = tonumber(Amount)
	if not S or not A then return false, "Invalid input" end
	local Value = Player.Data.PlayerData:FindFirstChild("GemUpgrade" .. S)
	if not Value then return false, "Upgrade not found" end
	Value.Value = A
	return true, "Set gem upgrade " .. S
end

function PlayersHandler.ToggleGamepass(Player, Name, State)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Value = Player.Data.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(tostring(Name))
	if not Value then return false, "Gamepass not found" end
	Value.Value = (State == true or State == "true")
	return true, "Set " .. Name .. " = " .. tostring(Value.Value)
end

function PlayersHandler.KickPlayer(Player, Reason)
	if not Player then return false, "Player not found" end
	local R = tostring(Reason or "Kicked by admin")
	if R == "" then R = "Kicked by admin" end
	Player:Kick(R)
	return true, "Kicked " .. Player.Name
end

return PlayersHandler

--// Services
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

--// Modules
local Config = require(script.Config)
local Mail = require(script.Mail)
local Pets = require(script.Pets)
local Shards = require(script.Shards)

--// State
local Cooldowns = {} -- [userId] = last action time

--// Remotes
local RemoteFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes:FindFirstChild("AuctionHouse")
if not RemoteFolder then
	RemoteFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	RemoteFolder.Name = "AuctionHouse"
	RemoteFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes
end

local function CreateRemote(Name, ClassName)
	local Existing = RemoteFolder:FindFirstChild(Name)
	if Existing then return Existing end

	local NewRemote = Instance.new(ClassName)
	NewRemote.Name = Name
	NewRemote.Parent = RemoteFolder
	return NewRemote
end

local ListPetRemote = CreateRemote("ListPet", "RemoteFunction")
local CancelRemote = CreateRemote("CancelListing", "RemoteFunction")
local BuyRemote = CreateRemote("BuyPet", "RemoteFunction")
local GetListingsRemote = CreateRemote("GetListings", "RemoteFunction")
local GetMyListingsRemote = CreateRemote("GetMyListings", "RemoteFunction")
local GetMailRemote = CreateRemote("GetMail", "RemoteFunction")
local ClaimMailRemote = CreateRemote("ClaimMail", "RemoteFunction")
local AuctionNotice = CreateRemote("AuctionNotice", "RemoteEvent")

--// Pet Return
local function ReturnListing(Listing)
	local Owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Listing.owner)

	if Owner and Owner:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Owner.Loaded.Value then
		if Pets.Grant(Owner, Listing.petName) then
			AuctionNotice:FireClient(Owner, "petReturned", Listing.petName)
			return
		end
	end

	Mail.Update(Listing.owner, function(MailData)
		MailData.pets[Listing.petId] = { petName = Listing.petName }
		return MailData
	end)

	if Owner then
		AuctionNotice:FireClient(Owner, "petReturned", Listing.petName)
	end
end

--// Rate Limiting
local function CheckCooldown(Player)
	local Last = Cooldowns[Player.UserId] or 0
	local Now = os.clock()
	if Now - Last < Config.COOLDOWN then return false end
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = Now
	return true
end

--// Expiry Sweep
local function SweepExpired()
	local Now = os.time()
	local AnyRemoved = false

	for i = 1, Config.SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Expired = {}

		local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
			for Id, Listing in Old do
				if Listing.expiresAt <= Now and not Expired[Id] then
					Expired[Id] = Listing
				end
			end
			for Id in Expired do Old[Id] = nil end
			return Old
		end)

		if Success then
			for Id, Listing in Expired do
				Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
				ReturnListing(Listing)
				AnyRemoved = true
			end
		end
	end

	if AnyRemoved then
		AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")
	end
end

--// Remote Handlers
ListPetRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, PetId, Price)
	if type(PetId) ~= "number" or type(Price) ~= "number" then return "Invalid input" end
	if not Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player.Loaded.Value then return "Not loaded" end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return "In a trade" end
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	Price = math.floor(Price)
	if Price < 1 or Price > Config.MAX_PRICE then return "Invalid price" end

	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Pet = Folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetId))
	if not Pet then return "Pet not found" end
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then return "Unequip the pet first" end

	local Active = 0
	for _, Listing in Shards.GetAll() do
		if Listing.owner == Player.UserId then Active += 1 end
	end
	if Active >= Config.MAX_ACTIVE_LISTINGS then return "Max active listings" end

	local Listing = {
		id = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
		owner = Player.UserId,
		ownerName = Player.Name,
		petId = PetId,
		petName = Pet.PetName.Value,
		price = Price,
		listedAt = os.time(),
		expiresAt = os.time() + Config.LISTING_DURATION,
	}

	local Key = Shards.GetOwnerShard(Player.UserId)
	local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
		Old[Listing.id] = Listing
		return Old
	end)

	if not Success then return "Try again" end

	Pet:Destroy()
	Shards.AddToCache(Listing, Key)
	AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")
	return Listing.id
end

CancelRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, ListingId)
	if type(ListingId) ~= "string" then return "Invalid input" end
	if not Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player.Loaded.Value then return "Not loaded" end
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	local Listing = Shards.GetListing(ListingId)
	if not Listing then return "Not found" end
	if Listing.owner ~= Player.UserId then return "Not your listing" end

	local Key = Shards.GetShardOf(ListingId)
	local Removed = false

	local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
		if Old[ListingId] and not Removed then
			Old[ListingId] = nil
			Removed = true
		end
		return Old
	end)

	if not Success then return "Try again" end
	if not Removed then return "Already gone" end

	Shards.RemoveFromCache(ListingId)

	AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")

	if Pets.Grant(Player, Listing.petName) then
		return "Returned"
	else
		local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
		MailData.pets[Listing.petId] = { petName = Listing.petName }
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
		return "Mailed"
	end
end

BuyRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, ListingId)
	if type(ListingId) ~= "string" then return "Invalid input" end
	if not Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player.Loaded.Value then return "Not loaded" end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return "In a trade" end
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	local Listing = Shards.GetListing(ListingId)
	if not Listing then return "Not available" end
	if Listing.owner == Player.UserId then return "You own this listing" end

	if #Player.Data.Pets:GetChildren() >= Pets.GetMaxStorage(Player) then return "Inventory full" end
	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value < Listing.price then return "Not enough gems" end

	local Key = Shards.GetShardOf(ListingId)
	local Purchased = nil

	local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
		local Target = Old[ListingId]
		if not Target then return Old end
		if Target.owner == Player.UserId then return Old end
		Old[ListingId] = nil
		if Purchased == nil then Purchased = Target end
		return Old
	end)

	if not Success then return "Try again" end
	if not Purchased then return "Sold already" end

	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value < Purchased.price then
		ReturnListing(Purchased)
		return "Not enough gems"
	end

	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value -= Purchased.price

	if not Pets.Grant(Player, Purchased.petName) then
		local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
		MailData.pets[Purchased.id] = { petName = Purchased.petName }
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
	end

	Shards.RemoveFromCache(ListingId)

	AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")

	local Seller = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Purchased.owner)
	if Seller and Seller:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Seller.Loaded.Value then
		Seller.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Purchased.price
		AuctionNotice:FireClient(Seller, "sold", Purchased.price)
	else
		Mail.Update(Purchased.owner, function(MailData)
			MailData.gems = (MailData.gems or 0) + Purchased.price
			return MailData
		end)
	end

	return "Purchased"
end

GetListingsRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Page)
	Page = (type(Page) == "number" and math.max(1, math.floor(Page))) or 1
	local Now = os.time()
	local List = {}

	for _, Listing in Shards.GetAll() do
		if Listing.expiresAt > Now then
			List[#List + 1] = Listing
		end
	end

	table.sort(List, function(A, B)
		return A.expiresAt < B.expiresAt
	end)

	local Start = (Page - 1) * Config.PAGE_SIZE + 1
	local Result = {}
	for i = Start, math.min(Start + Config.PAGE_SIZE - 1, #List) do
		local L = List[i]
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			id = L.id,
			ownerId = L.owner,
			ownerName = L.ownerName,
			petName = L.petName,
			price = L.price,
			timeLeft = L.expiresAt - Now,
		}
	end

	return { listings = Result, total = #List }
end

GetMyListingsRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	local Now = os.time()
	local List = {}

	for _, Listing in Shards.GetAll() do
		if Listing.owner == Player.UserId then
			List[#List + 1] = {
				id = Listing.id,
				petName = Listing.petName,
				price = Listing.price,
				timeLeft = Listing.expiresAt - Now,
			}
		end
	end

	table.sort(List, function(A, B)
		return A.timeLeft < B.timeLeft
	end)

	return List
end

GetMailRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
	local PetsList = {}

	for Id, PetInfo in MailData.pets do
		PetsList[#PetsList + 1] = { id = Id, petName = PetInfo.petName }
	end

	return { gems = MailData.gems, pets = PetsList }
end

ClaimMailRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
	local GemsToGive = MailData.gems
	local PetsToReturn = {}
	for Id, PetInfo in MailData.pets do PetsToReturn[Id] = PetInfo end

	MailData.gems = 0
	MailData.pets = {}
	Mail.Save(Player.UserId)

	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += GemsToGive

	local Granted = 0
	local Failed = {}
	for Id, PetInfo in PetsToReturn do
		if Pets.Grant(Player, PetInfo.petName) then
			Granted += 1
		else
			Failed[Id] = PetInfo
		end
	end

	if next(Failed) then
		MailData.pets = Failed
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
	end

	return { gems = GemsToGive, granted = Granted, failed = 0 }
end

--// Join / Leave
local function OnPlayerJoined(Player)
	repeat task.wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil
	if Player.Parent == nil then return end

	local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)

	if MailData.gems > 0 then
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += MailData.gems
		MailData.gems = 0
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
		AuctionNotice:FireClient(Player, "sold", 0)
	end

	if next(MailData.pets) then
		local Failed = {}
		for Id, PetInfo in MailData.pets do
			if Pets.Grant(Player, PetInfo.petName) then
				-- granted
			else
				Failed[Id] = PetInfo
			end
		end
		MailData.pets = Failed
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
		if not next(Failed) then
			AuctionNotice:FireClient(Player, "petReturned", "pet")
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(OnPlayerJoined)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = nil
	Mail.Flush(Player.UserId)
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Mail.Flush(Player.UserId)
	end
end)

--// Startup
Shards.RebuildCache()
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(Config.SWEEP_INTERVAL)
		Shards.RebuildCache()
		SweepExpired()
	end
end)

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"]
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules

local Multipliers = require(Modules.Multipliers)
local PetMultipliers = require(Modules.PetMultipliers)

local Cooldowns = {}

--// Script

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false

	local PetFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	PetFolder.Name = Player.Name
	PetFolder.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets

	repeat wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil
	if Player.Parent == nil then return end

	LoadEquipped(Player)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.Name] = nil
	workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:Destroy()
end)

-- Clicker
Remotes.Clicker.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player)
	if GameSettings.GameType.Value ~= "Clicker" then return end

	if Cooldowns[Player.Name] == false then
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = true
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
		Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
		task.wait(0.08)
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false
	end
end)

-- Music
Remotes.Setting.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, SettingName, Toggled)
	Player.Data.PlayerData[SettingName].Value = Toggled
end)

-- Rebirth
function Rebirth(Player) -- this will run the action when you passed all requirements for rebirthing
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value = 0
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value += 1
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += 10 -- gems
end

Remotes.Rebirth.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player)
	if Cooldowns[Player.Name] == false then
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = true	
		if GameSettings.RebirthType.Value == "Linear" then
			if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value >= GameSettings.RebirthBasePrice.Value * (Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value + 1) then
				Rebirth(Player)
			end
		else
			if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value >= GameSettings.RebirthBasePrice.Value * (GameSettings.RebirthMultiplier.Value + 1.25) ^ Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value then
				Rebirth(Player)
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.08)
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false
	end
end)

-- Pet
function LoadEquipped(Player)
	local EquippedPets = PetMultipliers.Multipliers[Player.Name]

	for PetId, Value in EquippedPets do
		local PetModel = workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:FindFirstChild(PetId)

		if not PetModel then
			local PetInstance = Player.Data.Pets[PetId]
			local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value]:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = PetId
			NewPet:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", Player.UserId)
			NewPet:SetAttribute("PetName", PetInstance.PetName.Value)
			NewPet:SetAttribute("PetInteractionState", "Follow")

			for _, Part in NewPet:GetChildren() do
				if Part:IsA("BasePart") then
					Part.Anchored = true
				end
			end

			local Billboard = script.BillboardGui:Clone()
			Billboard.PetName.Text = PetInstance.PetName.Value
			Billboard.PetRarity.Text = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Rarity.Value
			Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, NewPet.MainPart.Size.Y, 0)
			Billboard.Parent = NewPet

			local character = Player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then NewPet:PivotTo(root.CFrame) end
			NewPet.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]
		end
	end

	for _,PlayerPet in workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:GetChildren() do
		if not EquippedPets[tonumber(PlayerPet.Name)] then
			PlayerPet:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

function EquipPet(Player, Pet)
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then return end -- Already equipped
	if Multipliers.GetMaxPetsEquipped(Player) <= Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value then return end -- Too many pets equipped
	Pet.Equipped.Value = true
	PetMultipliers.AddPet(Player.Name, Pet)
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

function UnequipPet(Player, Pet)
	if not Pet or not Pet:IsDescendantOf(Player.Data.Pets) then return end
	if not Pet.Equipped.Value then return end
	Pet.Equipped.Value = false
	PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

function UnequipAll(Player)
	local pets = Player:FindFirstChild("Data") and Player.Data:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	if not pets then return end
	for _, Pet in pets:GetChildren() do
		if Pet:IsA("Folder") or Pet:IsA("Configuration") then
			UnequipPet(Player, Pet)
		end
	end
	LoadEquipped(Player)
end

function EquipAction(Player, Pet) -- this is the action for equipping a pet
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then
		UnequipPet(Player, Pet)
	else
		EquipPet(Player, Pet)
	end
end

function DeleteAction(Player, Pet) -- this is the action for deleting a pet
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then UnequipPet(Player, Pet) end -- unequip if it's equipped
	Pet:Destroy()
end

Remotes.Pet.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, Action, Parameter)
	if Action == "UnequipAll" then
		UnequipAll(Player)
		return
	end
	if type(Parameter) ~= "table" then -- so if this condition is true, then Parameter should be the id of the pet
		local Pet = Player.Data.Pets[Parameter]

		if Action == "Equip" then
			EquipAction(Player, Pet)
		elseif Action == "Delete" then
			DeleteAction(Player, Pet)
		end

		LoadEquipped(Player)
	else -- there are multiple ids
		if Action == "Equip" then -- equip all pets
			for _,PetId in Parameter do
				local Pet = Player.Data.Pets[PetId]
				EquipAction(Player, Pet)
			end

		elseif Action == "Delete" then -- delete all pets
			for _,PetId in Parameter do
				local Pet = Player.Data.Pets[PetId]
				DeleteAction(Player, Pet)				
			end
		end

		LoadEquipped(Player)
	end
end)

-- Egg
function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end

function ChooseRandomPet(Egg, LuckMultiplier)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]
	local Pets, TotalWeight = {}, 0

	for _, Pet in EggInfo.Pets:GetChildren() do
		table.insert(Pets, {Pet.Name, Pet.Value})
	end

	table.sort(Pets, function(a,b)
		return a[2] > b[2]
	end)

	local BaseChance = Pets[1][2] -- this is the most common pet

	for _,v in Pets do
		local Chance = math.min(v[2] * LuckMultiplier, BaseChance) -- so if the easiest pet is 70%, all pets will go towards 70% 
		TotalWeight += Chance
		v[2] = Chance
	end

	local Chance = Random.new():NextNumber(0,TotalWeight)

	local Counter = 0
	for _,v in Pets do	
		Counter += v[2]

		if Counter >= Chance then
			return v[1]
		end
	end
end

Remotes.Egg.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Egg, Amount)
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value then return end -- cooldown
	if #Player.Data.Pets:GetChildren() + Amount > Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player) then return end -- max storage

	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg)

	if not EggInfo then print(Egg.." does not exist!") return end -- egg does not exist!
	if EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then return end -- robux egg

	if Amount == 3 and ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild("TripleEgg") and not Player.Data.Gamepasses.TripleEgg.Value then
		return -- if this is true, it means the player is trying to open a triple egg while there is a gamepass which they don't own
	end

	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value >= EggInfo.Cost.Value * Amount then
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value -= EggInfo.Cost.Value * Amount
		Player.Data.PlayerData.EggsHatched.Value += Amount
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = true

		coroutine.wrap(function()
			task.wait(3)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = false
		end)()

		local Results = {}

		local LuckMultiplier = Multipliers.GetLuckMultiplier(Player)

		for i = 1, Amount do
			local PetName = ChooseRandomPet(Egg, LuckMultiplier) 

			if not Player.Data.AutoDelete[PetName].Value then -- auto delete
				local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
				NewPet.Name = RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
				NewPet.PetName.Value = PetName
				NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets
			end

			Results[i] = PetName
		end

		return Results
	end
end

--// Auto Delete
Remotes.AutoDelete.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Pet)
	Player.Data.AutoDelete[Pet].Value = not Player.Data.AutoDelete[Pet].Value
	return Player.Data.AutoDelete[Pet].Value
end

--// Area
Remotes.Area.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player)
	if Cooldowns[Player.Name] == true then return end
	Cooldowns[Player.Name] = true

	coroutine.wrap(function()
		task.wait(0.08)
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false
	end)()

	local NextArea = ReplicatedStorage.Areas:FindFirstChild(Player.Data.PlayerData.BestZone.Value + 1)
	if not NextArea then return end


	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value < NextArea.Cost.Value then return end

	if NextArea.Cost.Value == -1 then return end -- max area

	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value -= NextArea.Cost.Value
	Player.Data.PlayerData.BestZone.Value = tonumber(NextArea.Name)
end)

--// Gemshop
Remotes.GemUpgrade.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, Upgrade)
	if not ReplicatedStorage.GemShop:FindFirstChild(Upgrade) then return end

	local GemUpg = ReplicatedStorage.GemShop[Upgrade]
	local UpgradeTier = Player.Data.PlayerData["GemUpgrade"..Upgrade]

	if UpgradeTier.Value >= GemUpg.Max.Value then return end -- max

	local Cost = GemUpg.Price
	local Price

	if Cost.Exponential.Value then
		Price = Cost.DefaultPrice.Value * Cost.IncreasePer.Value ^ UpgradeTier.Value
	else
		Price = Cost.DefaultPrice.Value + Cost.IncreasePer.Value * (UpgradeTier.Value+1)
	end

	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value >= Price then
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value -= Price
		UpgradeTier.Value += 1
	end
end)

--!strict
-- CameraEffects.lua
-- Camera shake, punch zoom, orbit, slow-motion effects

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local CameraEffects = {}
CameraEffects.__index = CameraEffects

local activeEffects = {}
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local connection = nil

-- Noise generator for shake
local function perlinNoise(x: number, y: number): number
	local n = bit32.bxor(bit32.lshift(x, 16), y)
	n = bit32.bxor(n, bit32.rshift(n, 13))
	n = (n * (n * n * 60493 + 19990303) + 1376312589) % 2147483648
	return (n / 2147483648) * 2 - 1
end

local function getNoise(t: number): Vector2
	return Vector2.new(perlinNoise(math.floor(t * 100), 0), perlinNoise(0, math.floor(t * 100)))
end

-- Start the update loop
local function ensureConnection()
	if connection then return end
	connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		if not camera then return end
		
		local totalOffset = Vector3.zero
		local totalFOVOffset = 0
		local timeScale = 1
		local now = os.clock()
		
		for _, effect in activeEffects do
			if now > effect.endTime then continue end
			
			local progress = (now - effect.startTime) / effect.duration
			local eased = 1 - (1 - progress) ^ 2 -- ease-out quad
			
			if effect.type == "shake" then
				local noise = getNoise(now * effect.frequency)
				local intensity = effect.intensity * (1 - eased)
				totalOffset += Vector3.new(noise.X, noise.Y, 0) * intensity
				
			elseif effect.type == "punch" then
				totalFOVOffset += effect.amount * (1 - eased)
				
			elseif effect.type == "slowmo" then
				timeScale = math.min(timeScale, effect.factor)
			end
		end
		
		-- Apply shake
		if totalOffset.Magnitude > 0.01 then
			camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(totalOffset)
		end
		
		-- Apply FOV punch
		if totalFOVOffset ~= 0 then
			camera.FieldOfView = camera.FieldOfView + totalFOVOffset
		end
		
		-- Clean up expired
		for i = #activeEffects, 1, -1 do
			if os.clock() > activeEffects[i].endTime then
				table.remove(activeEffects, i)
			end
		end
		
		if #activeEffects == 0 and connection then
			connection:Disconnect()
			connection = nil
		end
	end)
end

-- Presets
local PRESETS = {
	Micro = { intensity = 2, duration = 0.1, frequency = 60 },
	Light = { intensity = 4, duration = 0.2, frequency = 40 },
	Medium = { intensity = 8, duration = 0.4, frequency = 30 },
	Heavy = { intensity = 16, duration = 0.6, frequency = 20 },
	Massive = { intensity = 24, duration = 1.0, frequency = 15 },
}

-- Public API
function CameraEffects.Shake(presetName: string?, custom: {intensity: number, duration: number, frequency: number}?)
	local preset = PRESETS[presetName or "Light"]
	local params = custom or preset
	ensureConnection()
	table.insert(activeEffects, {
		type = "shake",
		startTime = os.clock(),
		duration = params.duration,
		intensity = params.intensity,
		frequency = params.frequency,
		endTime = os.clock() + params.duration,
	})
end

function CameraEffects.PunchZoom(amount: number, duration: number, easingStyle: Enum.EasingStyle?)
	ensureConnection()
	local startFOV = camera.FieldOfView
	local tween = TweenService:Create(camera, TweenInfo.new(duration, easingStyle or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		FieldOfView = startFOV + amount
	})
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(camera, TweenInfo.new(duration * 0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			FieldOfView = startFOV
		}):Play()
	end)
end

function CameraEffects.Orbit(center: Vector3, radius: number, duration: number)
	ensureConnection()
	local startTime = os.clock()
	table.insert(activeEffects, {
		type = "orbit",
		startTime = startTime,
		duration = duration,
		center = center,
		radius = radius,
		endTime = startTime + duration,
		-- Orbit handled in RenderStepped would need more complex implementation
	})
end

function CameraEffects.SlowMotion(factor: number, duration: number)
	ensureConnection()
	table.insert(activeEffects, {
		type = "slowmo",
		startTime = os.clock(),
		duration = duration,
		factor = factor,
		endTime = os.clock() + duration,
	})
end

function CameraEffects.StopAll()
	table.clear(activeEffects)
	if connection then
		connection:Disconnect()
		connection = nil
	end
end

-- Effect presets for game moments
CameraEffects.Presets = {
	BigClick = function() CameraEffects.Shake("Micro") end,
	LevelUp = function() CameraEffects.Shake("Light") end,
	EnemyHit = function() CameraEffects.Shake("Medium") end,
	BossDefeat = function() CameraEffects.Shake("Heavy") end,
	Rebirth = function() 
		CameraEffects.Shake("Massive")
		CameraEffects.PunchZoom(10, 0.3)
	end,
	RareHatch = function()
		CameraEffects.PunchZoom(-15, 0.3)
		task.wait(0.05)
		CameraEffects.PunchZoom(15, 0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	end,
}

return CameraEffects

--!strict
-- AudioEffects.lua
-- Layered sound effects with pitch variation, spatial audio, and pooling

local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local AudioEffects = {}
AudioEffects.__index = AudioEffects

local soundPool = {}
local MAX_POOL = 50
local soundGroups = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function getSound(): Sound
	for _, sound in soundPool do
		if not sound.IsPlaying and sound.Parent then
			return sound
		end
	end
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Parent = SoundService
	table.insert(soundPool, sound)
	return sound
end

local function playAtPosition(soundId: string, position: Vector3, volume: number, pitch: number, parent: Instance?)
	local sound = getSound()
	sound.SoundId = soundId
	sound.Volume = volume
	sound.Pitch = pitch
	sound.PlayOnRemove = false
	sound.Looped = false
	sound.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.Linear
	sound.MaxDistance = 100
	sound.Parent = parent or workspace
	sound.Position = position
	sound:Play()
	
	sound.Ended:Connect(function()
		sound.Parent = SoundService
	end)
	
	return sound
end

function AudioEffects.PlayGlobal(soundId: string, volume: number?, pitch: number?)
	local sound = getSound()
	sound.SoundId = soundId
	sound.Volume = volume or 1
	sound.Pitch = pitch or 1
	sound.Parent = SoundService
	sound:Play()
	sound.Ended:Connect(function()
		sound.Parent = SoundService
	end)
	return sound
end

function AudioEffects.PlayAt(soundId: string, position: Vector3, volume: number?, pitch: number?)
	return playAtPosition(soundId, position, volume or 1, pitch or 1)
end

function AudioEffects.PlayOnPart(soundId: string, part: BasePart, volume: number?, pitch: number?)
	return playAtPosition(soundId, part.Position, volume or 1, pitch or 1, part)
end

function AudioEffects.PlayLayered(layers: {{soundId: string, volume: number?, pitch: number?, delay: number?}}, position: Vector3?)
	for _, layer in layers do
		task.delay(layer.delay or 0, function()
			if position then
				AudioEffects.PlayAt(layer.soundId, position, layer.volume, layer.pitch)
			else
				AudioEffects.PlayGlobal(layer.soundId, layer.volume, layer.pitch)
			end
		end)
	end
end

function AudioEffects.PlayWithPitchVariation(soundId: string, position: Vector3, baseVolume: number, basePitch: number, pitchVariance: number)
	local pitch = basePitch + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * pitchVariance
	AudioEffects.PlayAt(soundId, position, baseVolume, pitch)
end

function AudioEffects.StopAll()
	for _, sound in soundPool do
		sound:Stop()
		sound.Parent = SoundService
	end
end

-- Preset sound configurations for game moments
AudioEffects.Presets = {
	Click = {
		{soundId = "rbxassetid://12222005", volume = 0.4, pitch = 1.0}, -- base click
	},
	
	BigClick = {

		end
	end
end

-- ============================================
-- RARITY SLOT CONFIGURATION
-- ============================================

export type RarityConfig = {
	slots: {min: number, max: number},
	tierWeights: {[number]: number}, -- tier -> weight
}

local RARITY_CONFIG: {[string]: RarityConfig} = {
	Common = {
		slots = {min = 1, max = 1},
		tierWeights = {1 = 80, 2 = 18, 3 = 2, 4 = 0, 5 = 0},
	},
	Uncommon = {

		tierWeights = {1 = 60, 2 = 30, 3 = 9, 4 = 1, 5 = 0},
	},
	Rare = {
		slots = {min = 2, max = 2},
		tierWeights = {1 = 40, 2 = 35, 3 = 20, 4 = 5, 5 = 0},
	},
	Epic = {
		slots = {min = 2, max = 3},
		tierWeights = {1 = 20, 2 = 30, 3 = 30, 4 = 15, 5 = 5},
	},
	Legendary = {
		slots = {min = 3, max = 3},
		tierWeights = {1 = 10, 2 = 20, 3 = 30, 4 = 30, 5 = 10},
	},
}

-- ============================================
-- TALENT ENGINE CORE
-- ============================================

function TalentEngine.GetTalent(talentId: string): Talent?
	return TALENT_REGISTRY[talentId]
end

function TalentEngine.GetAllTalents(): {Talent}
	local result = {}
	for _, talent in TALENT_REGISTRY do
		table.insert(result, talent)
	end
	return result
end

function TalentEngine.GetTalentsByCategory(category: string): {Talent}
	local result = {}
	for _, talent in TALENT_REGISTRY do
		if talent.category == category then
			table.insert(result, talent)
		end
	end
	return result
end

function TalentEngine.GetTalentsByTier(tier: number): {Talent}
	local result = {}
	for _, talent in TALENT_REGISTRY do
		if talent.tier == tier then
			table.insert(result, talent)
		end
	end
	return result
end

-- Weighted random selection
function TalentEngine.RollTalents(rarity: string): {{id: string, locked: boolean}}
	local config = RARITY_CONFIG[rarity] or RARITY_CONFIG.Common
	local slotCount = math.random(config.slots.min, config.slots.max)
	local results = {}
	
	-- Build weighted pool per tier
	local tierPools = {}
	for tier = 1, 5 do
		tierPools[tier] = {}
		for _, talent in TALENT_REGISTRY do
			if talent.tier == tier then
				table.insert(tierPools[tier], talent.id)
			end
		end
	end
	
	for i = 1, slotCount do
		-- Pick tier based on rarity weights
		local tier = TalentEngine._PickWeighted(config.tierWeights)
		local pool = tierPools[tier]
		
		if #pool > 0 then
			local talentId = pool[math.random(1, #pool)]
			table.insert(results, {id = talentId, locked = false})
		end
	end
	
	return results
end

function TalentEngine._PickWeighted(weights: {[number]: number}): number
	local total = 0
	for _, w in weights do total += w end
	
	local roll = math.random(1, total)
	local cumulative = 0
	for tier, weight in weights do
		cumulative += weight
		if roll <= cumulative then
			return tier
		end
	end
	return 1
end

-- Re-roll a specific slot
export type RerollResult = {
	success: boolean,
	newTalentId: string?,
	error: string?,
	cost: number,
}

function TalentEngine.RerollTalent(petData: {Talents: {{id: string, locked: boolean}}}, slotIndex: number, petRarity: string): RerollResult
	local config = RARITY_CONFIG[petRarity] or RARITY_CONFIG.Common
	local slot = petData.Talents[slotIndex]
	
	if not slot then
		return {success = false, error = "Invalid slot index", cost = 0}
	end
	
	if slot.locked then
		return {success = false, error = "Slot is locked", cost = 0}
	end
	
	-- Calculate cost
	local slotCount = #petData.Talents
	local baseCost = 500 * (1.5 ^ (slotIndex - 1))
	local cost = math.floor(baseCost * (1 + (#petData.Talents - config.slots.min) * 0.5))
	
	-- Roll new talent from same tier distribution
	local tier = TalentEngine._PickWeighted(config.tierWeights)
	local tierPool = {}
	for _, talent in TALENT_REGISTRY do
		if talent.tier == tier then
			table.insert(tierPool, talent.id)
		end
	end
	
	if #tierPool == 0 then
		return {success = false, error = "No talents available", cost = 0}
	end
	
	local newTalentId = tierPool[math.random(1, #tierPool)]
	
	return {
		success = true,
		newTalentId = newTalentId,
		cost = cost,
	}
end

-- Lock/unlock talent slot
function TalentEngine.LockTalent(petData: {Talents: {{id: string, locked: boolean}}}, slotIndex: number, lock: boolean): boolean
	local slot = petData.Talents[slotIndex]
	if not slot then return false end
	
	slot.locked = lock
	return true
end

-- Calculate re-roll cost
function TalentEngine.GetRerollCost(petData: {Talents: {{id: string, locked: boolean}}}, slotIndex: number, petRarity: string): number
	local config = RARITY_CONFIG[petRarity] or RARITY_CONFIG.Common
	local baseCost = 500 * (1.5 ^ (slotIndex - 1))
	return math.floor(baseCost * (1 + (#petData.Talents - config.slots.min) * 0.5))
end

-- ============================================
-- TALENT APPLICATION ENGINE
-- ============================================

export type StatModifiers = {
	[multiplicative: string]: number,  -- multipliers (stack multiplicatively)
	[additive: string]: number,        -- flat additions
	[flat: string]: number,            -- flat values
	[chance: string]: number,          -- percentage chances
}

function TalentEngine.CalculateModifiers(petData: {Talents: {{id: string, locked: boolean}}}, baseStats: StatModifiers?): StatModifiers
	local modifiers: StatModifiers = {}
	
	-- Initialize with base stats
	if baseStats then
		for k, v in baseStats do
			modifiers[k] = v
		end
	end
	
	for _, slot in petData.Talents do
		local talent = TALENT_REGISTRY[slot.id]
		if not talent then continue end
		
		local effect = talent.effect
		local stat = effect.stat
		local value = effect.value
		
		if effect.type == "Multiply" then
			modifiers[stat] = (modifiers[stat] or 1) * value
		elseif effect.type == "Add" then
			modifiers[stat] = (modifiers[stat] or 0) + value
		elseif effect.type == "Flat" then
			modifiers[stat] = value
		elseif effect.type == "Chance" then
			modifiers[stat] = (modifiers[stat] or 0) + value
		end
	end
	
	return modifiers
end

function TalentEngine.ApplyToPetMultipliers(petData: {Talents: {{id: string, locked: boolean}}}, petMultipliers: any)
	local modifiers = TalentEngine.CalculateModifiers(petData)
	
	-- Apply to PetMultipliers module (integration point)
	for stat, value in modifiers do
		if petMultipliers[stat] then
			if type(petMultipliers[stat]) == "number" then
				petMultipliers[stat] = petMultipliers[stat] * value
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Get talent display info for UI
function TalentEngine.GetTalentDisplayInfo(talentId: string): {name: string, description: string, tier: number, category: string, icon: string}
	local talent = TALENT_REGISTRY[talentId]
	if not talent then
		return {name = "Unknown", description = "", tier = 1, category = "Unknown", icon = "?"}
	end
	
	return {
		name = talent.name,
		description = talent.description,
		tier = talent.tier,
		category = talent.category,
		icon = TalentEngine._GetCategoryIcon(talent.category),
	}
end

function TalentEngine._GetCategoryIcon(category: string): string
	local icons = {
		Hatching = "🥚",
		Combat = "⚔️",
		Movement = "🏃",
		Economy = "💰",
		Utility = "🔧",
	}
	return icons[category] or "✨"
end

-- Validation
function TalentEngine.ValidateTalents(petData: {Talents: {{id: string, locked: boolean}}}): boolean
	for _, slot in petData.Talents do
		if not TALENT_REGISTRY[slot.id] then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

-- Get all talents for a category (for UI filtering)
function TalentEngine.GetTalentsForUI(): {{category: string, talents: {Talent}}}
	local categories = {"Hatching", "Combat", "Movement", "Economy", "Utility"}
	local result = {}
	
	for _, cat in categories do
		local talents = TalentEngine.GetTalentsByCategory(cat)
		table.sort(talents, function(a, b) return a.tier < b.tier end)
		table.insert(result, {category = cat, talents = talents})
	end
	
	return result
end

return TalentEngine

--// Auction House Shards
-- Owns the DataStore connection, listing shards, and the in-memory listing cache.
-- Listings are spread across N shards (by owner for writes, hash for lookups) to
-- avoid single-key throttling on the DataStore.

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)

local Shards = {}

local AuctionStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.DATASTORE_NAME)

--// State
local Listings = {} -- [listingId] = listing
local ListingShard = {} -- [listingId] = shard key

--// Shard Helpers
function Shards.GetShardKey(ListingId)
	local Hash = 0
	for i = 1, #ListingId do
		Hash = (Hash * 31 + string.byte(ListingId, i)) % 2147483647
	end
	return "L_" .. (Hash % Config.SHARD_COUNT + 1)
end

function Shards.GetOwnerShard(UserId)
	return "L_" .. (UserId % Config.SHARD_COUNT + 1)
end

function Shards.ReadShard(ShardKey)
	local Success, Data = pcall(function()
		return AuctionStore:GetAsync(ShardKey)
	end)

	if Success and type(Data) == "table" then
		return Data
	end
	return nil
end

function Shards.UpdateShard(ShardKey, Updater)
	local Success, Data = pcall(function()
		return AuctionStore:UpdateAsync(ShardKey, function(Old)
			Old = (type(Old) == "table" and Old) or {}
			return Updater(Old)
		end)
	end)

	return Success, Data
end

function Shards.RebuildCache()
	local NewListings = {}
	local NewShard = {}
	local CarryOver = {}

	for i = 1, Config.SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Data = Shards.ReadShard(Key)

		if Data then
			for Id, Listing in Data do
				NewListings[Id] = Listing
				NewShard[Id] = Key
			end
		else
			CarryOver[Key] = true
		end
	end

	for Id, Key in ListingShard do
		if CarryOver[Key] and NewListings[Id] == nil then
			NewListings[Id] = Listings[Id]
			NewShard[Id] = Key
		end
	end

	Listings = NewListings
	ListingShard = NewShard
end

--// Cache Access
function Shards.GetAll()
	return Listings
end

function Shards.GetListing(Id)
	return Listings[Id]
end

function Shards.AddToCache(Listing, Key)
	Listings[Listing.id] = Listing
	ListingShard[Listing.id] = Key
end

function Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
	Listings[Id] = nil
	ListingShard[Id] = nil
end

function Shards.GetShardOf(Id)
	return ListingShard[Id] or Shards.GetShardKey(Id)
end

function Shards.GetStore()
	return AuctionStore
end

return Shards

--!strict
-- ScreenEffects.lua
-- Full-screen visual effects: flash, vignette, chromatic aberration, color grade

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local ScreenEffects = {}
ScreenEffects.__index = ScreenEffects

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Effect container
local effectGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
effectGui.Name = "ScreenEffects"
effectGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
effectGui.DisplayOrder = 200
effectGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
effectGui.Parent = playerGui

-- Pool for flash frames
local flashPool = {}
local MAX_POOL = 10

local function getFlashFrame(): Frame
	for _, frame in flashPool do
		if not frame.Visible then
			frame.Visible = true
			return frame
		end
	end
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Parent = effectGui
	table.insert(flashPool, frame)
	return frame
end

local function returnToPool(frame: Frame)
	frame.Visible = false
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
end

-- Chromatic aberration frames
local chromaticFrames = {}
local function ensureChromatic()
	if #chromaticFrames > 0 then return end
	for _, color in {Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0), Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0), Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)} do
		local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
		frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		frame.BackgroundColor3 = color
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
		frame.Parent = effectGui
		table.insert(chromaticFrames, frame)
	end
end

local function returnChromatic()
	for _, frame in chromaticFrames do
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
	end
end

-- Vignette
local vignetteFrame = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
vignetteFrame.Name = "Vignette"
vignetteFrame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
vignetteFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
vignetteFrame.Image = "rbxassetid://5028857084" -- soft circle
vignetteFrame.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
vignetteFrame.ImageTransparency = 1
vignetteFrame.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
vignetteFrame.Parent = effectGui

-- Color correction (via Lighting)
local colorCorrection = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
colorCorrection.Name = "ScreenEffectsCC"
colorCorrection.Enabled = false
colorCorrection.Parent = game.Lighting

-- Public API
function ScreenEffects.Flash(color: Color3, duration: number, easingStyle: Enum.EasingStyle?)
	local frame = getFlashFrame()
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = color
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	
	local tween = TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(duration, easingStyle or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1
	})
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		returnToPool(frame)
	end)
end

function ScreenEffects.RadialFlash(position: Vector2, color: Color3, maxRadius: number, duration: number)
	local frame = getFlashFrame()
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = color
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
	frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(position.X, position.Y)
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	
	local corner = frame:FindFirstChild("UICorner") or Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	corner.Parent = frame
	
	local tween = TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(maxRadius * 2, maxRadius * 2),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1
	})
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		returnToPool(frame)
	end)
end

function ScreenEffects.ChromaticAberration(intensity: number, duration: number)
	ensureChromatic()
	local offset = intensity * 4
	
	for i, frame in chromaticFrames do
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.8
		local angle = (i - 1) * (2 * math.pi / 3)
		local targetPos = UDim2.fromOffset(math.cos(angle) * offset, math.sin(angle) * offset)
		
		local tween = TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.05, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
			Position = targetPos
		})
		tween:Play()
	end
	
	task.delay(duration, function()
		for _, frame in chromaticFrames do
			TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(duration * 0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
				Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1
			}):Play()
		end
	end)
end

function ScreenEffects.Vignette(intensity: number, duration: number, holdDuration: number?)
	vignetteFrame.ImageTransparency = 1 - intensity
	
	local tween = TweenService:Create(vignetteFrame, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
		ImageTransparency = 1
	})
	tween:Play()
	
	if holdDuration then
		task.delay(holdDuration, function()
			TweenService:Create(vignetteFrame, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
				ImageTransparency = 1
			}):Play()
		end)
	end
end

function ScreenEffects.ColorGrade(tintColor: Color3, saturation: number, contrast: number, duration: number, holdDuration: number?)
	colorCorrection.Enabled = true
	colorCorrection.TintColor = tintColor
	colorCorrection.Saturation = saturation
	colorCorrection.Contrast = contrast
	
	if holdDuration then
		task.delay(holdDuration, function()
			TweenService:Create(colorCorrection, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
				TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
				Saturation = 0,
				Contrast = 0
			}):Play()
			task.wait(duration)
			colorCorrection.Enabled = false
		end)
	else
		TweenService:Create(colorCorrection, TweenInfo.new(duration * 2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
			TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			Saturation = 0,
			Contrast = 0
		}):Play()
		task.wait(duration * 2)
		colorCorrection.Enabled = false
	end
end

function ScreenEffects.SlowMotion(factor: number, duration: number)
	-- Note: This only affects client-side visual timing
	-- Actual game logic should use server time
	local originalWait = task.wait
	local startTime = os.clock()
	
	local connection
	connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		if os.clock() - startTime > duration then
			connection:Disconnect()
			return
		end
		-- Visual slow-mo via time scaling would need custom heartbeat
	end)
	
	task.delay(duration, function()
		if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
	end)
end

function ScreenEffects.StopAll()
	for _, frame in flashPool do
		frame.Visible = false
	end
	returnChromatic()
	vignetteFrame.ImageTransparency = 1
	colorCorrection.Enabled = false
	colorCorrection.TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	colorCorrection.Saturation = 0
	colorCorrection.Contrast = 0
end

-- Preset sequences for game moments
ScreenEffects.Presets = {
	BigClick = function(position: Vector2?)
		ScreenEffects.RadialFlash(position or Vector2.new(0, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0), 100, 0.15)
	end,
	
	RareHatch = function()
		ScreenEffects.Flash(Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 60), 0.1)
		ScreenEffects.ChromaticAberration(1, 0.5)
		ScreenEffects.Vignette(0.6, 0.2, 0.3)
		ScreenEffects.ColorGrade(Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 100), 0.5, 0.2, 0.5, 0.5)
	end,
	
	LegendaryHatch = function()
		ScreenEffects.Flash(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 200), 0.05)
		ScreenEffects.ChromaticAberration(2, 0.8)
		ScreenEffects.Vignette(0.8, 0.1, 0.5)
		ScreenEffects.ColorGrade(Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 150), 1, 0.5, 0.3, 1.0)
		-- Slow-mo pulse
		task.wait(0.05)
		ScreenEffects.Flash(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 0.02)
	end,
	
	LevelUp = function()
		ScreenEffects.Flash(Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150), 0.15)
		ScreenEffects.Vignette(0.4, 0.2, 0.3)
		ScreenEffects.ColorGrade(Color3.fromRGB(150, 255, 200), 0.3, 0.1, 0.4, 0.4)
	end,
	
	Rebirth = function()
		ScreenEffects.Flash(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.05)
		task.wait(0.05)
		ScreenEffects.Flash(Color3.fromRGB(100, 150, 255), 0.3)
		ScreenEffects.Vignette(1, 0.2, 0.5)
		ScreenEffects.ColorGrade(Color3.fromRGB(100, 120, 255), 0.8, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5)
	end,
	
	EnemyDefeat = function()
		ScreenEffects.Flash(Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80), 0.08)
		ScreenEffects.Vignette(0.3, 0.1)
	end,
	
	BossDefeat = function()
		ScreenEffects.Flash(Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50), 0.1)
		ScreenEffects.ChromaticAberration(1.5, 0.6)
		ScreenEffects.Vignette(0.7, 0.15, 0.4)
		ScreenEffects.ColorGrade(Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 50), 0.6, 0.3, 0.6, 0.6)
	end,
	
	TradeComplete = function()
		ScreenEffects.Flash(Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 120), 0.1)
	end,
	
	DailyClaim = function(position: Vector2?)
		ScreenEffects.RadialFlash(position or Vector2.new(0, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 80), 80, 0.2)
	end,
}

return ScreenEffects

local ButtonAnimations = {}
local Tween = require(script.Parent.Tween)

--// Creates the animation of the buttons
ButtonAnimations.Create = function(Frame : Button, Modifier : SizeModifier, Length : TweenLength)
	local BaseSize = {X = Frame.Size.X.Scale, Y = Frame.Size.Y.Scale}
	
	local HasOverlay = false
	local HasGradientBorder = false
		
	if Frame:FindFirstChild("Overlay") then -- for if there is an overlay it will do 3d effect
		HasOverlay = {X = Frame.Overlay.Size.X.Scale, Y = Frame.Overlay.Size.Y.Scale}
	end
	
	if Frame:FindFirstChild("Border") and Frame.Border:FindFirstChild("UIGradient") then -- for if there is a gradient itll change offset
		HasGradientBorder = {X = Frame.Border.UIGradient.Offset.X, Y = Frame.Border.UIGradient.Offset.Y}
	end
		
	--// Setup
	if not Length then Length = 0.075 end
	if not Modifier then Modifier = 1.05 end 
	
	--// Hover in & out
	Frame.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X * Modifier, BaseSize.Y * Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length)
		
		--// 3D Effect
		
		if HasOverlay then
			Frame.Overlay:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(HasOverlay.X*Modifier,HasOverlay.Y*Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Length, true)
		end
		
		--// Rotate Gradient
		if HasGradientBorder then
			Tween.Tween(Frame.Border.UIGradient, {Speed = Length}, {Offset = Vector2.new(HasGradientBorder.X + 0.5, HasGradientBorder.Y)})
		end
	end)
		
	Frame.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		wait(Length)
		Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X, BaseSize.Y), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length)
		
		--// Resets overlay
		if HasOverlay then
			Frame.Overlay:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(HasOverlay.X,HasOverlay.Y), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Length, true)
		end
		
		--// Resets Gradient
		
		if HasGradientBorder then
			Tween.Tween(Frame.Border.UIGradient, {Speed = Length}, {Offset = Vector2.new(HasGradientBorder.X, HasGradientBorder.Y)})
		end
	end)
	
	local Button = Frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextButton")
	
	--// Button Presses
	if Button then
		Button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
			Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X / Modifier, BaseSize.Y / Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length/1.5)
		end)
		
		Button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
			Frame:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(BaseSize.X * Modifier, BaseSize.Y * Modifier), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Length/1.5)
			
			--// Resets overlay
			if HasOverlay then
				Frame.Overlay:TweenSize(UDim2.fromScale(HasOverlay.X,HasOverlay.Y), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Length/1.5, true)
			end
			
			--// Resets Gradient

			if HasGradientBorder then
				Tween.Tween(Frame.Border.UIGradient, {Speed = Length/1.5}, {Offset = Vector2.new(HasGradientBorder.X, HasGradientBorder.Y)})
			end
		end)
	end
end

return ButtonAnimations

--// Function for handling buttons

local ButtonHandler = {}

local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer

local Tween = require(script.Parent.Tween)

local function BlurAnimation(Transparency)
	Tween.Tween(LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.GameUI.Blur, {Speed = 0.25}, {BackgroundTransparency=Transparency})
end

ButtonHandler.OnClick = function(Frame,Size)	
	if not Frame.Visible then
		--// Close other frames
		for _,OtherFrame in Frame.Parent:GetChildren() do
			if OtherFrame:IsA("Frame") and OtherFrame.Visible then
				OtherFrame:TweenSize(Size - UDim2.fromScale(0.15,0.15), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.1, true)
				task.wait(0.04)
				OtherFrame.Visible = false
			end
		end

		--// Open frame

		Frame.Size = Size - UDim2.fromScale(0.1,0.1)
		Frame.Visible = true
		Frame:TweenSize(Size, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.25, true)
		BlurAnimation(0.4)
	else
		--// Close the frame

		BlurAnimation(1)
		Frame:TweenSize(Size - UDim2.fromScale(0.15,0.15), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.25, true)
		task.wait(0.1)
		Frame.Visible = false
	end
end

return ButtonHandler
