--!strict
-- AuctionEngine.lua
-- Buy order matching, price history, sniping alerts

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local MessagingService = game:GetService("MessagingService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local AuctionEngine = {}
AuctionEngine.__index = AuctionEngine

-- DataStore keys
local DATASTORE_KEYS = {
	Listing = "Auction_Listing_",
	BuyOrder = "Auction_BuyOrder_",
	History = "Auction_History_",
	Watchlist = "Auction_Watchlist_",
}

-- In-memory caches
local activeListings = {}      -- [listingId] = listing
local activeBuyOrders = {}     -- [orderId] = order
local priceHistory = {}        -- [itemId][bucketKey] = {min, max, avg, volume}
local watchlists = {}          -- [playerId] = {itemId, ...}
local snipingThresholds = {}   -- [playerId][itemId] = threshold (0-1)

-- Messaging topics
local TOPICS = {
	ListingPosted = "Auction_ListingPosted",
	BuyOrderPlaced = "Auction_BuyOrderPlaced",
	BuyOrderFilled = "Auction_BuyOrderFilled",
	SnipingAlert = "Auction_SnipingAlert",
	HistoryUpdated = "Auction_HistoryUpdated",
}

-- ============================================
-- DATA MODELS
-- ============================================

export type Listing = {
	id: string,
	itemId: string,
	sellerId: number,
	price: number,
	quantity: number,
	listedAt: number,
	expiresAt: number,
	status: "active" | "filled" | "cancelled" | "expired",
}

export type BuyOrder = {
	id: string,
	itemId: string,
	buyerId: number,
	maxPrice: number,
	quantity: number,
	filled: number,
	placedAt: number,
	expiresAt: number,
	status: "open" | "partial" | "filled" | "cancelled" | "expired",
}

export type HistoryBucket = {
	minPrice: number,
	maxPrice: number,
	avgPrice: number,
	volume: number,
	timestamp: number,
}

-- ============================================
-- MATCHING ENGINE
-- ============================================

function AuctionEngine.MatchBuyOrders(listing: Listing): {filled: number, orders: {BuyOrder}}
	local matches = {}
	local remainingQty = listing.quantity
	
	-- Find compatible buy orders: same item, maxPrice >= listPrice, open/partial status
	local candidates = {}
	for _, order in activeBuyOrders do
		if order.itemId == listing.itemId
			and order.maxPrice >= listing.price
			and (order.status == "open" or order.status == "partial")
			and order.buyerId ~= listing.sellerId
			and os.time() < order.expiresAt then
			table.insert(candidates, order)
		end
	end
	
	-- Sort by price-time priority: highest maxPrice first, then earliest placed
	table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
		if a.maxPrice ~= b.maxPrice then
			return a.maxPrice > b.maxPrice
		end
		return a.placedAt < b.placedAt
	end)
	
	for _, order in candidates do
		if remainingQty <= 0 then break end
		
		local fillQty = math.min(remainingQty, order.quantity - order.filled)
		if fillQty <= 0 then continue end
		
		order.filled += fillQty
		remainingQty -= fillQty
		
		if order.filled >= order.quantity then
			order.status = "filled"
		else
			order.status = "partial"
		end
		
		table.insert(matches, {orderId = order.id, filledQty = fillQty, fillPrice = listing.price})
	end
	
	return {filled = listing.quantity - remainingQty, orders = matches}
end

-- ============================================
-- BUY ORDER MANAGEMENT
-- ============================================

function AuctionEngine.PlaceBuyOrder(buyerId: number, itemId: string, maxPrice: number, quantity: number, durationHours: number): (boolean, string?, string?)
	if maxPrice <= 0 or quantity <= 0 then
		return false, "Invalid price or quantity"
	end
	
	if durationHours < 1 or durationHours > 168 then -- max 1 week
		return false, "Duration must be 1-168 hours"
	end
	
	local orderId = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	local now = os.time()
	
	local order: BuyOrder = {
		id = orderId,
		itemId = itemId,
		buyerId = buyerId,
		maxPrice = maxPrice,
		quantity = quantity,
		filled = 0,
		placedAt = now,
		expiresAt = now + (durationHours * 3600),
		status = "open",
	}
	
	activeBuyOrders[orderId] = order
	
	-- Check for immediate matches against existing listings
	-- (In production, this would iterate active listings)
	
	-- Publish event
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.BuyOrderPlaced, {
			orderId = orderId,
			itemId = itemId,
			maxPrice = maxPrice,
			quantity = quantity,
			buyerId = buyerId,
		})
	end
	
	return true, orderId, nil
end

function AuctionEngine.CancelBuyOrder(buyerId: number, orderId: string): boolean
	local order = activeBuyOrders[orderId]
	if not order or order.buyerId ~= buyerId then return false end
	
	if order.status ~= "open" and order.status ~= "partial" then
		return false
	end
	
	order.status = "cancelled"
	activeBuyOrders[orderId] = nil
	return true
end

function AuctionEngine.GetPlayerBuyOrders(playerId: number): {BuyOrder}
	local result = {}
	for _, order in activeBuyOrders do
		if order.buyerId == playerId then
			table.insert(result, order)
		end
	end
	return result
end

-- ============================================
-- PRICE HISTORY
-- ============================================

local BUCKET_DURATIONS = {
	Hour = 3600,
	SixHour = 21600,
	Day = 86400,
	Week = 604800,
}

function AuctionEngine.GetBucketKey(bucketType: string, timestamp: number): string
	local duration = BUCKET_DURATIONS[bucketType] or BUCKET_DURATIONS.Hour
	return tostring(math.floor(timestamp / duration) * duration)
end

function AuctionEngine.RecordSale(itemId: string, price: number, quantity: number, timestamp: number?)
	timestamp = timestamp or os.time()
	
	for bucketType, duration in BUCKET_DURATIONS do
		local bucketKey = AuctionEngine.GetBucketKey(bucketType, timestamp)
		local key = itemId .. "_" .. bucketKey
		
		if not priceHistory[key] then
			priceHistory[key] = {
				minPrice = price,
				maxPrice = price,
				totalPrice = price * quantity,
				volume = quantity,
				count = 1,
				timestamp = timestamp,
			}
		else
			local bucket = priceHistory[key]
			bucket.minPrice = math.min(bucket.minPrice, price)
			bucket.maxPrice = math.max(bucket.maxPrice, price)
			bucket.totalPrice += price * quantity
			bucket.volume += quantity
			bucket.count += 1
		end
	end
end

function AuctionEngine.GetPriceHistory(itemId: string, bucketType: string, fromTimestamp: number, toTimestamp: number): {HistoryBucket}
	local results = {}
	local duration = BUCKET_DURATIONS[bucketType] or BUCKET_DURATIONS.Hour
	
	for bucketKey, data in priceHistory do
		if not string.find(bucketKey, itemId .. "_") then continue end
		if data.timestamp < fromTimestamp or data.timestamp > toTimestamp then continue end
		
		table.insert(results, {
			minPrice = data.minPrice,
			maxPrice = data.maxPrice,
			avgPrice = data.count > 0 and (data.totalPrice / data.volume) or 0,
			volume = data.volume,
			timestamp = data.timestamp,
		})
	end
	
	table.sort(results, function(a, b) return a.timestamp < b.timestamp end)
	return results
end

function AuctionEngine.GetMovingAverage(itemId: string, bucketType: string, periods: number): number
	local history = AuctionEngine.GetPriceHistory(itemId, bucketType, os.time() - periods * BUCKET_DURATIONS[bucketType], os.time())
	if #history == 0 then return 0 end
	
	local sum = 0
	for _, bucket in history do
		sum += bucket.avgPrice
	end
	return sum / #history
end

function AuctionEngine.GetCurrentPriceStats(itemId: string): {min: number, max: number, avg: number, volume: number, movingAvg7d: number}
	local now = os.time()
	local dayHistory = AuctionEngine.GetPriceHistory(itemId, "Day", now - 7 * 86400, now)
	
	if #dayHistory == 0 then
		return {min = 0, max = 0, avg = 0, volume = 0, movingAvg7d = 0}
	end
	
	local totalVolume = 0
	local weightedSum = 0
	local minPrice = math.huge
	local maxPrice = 0
	
	for _, bucket in dayHistory do
		minPrice = math.min(minPrice, bucket.minPrice)
		maxPrice = math.max(maxPrice, bucket.maxPrice)
		totalVolume += bucket.volume
		weightedSum += bucket.avgPrice * bucket.volume
	end
	
	return {
		min = minPrice == math.huge and 0 or minPrice,
		max = maxPrice,
		avg = totalVolume > 0 and (weightedSum / totalVolume) or 0,
		volume = totalVolume,
		movingAvg7d = totalVolume > 0 and (weightedSum / totalVolume) or 0,
	}
end

-- ============================================
-- SNIPING ALERTS
-- ============================================

function AuctionEngine.SetSnipingThreshold(playerId: number, itemId: string, threshold: number)
	-- threshold = discount percentage (0.15 = 15% below moving average)
	if not snipingThresholds[playerId] then snipingThresholds[playerId] = {} end
	snipingThresholds[playerId][itemId] = math.clamp(threshold, 0.01, 0.50)
end

function AuctionEngine.GetSnipingThresholds(playerId: number): {[string]: number}
	return snipingThresholds[playerId] or {}
end

function AuctionEngine.CheckSnipingAlert(listing: Listing): boolean
	local stats = AuctionEngine.GetCurrentPriceStats(listing.itemId)
	if stats.movingAvg7d == 0 then return false end
	
	local discount = 1 - (listing.price / stats.movingAvg7d)
	
	-- Check all players watching this item
	-- In practice, iterate watchlists or subscriptions
	return discount >= 0.15 -- default threshold
end

function AuctionEngine.TriggerSnipingAlert(listing: Listing, discount: number)
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.SnipingAlert, {
			itemId = listing.itemId,
			listingPrice = listing.price,
			movingAvg = AuctionEngine.GetCurrentPriceStats(listing.itemId).movingAvg7d,
			discount = discount,
			listingId = listing.id,
		})
	end
end

-- ============================================
-- WATCHLIST
-- ============================================

function AuctionEngine.AddToWatchlist(playerId: number, itemId: string)
	if not watchlists[playerId] then watchlists[playerId] = {} end
	if not table.find(watchlists[playerId], itemId) then
		table.insert(watchlists[playerId], itemId)
	end
end

function AuctionEngine.RemoveFromWatchlist(playerId: number, itemId: string)
	if watchlists[playerId] then
		local idx = table.find(watchlists[playerId], itemId)
		if idx then table.remove(watchlists[playerId], idx) end
	end
end

function AuctionEngine.GetWatchlist(playerId: number): {string}
	return watchlists[playerId] or {}
end

function AuctionEngine.GetWatchlistData(playerId: number): {{itemId: string, lowestAsk: number, avgPrice: number, volume24h: number, priceDelta24h: number}}
	local watchlist = watchlists[playerId] or {}
	local results = {}
	
	for _, itemId in watchlist do
		local stats = AuctionEngine.GetCurrentPriceStats(itemId)
		-- In production, fetch lowest ask from active listings
		table.insert(results, {
			itemId = itemId,
			lowestAsk = stats.min,
			avgPrice = stats.avg,
			volume24h = stats.volume,
			priceDelta24h = 0, -- would need previous day comparison
		})
	end
	
	return results
end

-- ============================================
-- LISTING MANAGEMENT (stubs for integration)
-- ============================================

function AuctionEngine.CreateListing(sellerId: number, itemId: string, price: number, quantity: number, durationHours: number): (boolean, string?)
	local listingId = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	local now = os.time()
	
	local listing: Listing = {
		id = listingId,
		itemId = itemId,
		sellerId = sellerId,
		price = price,
		quantity = quantity,
		listedAt = now,
		expiresAt = now + (durationHours * 3600),
		status = "active",
	}
	
	activeListings[listingId] = listing
	
	-- Check for matching buy orders
	local matches = AuctionEngine.MatchBuyOrders(listing)
	if matches.filled > 0 then
		-- Process fills
		for _, match in matches.orders do
			-- Record sale for history
			AuctionEngine.RecordSale(listing.itemId, match.fillPrice, match.filledQty)
			
			-- Notify buyer
			if RunService:IsServer() then
				MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.BuyOrderFilled, {
					orderId = match.orderId,
					itemId = listing.itemId,
					fillPrice = match.fillPrice,
					quantity = match.filledQty,
				})
			end
		end
	end
	
	-- Check sniping alerts
	if AuctionEngine.CheckSnipingAlert(listing) then
		local stats = AuctionEngine.GetCurrentPriceStats(listing.itemId)
		if stats.movingAvg7d > 0 then
			local discount = 1 - (listing.price / stats.movingAvg7d)
			AuctionEngine.TriggerSnipingAlert(listing, discount)
		end
	end
	
	-- Publish listing event
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.ListingPosted, {
			listingId = listingId,
			itemId = itemId,
			price = price,
			quantity = quantity,
			sellerId = sellerId,
		})
	end
	
	return true, listingId
end

function AuctionEngine.GetActiveListings(itemId: string?): {Listing}
	local results = {}
	for _, listing in activeListings do
		if listing.status == "active" and os.time() < listing.expiresAt then
			if not itemId or listing.itemId == itemId then
				table.insert(results, listing)
			end
		end
	end
	
	-- Sort by price ascending
	table.sort(results, function(a, b) return a.price < b.price end)
	return results
end

-- ============================================
-- BACKGROUND JOBS
-- ============================================

if RunService:IsServer() then
	-- Price history aggregation (every 5 minutes)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(300)
			
			-- Cleanup expired orders/listings
			local now = os.time()
			for id, order in activeBuyOrders do
				if now >= order.expiresAt then
					order.status = "expired"
					activeBuyOrders[id] = nil
				end
			end
			
			for id, listing in activeListings do
				if now >= listing.expiresAt then
					listing.status = "expired"
				end
			end
			
			-- Cleanup old price history (keep 90 days)
			local cutoff = os.time() - 90 * 86400
			for key, data in priceHistory do
				if data.timestamp < cutoff then
					priceHistory[key] = nil
				end
			end
			
			MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.HistoryUpdated, {timestamp = os.time()})
		end
	end)
end

return AuctionEngine

--// Auction House Pets
-- Pet lifecycle helpers shared by the auction handlers: granting a new pet
-- into a player's inventory and generating unique pet IDs.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Multipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Multipliers)

local Pets = {}

function Pets.GenerateId(Player)
	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Id
	repeat
		Id = math.random(1, 999999999)
	until not Folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(Id))
	return Id
end

function Pets.GetMaxStorage(Player)
	return Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player)
end

function Pets.Grant(Player, PetName)
	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local MaxStorage = Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player)
	if #Folder:GetChildren() >= MaxStorage then return false end

	local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
	NewPet.Name = Pets.GenerateId(Player)
	NewPet.PetName.Value = PetName
	NewPet.Equipped.Value = false
	NewPet.Parent = Folder
	return true
end

return Pets

-- In this module you can find things like Rebirth Multiplier. By using code such as Multipliers.RebirthMultiplier(Player) returns a number which is that player's multiplier. Useful if you have multipliers in multiple scripts

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"]

local PetMultipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.PetMultipliers)

local Multipliers = {}

function Multipliers.RebirthMultiplier(Player)
	local Multi = 1
	
	if GameSettings.RebirthType.Value == "Linear" then
		Multi *= (Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value * GameSettings.RebirthMultiplier.Value + 1) -- so multi = RebirthMulti + 1
	else
		Multi *= (GameSettings.RebirthMultiplier.Value + 0.5) ^ Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value
	end
	
	return Multi	
end

function Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
	local Multi = GameSettings.CurrencyMultiplier.Value
	Multi *= (Player.Data.Gamepasses.DoubleCurrency.Value and 2 or 1)
	Multi *= Multipliers.RebirthMultiplier(Player)
	Multi *= PetMultipliers.ReadPlayerMultiplier(Player.Name)
	
	local R = ReplicatedStorage.GemShop["2"].Reward
	if R.Exponential.Value then
		Multi *= R.DefaultReward.Value + R.IncreasePer.Value ^ Player.Data.PlayerData.GemUpgrade2.Value
	else
		Multi *= R.DefaultReward.Value + R.IncreasePer.Value * Player.Data.PlayerData.GemUpgrade2.Value
	end
	
	return Multi
end

function Multipliers.GetMaxPetsEquipped(Player)
	return 5
		+ (Player.Data.Gamepasses["MorePets1"].Value and 3 or 0)
		+ (Player.Data.Gamepasses["MorePets2"].Value and 10 or 0)
end

function Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player)
	return 50 + (Player.Data.Gamepasses["MoreStorage1"].Value and 50 or 0) + (Player.Data.Gamepasses["MoreStorage2"].Value and 250 or 0)
end

function Multipliers.GetLuckMultiplier(Player)
	return 1 * (Player.Data.Gamepasses.Lucky.Value and 2 or 1)
end

return Multipliers

--// Admin Dashboard Logs
-- In-memory audit log buffer. Every admin action is recorded here.

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)

local Logs = {}
local Buffer = {}

function Logs.Add(AdminName, Action, Target, Details)
	local Entry = {
		timestamp = os.time(),
		admin = AdminName or "?",
		action = Action or "?",
		target = Target or "",
		details = Details or "",
	}
	table.insert(Buffer, Entry)

	-- trim oldest if over limit
	while #Buffer > Config.MAX_LOGS do
		table.remove(Buffer, 1)
	end

	return Entry
end

function Logs.Get(Count)
	local N = math.min(Count or #Buffer, #Buffer)
	local Result = {}
	for i = #Buffer, math.max(1, #Buffer - N + 1), -1 do
		Result[#Result + 1] = Buffer[i]
	end
	return Result
end

function Logs.Clear()
	table.clear(Buffer)
	return true
end

function Logs.Count()
	return #Buffer
end

return Logs

--// Services
local MarketPlaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables

local GamepassFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses

function GetGamepassFromID(ID)
	for _, Gamepass in GamepassFolder:GetChildren() do
		if Gamepass.Value == ID then
			return Gamepass
		end
	end
	return nil
end

MarketPlaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(Player, Gamepass, Succes)
	if not Succes then return end

	local GamepassType = GetGamepassFromID(Gamepass)
	if GamepassType == nil then return end -- Gamepass does not exist in the game!	

	local GP = Player.Data.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(GamepassType.Name)
	if not GP then warn("Gamepass: "..GamepassType.Name.." does not exist in Player.Data.Gamepasses! Edit Datastore.Datastore.Values to add it!") return end

	GP.Value = true
end)

local function GetPet(SelectedEgg)
	local TotalWeight = 0
	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		TotalWeight += v.Value
	end

	local Chance = Random.new():NextNumber(0.0001,TotalWeight)
	local Counter = 0

	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		Counter += v.Value
		if Counter >= Chance then
			return v.Name
		end
	end
end

local function GetRobuxEgg(Player, Egg)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]
	local ChosenPet = GetPet(EggInfo.Pets)
	if ChosenPet ~= nil then
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = true
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			task.wait(3)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = false
		end)()
		ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Egg:InvokeClient(Player, Egg, ChosenPet, 0)
		return ChosenPet
	end
end

function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end


MarketPlaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(ReceiptInfo)
	local Player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(ReceiptInfo.PlayerId)

	for _, EggInfo in ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:GetChildren() do
		if not EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then continue end

		if tonumber(EggInfo.ProductId.Value) == ReceiptInfo.ProductId then
			local PetChosen = GetRobuxEgg(Player, EggInfo.Name)	-- this selects a random pet from the egg

			--// Create Pet
			local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
			NewPet.PetName.Value = PetChosen
			NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets

			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
		end
	end	
end

--[[ This Script Handles Admin Commands

Current Commands:
/givestats Player Stat Amount
/givepet PlayerName PetName

]]

local ADMINS = {
	3791434058, -- Put userids here. If you are the owner of the game this is not required
	
}



--------- Main Script ---------

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local AdminFunctions = require(script.AdminFunctions)

function Main(Player) -- this code is called for each player joining
	if not AdminFunctions.IsPlayerAdmin(Player, ADMINS) then return end -- player is not an admin if this returns false
	
	Player.Chatted:Connect(function(Message)
		local SplittedMessage = string.split(Message, " ")
		local Command = string.lower(SplittedMessage[1] or "")
		local PlayerName = SplittedMessage[2] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[2]) or ""
		local Arg1 = SplittedMessage[3] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[3]) or ""
		local Arg2 = SplittedMessage[4] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[4]) or ""
		
		if Command == "/gm" then
			Player:SetAttribute("IsGM", not (Player:GetAttribute("IsGM") == true))
		elseif Command == "/givestats" then -- /givestats PlayerName StatName Amount
			local TargetPlayer = AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
			if TargetPlayer == nil then return end -- no player exists
			
			if Arg1 == string.lower(ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"].CurrencyName.Value) then
				Arg1 = "currency"
			end
			
			local Stat = AdminFunctions.FindStatFromStatName(TargetPlayer, Arg1)
			if Stat == nil then return end -- stat does not exist
			
			if Stat:IsA("IntValue") or Stat:IsA("NumberValue") then
				Arg2 = tonumber(Arg2)
				if Arg2 == nil then return end
				
				Stat.Value = Arg2 -- set the stat to Arg2 if it's a number
			elseif Stat:IsA("BoolValue") then
				Stat.Value = Arg1 == "true" and true or false -- make it true if you put in True or true and the rest if false	
			elseif Stat:IsA("StringValue") then
				Stat.Value = Arg1
			end
		elseif Command == "/givepet" then -- /givepet PlayerName PetName
			local TargetPlayer = AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
			if TargetPlayer == nil then return end -- no player exists

			local Pet = AdminFunctions.FindPetFromPetName(TargetPlayer, Arg1)
			if Pet == nil then return end -- pet does not exist

			local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = AdminFunctions.RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
			NewPet.PetName.Value = Pet.Name
			NewPet.Parent = TargetPlayer.Data.Pets
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(Main)

	local self = setmetatable({}, EmoteWheel)
	self.config = setmetatable(config or {}, {__index = DEFAULT_CONFIG})
	self.isOpen = false
	self.buttons = {}
	self.gui = nil
	self.emoteEngine = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.EmoteEngine)

end

function EmoteWheel:_createGui()
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.DisplayOrder = 250
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.Parent = playerGui

	local wheel = Instance.new("Frame")
	wheel.Name = "Wheel"
	wheel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.radius * 2, self.config.radius * 2)
	wheel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	wheel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	wheel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	wheel.Visible = false
	wheel.Parent = gui

	-- Center hub
	local center = Instance.new("Frame")
	center.Name = "Center"
	center.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 80)
	center.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	center.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	center.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 26, 38)
	center.BorderSizePixel = 0
	center.Parent = wheel

	local centerCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	centerCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	centerCorner.Parent = center

	local centerStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	centerStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
	centerStroke.Thickness = 2
	centerStroke.Transparency = 0.3
	centerStroke.Parent = center

	local centerLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	centerLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	centerLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	centerLabel.Text = "EMOTES"
	centerLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	centerLabel.TextSize = 12
	centerLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 175, 200)
	centerLabel.Parent = center

	self.wheel = wheel
	self.gui = gui
end

function EmoteWheel:Toggle()
	if self.isOpen then
		self:Close()
	else
		self:Open()
	end
end

function EmoteWheel:Open()
	if self.isOpen then return end
	self.isOpen = true
	self.wheel.Visible = true
	self:_updateButtons()
	
	self.wheel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(self.wheel, TweenInfo.new(self.config.animationDuration, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.radius * 2, self.config.radius * 2)
	}):Play()
	
	-- Listen for close
	self._closeConnection = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if not processed and (input.KeyCode == self.config.openKey or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then
			self:Close()
		end
	end)
end

function EmoteWheel:Close()
	if not self.isOpen then return end
	self.isOpen = false
	
	if self._closeConnection then
		self._closeConnection:Disconnect()
		self._closeConnection = nil
	end
	
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(self.wheel, TweenInfo.new(self.config.animationDuration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	}):Play()
	
	task.wait(self.config.animationDuration)
	self.wheel.Visible = false
end

function EmoteWheel:_updateButtons()
	-- Clear old buttons
	for _, btn in self.buttons do
		btn:Destroy()
	end
	self.buttons = {}

	local ownedEmotes = self.emoteEngine.GetOwnedEmotes(player.UserId)
	local emotesToShow = {}
	
	for _, emoteId in ipairs(ownedEmotes) do
		local emote = self.emoteEngine.GetEmote(emoteId)
		if emote then
			table.insert(emotesToShow, emote)
		end
	end
	
	if #emotesToShow == 0 then
		-- Show placeholder
		local frame = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		frame.Text = "No emotes unlocked"
		frame.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		frame.TextSize = 16
		frame.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 165, 190)
		frame.Parent = self.wheel
		return
	end

	-- Limit to max buttons
	local angleStep = (2 * math.pi) / math.min(#emotesToShow, self.config.maxButtons)
	local startAngle = -math.pi / 2

	for i, emote in ipairs(emotesToShow) do
		if i > self.config.maxButtons then break end
		
		local angle = startAngle + (i - 1) * angleStep
		local x = self.config.radius * 0.7 * math.cos(angle)
		local y = self.config.radius * 0.7 * math.sin(angle)

		local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
		btn.Name = emote.id
		btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.buttonSize, self.config.buttonSize)
		btn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.radius + x, self.config.radius + y)
		btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 34, 48)
		btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
		btn.Text = ""
		btn.Parent = self.wheel

		local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
		btnCorner.Parent = btn

		local btnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		btnStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
		btnStroke.Thickness = 1.5
		btnStroke.Transparency = 0.4
		btnStroke.Parent = btn

		local icon = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		icon.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.7)
		icon.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.15, 0.1)
		icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		icon.Text = self.emoteEngine._GetEmoteIcon(emote.id)
		icon.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		icon.TextSize = 28
		icon.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		icon.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
		icon.Parent = btn

		local name = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		name.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.3)
		name.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.7)
		name.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		name.Text = emote.name
		name.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
		name.TextSize = 10
		name.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 215, 230)
		name.TextWrapped = true
		name.Parent = btn

		-- Cooldown overlay
		local cooldownOverlay = Instance.new("Frame")
		cooldownOverlay.Name = "CooldownOverlay"
		cooldownOverlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		cooldownOverlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		cooldownOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
		cooldownOverlay.Visible = false
		cooldownOverlay.ZIndex = 2
		cooldownOverlay.Parent = btn

		local overlayCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		overlayCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
		overlayCorner.Parent = cooldownOverlay

		local cdText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		cdText.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		cdText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		cdText.Text = ""
		cdText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		cdText.TextSize = 16
		cdText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		cdText.Parent = cooldownOverlay

		-- Hover effects
		btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 50, 70)
			}):Play()
		end)
		btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 34, 48)
			}):Play()
		end)

		btn.Activated:Connect(function()
			if self.emoteEngine.TriggerEmote(player.UserId, emote.id) then
				self:Close()
			end
		end)

		-- Cooldown update
		task.spawn(function()
			while btn.Parent do
				local cd = self.emoteEngine.GetRemainingCooldown(player.UserId, emote.id)
				if cd > 0 then
					cooldownOverlay.Visible = true
					cdText.Text = string.format("%.1fs", cd)
				else
					cooldownOverlay.Visible = false
				end
				task.wait(0.1)
			end
		end)

		table.insert(self.buttons, btn)
	end
end

function EmoteWheel:IsOpen()
	return self.isOpen
end

function EmoteWheel:Destroy()
	if self._closeConnection then
		self._closeConnection:Disconnect()
	end
	if self.gui then self.gui:Destroy() end
end

return EmoteWheel

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local tagName = "GMHeadTag"
local glowName = "GMHeadGlow"
local tagColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 221, 54)
local tagHex = "#FFDD36"

local function removeTag(character)
	if not character then return end
	local existing = character:FindFirstChild(tagName)
	if existing then existing:Destroy() end
	local glow = character:FindFirstChild(glowName)
	if glow then glow:Destroy() end
end

local function addTag(character)
	if not character then return end
	removeTag(character)
	if player:GetAttribute("IsGM") ~= true then return end
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head then return end

	local glow = Instance.new("Highlight")

	glow.FillColor = tagColor
	glow.FillTransparency = 0.78
	glow.OutlineColor = tagColor
	glow.OutlineTransparency = 0.08

	local glowTween = TweenService:Create(
		glow,
		TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true),
		{FillTransparency = 0.94, OutlineTransparency = 0.42}
	)
	glowTween:Play()

	billboard.Adornee = head
	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboard.MaxDistance = 100
	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 32)

	label.TextSize = 22
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 35, 0)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.25

		TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true),
		{TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 245, 150), TextStrokeTransparency = 0.55}
	)
	textTween:Play()
end

end

	local properties = Instance.new("TextChatMessageProperties")
	local source = message.TextSource
	if source then
		local sender = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(source.UserId)
		if sender and sender:GetAttribute("IsGM") == true then
			properties.PrefixText = string.format("<font color='%s'>[GM]</font> %s", tagHex, message.PrefixText)
		end
	end
	return properties
end

TextChatService.OnBubbleAdded = function(message, adornee)

	if source then

			properties.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 35, 8)
			properties.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 238, 125)
			properties.TextSize = 18
			properties.FontFace = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.SourceSansBold)
			properties.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
			properties.TailVisible = true
		end
	end
	return properties
end

refresh()

local enemies = workspace:WaitForChild("PetEnemies")

local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("EnemyCombatUI")
if old then old:Destroy() end

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "EnemyCombatUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.DisplayOrder = 75
gui.Parent = playerGui

local hud = Instance.new("Frame")
hud.Name = "CombatHUD"
hud.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
hud.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 74)
hud.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(280, 74)
hud.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 23, 33)

hud.Visible = false

local hudCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

hudCorner.Parent = hud
local hudStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")

local status = Instance.new("TextLabel")

substatus.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 18)
substatus.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans

substatus.TextSize = 14
substatus.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
substatus.Text = "Scanning for enemies..."
substatus.Parent = hud

local barBack = Instance.new("Frame")
barBack.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 55)
barBack.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 9)
barBack.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 62, 75)
barBack.BorderSizePixel = 0
barBack.Parent = hud
local barCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

barCorner.Parent = barBack

bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 85, 85)
bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
bar.Parent = barBack
local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
fillCorner.Parent = bar

local overlays = {}
local function makeOverlay(enemy)
	if overlays[enemy] or not enemy:IsA("Model") then return end
	local adornee = enemy:FindFirstChild("Head", true) or enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if not adornee then return end
	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")

	billboard.Adornee = adornee
	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 66)

	billboard.MaxDistance = 28
	billboard.Enabled = false
	billboard.Parent = enemy

	local root = Instance.new("Frame")
	root.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	root.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 20, 30)
	root.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
	root.BorderSizePixel = 0
	root.Parent = billboard
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = root
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 3)
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 18)
	title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	title.TextSize = 14
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 230)
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Parent = root
	local state = title:Clone()
	state.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 21)
	state.Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 16)
	state.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
	state.TextSize = 12
	state.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 230, 245)
	state.Parent = root
	local track = Instance.new("Frame")
	track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 47)
	track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 8)
	track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(57, 62, 75)
	track.BorderSizePixel = 0
	track.Parent = root
	local trackCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	trackCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	trackCorner.Parent = track
	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.Name = "HealthFill"
	fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 220, 120)
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.Parent = track
	local fillCorner2 = Instance.new("UICorner")
	fillCorner2.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	fillCorner2.Parent = fill
	overlays[enemy] = {billboard = billboard, title = title, state = state, fill = fill}
	enemy.Destroying:Connect(function() overlays[enemy] = nil end)
end

local function updateOverlay(enemy, data)
	local entry = overlays[enemy]
	if not entry then makeOverlay(enemy) entry = overlays[enemy] end
	if not entry then return end
	local main = enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	local rootPart = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local distance = main and rootPart and (main.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
	local health = math.max(0, tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0)
	local maxHealth = math.max(1, tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("MaxHealth")) or health)
	local stateText = tostring(enemy:GetAttribute("AIState") or "Roaming")
	entry.billboard.Enabled = distance <= 28 and health > 0
	entry.title.Text = enemy.Name:gsub("PetEnemy_Player_%d+_", "ENEMY ")
	entry.state.Text = string.upper(stateText) .. (data and data.damage and "  -" .. tostring(data.damage) or "")
	entry.state.TextColor3 = stateText == "Attacking" and Color3.fromRGB(255, 125, 125) or Color3.fromRGB(220, 230, 245)
	entry.fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(health / maxHealth, 0, 1), 1)
end

for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies:GetChildren()) do makeOverlay(enemy) end
enemies.ChildAdded:Connect(function(enemy) task.defer(makeOverlay, enemy) end)

local selectedEnemy
local lastCombat = {}
combatFeedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
	local enemyName = data.enemy
	local enemy = enemyName and enemies:FindFirstChild(enemyName)
	if enemy then
		selectedEnemy = enemy
		lastCombat[enemy] = data
		updateOverlay(enemy, data)
		hud.Visible = true
		status.Text = string.upper(enemy.Name:gsub("PetEnemy_Player_%d+_", "ENEMY "))
		local stateText = tostring(enemy:GetAttribute("AIState") or "COMBAT")
		substatus.Text = string.upper(stateText) .. (data.damage and "  |  DAMAGE " .. tostring(data.damage) or "")
		local health = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0
		local maxHealth = math.max(1, tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("MaxHealth")) or health)
		bar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(health / maxHealth, 0, 1), 1)
	end
end)

local updateTimer = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	updateTimer += deltaTime
	if updateTimer < 0.1 then return end
	updateTimer = 0
	for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies:GetChildren()) do
		if enemy:IsA("Model") then updateOverlay(enemy, lastCombat[enemy]) end
	end
	if selectedEnemy and selectedEnemy.Parent then
		local main = selectedEnemy.PrimaryPart or selectedEnemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		local rootPart = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if main and rootPart and (main.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude > 28 then hud.Visible = false end
	end
end)

--!strict
-- EffectSequence.lua
-- Composable effect chains for complex multi-stage visual sequences

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local EffectSequence = {}
EffectSequence.__index = EffectSequence

type EffectStep = {
	type: "wait" | "function" | "tween" | "parallel",
	duration: number?,
	callback: (() -> ())?,
	tweenInfo: TweenInfo?,
	target: Instance?,
	properties: {[string]: any}?,
	children: {EffectStep}?
}

function EffectSequence.new()
	local self = setmetatable({}, EffectSequence)
	self.steps = {}
	self.running = false
	self.cancelled = false
	return self
end

function EffectSequence:Wait(duration: number)
	table.insert(self.steps, {type = "wait", duration = duration})
	return self
end

function EffectSequence:Call(callback: () -> ())
	table.insert(self.steps, {type = "function", callback = callback})
	return self
end

function EffectSequence:Tween(target: Instance, tweenInfo: TweenInfo, properties: {[string]: any})
	table.insert(self.steps, {type = "tween", target = target, tweenInfo = tweenInfo, properties = properties})
	return self
end

function EffectSequence:Parallel(children: {EffectStep})
	table.insert(self.steps, {type = "parallel", children = children})
	return self
end

function EffectSequence:Then(callback: () -> ())
	table.insert(self.steps, {type = "function", callback = callback})
	return self
end

function EffectSequence:Play()
	if self.running then return end
	self.running = true
	self.cancelled = false
	
	task.spawn(function()
		for _, step in self.steps do
			if self.cancelled then break end
			
			if step.type == "wait" then
				task.wait(step.duration or 0)
				
			elseif step.type == "function" then
				if step.callback then
					step.callback()
				end
				
			elseif step.type == "tween" then
				if step.target and step.tweenInfo and step.properties then
					local tween = TweenService:Create(step.target, step.tweenInfo, step.properties)
					tween:Play()
					tween.Completed:Wait()
				end
				
			elseif step.type == "parallel" then
				local threads = {}
				for _, child in step.children or {} do
					table.insert(threads, task.spawn(function()
						-- Execute child step inline
						if child.type == "wait" then
							task.wait(child.duration or 0)
						elseif child.type == "function" then
							if child.callback then child.callback() end
						elseif child.type == "tween" then
							if child.target and child.tweenInfo and child.properties then
								local tween = TweenService:Create(child.target, child.tweenInfo, child.properties)
								tween:Play()
								tween.Completed:Wait()
							end
						end
					end))
				end
				for _, thread in threads do
					task.wait() -- yield to let all start
				end
				-- Wait for all to complete (simplified)
				task.wait(0.1)
			end
		end
		self.running = false
	end)
end

function EffectSequence:Cancel()
	self.cancelled = true
	self.running = false
end

-- Builder helpers
function EffectSequence.Sequence()
	return EffectSequence.new()
end

function EffectSequence.Chain(...)
	local seq = EffectSequence.new()
	for _, fn in {...} do
		if type(fn) == "function" then
			fn(seq)
		end
	end
	return seq
end

return EffectSequence

--// Admin Dashboard Logs
-- In-memory audit log buffer. Every admin action is recorded here.

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)

local Logs = {}
local Buffer = {}

function Logs.Add(AdminName, Action, Target, Details)
	local Entry = {
		timestamp = os.time(),
		admin = AdminName or "?",
		action = Action or "?",
		target = Target or "",
		details = Details or "",
	}
	table.insert(Buffer, Entry)

	-- trim oldest if over limit
	while #Buffer > Config.MAX_LOGS do
		table.remove(Buffer, 1)
	end

	return Entry
end

function Logs.Get(Count)
	local N = math.min(Count or #Buffer, #Buffer)
	local Result = {}
	for i = #Buffer, math.max(1, #Buffer - N + 1), -1 do
		Result[#Result + 1] = Buffer[i]
	end
	return Result
end

function Logs.Clear()
	table.clear(Buffer)
	return true
end

function Logs.Count()
	return #Buffer
end

return Logs

--[[
	Shortening module,
	
	Module.en(number) to shorten a number to a suffix
	Module.time(seconds) to get a string in the D/H/M/S format
]]

local Module = {}

Module.Prefixes = {"K","M","B","T","Qd","Qn","Sx","Sp","Oc","No",
	"De","UDe","DDe","TDe","QtDe","QnDe","SxDe","SpDe","OcDe","NoDe",
	"Vg","UVg","DVg","TVg","QdVg","QnVg","SxVg","SpVg","OcVg","NoVg",
	"Tg","UTg","DTg","TTg","QdTg","QnTg","SxTg","SpTg","OcTg","NoTg",
	"qg","Uqg","Dqg","Tqg","Qdqg","Qnqg","Sxqg","Spqg","Ocqg","Noqg",
	"Qg","UQg","DQg","TQg","QdQg","QnQg","SxQg","SpQg","OcQg","NoQg",
	"sg","Usg","Dsg","Tsg","Qdsg","Qnsg","Sxsg","Spsg","Ocsg","Nosg",
	"Sg","USg","DSg","TSg","QdSg","QnSg","SxSg","SpSg","OcSg","NoSg",
	"Og","UOg","DOg","TOg","QdOg","QnOg","SxOg","SpOg","OcOg","NoOg",
	"Ng","UNg","DNg","TNg","QdNg","QnNg","SxNg","SpNg","OcNg","NoNg",
	"Ce", "UCe"}


function Module.CutDigits(x)
	if x - math.floor(x) == 0 then return x end
	return string.format("%.2f", x)
end


function Module.en(number, digits)
	if number == 0 then return number end
	if number < 1 then return Module.CutDigits(number) end
	
	number = (number < 0 and math.abs(number)) or number
	digits = digits or 2
	
	local suffix = math.floor(math.log10(number)/3)
	
	return Module.CutDigits(number / 1000^(suffix)) .. ( Module.Prefixes[math.floor(suffix)] or "")
end

Module.time = function(val)
	if not tonumber(val) then return val end

	local days = math.floor(val / 86400)
	val = val - days * 86400

	local hours = math.floor(val / 3600)
	val = val - hours * 3600

	local mins = math.floor(val / 60)
	val = val - mins * 60

	val = val > 0 and " " .. math.floor(val) .. "s" or ""
	return (days > 0 and days .. "d" or "") .. (hours > 0 and " " .. hours .. "h" or "") .. (mins > 0 and " " .. mins .. "m" or "") .. val
end

Module.date = function(val)
	if not tonumber(val) then return val end
	
	local DateTable = os.date("!*t", val)
	local Months = {"Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"}
	
	return DateTable.day.." "..Months[DateTable.month].." "..DateTable.year
end

Module.comma = function(value)
	value = tostring(value)
	return value:reverse():gsub("%d%d%d", "%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,", "")
end

return Module

-- Banner.lua
-- Full-width banner notifications for high-priority alerts

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Banner = {}
Banner.__index = Banner

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
	animationDuration = 0.4,
	position = "top-center",
	autoDismiss = true,
}

function Banner.new(config)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Banner)
	self.config = setmetatable(config or {}, {__index = DEFAULT_CONFIG})
	self.activeBanners = {}
	self:_createContainer()
	return self
end

function Banner:_createContainer()
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "BannerSystem"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.DisplayOrder = 210
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.Parent = playerGui

	local container = Instance.new("Frame")
	container.Name = "Container"
	container.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 80)
	container.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 20)
	container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	container.Parent = gui

	self.container = container
	self.gui = gui
end

function Banner:Show(data)
	data.id = data.id or game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false)
	data.autoDismiss = data.autoDismiss or 10

	local banner = self:_createBanner(data)
	banner.Parent = self.container
	table.insert(self.activeBanners, {id = data.id, frame = banner})

	if data.autoDismiss then
		task.delay(data.autoDismiss, function()
			self:Dismiss(data.id)
		end)
	end

	return data.id
end

function Banner:_createBanner(data)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "Banner_" .. data.id
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 80)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 20, 30)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.ZIndex = 10

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
	corner.Parent = frame

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = data.strokeColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80)
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Parent = frame

	-- Icon
	local icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(48, 48)
	icon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 16)
	icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	icon.Image = data.icon or ""
	icon.ZIndex = 11
	icon.Parent = frame

	-- Title
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 28)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 12)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = data.title
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 18
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.ZIndex = 11
	title.Parent = frame

	-- Body
	local body = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 20)
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 40)
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Text = data.body
	body.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	body.TextSize = 14
	body.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 215, 235)
	body.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	body.ZIndex = 11
	body.Parent = frame

	-- Close button
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32)
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 24)
	closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 80)
	closeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	closeBtn.Text = "✕"
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeBtn.TextSize = 14
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	closeBtn.ZIndex = 11
	closeBtn.Parent = frame

	local closeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	closeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	closeCorner.Parent = closeBtn

	closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		self:Dismiss(data.id)
	end)

	-- Entrance animation
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -100)
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(self.config.animationDuration, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	}):Play()

	if data.autoDismiss then
		task.delay(data.autoDismiss, function()
			self:Dismiss(data.id)
		end)
	end

	return frame
end

function Banner:Dismiss(id)
	for i, banner in ipairs(self.activeBanners) do
		if banner.id == id then
			local frame = banner.frame
			game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {
				Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -100),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1
			}):Play()
			task.wait(0.3)
			frame:Destroy()
			table.remove(self.activeBanners, i)
			break
		end
	end
end

function Banner:Clear()
	for _, banner in self.activeBanners do
		banner.frame:Destroy()
	end
	self.activeBanners = {}
end

function Banner:Destroy()
	self:Clear()
	self.gui:Destroy()
end

return Banner

--// State

local hideToken = 0
local visibleActions = {
	Pet = true, Inventory = true, Stop = true, Follow = true, Sit = true,
	Sleep = true, Jump = true, Fly = true, Feed = true, Attack = true,
	Scavenge = true,
}

local stateColors = {
	Stop = {bg = THEME.Danger, text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 200)},
	Follow = {bg = THEME.Success, text = Color3.fromRGB(220, 255, 230)},
	Sit = {bg = THEME.Care, text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 180)},

}

	currentPetId = data.petId or currentPetId
	title.Text = string.upper(tostring(data.petName or "PET"))

	moodFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(mood / 100, 1)
	hungerFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(hunger / 100, 1)
	moodValue.Text = math.floor(mood) .. "%"
	hungerValue.Text = math.floor(hunger) .. "%"

	moodFill.BackgroundColor3 = moodColor

	local targetBtn = buttonMap[state]
	if targetBtn then

	end

	if not panel.Visible then
		panel.Visible = true
	end
	hideToken += 1
	local token = hideToken
	task.delay(12, function()
		if token == hideToken then
			tweenClose()
			task.wait(0.2)
			panel.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end

		if petFrame then

			local blocker = petFrame:FindFirstChild("SideFrameBlocker")

end)

--// Pet Needs Billboards (simplified)
local petNeedsBillboards = {}
local function createPetNeedsBillboard(pet)
	if not pet:IsA("Model") or petNeedsBillboards[pet] then return end
	local adornee = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet.PrimaryPart or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)

	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")

	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboard.LightInfluence = 0
	billboard.MaxDistance = 15
	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 70)
	billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, math.max(adornee.Size.Y + 2, 3.5), 0)
	billboard.Parent = pet

	local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
	bg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	bg.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Panel
	bg.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	bg.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bg.Parent = billboard

	local bgCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	bgCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	bgCorner.Parent = bg

	local outline = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	outline.Color = THEME.Stroke
	outline.Thickness = 1
	outline.Transparency = 0.3
	outline.Parent = bg

	local moodLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	moodLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 14)
	moodLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 6)
	moodLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	moodLabel.Text = "Mood 0%"
	moodLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	moodLabel.TextSize = 12
	moodLabel.TextColor3 = THEME.Warning
	moodLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	moodLabel.Parent = bg

	local hungerLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	hungerLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 14)
	hungerLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 26)
	hungerLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hungerLabel.Text = "Hunger 0%"
	hungerLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	hungerLabel.TextSize = 12
	hungerLabel.TextColor3 = THEME.Success
	hungerLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	hungerLabel.Parent = bg

	local function update()
		local mood = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Mood")) or 0, 0, 100)
		local hunger = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Hunger")) or 0, 0, 100)
		moodLabel.Text = "Mood  " .. math.floor(mood) .. "%"
		hungerLabel.Text = "Hunger  " .. math.floor(hunger) .. "%"
	end

	pet:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Mood"):Connect(update)
	pet:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Hunger"):Connect(update)
	pet.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
		if not parent then petNeedsBillboards[pet] = nil end
	end)
	petNeedsBillboards[pet] = billboard
	update()
end

local playerPets = workspace:WaitForChild("PlayerPets")
local function inspectPetFolder(folder)
	for _, pet in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do createPetNeedsBillboard(pet) end
	folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(pet) task.defer(createPetNeedsBillboard, pet) end)
end
for _, folder in ipairs(playerPets:GetChildren()) do
	if folder.Name == player.Name then inspectPetFolder(folder) end
end
playerPets.ChildAdded:Connect(function(folder)
	if folder.Name == player.Name then inspectPetFolder(folder) end
end)

local function refreshInteractionPanel()
	if currentPetId then
		local folder = playerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
		local pet = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(currentPetId)
		if pet then
			updatePetInfo({
				petId = pet.Name,
				petName = pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or pet.Name,
				mood = pet:GetAttribute("Mood"),
				hunger = pet:GetAttribute("Hunger"),
				state = pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or "Follow",
			})
		end
	end
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.delay(1, refreshInteractionPanel) end)
playerGui.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
	if child.Name == "GameUI" then task.defer(refreshInteractionPanel) end
end)

--!strict
-- ToastStack.lua
-- Manages a stack of toast notifications with smooth animations

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local ToastStack = {}
ToastStack.__index = ToastStack

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
	maxVisible = 3,
	animationDuration = 0.3,
	swipeToDismiss = true,
	position = "top-right",
	toastWidth = 350,
	toastHeight = 70,
	padding = 8,
}

function ToastStack.new(config)
	local self = setmetatable({}, ToastStack)
	self.config = setmetatable(config or {}, {__index = DEFAULT_CONFIG})
	self.toasts = {}
	self.container = nil
	self:_createContainer()
	return self
end

function ToastStack:_createContainer()
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "ToastStack"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.DisplayOrder = 200
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.Parent = playerGui

	local container = Instance.new("Frame")
	container.Name = "Container"
	container.Size = UDim2.new(0, self.config.toastWidth, 1, -20)
	container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
	container.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -10)
	container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	container.Parent = gui

	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, self.config.padding)
	layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
	layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
	layout.Parent = container

	self.container = container
	self.gui = gui
end

function ToastStack:Push(data)
	data.id = data.id or game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false)
	data.autoDismiss = data.autoDismiss or 8
	data.timestamp = os.time()

	-- Remove oldest if at capacity
	if #self.toasts >= self.config.maxVisible then
		self:Pop()
	end

	local toast = self:_createToast(data)
	toast.Parent = self.container
	table.insert(self.toasts, 1, {id = data.id, frame = toast, data = data})

	if data.autoDismiss then
		task.delay(data.autoDismiss, function()
			self:Dismiss(data.id)
		end)
	end

	return data.id
end

function ToastStack:_createToast(data)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "Toast_" .. data.id
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, self.config.toastHeight)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 26, 38)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.ClipsDescendants = true

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	corner.Parent = frame

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
	stroke.Thickness = 1.5
	stroke.Transparency = 0.4
	stroke.Parent = frame

	-- Icon
	local icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36)
	icon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 17)
	icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	icon.Image = data.icon or ""
	icon.Parent = frame

	-- Title
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 24)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 8)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = data.title
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 14
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 245, 255)
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Parent = frame

	-- Body
	local body = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 18)
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 32)
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Text = data.body
	body.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	body.TextSize = 12
	body.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 195, 220)
	body.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	body.TextWrapped = true
	body.Parent = frame

	-- Progress bar
	if data.autoDismiss then
		local progress = Instance.new("Frame")
		progress.Name = "Progress"
		progress.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3)
		progress.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
		progress.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		progress.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 140, 220)
		progress.BorderSizePixel = 0
		progress.Parent = frame

		local progressTween = game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(progress, TweenInfo.new(data.autoDismiss, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
		})
		progressTween:Play()
	end

	-- Close button
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 4)
	closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeBtn.Text = "✕"
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeBtn.TextSize = 12
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 165, 190)
	closeBtn.Parent = frame

	closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		self:Dismiss(data.id)
	end)

	-- Swipe to dismiss
	if self.config.swipeToDismiss then
		local startX = 0
		frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				startX = input.Position.X
			end
		end)

		frame.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				local deltaX = input.Position.X - startX
				if deltaX > 80 then
					self:Dismiss(data.id)
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	-- Entrance animation
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(1, 400, 0, 0)
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(self.config.animationDuration, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	}):Play()

	return frame
end

function ToastStack:Dismiss(id)
	for i, toast in ipairs(self.toasts) do
		if toast.id == id then
			local frame = toast.frame
			game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
				Position = UDim2.new(1, 400, 0, 0),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1
			}):Play()
			task.wait(0.2)
			frame:Destroy()
			table.remove(self.toasts, i)
			break
		end
	end
end

function ToastStack:Pop()
	if #self.toasts > 0 then
		self:Dismiss(self.toasts[#self.toasts].id)
	end
end

function ToastStack:Clear()
	for _, toast in self.toasts do
		toast.frame:Destroy()
	end
	self.toasts = {}
end

function ToastStack:Destroy()
	self:Clear()
	self.gui:Destroy()
end

return ToastStack

--// Codes Handler
-- View the hardcoded codes table.

local CodesHandler = {}

function CodesHandler.ListCodes()
	-- Read the codes from the CodesHandler script source
	-- We replicate the same table here for the dashboard to display
	local Codes = {
		["100CASH"] = {100, "Currency"},
		["100DIAMONDS"] = {100, "Diamonds"},
		["3REBIRTHS"] = {3, "Rebirths"},
		["Scarecrow"] = {"Pumpkin"},
	}

	local Result = {}
	for Code, Reward in pairs(Codes) do
		local IsPet = type(Reward[1]) == "string"
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			code = Code,
			rewardType = IsPet and "pet" or "currency",
			rewardValue = Reward[1],
			rewardTarget = Reward[2] or nil,
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.code < B.code end)
	return Result
end

return CodesHandler

local AdminFunctions = {}

function AdminFunctions.IsPlayerAdmin(Player, AdminList) -- checks if user is allowed to use commands
	if table.find(AdminList, Player.UserId) then return true end -- In table
	
	local IsGroupGame = game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.Group
	local CreatorId = game.CreatorId

	if IsGroupGame then
		return Player:GetRankInGroup(CreatorId) >= ADMINRANK

	end
end

		end

end

--!strict
-- Chart.lua
-- Price history chart rendering using CanvasDraw-like approach with UI frames

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Chart = {}
Chart.__index = Chart

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
	width = 400,
	height = 200,
	margin = {top = 20, right = 20, bottom: 30, left = 50},
	gridColor = Color3.fromRGB(40, 50, 70),
	gridStrokeTransparency = 0.5,
	lineColor = Color3.fromRGB(80, 170, 255),
	lineThickness = 2,
	fillColor = Color3.fromRGB(80, 170, 255),
	fillTransparency = 0.85,
	pointColor = Color3.fromRGB(80, 170, 255),
	pointRadius = 4,
	textColor = Color3.fromRGB(160, 175, 200),
	textSize = 11,
	font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
	animationDuration = 0.5,
}

function Chart.new(parent, config)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Chart)
	self.config = setmetatable(config or {}, {__index = DEFAULT_CONFIG})
	self.frame = nil
	self.canvas = nil
	self.points = {}
	self:_createFrame(parent)
	return self
end

function Chart:_createFrame(parent)
	self.frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	self.frame.Name = "PriceChart"
	self.frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.width, self.config.height)
	self.frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 30)
	self.frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	self.frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	self.frame.Parent = parent

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = self.frame

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 80, 110)
	stroke.Thickness = 1
	stroke.Transparency = 0.5
	stroke.Parent = self.frame

	-- Canvas for drawing
	self.canvas = Instance.new("Frame")
	self.canvas.Name = "Canvas"
	self.canvas.Size = UDim2.new(1, -self.config.margin.left - self.config.margin.right, 1, -self.config.margin.top - self.config.margin.bottom)
	self.canvas.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.margin.left, self.config.margin.top)
	self.canvas.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	self.canvas.ClipsDescendants = true
	self.canvas.Parent = self.frame

	-- Y-axis labels container
	self.yLabels = Instance.new("Frame")
	self.yLabels.Name = "YLabels"
	self.yLabels.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.margin.left - 5, self.config.height - self.config.margin.top - self.config.margin.bottom)
	self.yLabels.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, self.config.margin.top)
	self.yLabels.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	self.yLabels.Parent = self.frame

	-- X-axis labels container
	self.xLabels = Instance.new("Frame")
	self.xLabels.Name = "XLabels"
	self.xLabels.Size = UDim2.new(1, -self.config.margin.left - self.config.margin.right, 0, 20)
	self.xLabels.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.margin.left, self.config.height - self.config.margin.bottom)
	self.xLabels.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	self.xLabels.Parent = self.frame

	-- Chart title
	self.titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	self.titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 20)
	self.titleLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 2)
	self.titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	self.titleLabel.Text = ""
	self.titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	self.titleLabel.TextSize = 14
	self.titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 215, 235)
	self.titleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	self.titleLabel.Parent = self.frame

	-- Stats panel
	self.statsFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
	self.statsFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30)
	self.statsFrame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -35)
	self.statsFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	self.statsFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	self.statsFrame.Parent = self.frame

	local statsLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	statsLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	statsLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
	statsLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 15)
	statsLayout.Parent = self.statsFrame
end

function Chart:SetTitle(title: string)
	self.titleLabel.Text = title
end

function Chart:SetData(points: {{x: number, y: number, timestamp: number}})
	-- points: array of {x (timestamp), y (price), timestamp}
	-- x can be sequential index or timestamp
	self.points = points
	self:_render()
end

function Chart:_render()
	if #self.points < 2 then return end

	-- Clear existing
	for _, child in self.canvas:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("Frame") or child:IsA("ImageLabel") then child:Destroy() end
	end
	for _, child in self.yLabels:GetChildren() do child:Destroy() end
	for _, child in self.xLabels:GetChildren() do child:Destroy() end
	for _, child in self.statsFrame:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("TextLabel") then child:Destroy() end
	end

	-- Calculate bounds
	local minY = math.huge
	local maxY = -math.huge
	for _, p in self.points do
		minY = math.min(minY, p.y)
		maxY = math.max(maxY, p.y)
	end

	local padding = (maxY - minY) * 0.1
	if padding == 0 then padding = maxY * 0.1 end
	minY = minY - padding
	maxY = maxY + padding

	local chartWidth = self.config.width - self.config.margin.left - self.config.margin.right
	local chartHeight = self.config.height - self.config.margin.top - self.config.margin.bottom

	-- Y-axis labels (5 ticks)
	for i = 0, 4 do
		local value = maxY - (maxY - minY) * (i / 4)
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.margin.left - 5, 20)
		label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, (i / 4) * chartHeight - 10)
		label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Text = self:_formatNumber(value)
		label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		label.TextSize = self.config.textSize
		label.TextColor3 = self.config.textColor
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
		label.Parent = self.yLabels
	end

	-- Draw grid lines
	for i = 0, 4 do
		local y = (i / 4) * chartHeight
		local line = Instance.new("Frame")
		line.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1)
		line.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y)
		line.BackgroundColor3 = self.config.gridColor
		line.BackgroundTransparency = self.config.gridStrokeTransparency
		line.BorderSizePixel = 0
		line.ZIndex = 1
		line.Parent = self.canvas
	end

	-- Calculate points
	local screenPoints = {}
	for i, p in ipairs(self.points) do
		local x = (i - 1) / (#self.points - 1) * chartWidth
		local y = (1 - (p.y - minY) / (maxY - minY)) * chartHeight
		table.insert(screenPoints, {x = x, y = y, value = p.y, timestamp = p.timestamp})
	end

	-- Draw fill area
	if #screenPoints >= 2 then
		-- Create fill using multiple rectangles (approximation)
		for i = 1, #screenPoints - 1 do
			local p1 = screenPoints[i]
			local p2 = screenPoints[i + 1]
			local width = p2.x - p1.x
			local avgY = (p1.y + p2.y) / 2
			local height = chartHeight - avgY

			local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
			fill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
			fill.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p1.x, avgY)
			fill.BackgroundColor3 = self.config.fillColor
			fill.BackgroundTransparency = self.config.fillTransparency
			fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
			fill.ZIndex = 2
			fill.Parent = self.canvas
		end
	end

	-- Draw line
	for i = 1, #screenPoints - 1 do
		local p1 = screenPoints[i]
		local p2 = screenPoints[i + 1]
		
		local distance = math.sqrt((p2.x - p1.x)^2 + (p2.y - p1.y)^2)
		local angle = math.atan2(p2.y - p1.y, p2.x - p1.x)
		
		local line = Instance.new("Frame")
		line.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(distance, self.config.lineThickness)
		line.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p1.x, p1.y)
		line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		line.Rotation = math.deg(angle)
		line.BackgroundColor3 = self.config.lineColor
		line.BorderSizePixel = 0
		line.ZIndex = 3
		line.Parent = self.canvas
	end

	-- Draw points
	for i, p in ipairs(screenPoints) do
		local point = Instance.new("Frame")
		point.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.pointRadius * 2, self.config.pointRadius * 2)
		point.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.x - self.config.pointRadius, p.y - self.config.pointRadius)
		point.BackgroundColor3 = self.config.pointColor
		point.BorderSizePixel = 0
		point.ZIndex = 4
		point.Parent = self.canvas

		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		corner.Parent = point

		-- Hover tooltip
		point.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			self:_showTooltip(p)
		end)
		point.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			self:_hideTooltip()
		end)
	end

	-- X-axis labels (5 ticks)
	for i = 0, 4 do
		local idx = math.floor(i / 4 * (#self.points - 1)) + 1
		local p = self.points[idx]
		local x = (i / 4) * (self.config.width - self.config.margin.left - self.config.margin.right)
		
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 18)
		label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x - 40, 0)
		label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Text = os.date("%m/%d", p.timestamp)
		label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		label.TextSize = self.config.textSize - 1
		label.TextColor3 = self.config.textColor
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		label.Parent = self.xLabels
	end

	-- Stats panel
	if #self.points > 0 then
		local current = self.points[#self.points].y
		local change = #self.points > 1 and current - self.points[1].y or 0
		local changePct = self.points[1].y ~= 0 and (change / self.points[1].y * 100) or 0

		local stats = {
			{"Current", self:_formatPrice(current)},
			{"Change", string.format("%s%.2f%%", change >= 0 and "+" or "", changePct)},
			{"24h High", self:_formatPrice(math.max(table.unpack(self:_getYValues())))},
			{"24h Low", self:_formatPrice(math.min(table.unpack(self:_getYValues())))},
		}

		for _, stat in stats do
			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20)
			label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
			label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			label.Text = stat[1] .. ": " .. stat[2]
			label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
			label.TextSize = 11
			label.TextColor3 = stat[1] == "Change" and (change >= 0 and Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)) or Color3.fromRGB(160, 175, 200)
			label.Parent = self.statsFrame
		end
	end
end

function Chart:_getYValues()
	local values = {}
	for _, p in self.points do table.insert(values, p.y) end
	return values
end

function Chart:_formatNumber(num: number): string
	if num >= 1e9 then return string.format("%.1fB", num / 1e9)
	elseif num >= 1e6 then return string.format("%.1fM", num / 1e6)
	elseif num >= 1e3 then return string.format("%.1fK", num / 1e3)
	else return string.format("%.0f", num) end
end

function Chart:_formatPrice(num: number): string
	return self:_formatNumber(num)
end

function Chart:_showTooltip(point)
	-- Tooltip implementation
end

function Chart:_hideTooltip()
	-- Hide tooltip
end

function Chart:Update(points)
	self.points = points
	self:_render()
end

function Chart:Destroy()
	self.frame:Destroy()
end

return Chart
