--!strict
-- TalentPanel.lua
-- Pet talent inspection and re-roll UI

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local TalentPanel = {}
TalentPanel.__index = TalentPanel

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local TalentEngine = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.TalentEngine)

local DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
	width = 400,
	height = 500,
	animationDuration = 0.3,
}

function TalentPanel.new(config)
	local self = setmetatable({}, TalentPanel)
	self.config = setmetatable(config or {}, {__index = DEFAULT_CONFIG})
	self.gui = nil
	self.currentPet = nil
	self.slotFrames = {}
	return self
end

function TalentPanel:_createGui()
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "TalentPanel"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.DisplayOrder = 220
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.Parent = playerGui

	local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
	panel.Name = "Panel"
	panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.width, self.config.height)
	panel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 18, 28)
	panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
	panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
	panel.Visible = false
	panel.Parent = gui

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
	corner.Parent = panel

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Transparency = 0.3
	stroke.Parent = panel

	local panelScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	panelScale.Scale = 0.85
	panelScale.Parent = panel

	local function tweenOpen()
		game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(panelScale, TweenInfo.new(self.config.animationDuration, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
	end

	local function tweenClose()
		game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(panelScale, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Scale = 0.85}):Play()
	end

	panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if panel.Visible then tweenOpen() else tweenClose() end
	end)

	-- Header
	local header = Instance.new("Frame")
	header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60)
	header.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 30)
	header.BorderSizePixel = 0
	header.Parent = panel

	local headerCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	headerCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
	headerCorner.Parent = header

	local headerStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	headerStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
	headerStroke.Thickness = 1
	headerStroke.Transparency = 0.3
	headerStroke.Parent = header

	-- Close button
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32)
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 14)
	closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 80)
	closeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	closeBtn.Text = "✕"
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeBtn.TextSize = 16
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	closeBtn.Parent = header

	local closeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	closeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	closeCorner.Parent = closeBtn

	closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		self:Close()
	end)

	-- Title
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 1, 0)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 0)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = "PET TALENTS"
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 20
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Parent = header

	-- Talent slots container
	local slotsContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
	slotsContainer.Name = "SlotsContainer"
	slotsContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, -80)
	slotsContainer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 70)
	slotsContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	slotsContainer.Parent = panel

	local slotsLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	slotsLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 16)
	slotsLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	slotsLayout.Parent = slotsContainer

	self.panel = panel
	self.panelScale = panelScale
	self.slotsContainer = slotsContainer
	self.gui = gui
end

function TalentPanel:Open(petData)
	if not self.gui then self:_createGui() end
	
	self.currentPet = petData
	self.panel.Visible = true
	self:_renderTalents(petData)
end

function TalentPanel:_renderTalents(petData)
	for _, child in self.slotsContainer:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("Frame") then child:Destroy() end
	end
	self.slotFrames = {}

	local talents = petData.Talents or {}
	
	for slotIndex, slot in ipairs(talents) do
		local talent = TalentEngine.GetTalent(slot.id)
		local frame = self:_createTalentSlot(slotIndex, talent, slot)
		frame.Parent = self.slotsContainer
		self.slotFrames[slotIndex] = frame
	end

	-- Reroll info
	if #talents > 0 then
		local infoFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
		infoFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
		infoFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		infoFrame.Parent = self.slotsContainer

		local infoText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		infoText.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		infoText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		infoText.Text = "Select a slot to re-roll • Locked slots cannot be re-rolled"
		infoText.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		infoText.TextSize = 12
		infoText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 175, 200)
		infoText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		infoText.Parent = infoFrame
	end
end

function TalentPanel:_createTalentSlot(slotIndex, talent, slot)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "TalentSlot_" .. slotIndex
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 100)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 26, 38)
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
	corner.Parent = frame

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 80, 110)
	stroke.Thickness = 1
	stroke.Transparency = 0.5
	stroke.Parent = frame

	if not talent then
		-- Empty slot
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Text = "Empty Slot " .. slotIndex
		label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		label.TextSize = 14
		label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 120, 150)
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		label.Parent = frame
		return frame
	end

	-- Tier badge
	local tierColors = {
		[1] = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150),
		[2] = Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 100),
		[3] = Color3.fromRGB(100, 150, 255),
		[4] = Color3.fromRGB(200, 100, 255),
		[5] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50),
	}

	local tierBadge = Instance.new("Frame")
	tierBadge.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 24)
	tierBadge.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12)
	tierBadge.BackgroundColor3 = tierColors[talent.tier] or Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
	tierBadge.BorderSizePixel = 0
	tierBadge.Parent = frame

	local tierBadgeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	tierBadgeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	tierBadgeCorner.Parent = tierBadge

	local tierLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	tierLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	tierLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	tierLabel.Text = "T" .. talent.tier
	tierLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	tierLabel.TextSize = 12
	tierLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	tierLabel.Parent = tierBadge

	-- Category icon
	local iconLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	iconLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
	iconLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 12)
	iconLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	iconLabel.Text = self:_getCategoryIcon(talent.category)
	iconLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	iconLabel.TextSize = 16
	iconLabel.Parent = frame

	-- Talent name
	local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 24)
	nameLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 12)
	nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	nameLabel.Text = talent.name
	nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	nameLabel.TextSize = 16
	nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	nameLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	nameLabel.Parent = frame

	-- Description
	local descLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	descLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 30)
	descLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 36)
	descLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	descLabel.Text = talent.description
	descLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	descLabel.TextSize = 13
	descLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 195, 220)
	descLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	descLabel.TextWrapped = true
	descLabel.Parent = frame

	-- Lock toggle
	local lockBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	lockBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 32)
	lockBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0, 12)
	lockBtn.BackgroundColor3 = slot.locked and Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 80) or Color3.fromRGB(80, 180, 120)
	lockBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	lockBtn.Text = slot.locked and "UNLOCK" or "LOCK"
	lockBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	lockBtn.TextSize = 12
	lockBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	lockBtn.Parent = frame

	local lockCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	lockCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	lockCorner.Parent = lockBtn

	lockBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		local newLocked = not slot.locked
		slot.locked = newLocked
		lockBtn.Text = newLocked and "UNLOCK" or "LOCK"
		lockBtn.BackgroundColor3 = newLocked and Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 80) or Color3.fromRGB(80, 180, 120)
	end)

	-- Reroll button
	local rerollBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	rerollBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 32)
	rerollBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0, 52)
	rerollBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 140, 220)
	rerollBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	rerollBtn.Text = "REROLL"
	rerollBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	rerollBtn.TextSize = 12
	rerollBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	rerollBtn.Parent = frame

	local rerollCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	rerollCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	rerollCorner.Parent = rerollBtn

	if slot.locked then
		rerollBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
		rerollBtn.Text = "LOCKED"
	end

	rerollBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		if slot.locked then return end
		self:_requestReroll(slotIndex)
	end)

	-- Reroll cost label
	local cost = ReplicatedStorage.Modules.TalentEngine.GetRerollCost(petData, slotIndex, petData.Rarity or "Common")
	local costLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	costLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 20)
	costLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -92, 1, -22)
	costLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	costLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	costLabel.Text = "Cost: " .. cost .. " 💎"
	costLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	costLabel.TextSize = 11
	costLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 100)
	costLabel.Parent = frame

	return frame
end

function TalentPanel:_getCategoryIcon(category: string): string
	local icons = {
		Hatching = "🥚",
		Combat = "⚔️",
		Movement = "🏃",
		Economy = "💰",
		Utility = "🔧",
	}
	return icons[category] or "✨"
end

function TalentPanel:_requestReroll(slotIndex)
	if not self.currentPet then return end
	
	-- In practice, fire server remote
	local result = ReplicatedStorage.Modules.TalentEngine.RerollTalent(
		self.currentPet, slotIndex, self.currentPet.Rarity or "Common"
	)
	
	if result.success and result.newTalentId then
		-- Update local data
		self.currentPet.Talents[slotIndex].id = result.newTalentId
		self.currentPet.Talents[slotIndex].locked = false
		self:_renderTalents(self.currentPet)
	else
		-- Show error
	end
end

function TalentPanel:Close()
	if self.panel then
		self.panel.Visible = false
	end
end

function TalentPanel:Show(petData)
	if not self.gui then self:_createGui() end
	self:Open(petData)
end

function TalentPanel:Destroy()
	if self.gui then self.gui:Destroy() end
end

return TalentPanel

studioChanges.source:
--// Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

--// Loading
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
repeat task.wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil
if Player.Parent == nil then return end

--// Variables
local UI = Player.PlayerGui:WaitForChild("GameUI")
local Frames = UI.Frames
local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"]
local Utilities = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Utilities)
local Short = Utilities.Short

local RemoteFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("AuctionHouse")
local ListPetRemote = RemoteFolder:WaitForChild("ListPet")
local CancelRemote = RemoteFolder:WaitForChild("CancelListing")
local BuyRemote = RemoteFolder:WaitForChild("BuyPet")
local GetListingsRemote = RemoteFolder:WaitForChild("GetListings")
local GetMyListingsRemote = RemoteFolder:WaitForChild("GetMyListings")
local GetMailRemote = RemoteFolder:WaitForChild("GetMail")
local ClaimMailRemote = RemoteFolder:WaitForChild("ClaimMail")
local AuctionNotice = RemoteFolder:WaitForChild("AuctionNotice")

--// Theme
local Colors = {
	Background = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 38),
	Darker = Color3.fromRGB(21, 21, 27),
	Card = Color3.fromRGB(46, 46, 56),
	Accent = Color3.fromRGB(126, 96, 255),
	Green = Color3.fromRGB(90, 200, 90),
	Red = Color3.fromRGB(225, 70, 70),
	Text = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 245),
	Dim = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 175),
}

local FrameSize = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.62)

local function New(ClassName, Props, Parent)
	local Obj = Instance.new(ClassName)
	for Name, Value in Props do
		Obj[Name] = Value
	end
	if Parent then Obj.Parent = Parent end
	return Obj
end

local function Rounded(Obj, Radius)
	local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, Radius)
	Corner.Parent = Obj
end

local function Clear(Parent)
	for _, Child in Parent:GetChildren() do
		if Child:IsA("UIListLayout") or Child:IsA("UIGridLayout") then continue end
		Child:Destroy()
	end
end

--// Forward Declarations
local PageLabel
local RefreshBrowse, RefreshList, RefreshMyListings, RefreshInbox

--// Main Frame
local AuctionFrame = New("Frame", {
	Name = "AuctionHouse",
	Size = FrameSize,
	Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
	BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Background,
	Visible = false,
	ZIndex = 5,
})
AuctionFrame:SetAttribute("Keep", true)
Rounded(AuctionFrame, 14)
New("UIStroke", { Color = Colors.Darker, Thickness = 3 }, AuctionFrame)

local Title = New("TextLabel", {
	Text = "Auction House",
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextScaled = true,
	TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.02),
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.08),
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, AuctionFrame)

local Close = New("Frame", {
	Name = "Close",
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.07, 0.07),
	Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.02),
	BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Red,
	ZIndex = 6,
}, AuctionFrame)
Rounded(Close, 8)
New("TextButton", {
	Name = "Click",
	Text = "X",
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextScaled = true,
	TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
}, Close)
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(Close)

local TabsFrame = New("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.94, 0.1),
	Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.03, 0.13),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
}, AuctionFrame)
local TabLayout = New("UIListLayout", {
	FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
	HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
	SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
	Padding = UDim.new(0, 10),
}, TabsFrame)

local ContentFrame = New("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.94, 0.76),
	Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.03, 0.22),
	BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Darker,
}, AuctionFrame)
Rounded(ContentFrame, 12)

local Notice = New("TextLabel", {
	Text = "",
	Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
	TextScaled = false,
	TextSize = 18,
	TextColor3 = Colors.Green,
	BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
	BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
	Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.03, 0.94),
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.94, 0.05),
	Visible = false,
	ZIndex = 8,
}, AuctionFrame)
Rounded(Notice, 8)

local function ShowNotice(Text, Color)
	Notice.Text = Text
	Notice.TextColor3 = Color or Colors.Green
	Notice.TextTransparency = 0
	Notice.Visible = true

	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(2.2)
		Notice.Visible = false
		Notice.TextTransparency = 0
	end)
end

--// View Builder
local Views = {}

local function MakeScroll(Parent, Position, Size)
	local Scroll = New("ScrollingFrame", {
		Size = Size,
		Position = Position,
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		ScrollBarThickness = 5,
	}, Parent)
	New("UIListLayout", {
		Padding = UDim.new(0, 8),
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
	}, Scroll)
	return Scroll
end

local function SetupPetViewport(Viewport, PetName)
	local PetModel = ReplicatedStorage.Pets:FindFirstChild(PetName)
	if not PetModel then return end

	local Clone = PetModel:Clone()
	Clone.Parent = Viewport

	local MainPart = Clone:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	if not MainPart then
		MainPart = Clone:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart")
	end
	if not MainPart then return end

	local Camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	Viewport.CurrentCamera = Camera

	local Pos = MainPart.Position
	local Size = Clone:GetExtentsSize()
	Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(Pos.X + Size.X * 1.5, Pos.Y, Pos.Z + 1), Pos)
end

local function PetRarity(PetName)
	local Pet = ReplicatedStorage.Pets:FindFirstChild(PetName)
	if Pet and Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings") and Pet.Settings:FindFirstChild("Rarity") then
		return Pet.Settings.Rarity.Value
	end
	return "?"
end

--// Browse View
local BrowseView = New("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
}, ContentFrame)
Views.Browse = BrowseView

local BrowsePage = 1
local BrowseList = MakeScroll(BrowseView, UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.16), UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.84))

RefreshBrowse = function()
	Clear(BrowseList)
	local Data = GetListingsRemote:InvokeServer(BrowsePage)
	local TotalPages = math.max(1, math.ceil(Data.total / 12))
	PageLabel.Text = "Page " .. BrowsePage .. " / " .. TotalPages

	if #Data.listings == 0 then
		New("TextLabel", {
			Text = "No listings available.",
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Dim,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.1),
		}, BrowseList)
		return
	end

	for _, Listing in Data.listings do
		local Card = New("Frame", {
			LayoutOrder = Listing.timeLeft,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.3),
			BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Card,
		}, BrowseList)
		Rounded(Card, 10)

		local Viewport = New("ViewportFrame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.2, 1),
			BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Darker,
		}, Card)
		Rounded(Viewport, 8)
		SetupPetViewport(Viewport, Listing.petName)

		New("TextLabel", {
			Text = Listing.petName,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.24, 0.06),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.25),
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, Card)

		New("TextLabel", {
			Text = "Rarity: " .. PetRarity(Listing.petName),
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Dim,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.24, 0.34),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.2),
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, Card)

		New("TextLabel", {
			Text = "Gems: " .. Short.en(Listing.price),
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Accent,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.24, 0.6),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.3),
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, Card)

		New("TextLabel", {
			Text = "by " .. Listing.ownerName,
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Dim,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.56, 0.1),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.24, 0.25),
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, Card)

		New("TextLabel", {
			Text = "Time left: " .. Short.time(Listing.timeLeft),
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.56, 0.4),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.24, 0.25),
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, Card)

		if Listing.ownerId == Player.UserId then
			New("TextLabel", {
				Text = "Your listing",
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
				TextScaled = true,
				TextColor3 = Colors.Dim,
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.82, 0.3),
				Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.14, 0.4),
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
			}, Card)
		else
			local Buy = New("TextButton", {
				Text = "Buy",
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
				TextScaled = true,
				TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
				BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Green,
				Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.82, 0.3),
				Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.14, 0.4),
				AutoButtonColor = false,
			}, Card)
			Rounded(Buy, 8)
			Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(Buy)

			Buy.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				Buy.Text = "..."
				local Result = BuyRemote:InvokeServer(Listing.id)
				ShowNotice(Result, Result == "Purchased" and Colors.Green or Colors.Red)
				Buy.Text = "Buy"
				RefreshBrowse()
				RefreshInbox()
			end)
		end
	end
end

local function BrowseButton(Text, Position)
	local Btn = New("TextButton", {
		Text = Text,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
		BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Card,
		Position = Position,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 0.1),
		AutoButtonColor = false,
	}, BrowseView)
	Rounded(Btn, 8)
	Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(Btn)
	return Btn
end

local PrevPage = BrowseButton("Prev", UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0))
PageLabel = New("TextLabel", {
	Text = "Page 1 / 1",
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.64, 0),
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.2, 0.1),
}, BrowseView)
local NextPage = BrowseButton("Next", UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0))

PrevPage.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if BrowsePage > 1 then
		BrowsePage -= 1
		RefreshBrowse()
	end
end)

NextPage.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	BrowsePage += 1
	RefreshBrowse()
end)

--// List View
local ListView = New("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Visible = false,
}, ContentFrame)
Views.List = ListView

local SelectedPetId = nil
local SelectedPetName = nil
local PetList = MakeScroll(ListView, UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.12), UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.88))

local SelectedLabel = New("TextLabel", {
	Text = "No pet selected",
	Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
	TextColor3 = Colors.Dim,
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.63, 0.05),
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.34, 0.15),
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	TextWrapped = true,
}, ListView)

local PriceBox = New("TextBox", {
	Text = "",
	PlaceholderText = "Price in gems",
	Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
	TextScaled = true,
	TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
	PlaceholderColor3 = Colors.Dim,
	BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Card,
	Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.63, 0.28),
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.34, 0.14),
	ClearTextOnFocus = true,
}, ListView)
Rounded(PriceBox, 8)

local ListConfirm = New("TextButton", {
	Text = "List for 24h",
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextScaled = true,
	TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
	BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Accent,
	Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.63, 0.5),
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.34, 0.16),
	AutoButtonColor = false,
}, ListView)
Rounded(ListConfirm, 8)
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(ListConfirm)

RefreshList = function()
	Clear(PetList)
	local Count = 0
	for _, Pet in Player.Data.Pets:GetChildren() do
		if Pet.Equipped.Value then continue end

		local Card = New("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.26),
			BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Card,
		}, PetList)
		Rounded(Card, 10)

		local Viewport = New("ViewportFrame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.22, 1),
			BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Darker,
		}, Card)
		Rounded(Viewport, 8)
		SetupPetViewport(Viewport, Pet.PetName.Value)

		New("TextLabel", {
			Text = Pet.PetName.Value,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.2),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.4, 0.3),
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, Card)

		New("TextLabel", {
			Text = PetRarity(Pet.PetName.Value),
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Dim,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.55),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.4, 0.25),
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, Card)

		local SelectBtn = New("TextButton", {
			Text = "Select",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
			BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Accent,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.25),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.5),
			AutoButtonColor = false,
		}, Card)
		Rounded(SelectBtn, 8)
		Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(SelectBtn)

		SelectBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			SelectedPetId = tonumber(Pet.Name)
			SelectedPetName = Pet.PetName.Value
			SelectedLabel.Text = "Selected: " .. SelectedPetName
			SelectedLabel.TextColor3 = Colors.Accent
		end)
	end

	if Count == 0 then
		New("TextLabel", {
			Text = "No pets available to list.",
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Dim,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.1),
		}, PetList)
	end
end

ListConfirm.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local Price = tonumber(PriceBox.Text)
	if not SelectedPetId then
		ShowNotice("Select a pet first", Colors.Red)
		return
	end
	if not Price or Price < 1 then
		ShowNotice("Enter a valid price", Colors.Red)
		return
	end

	ListConfirm.Text = "..."
	local Result = ListPetRemote:InvokeServer(SelectedPetId, Price)
	if Result and Result ~= "" and Result ~= "Not loaded" and Result ~= "In a trade" and Result ~= "Slow down" and Result ~= "Invalid price" and Result ~= "Pet not found" and Result ~= "Unequip the pet first" and Result ~= "Max active listings" and Result ~= "Try again" and Result ~= "Invalid input" then
		local ListedName = SelectedPetName
		SelectedPetId = nil
		SelectedPetName = nil
		SelectedLabel.Text = "No pet selected"
		SelectedLabel.TextColor3 = Colors.Dim
		ShowNotice("Listed " .. ListedName .. " for " .. Price .. " gems", Colors.Green)
		PriceBox.Text = ""
		RefreshList()
		RefreshMyListings()
	else
		ShowNotice(Result or "Failed to list", Colors.Red)
	end
	ListConfirm.Text = "List for 24h"
end)

--// My Listings View
local MyListView = New("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Visible = false,
}, ContentFrame)
Views["My Listings"] = MyListView

local MyList = MakeScroll(MyListView, UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), UDim2.fromScale(1, 1))

RefreshMyListings = function()
	Clear(MyList)
	local List = GetMyListingsRemote:InvokeServer()

	if #List == 0 then
		New("TextLabel", {
			Text = "You have no active listings.",
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Dim,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.1),
		}, MyList)
		return
	end

	for _, Listing in List do
		local Card = New("Frame", {
			LayoutOrder = Listing.timeLeft,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.26),
			BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Card,
		}, MyList)
		Rounded(Card, 10)

		local Viewport = New("ViewportFrame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.22, 1),
			BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Darker,
		}, Card)
		Rounded(Viewport, 8)
		SetupPetViewport(Viewport, Listing.petName)

		New("TextLabel", {
			Text = Listing.petName,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.15),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.3),
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, Card)

		New("TextLabel", {
			Text = "Gems: " .. Short.en(Listing.price),
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Accent,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.3),
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, Card)

		New("TextLabel", {
			Text = "Time left: " .. Short.time(Listing.timeLeft),
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Dim,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.58, 0.15),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.2, 0.3),
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, Card)

		local Cancel = New("TextButton", {
			Text = "Cancel",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
			BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Red,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.82, 0.25),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.14, 0.5),
			AutoButtonColor = false,
		}, Card)
		Rounded(Cancel, 8)
		Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(Cancel)

		Cancel.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			local Result = CancelRemote:InvokeServer(Listing.id)
			ShowNotice(Result, Result == "Returned" and Colors.Green or Colors.Red)
			RefreshMyListings()
			RefreshInbox()
		end)
	end
end

--// Inbox View
local InboxView = New("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Visible = false,
}, ContentFrame)
Views.Inbox = InboxView

local InboxGems = New("TextLabel", {
	Text = "Pending gems: 0",
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextScaled = true,
	TextColor3 = Colors.Accent,
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.1),
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.2),
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, InboxView)

local InboxPets = New("TextLabel", {
	Text = "Pets to claim: 0",
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextScaled = true,
	TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.3),
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.2),
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
}, InboxView)

local InboxList = MakeScroll(InboxView, UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.5))

local ClaimBtn = New("TextButton", {
	Text = "Claim All",
	Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	TextScaled = true,
	TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
	BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Green,
	Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.35, 0.18),
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.12),
	AutoButtonColor = false,
}, InboxView)
Rounded(ClaimBtn, 8)
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(ClaimBtn)

RefreshInbox = function()
	local Mail = GetMailRemote:InvokeServer()
	InboxGems.Text = "Pending gems: " .. Short.en(Mail.gems)
	InboxPets.Text = "Pets to claim: " .. #Mail.pets

	Clear(InboxList)
	for _, Pet in Mail.pets do
		local Row = New("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.5),
			BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Card,
		}, InboxList)
		Rounded(Row, 8)
		New("TextLabel", {
			Text = Pet.petName,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.2),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.6),
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, Row)
	end

	if #Mail.pets == 0 then
		New("TextLabel", {
			Text = "No pets waiting.",
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextColor3 = Colors.Dim,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.4),
		}, InboxList)
	end
end

ClaimBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local Result = ClaimMailRemote:InvokeServer()
	if type(Result) == "table" then
		ShowNotice("Claimed " .. Result.gems .. " gems and " .. Result.granted .. " pets", Colors.Green)
	else
		ShowNotice(Result or "Failed to claim", Colors.Red)
	end
	RefreshInbox()
end)

--// Tabs
local Tabs = { "Browse", "List", "My Listings", "Inbox" }
local TabButtons = {}

local function ShowView(Name)
	for ViewName, View in Views do
		View.Visible = ViewName == Name
	end
	for _, TabButton in TabButtons do
		TabButton.BackgroundColor3 = TabButton.Name == Name and Colors.Accent or Colors.Card
	end
end

for _, TabName in Tabs do
	local TabButton = New("TextButton", {
		Name = TabName,
		Text = TabName,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
		BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Card,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.22, 0.9),
		LayoutOrder = #TabButtons,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
	}, TabsFrame)
	Rounded(TabButton, 8)
	Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(TabButton)
	TabButtons[#TabButtons + 1] = TabButton

	TabButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		ShowView(TabName)
	end)
end

AuctionFrame.Parent = Frames

--// Open / Close
local function RefreshAll()
	RefreshBrowse()
	RefreshList()
	RefreshMyListings()
	RefreshInbox()
end

Close.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	Utilities.ButtonHandler.OnClick(AuctionFrame, FrameSize)
end)

local ButtonSide = UI[GameSettings.ButtonSide.Value]
local ButtonTemplate = nil
for _, Child in ButtonSide.Buttons:GetChildren() do
	if Child:IsA("Frame") then
		ButtonTemplate = Child
		break
	end
end

local OpenButton
if ButtonTemplate then
	OpenButton = ButtonTemplate:Clone()
else
	OpenButton = New("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 0.08),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.9),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Accent,
	})
	New("TextButton", {
		Text = "Auction",
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
	}, OpenButton)
end

OpenButton.Name = "AuctionHouse"
OpenButton:SetAttribute("AuctionButton", true)

if OpenButton:FindFirstChild("Title") then
	OpenButton.Title.Text = "Auction"
end

--// Position: find the last existing button BEFORE parenting the clone,
-- otherwise the clone is its own "last child" and ends up overlapping it.
local HasLayout = ButtonSide.Buttons:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout") ~= nil
	or ButtonSide.Buttons:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGridLayout") ~= nil

local LastButton = nil
if not HasLayout then
	for _, Child in ButtonSide.Buttons:GetChildren() do
		if Child:IsA("Frame") then LastButton = Child end
	end
end

OpenButton.Parent = ButtonSide.Buttons
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(OpenButton)

if HasLayout then
	OpenButton.LayoutOrder = 999
elseif LastButton then
	OpenButton.Position = UDim2.new(LastButton.Position.X.Scale, LastButton.Position.X.Offset, LastButton.Position.Y.Scale + LastButton.Size.Y.Scale + 0.01, LastButton.Position.Y.Offset)
end

local OpenClick = OpenButton:FindFirstChild("Click") or OpenButton:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextButton")
if OpenClick then
	OpenClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Utilities.ButtonHandler.OnClick(AuctionFrame, FrameSize)
		RefreshAll()
	end)
end

--// Notifications
AuctionNotice.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(Kind, Value)
	if Kind == "sold" then
		if Value > 0 then
			ShowNotice("Your pet sold for " .. Short.en(Value) .. " gems!", Colors.Green)
		end
		RefreshInbox()
		RefreshMyListings()
	elseif Kind == "petReturned" then
		ShowNotice("An unsold pet was returned to you", Colors.Accent)
		RefreshInbox()
	elseif Kind == "listingsChanged" then
		if AuctionFrame.Visible then
			RefreshBrowse()
			RefreshMyListings()
		end
	end
end)

--// ============================================================
--// Admin Dashboard Client v4 — Premium Dark UI
--// Opens with /admin chat command. Server-verified.
--// ============================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TS = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

repeat task.wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil
if Player.Parent == nil then return end

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 15)
if not Remotes then return end
local RF = Remotes:WaitForChild("AdminDashboard", 15)
if not RF then return end
local AdminCheck = RF:WaitForChild("AdminCheck", 10)
local AdminRemote = RF:WaitForChild("AdminRemote", 10)
if not AdminCheck or not AdminRemote then return end
local AdminNotify = RF:WaitForChild("AdminNotify", 10)

local OK, IsAdmin = pcall(function() return AdminCheck:InvokeServer() end)
if not OK or not IsAdmin then return end

--// ============================================================
--// Theme
--// ============================================================
local Th = {
	Bg          = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 18),
	Surface     = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 28),
	Surface2    = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 32),
	Card        = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 38),
	CardHover   = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 50),
	Input       = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 24),
	Accent      = Color3.fromRGB(108, 72, 220),
	AccentHover = Color3.fromRGB(130, 94, 240),
	AccentDim   = Color3.fromRGB(60, 38, 140),
	Green       = Color3.fromRGB(40, 190, 90),
	GreenDim    = Color3.fromRGB(24, 110, 52),
	Red         = Color3.fromRGB(220, 55, 55),
	RedHover    = Color3.fromRGB(240, 75, 75),
	RedDim      = Color3.fromRGB(140, 35, 35),
	Orange      = Color3.fromRGB(240, 170, 40),
	Yellow      = Color3.fromRGB(235, 210, 60),
	Text        = Color3.fromRGB(225, 225, 235),
	Sub         = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 165),
	Muted       = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 100),
	Border      = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 48),
	BorderLight = Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 60),
	Online      = Color3.fromRGB(40, 200, 100),
	Offline     = Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 110),
}

--// ============================================================
--// Helpers
--// ============================================================
local function Inst(Class: string, Props: {[string]: any}, Parent: Instance?): Instance
	local I = Instance.new(Class)
	for K, V in pairs(Props) do I[K] = V end
	if Parent then I.Parent = Parent end
	return I
end

local function RC(F, R) Inst("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R or 6)}, F) end
local function RS(F, Col) Inst("UIStroke", {Color = Col or Th.Border, Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.3}, F) end
local function RP(F, T, B, L, R)
	Inst("UIPadding", {
		PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, T or 4),
		PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, B or 4),
		PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, L or 6),
		PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, R or 6),
	}, F)
end

local function Lbl(P, Text, Col, Sz, Pos)
	local L = Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Col or Th.Text, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = Sz or UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 16),
		Position = Pos or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
	}, P)
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 14}, L)
	return L
end

local function Btn(P, Text, Fn, Col, Sz, Pos)
	local BC = Col or Th.Accent
	local B = Inst("TextButton", {
		Text = Text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text, BackgroundColor3 = BC,
		AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = Sz or UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 28),
		Position = Pos or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
	}, P)
	RC(B, 6)
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 12}, B)
	B.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = BC:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.15)}):Play()
	end)
	B.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = BC}):Play()
	end)
	if Fn then B.MouseButton1Click:Connect(Fn) end
	return B
end

local function Txt(P: Instance, Ph: string?, Sz: UDim2?, Pos: UDim2?): TextBox
	local B = Inst("TextBox", {
		PlaceholderText = Ph or "", Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text, PlaceholderColor3 = Th.Muted,
		BackgroundColor3 = Th.Input, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ClearTextOnFocus = false,
		Size = Sz or UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0, 28),
		Position = Pos or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
	}, P) :: TextBox
	RC(B, 6)
	RP(B, 2, 2, 8, 8)
	RS(B)
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 12}, B)
	return B
end

local function Scr(P, Sz, Pos)
	local S = Inst("ScrollingFrame", {
		Size = Sz or UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		Position = Pos or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ScrollBarThickness = 2,
		ScrollBarImageColor3 = Th.AccentDim,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
	}, P)
	Inst("UIListLayout", {SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)}, S)
	RP(S, 4, 4, 4, 4)
	return S
end

local function Card(P, H, Ord)
	local F = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, H or 36),
		BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		LayoutOrder = Ord or 0,
	}, P)
	RC(F, 6)
	RS(F, Th.Border)
	return F
end

local function StatCard(P, Title, Value, Ord)
	local F = Card(P, 46, Ord)
	RP(F, 6, 6, 10, 10)
	Lbl(F, Title, Th.Sub, UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, 11), UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.06))
	Lbl(F, tostring(Value), Th.Text, UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, 16), UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.44))
	return F
end

local function ARow(P, Title, Ph, Btns, Ord)
	local F = Card(P, 40, Ord)
	RP(F, 4, 4, 8, 8)
	Lbl(F, Title, Th.Text, UDim2.new(0.28, 0, 0, 13), UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.1))
	local Box = Txt(F, Ph, UDim2.new(0.26, 0, 0, 28), UDim2.fromScale(0.32, 0.08))
	local N = #Btns
	local Gap = 4
	local BW = (0.34 * F.AbsoluteSize.X - Gap * (N - 1)) / N
	BW = math.max(BW / F.AbsoluteSize.X, 0.08)
	local X = 0.62
	for _, S in Btns do
		local LS = S
		Btn(F, LS.text, function() LS.click(Box) end, LS.color, UDim2.new(BW, -2, 0, 28), UDim2.new(X, 0, 0.06, 0))
		X += BW + Gap / F.AbsoluteSize.X
	end
	return F, Box
end

local function DangerRow(P, Title, Fn, Ord)
	local F = Card(P, 36, Ord)
	RP(F, 4, 4, 8, 8)
	Btn(F, Title, function() Fn(F) end, Th.Red, UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 0, 26), UDim2.new(0.32, 0, 0.08, 0))
	return F
end

local function SectionHdr(P, Text, Ord)
	Lbl(P, Text, Th.Accent, UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 20), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)).LayoutOrder = Ord or 0
end

local function EmptyState(P, Icon, Title, Desc)
	local Holder = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		LayoutOrder = 0,
	}, P)
	Inst("UIListLayout", {
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
		VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
		Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
	}, Holder)
	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Icon, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 30,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Th.Muted,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36), LayoutOrder = 1,
	}, Holder)
	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Title, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 14,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Th.Sub,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), LayoutOrder = 2,
	}, Holder)
	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Desc, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 11,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Th.Muted,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.75, 0, 0, 16), LayoutOrder = 3,
		TextWrapped = true,
	}, Holder)
	return Holder
end

--// ============================================================
--// Toast
--// ============================================================
local ToastId = 0
local function Toast(Msg, Type)
	ToastId += 1
	local MyId = ToastId
	local Col = Type == "error" and Th.Red or Type == "warning" and Th.Orange or Th.Green
	local Icon = Type == "error" and "✕  " or Type == "warning" and "⚠  " or "✓  "

	local T = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 38),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, -0.08, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Th.Surface,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ZIndex = 600,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	}, SG)
	RC(T, 8)
	RS(T, Col)

	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Icon .. tostring(Msg), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = Col, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.new(0.04, 0, 0.15, 0),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		ZIndex = 601,
	}, T)

	TS:Create(T, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.04, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0}):Play()
	task.delay(3, function()
		if ToastId == MyId then
			TS:Create(T, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, -0.08, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
			task.delay(0.3, function() T:Destroy() end)
		end
	end)
end

--// ============================================================
--// Confirm Modal
--// ============================================================
local function Confirm(Title, Msg, BtnText, Callback)
	local Overlay = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
		ZIndex = 500,
	}, SG)

	local Modal = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 340, 0, 190),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ZIndex = 501,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	}, Overlay)
	RC(Modal, 12)
	RS(Modal, Th.BorderLight)

	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Title, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 16,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 24), Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 502,
	}, Modal)

	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Msg, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = Th.Sub, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 50), Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 46),
		TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, ZIndex = 502,
	}, Modal)

	local CancelBtn = Inst("TextButton", {
		Text = "Cancel", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text, BackgroundColor3 = Th.Border,
		AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 34), Position = UDim2.new(1, -184, 1, -54),
		ZIndex = 502,
	}, Modal)
	RC(CancelBtn, 6)

	local ConfirmBtn = Inst("TextButton", {
		Text = BtnText or "Confirm", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text, BackgroundColor3 = Th.Red,
		AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 34), Position = UDim2.new(1, -96, 1, -54),
		ZIndex = 502,
	}, Modal)
	RC(ConfirmBtn, 6)

	local function Close()
		TS:Create(Modal, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
		TS:Create(Overlay, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
		task.delay(0.2, function() Overlay:Destroy() end)
	end

	CancelBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(Close)
	ConfirmBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Callback()
		Close()
	end)

	TS:Create(Modal, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart), {BackgroundTransparency = 0}):Play()
end

--// ============================================================
--// Remote wrappers
--// ============================================================
local function Req(Action, ...)
	local A = table.pack(...)
	local OK, R, M = pcall(function() return AdminRemote:InvokeServer(Action, table.unpack(A)) end)
	if not OK then Toast("Error: " .. tostring(R), "error") return nil end
	if type(R) == "string" then Toast(M or R, R:find("Error") and "error" or "success")
	elseif type(R) == "boolean" and M then Toast(M, R and "success" or "error") end
	return R
end

local function ReqS(Action, ...)
	local A = table.pack(...)
	local OK, R = pcall(function() return AdminRemote:InvokeServer(Action, table.unpack(A)) end)
	return OK and R or nil
end

--// ============================================================
--// Main Window
--// ============================================================
local SG = Inst("ScreenGui", {
	Name = "AdminDashboard", ResetOnSpawn = false,
	ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
	DisplayOrder = 100, IgnoreGuiInset = true,
}, Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))

local WIN_W, WIN_H = 840, 540
local SideW = 144

local Main = Inst("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.new(0, WIN_W, 0, WIN_H),
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
	Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
	BackgroundColor3 = Th.Bg,
	BorderSizePixel = 0,
	Visible = false,
}, SG)
RC(Main, 12)
RS(Main, Th.Border)

-- Title bar
local TitleH = 38
local TitleBar = Inst("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, TitleH),
	BackgroundColor3 = Th.Surface,
	BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, Main)
RC(TitleBar, 12)

Inst("TextLabel", {
	Text = "⚡ Admin Panel", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 15,
	TextColor3 = Th.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, 18), Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 0),
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
	ZIndex = 2,
}, TitleBar)

Inst("TextLabel", {
	Text = "v4.0", Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 11,
	TextColor3 = Th.Muted, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 2),
	ZIndex = 2,

--// ============================================================
--// Tab System
--// ============================================================
local Tabs = {}
local TabSide = {}
local TabRefresh = {}
local CurTab = "Players"
local TabBtns = {}

local function ShowTab(Name)
	CurTab = Name
	for N, F in pairs(Tabs) do F.Visible = (N == Name) end
	for N, F in pairs(TabSide) do F.Visible = (N == Name) end
	for N, B in pairs(TabBtns) do
		if N == Name then
			B.BackgroundColor3 = Th.Accent
			B.TextColor3 = Th.Text
		else
			B.BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card
			B.TextColor3 = Th.Sub
		end
	end
	if TabRefresh[Name] then pcall(TabRefresh[Name]) end
end

local TabOrder = 0
local function AddTab(Name, Ord)
	TabOrder += 1
	local OrdVal = Ord or TabOrder

	local B = Inst("TextButton", {
		Text = Name, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Th.Sub, BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card,
		AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, 30),
		LayoutOrder = OrdVal,
	}, TabBar)
	RC(B, 6)
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 11}, B)
	B.Name = Name
	TabBtns[Name] = B

	B.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		if CurTab ~= Name then
			TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {BackgroundColor3 = Th.CardHover}):Play()
		end
	end)
	B.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		if CurTab ~= Name then
			TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card}):Play()
		end
	end)
	B.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() ShowTab(Name) end)

	local S = Scr(Content, UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0))
	S.Visible = false
	Tabs[Name] = S
	return S
end

--// Clear helper
local function Clear(P: Instance?)
	if not P then return end
	for _, Child in P:GetChildren() do
		if not Child:IsA("UIListLayout") and not Child:IsA("UIPadding") and not Child:IsA("UICorner") and not Child:IsA("UIStroke") then
			Child:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

--[[
  VisualFeedbackHandler
  Location: StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts
  Setup:
  1. Create a RemoteEvent in ReplicatedStorage.Remotes named "CollectEvent"
  2. Ensure a ParticleEmitter is parented to a TemplatePart inside ReplicatedStorage or a custom folder.
]]

local CONFIG = {
	BURST_COUNT = 15,
	LIFETIME = 1.5,
	COLOR_SEQUENCE = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
	PART_NAME = "CollectionBurstTemplate"
}

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local CollectEvent = Remotes:WaitForChild("CollectEvent") :: RemoteEvent

-- Cache the particle template for performance
local function createBurstTemplate(): ParticleEmitter
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Name = CONFIG.PART_NAME
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.0)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Color = CONFIG.COLOR_SEQUENCE
	emitter.Enabled = false
	return emitter
end

local BURST_TEMPLATE = createBurstTemplate()

--[[
  Plays the visual feedback at a specific position.
]]
local function playCollectionBurst(position: Vector3)
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		local container = Instance.new("Part")
		container.Anchored = true
		container.CanCollide = false
		container.Transparency = 1
		container.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
		container.Position = position
		container.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

		local emitter = BURST_TEMPLATE:Clone()
		emitter.Parent = container
		emitter:Emit(CONFIG.BURST_COUNT)

		-- Schedule cleanup to prevent memory leaks
		Debris:AddItem(container, CONFIG.LIFETIME)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("[VisualFeedback] Failed to render burst: ", result)
	end
end

-- Listen for server-confirmed collections
local connection = CollectEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(position: Vector3)
	if typeof(position) == "Vector3" then
		playCollectionBurst(position)
	end
end)

-- Memory Management on script destruction
local function onAncestryChanged()
	if not script:IsDescendantOf(game) then
		connection:Disconnect()
		BURST_TEMPLATE:Destroy()
	end
end

script.AncestryChanged:Connect(onAncestryChanged)

print("⚡ [Squeeze Studio] VisualFeedbackHandler initialized.")

--// Players Handler
-- View player data, modify stats, kick, manage pets/gamepasses.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PlayersHandler = {}

function PlayersHandler.FindPlayer(Name)
	if type(Name) ~= "string" then return nil end
	Name = string.lower(Name)
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if string.lower(Player.Name) == Name or string.lower(Player.DisplayName) == Name then
			return Player
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function PlayersHandler.ListPlayers()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local Data = Player:FindFirstChild("Data")
		local PD = Data and Data:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Player.Name,
			displayName = Player.DisplayName,
			userId = Player.UserId,
			accountAge = Player.AccountAge,
			petCount = Data and Data:FindFirstChild("Pets") and #Data.Pets:GetChildren() or 0,
			currency = PD and PD.Currency.Value or 0,
			gems = PD and PD.Currency2.Value or 0,
			rebirths = PD and PD.Rebirth.Value or 0,
			zone = PD and PD.BestZone.Value or 0,
			eggsHatched = PD and PD.EggsHatched.Value or 0,
			totalCurrency = PD and PD.TotalCurrency.Value or 0,
			loaded = Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or false,
			isTrading = (function()
				local NSV = Data and Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues")
				return NSV and NSV:FindFirstChild("IsTrading") and NSV.IsTrading.Value or false
			end)(),
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
	return Result
end

function PlayersHandler.GetPlayerData(Player)
	if not Player or not Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then return nil end
	local Data = Player.Data
	local PD = Data.PlayerData
	local GP = Data.Gamepasses

	local Gamepasses = {}
	for _, Value in GP:GetChildren() do
		if Value:IsA("BoolValue") then
			Gamepasses[Value.Name] = Value.Value
		end
	end

	local Pets = {}
	for _, Pet in Data.Pets:GetChildren() do
		Pets[#Pets + 1] = {
			id = Pet.Name,
			name = Pet.PetName.Value,
			equipped = Pet.Equipped.Value,
		}
	end

	local AutoDelete = {}
	for _, AD in Data.AutoDelete:GetChildren() do
		if AD:IsA("BoolValue") then
			AutoDelete[AD.Name] = AD.Value
		end
	end

	local GemShop = {}
	local GemShopFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GemShop")
	if GemShopFolder then
		for _, Upgrade in GemShopFolder:GetChildren() do
			local Reward = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Reward")
			local Price = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Price")
			local MaxVal = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Max")
			local CurrentLevel = PD:FindFirstChild("GemUpgrade" .. Upgrade.Name)
			GemShop[#GemShop + 1] = {
				id = Upgrade.Name,
				name = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("UpgradeName") and Reward.UpgradeName.Value or ("Upgrade " .. Upgrade.Name),
				level = CurrentLevel and CurrentLevel.Value or 0,
				max = MaxVal and MaxVal.Value or 0,
			}
		end
	end

	return {
		name = Player.Name,
		displayName = Player.DisplayName,
		userId = Player.UserId,
		accountAge = Player.AccountAge,
		loaded = Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or false,
		isTrading = (function() local V = Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues") and Data.NonSaveValues:FindFirstChild("IsTrading"); return V and V.Value or false end)(),
		isOpeningEgg = (function() local V = Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues") and Data.NonSaveValues:FindFirstChild("IsOpeningEgg"); return V and V.Value or false end)(),
		petsEquipped = (function() local V = Data:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues") and Data.NonSaveValues:FindFirstChild("PetsEquipped"); return V and V.Value or 0 end)(),

		currency = PD.Currency.Value,
		gems = PD.Currency2.Value,
		rebirths = PD.Rebirth.Value,
		zone = PD.BestZone.Value,
		eggsHatched = PD.EggsHatched.Value,
		totalCurrency = PD.TotalCurrency.Value,
		gemUpgrade1 = PD.GemUpgrade1.Value,
		gemUpgrade2 = PD.GemUpgrade2.Value,

		music = PD.Music.Value,
		showOtherPets = PD.ShowOtherPets.Value,

		gamepasses = Gamepasses,
		pets = Pets,
		petCount = #Pets,
		autoDelete = AutoDelete,
		gemShop = GemShop,

		maxStorage = 50
			+ (Gamepasses.MoreStorage1 and 50 or 0)
			+ (Gamepasses.MoreStorage2 and 250 or 0),
		maxEquipped = 5
			+ (Gamepasses.MorePets1 and 3 or 0)
			+ (Gamepasses.MorePets2 and 10 or 0),
	}
end

function PlayersHandler.SetValue(Value, NewValue)
	if Value:IsA("IntValue") or Value:IsA("NumberValue") then
		local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
		if Num == nil then return false end
		Value.Value = Num
		return true
	elseif Value:IsA("BoolValue") then
		Value.Value = (NewValue == true or NewValue == "true")
		return true
	elseif Value:IsA("StringValue") then
		Value.Value = tostring(NewValue)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function PlayersHandler.SetCurrency(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value = Num
	return true, "Set currency"
end

function PlayersHandler.GiveCurrency(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += Num
	Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += Num
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " currency"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetGems(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value = Num
	return true, "Set gems"
end

function PlayersHandler.GiveGems(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Num
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " gems"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetRebirths(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value = Num
	return true, "Set rebirths"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetZone(Player, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	Player.Data.PlayerData.BestZone.Value = Num
	return true, "Set zone"
end

function PlayersHandler.SetGemUpgrade(Player, Slot, Amount)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local S = tonumber(Slot)
	local A = tonumber(Amount)
	if not S or not A then return false, "Invalid input" end
	local Value = Player.Data.PlayerData:FindFirstChild("GemUpgrade" .. S)
	if not Value then return false, "Upgrade not found" end
	Value.Value = A
	return true, "Set gem upgrade " .. S
end

function PlayersHandler.ToggleGamepass(Player, Name, State)
	if not Player or not Player.Data then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Value = Player.Data.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(tostring(Name))
	if not Value then return false, "Gamepass not found" end
	Value.Value = (State == true or State == "true")
	return true, "Set " .. Name .. " = " .. tostring(Value.Value)
end

function PlayersHandler.KickPlayer(Player, Reason)
	if not Player then return false, "Player not found" end
	local R = tostring(Reason or "Kicked by admin")
	if R == "" then R = "Kicked by admin" end
	Player:Kick(R)
	return true, "Kicked " .. Player.Name
end

return PlayersHandler

--[[
Code system originally made by Croissant God, on roblox @DemonicMakesGames
]]

local Codes = {
	["100CASH"] = {100, "Currency"}, -- Put in amount, then the stat name
	["100DIAMONDS"] = {100, "Diamonds"},
	["3REBIRTHS"] = {3, "Rebirths"},
	["Scarecrow"] = {"Pumpkin"}, -- Put in pet name
}



--------- Main Script ---------

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

--// Functions
function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1, 20000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(Chance)) then
		return RandomID(Folder)
	end
	return Chance
end

--// Variables
local CodeStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("CodesStore")

--// Main
ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.RedeemCode.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, Code)
	if not Codes[Code] then return end -- code doesnt exist

	local isRedeemed = CodeStore:GetAsync(Code.."_"..tostring(Player.UserId))
	
	if isRedeemed then return end -- Already redeemed
	
	if type(Codes[Code][1]) == "number" then -- Stat
		if Codes[Code][2] == "Diamonds" then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Codes[Code][1]
		elseif Codes[Code][2] == "Currency" then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += Codes[Code][1]
			Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += Codes[Code][1]
		elseif Codes[Code][2] == "Rebirths" then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value += Codes[Code][1]
		else
			return
		end
	else -- Pet
		if ReplicatedStorage.Pets:FindFirstChild(Codes[Code][1]) == nil then warn("Error: "..Codes[Code][1].." Does not exist") return end -- Pet doesn't exist
		local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
		NewPet.Name = RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
		NewPet.PetName.Value = Codes[Code][1]
		NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets
	end
	CodeStore:SetAsync(Code.."_"..tostring(Player.UserId), true)
end)

--!strict
-- VFXEffects.lua
-- Particle pooling, ring bursts, trails, and common VFX patterns

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local VFXEffects = {}
VFXEffects.__index = VFXEffects

local particlePool = {}
local MAX_PARTICLES = 100

local function getParticlePart(): Part
	for _, part in particlePool do
		if not part.Parent then
			return part
		end
	end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.one
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	table.insert(particlePool, part)
	return part
end

local function returnParticlePart(part: Part)
	if part.Parent then
		part.Parent = nil
	end
	part:ClearAllChildren()
end

-- Ring burst (expanding circle)
function VFXEffects.RingBurst(position: Vector3, color: Color3, startSize: number, endSize: number, duration: number, thickness: number?)
	local part = getParticlePart()
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace
	
	local ring = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	ring.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/ring_main.dds"
	ring.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	ring.LightEmission = 1
	ring.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(duration * 0.5, duration)
	ring.Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 0)
	ring.Size = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, startSize or 1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, endSize or 10),
	})
	ring.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, thickness and 0.1 or 0.3),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	ring.Rate = 0
	ring.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-180, 180)
	ring.Parent = part
	
	ring:Emit(1)
	Debris:AddItem(part, duration + 0.1)
	task.delay(duration + 0.1, function()
		returnParticlePart(part)
	end)
end

-- Radial burst (sparkles in all directions)
function VFXEffects.RadialBurst(position: Vector3, color: Color3, count: number, speedRange: NumberRange, lifetime: NumberRange, sizeRange: NumberRange)
	local part = getParticlePart()
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace
	
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 1
	emitter.Lifetime = lifetime
	emitter.Speed = speedRange
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, sizeRange.Min),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
	})
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = part
	
	emitter:Emit(count)
	Debris:AddItem(part, lifetime.Max + 0.1)
	task.delay(lifetime.Max + 0.1, function()
		returnParticlePart(part)
	end)
end

-- Directional burst (cone)
function VFXEffects.DirectionalBurst(position: Vector3, direction: Vector3, color: Color3, count: number, spread: number, speed: number, lifetime: number)
	local part = getParticlePart()
	part.Position = position
	part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + direction)
	part.Parent = workspace
	
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 1
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(lifetime * 0.5, lifetime)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(speed * 0.5, speed)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(spread, spread)
	emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
	})
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Drag = 2
	emitter.Parent = part
	
	emitter:Emit(count)
	Debris:AddItem(part, lifetime + 0.1)
	task.delay(lifetime + 0.1, function()
		returnParticlePart(part)
	end)
end

-- Trail between two points
function VFXEffects.Trail(from: Vector3, to: Vector3, color: Color3, width: number, duration: number)
	local part = getParticlePart()
	part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(from, to) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -(to - from).Magnitude / 2)
	part.Size = Vector3.new(width, width, (to - from).Magnitude)
	part.Parent = workspace
	
	local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
	trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	trail.LightEmission = 1
	trail.Lifetime = duration
	trail.MinLength = 0
	trail.MaxLength = (to - from).Magnitude + 2
	trail.WidthScale = NumberSequence.new(1)
	trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	
	local attachment0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment0.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, (to - from).Magnitude / 2)
	attachment0.Parent = part
	
	local attachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment1.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, -(to - from).Magnitude / 2)
	attachment1.Parent = part
	
	trail.Attachment0 = attachment0
	trail.Attachment1 = attachment1
	trail.Parent = part
	
	Debris:AddItem(part, duration + 0.1)
	task.delay(duration + 0.1, function()
		returnParticlePart(part)
	end)
end

-- Text pop (damage numbers, gold gain, etc.)
function VFXEffects.TextPop(position: Vector3, text: string, color: Color3, size: number, duration: number, offset: Vector3?)
	local part = getParticlePart()
	part.Position = position + (offset or Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
	part.Parent = workspace
	
	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 50)
	billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboard.Parent = part
	
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextSize = size
	label.TextColor3 = color
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	label.Parent = billboard
	
	-- Animate up and fade
	local tween = game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(part, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = part.Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-2, 2), 5, math.random(-2, 2))
	})
	tween:Play()
	
	local fadeTween = game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(label, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		TextTransparency = 1,
		TextStrokeTransparency = 1
	})
	fadeTween:Play()
	
	task.delay(duration, function()
		returnParticlePart(part)
	end)
end

-- Orbital particles around a point
function VFXEffects.OrbitalParticles(center: Vector3, color: Color3, count: number, radius: number, duration: number)
	local part = getParticlePart()
	part.Position = center
	part.Parent = workspace
	
	for i = 1, count do
		local angle = (i / count) * math.pi * 2
		local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
		attachment.Position = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * radius, 0, math.sin(angle) * radius)
		attachment.Parent = part
		
		local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
		emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
		emitter.LightEmission = 1
		emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(duration * 0.5, duration)
		emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 0)
		emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
		})
		emitter.Rate = 0
		emitter.Parent = attachment
		
		emitter:Emit(1)
	end
	
	-- Rotate the part for orbital motion
	local startTime = os.clock()
	local conn
	conn = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if os.clock() - startTime > duration then
			conn:Disconnect()
			returnParticlePart(part)
			return
		end
		part.CFrame = part.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, 2 * math.pi * 0.5 / 60, 0)
	end)
	
	task.delay(duration + 0.1, function()
		if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
		returnParticlePart(part)
	end)
end

-- Explosion with shockwave
function VFXEffects.Explosion(position: Vector3, color: Color3, scale: number)
	-- Shockwave ring
	VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, color, 1 * scale, 20 * scale, 0.4, 0.2)
	
	-- Core flash
	local part = getParticlePart()
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace
	
	local pointLight = Instance.new("PointLight")
	pointLight.Color = color
	pointLight.Range = 30 * scale
	pointLight.Brightness = 5
	pointLight.Parent = part
	
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(pointLight, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
		Brightness = 0,
		Range = 0
	}):Play()
	
	-- Debris burst
	VFXEffects.RadialBurst(position, color, 30, NumberRange.new(10, 30), NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.8), NumberRange.new(0.5, 2))
	
	Debris:AddItem(part, 0.5)
	task.delay(0.5, function()
		returnParticlePart(part)
	end)
end

-- Presets for game moments
VFXEffects.Presets = {
	BigClick = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.RadialBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0), 12, NumberRange.new(5, 15), NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.4), NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.5))
	end,
	
	LevelUp = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.OrbitalParticles(position, Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150), 12, 4, 1)
		VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150), 2, 15, 0.5)
	end,
	
	RareHatch = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 60), 1, 25, 0.6)
		VFXEffects.RadialBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 100), 30, NumberRange.new(10, 25), NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.8), NumberRange.new(0.8, 2))
		VFXEffects.OrbitalParticles(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 60), 16, 5, 1.5)
	end,
	
	LegendaryHatch = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.Explosion(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 100), 1.5)
		VFXEffects.OrbitalParticles(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 200), 24, 6, 2)
		task.wait(0.2)
		VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 1, 30, 0.5)
	end,
	
	LevelUp = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.OrbitalParticles(position, Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150), 12, 4, 1)
		VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150), 2, 15, 0.5)
	end,
	
	Rebirth = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.Explosion(position, Color3.fromRGB(100, 150, 255), 2)
		VFXEffects.OrbitalParticles(position, Color3.fromRGB(100, 150, 255), 32, 8, 3)
		for i = 1, 3 do
			task.wait(0.15)
			VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(100 + i * 30, 150 + i * 30, 255), 1, 40, 0.6)
		end
	end,
	
	EnemyDefeat = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.RadialBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100), 16, NumberRange.new(8, 20), NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5), NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.2))
		VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80), 1, 12, 0.4)
	end,
	
	BossDefeat = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.Explosion(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 60), 2)
		VFXEffects.OrbitalParticles(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 50), 24, 6, 2)
	end,
	
	TradeComplete = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.RadialBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 120), 15, NumberRange.new(5, 15), NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5), NumberRange.new(0.5, 1))
		VFXEffects.RingBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150), 1, 10, 0.3)
	end,
	
	DailyClaim = function(position: Vector3)
		VFXEffects.RadialBurst(position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 80), 20, NumberRange.new(5, 12), NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.6), NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.2))
	end,
}

return VFXEffects
