local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local combatFeedback = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("PetCombatFeedback")
local CameraEffects = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.CameraEffects)
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "PetCombatEffects"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.DisplayOrder = 80
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function worldPosition(position)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera or typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return nil end
	local screen, visible = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(position)
	return visible and Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) or nil
end

-- Combo Text System (Top-middle of screen)
local comboGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
comboGui.Name = "ComboTextGui"
comboGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
comboGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
comboGui.DisplayOrder = 90
comboGui.Parent = playerGui

local comboContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
comboContainer.Name = "ComboContainer"
comboContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 100)
comboContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 80)
comboContainer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
comboContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
comboContainer.Parent = comboGui

local comboLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
comboLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
comboLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
comboLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
comboLayout.Parent = comboContainer

local comboCounter = 0
local comboTimer = 0
local comboDisplayLabel = nil

local function updateComboDisplay()
	if comboDisplayLabel then
		comboDisplayLabel.Text = "COMBO x" .. comboCounter
		comboDisplayLabel.TextSize = math.clamp(36 + comboCounter * 2, 36, 72)
		comboDisplayLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHSV((comboCounter * 0.1) % 1, 0.8, 1)
	end
end

local function showComboText(combo)
	comboCounter = combo
	comboTimer = 2.5
	
	if not comboDisplayLabel then
		comboDisplayLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		comboDisplayLabel.Name = "ComboDisplay"
		comboDisplayLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 80)
		comboDisplayLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		comboDisplayLabel.Text = "COMBO x" .. comboCounter
		comboDisplayLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		comboDisplayLabel.TextSize = 36
		comboDisplayLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		comboDisplayLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		comboDisplayLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
		comboDisplayLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		comboDisplayLabel.Parent = comboContainer
		
		-- Add UIStroke for glow effect
		local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50)
		stroke.Thickness = 3
		stroke.Transparency = 0.2
		stroke.Parent = comboDisplayLabel
	end
	
	updateComboDisplay()
	
	-- Pulse animation
	local tween = TweenService:Create(comboDisplayLabel, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		TextSize = math.clamp(48 + comboCounter * 3, 48, 96)
	})
	tween:Play()
end

-- Combo timer
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.1)
		if comboTimer > 0 then
			comboTimer -= 0.1
			if comboTimer <= 0 then
				comboCounter = 0
				if comboDisplayLabel then
					local tween = TweenService:Create(comboDisplayLabel, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
						TextTransparency = 1,
						TextStrokeTransparency = 1
					})
					tween:Play()
					tween.Completed:Connect(function()
						if comboCounter == 0 and comboDisplayLabel then
							comboDisplayLabel:Destroy()
							comboDisplayLabel = nil
						end
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

local function textBurst(position, text, color, size)
	local point = worldPosition(position)
	if not point then return end
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(point.X, point.Y)
	label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, size or 42)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = color
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 28)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.1
	label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	label.TextSize = size or 30
	label.Parent = gui
	local target = label.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(math.random(-25, 25), -85)
	local tween = TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = target, TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1})
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Connect(function() label:Destroy() end)
end

local function burst(position, color, count)
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.one
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 1
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.45)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(8, 18)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = part
	emitter:Emit(count or 26)
	Debris:AddItem(part, 1)
end

local function ring(position, color)
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent = part
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/ring_main.dds"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 1
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 0)
	emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 5)})
	emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = attachment
	emitter:Emit(1)
	Debris:AddItem(part, 1)
end

local function playKillSound(position)
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local soundPart = Instance.new("Part")
	soundPart.Anchored = true
	soundPart.CanCollide = false
	soundPart.Transparency = 1
	soundPart.Size = Vector3.one
	soundPart.Position = position
	soundPart.Parent = workspace
	local killSound = Instance.new("Sound")
	-- Use a valid Roblox sound ID (click/pop sound)
	killSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://12222005"
	killSound.Volume = 0.5
	killSound.Pitch = 0.8
	killSound.Parent = soundPart
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		killSound:Play()
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("Failed to play kill sound:", err)
	end
	killSound.Ended:Connect(function()
		soundPart:Destroy()
	end)
	Debris:AddItem(soundPart, 2)
end

local function playAttackAnimation()
	local controller = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("AnimationController")
	if controller then
		local ok, module = pcall(require, controller)
		if ok and module and module.Play then
			module.Play("Punching Animation")
		end
	end
end

combatFeedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
	local kind = data.kind
	if kind == "PetHit" then
		playAttackAnimation()
		textBurst(data.position, "-" .. tostring(data.damage), Color3.fromRGB(255, 238, 120), 32)
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.3, 0), "COMBO x" .. tostring(data.combo), Color3.fromRGB(255, 145, 65), 22)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 65), 30)
		ring(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 80))
		
		-- Hit marker
		local hitMarker = Instance.new("Frame")
		hitMarker.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30)
		hitMarker.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		hitMarker.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		hitMarker.Parent = gui
		
		local worldPos = data.position
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local screenPos = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
		if screenPos.Z > 0 then
			hitMarker.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
			hitMarker.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			
			local marker = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
			marker.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40)
			marker.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			marker.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			marker.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			marker.Image = "rbxassetid://3926305904" -- X marker
			marker.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
			marker.ImageTransparency = 0.2
			marker.Parent = hitMarker
			
			local tween = TweenService:Create(hitMarker, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 80),
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y - 30)
			})
			tween:Play()
			
			local fadeTween = TweenService:Create(hitMarker, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1
			})
			fadeTween:Play()
			
			task.delay(0.3, function()
				hitMarker:Destroy()
			end)
		end
		
		-- Screen shake for impact
		if CameraEffects and CameraEffects.Shake then
			CameraEffects.Shake("Light")
		end
	elseif kind == "EnemyHit" then
		textBurst(data.position, "-" .. tostring(data.damage), Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 100), 30)
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0), "ENEMY ATTACK!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120), 19)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65), 24)
elseif kind == "EnemyDefeated" then
		-- Enhanced death VFX
		local pos = data.position
		local reward = data.reward or 0
		local combo = data.combo or 1
		
		-- Show combo text in top-middle
		showComboText(combo)
		
		-- Main defeat text
		textBurst(pos, tostring(data.text or "DEFEATED!"), Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 28)
		textBurst(pos + Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0), "+" .. tostring(reward) .. " GOLD", Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 80), 20)
		
		-- Enhanced burst with multiple rings
		burst(pos, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 55)
		burst(pos, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 30)
		ring(pos, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170))
		ring(pos, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
		
		-- Explosive burst particles
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Anchored = true
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.Transparency = 1
		part.Size = Vector3.one
		part.Position = pos
		part.Parent = workspace
		
		local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
		emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 150)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
		})
		emitter.LightEmission = 1
		emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 1.2)
		emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(15, 40)
		emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
		emitter.Rate = 0
		emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.5),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)
		})
		emitter.Parent = part
		emitter:Emit(60)
		
		-- Shockwave ring
		local shockwave = Instance.new("Part")
		shockwave.Anchored = true
		shockwave.CanCollide = false
		shockwave.Transparency = 1
		shockwave.Size = Vector3.new(2, 0.2, 2)
		shockwave.Position = pos
		shockwave.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
		shockwave.Parent = workspace
		
		local shockwaveMesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
		shockwaveMesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
		shockwaveMesh.MeshId = "rbxassetid://3270017"
		shockwaveMesh.Scale = Vector3.new(5, 5, 0.5)
		shockwaveMesh.Parent = shockwave
		
		local shockwaveTween = TweenService:Create(shockwave, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Size = Vector3.new(30, 0.2, 30),
			CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0),
			Transparency = 1
		})
		shockwaveTween:Play()
		shockwaveTween.Completed:Connect(function()
			shockwave:Destroy()
		end)
		Debris:AddItem(part, 1.5)
		Debris:AddItem(shockwave, 0.6)
		
		playKillSound(pos)
	elseif kind == "PetKnockedOut" then
		textBurst(data.position, tostring(data.text or "KNOCKED OUT!"), Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80), 27)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60), 40)
	elseif kind == "PetRecovered" then
		textBurst(data.position, "RECOVERED!", Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 22)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 22)
	elseif kind == "EnemySpawned" then
		textBurst(data.position, string.upper(tostring(data.zone or "ENEMY")), Color3.fromRGB(150, 210, 255), 18)
	elseif kind == "EnemyJump" then
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
			humanoid.Jump = false
		end
		local controller = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("AnimationController")
		if controller then
			local ok, module = pcall(require, controller)
			if ok and module and module.Play then module.Play("Double Jump Backflip Animation") end
		end
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), "JUMP!", Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255), 19)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 210, 255), 16)
	elseif kind == "Whiff" then
		playAttackAnimation()
		textBurst(data.position, "MISS", Color3.fromRGB(190, 200, 220), 20)
	end
end)

--// Server Handler
-- Server info, announcements, shutdown, and server-wide tools.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ServerHandler = {}

function ServerHandler.GetInfo()
	local Info = {
		jobId = game.JobId,
		playerCount = #Players:GetPlayers(),
		maxPlayers = Players.MaxPlayers,
		gameName = game.PlaceId,
		serverAge = os.time() - (game.Workspace:FindFirstChild("DistributedGameTime") and math.floor(game.Workspace.DistributedGameTime.Value) or 0),
		placeVersion = game.PlaceVersion,
	}

	pcall(function()
		Info.serverVersion = game.ServerVersion
	end)

	return Info
end

function ServerHandler.GetPlayerList()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Player.Name,
			displayName = Player.DisplayName,
			userId = Player.UserId,
			loaded = Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or false,
			isTrading = (function() local D = Player:FindFirstChild("Data"); local NSV = D and D:FindFirstChild("NonSaveValues"); return NSV and NSV:FindFirstChild("IsTrading") and NSV.IsTrading.Value or false end)(),
		}
	end
	return Result
end

function ServerHandler.Announce(Message, AdminNotify)
	if not Message or Message == "" then return false, "No message" end
	if AdminNotify then
		AdminNotify:FireAllClients("announce", tostring(Message))
	end
	return true, "Announced: " .. tostring(Message)
end

function ServerHandler.Shutdown()
	task.delay(1, function()
		game:Shutdown()
	end)
	return true, "Shutting down server"
end

function ServerHandler.GetServerStats()
	local Stats = {
		fps = 0,
		memory = 0,
	}
	pcall(function()
		Stats.fps = math.floor(1 / game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Wait())
		Stats.memory = math.floor(game:GetService("Stats").MemoryUsageMb * 1024 * 1024)
	end)
	return Stats
end

return ServerHandler

--// Auction House Shards
-- Owns the DataStore connection, listing shards, and the in-memory listing cache.
-- Listings are spread across N shards (by owner for writes, hash for lookups) to
-- avoid single-key throttling on the DataStore.

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)

local Shards = {}

local AuctionStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.DATASTORE_NAME)

--// State
local Listings = {} -- [listingId] = listing
local ListingShard = {} -- [listingId] = shard key

--// Shard Helpers
function Shards.GetShardKey(ListingId)
	local Hash = 0
	for i = 1, #ListingId do
		Hash = (Hash * 31 + string.byte(ListingId, i)) % 2147483647
	end
	return "L_" .. (Hash % Config.SHARD_COUNT + 1)
end

function Shards.GetOwnerShard(UserId)
	return "L_" .. (UserId % Config.SHARD_COUNT + 1)
end

function Shards.ReadShard(ShardKey)
	local Success, Data = pcall(function()
		return AuctionStore:GetAsync(ShardKey)
	end)

	if Success and type(Data) == "table" then
		return Data
	end
	return nil
end

function Shards.UpdateShard(ShardKey, Updater)
	local Success, Data = pcall(function()
		return AuctionStore:UpdateAsync(ShardKey, function(Old)
			Old = (type(Old) == "table" and Old) or {}
			return Updater(Old)
		end)
	end)

	return Success, Data
end

function Shards.RebuildCache()
	local NewListings = {}
	local NewShard = {}
	local CarryOver = {}

	for i = 1, Config.SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Data = Shards.ReadShard(Key)

		if Data then
			for Id, Listing in Data do
				NewListings[Id] = Listing
				NewShard[Id] = Key
			end
		else
			CarryOver[Key] = true
		end
	end

	for Id, Key in ListingShard do
		if CarryOver[Key] and NewListings[Id] == nil then
			NewListings[Id] = Listings[Id]
			NewShard[Id] = Key
		end
	end

	Listings = NewListings
	ListingShard = NewShard
end

--// Cache Access
function Shards.GetAll()
	return Listings
end

function Shards.GetListing(Id)
	return Listings[Id]
end

function Shards.AddToCache(Listing, Key)
	Listings[Listing.id] = Listing
	ListingShard[Listing.id] = Key
end

function Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
	Listings[Id] = nil
	ListingShard[Id] = nil
end

function Shards.GetShardOf(Id)
	return ListingShard[Id] or Shards.GetShardKey(Id)
end

function Shards.GetStore()
	return AuctionStore
end

return Shards

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Short = require(script.Parent.Short)
local Module = {}

local Player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

function CreatePopup(Type)
	if Player.Data.Settings.Popups.Value then
		local NewPopup = RS.Assets.Templates[Type]:Clone()
		NewPopup.Size = UDim2.new(0.1,0,0.1,0)
		NewPopup.Visible = true
		NewPopup.Parent = Player.PlayerGui.Interface.HUD.Popups
		return NewPopup
	end
	
	return
end

function PlayAnimation(Popup, Time)
	coroutine.wrap(function()
		Popup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(1,0,1,0), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Time * 0.2)
		task.wait(Time * 0.8)
		Popup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0,0,0,0), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Time * 0.2)
		task.wait(Time * 0.2)
		Popup:Destroy()
	end)()
end

function Module.CreateBottomStatPopup(Amount, Stat, Colors, Time)
	local NewPopup = CreatePopup("BottomStatPopup")

	if not NewPopup then return end
	
	NewPopup.Amt.Text = "You got +"..Short.en(Amount)
	NewPopup.Stat.Text = Stat
	NewPopup.Stat.TextColor3 = Colors.TextColor  or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
	NewPopup.Stat.UIGradient.Color = Colors.UIGradient or ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Color3.new(255,255,255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255))})
	NewPopup.Stat.UIStroke.Color = Colors.StrokeColor or Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
	
	PlayAnimation(NewPopup, Time)
end

--// So I don't have to copy paste the same RGB in every script
local function DefaultColors(Label, Color)
	if Color == "Green" then
		Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(109, 255, 41)
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(69, 157, 25)
	elseif Color == "Red" then
		Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 67, 67)
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(181, 0, 0)
	else
		Label.TextColor3 = Color.TextColor
		Label.UIStroke.Color = Color.StrokeColor
	end
end

function Module.CreateBottomPopup(Message, Time, Color)
	local NewPopup = CreatePopup("BottomPopup")

	if not NewPopup then return end
	
	DefaultColors(NewPopup.Label, Color)
	NewPopup.Label.Text = Message

	PlayAnimation(NewPopup, Time)
end

return Module

--[[
	This script handles the client. 
	
	Contents:
	- ClickButton
	- Overlay (Currency counter)
	- Popups
	- Close Buttons of Frames
	- Buttons on the side
	- Settings
	- Rebirth
	- Shop
	- Pet Inventory
	- Egg Preview (Frame that shows the price etc)
	- Egg Hatching
	- Pet Follow
	- Areas
	- Trading
	- Gem Shop
	- Codes
	- Stats
	- Functions
	
	Only edit if you know what you're doing!
]]

--// Services
local MarketPlaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Loading
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
repeat wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil

if Player.Parent == nil then return end

--// Variables
local Data = Player.Data
local PlayerData = Data.PlayerData

local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"]
local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules

local PetMultipliers = require(Modules.PetMultipliers)
local Multipliers = require(Modules.Multipliers)
local Utilities = require(Modules.Utilities)

local UI = Player.PlayerGui:WaitForChild("GameUI")
local Frames = UI.Frames

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes

--// Clicker
if GameSettings.GameType.Value == "Clicker" then
	Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(UI.Clicker)

	UI.Clicker.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Remotes.Clicker:FireServer()
		Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
	end)

	if GameSettings.ClickingAnywhere.Value then
		UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input, Processed)
			if Processed then return end
			if Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end -- not a left mouse click
			Remotes.Clicker:FireServer()
			Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
		end)
	end
end

--// Overlay
local CurrencySide = UI[GameSettings.CurrencySide.Value]
CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(PlayerData.Currency.Value)
PlayerData.Currency.Changed:Connect(function()
	CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(PlayerData.Currency.Value)
end)

CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel2.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(PlayerData.Currency2.Value)
PlayerData.Currency2.Changed:Connect(function()
	CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel2.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(PlayerData.Currency2.Value)
end)


--// Popups
local CurrencyOld = PlayerData.Currency.Value
PlayerData.Currency.Changed:Connect(function(NewValue)
	task.spawn(function()
		if NewValue > CurrencyOld then
			local NewPopup = script.Popup:Clone()
			NewPopup.Size = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
			NewPopup.Currency.Image = CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel.Currency.Image
			NewPopup.Amount.Text = "+"..Utilities.Short.en(NewValue - CurrencyOld)
			NewPopup.Position = UDim2.new(math.random(40, 60) / 100, 0, math.random(40, 60) / 100, 0) -- sets it in a random position in the middle square
			NewPopup.Parent = UI.Popups
			NewPopup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0.176,0,0.105,0), Enum.EasingDirection.In, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.5)
			task.wait(1)
			NewPopup:TweenPosition(CurrencySide.Position, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 2)
			NewPopup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0.1,0,0.05,0), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 2)
			task.wait(1.4)
			NewPopup:Destroy()
		end
	end)

	CurrencyOld = NewValue
end)

--// Frames
local BaseSize = {}
for _,Frame in Frames:GetChildren() do
	if not Frame:IsA("Frame") then continue end
	if Frame:GetAttribute("Keep") then continue end

	BaseSize[Frame.Name] = Frame.Size

	if Frame:FindFirstChild("Close") then
		Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(Frame.Close)
		Frame.Close.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Utilities.ButtonHandler.OnClick(Frame, UDim2.new(0,0,0,0))
			Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
		end)
	end
end

--// Buttons
local ButtonSide = UI[GameSettings.ButtonSide.Value]
for _,Button in ButtonSide.Buttons:GetChildren() do
	if not Button:IsA("Frame") then continue end
	if Button:GetAttribute("AuctionButton") then continue end

	Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(Button)
	Button.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Utilities.ButtonHandler.OnClick(UI.Frames[Button.Name], BaseSize[Button.Name])
		Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
	end)
end

--// Settings
local SettingsScroll = Frames.Settings.ObjectHolder

-- Music Setting
local MusicSetting = SettingsScroll.Music
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(MusicSetting.Toggle.On)
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(MusicSetting.Toggle.Off)

MusicSetting.Toggle.On.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Setting:FireServer("Music", true)
	Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
end)

MusicSetting.Toggle.Off.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Setting:FireServer("Music", false)
	Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
end)

SoundService.Music.PlaybackSpeed = PlayerData.Music.Value and 1 or 0
PlayerData.Music.Changed:Connect(function()
	SoundService.Music.PlaybackSpeed = PlayerData.Music.Value and 1 or 0
end)

-- ShowOtherPets
local ShowOtherPetsSetting = SettingsScroll.ShowOtherPets
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(ShowOtherPetsSetting.Toggle.On)
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(ShowOtherPetsSetting.Toggle.Off)

ShowOtherPetsSetting.Toggle.On.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Setting:FireServer("ShowOtherPets", true)
	Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
end)

ShowOtherPetsSetting.Toggle.Off.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Setting:FireServer("ShowOtherPets", false)
	Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
end)

--// Rebirth
local RebirthPrice, RebirthMulti = GameSettings.RebirthBasePrice.Value, GameSettings.RebirthMultiplier.Value

function UpdateRebirthInfo()
	Frames.Rebirth.Counter.Text = "You have "..Utilities.Short.en(PlayerData.Rebirth.Value).." Rebirths"
	if GameSettings.RebirthType.Value == "Linear" then
		Frames.Rebirth.Description.Text = "Buying a Rebirth will increase your "..GameSettings.CurrencyName.Value.." Multiplier with x"..RebirthMulti
		Frames.Rebirth.Cost.Text = "You need atleast "..Utilities.Short.en(RebirthPrice * (PlayerData.Rebirth.Value + 1)).." "..GameSettings.CurrencyName.Value
	elseif GameSettings.RebirthType.Value == "Exponential" then
		Frames.Rebirth.Description.Text = "Buying a Rebirth will increase your "..GameSettings.CurrencyName.Value.." Multiplier with ^"..(RebirthMulti+0.5)
		Frames.Rebirth.Cost.Text = "You need atleast "..Utilities.Short.en(RebirthPrice * ((RebirthMulti+1.25) ^ PlayerData.Rebirth.Value)).." "..GameSettings.CurrencyName.Value
	end
end

UpdateRebirthInfo()

PlayerData.Rebirth.Changed:Connect(function()
	UpdateRebirthInfo()
end)

Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(Frames.Rebirth.Buy)

Frames.Rebirth.Buy.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	Remotes.Rebirth:FireServer()
	Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
end)

--// Shop
for _,Gamepass in ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses:GetChildren() do
	local NewGamepass = script.GamepassTemplate:Clone()

	local GamepassInfo

	local Succes, Error = pcall(function()
		GamepassInfo = MarketPlaceService:GetProductInfo(Gamepass.Value, Enum.InfoType.GamePass)
	end)

	if Error then 
		warn("An error as occured while gathering gamepass data: "..Error) 
		NewGamepass:Destroy() continue 
	else
		NewGamepass.InnerPart.ImageLabel.Image = "rbxassetid://"..(GamepassInfo.IconImageAssetId or 666669321)
		NewGamepass.InnerPart.Description.Text = GamepassInfo.Description 
		NewGamepass.InnerPart.GPName.Text = GamepassInfo.Name
		NewGamepass.InnerPart.Price.Text = Data.Gamepasses[Gamepass.Name].Value and "Owned ✅" or "\u{E002}"..(GamepassInfo.PriceInRobux or 10000)

		Data.Gamepasses[Gamepass.Name].Changed:Connect(function()
			NewGamepass.InnerPart.Price.Text = Data.Gamepasses[Gamepass.Name].Value and "Owned ✅" or "\u{E002}"..GamepassInfo.PriceInRobux
		end)

function SortInventory(SortTable, ObjectHolder)
	local TableToSort = SortTable ~= nil and SortTable or PetInventory -- so it can differentiate between trade and normal inventories

	table.sort(TableToSort, function(a,b)
		if not a or not b then return end

		if a.Multiplier ~= b.Multiplier then
			return a.Multiplier > b.Multiplier
		else
			return a.ID > b.ID
		end
	end)

	for Order,PetInfo in TableToSort do
		if not Data.Pets:FindFirstChild(PetInfo.ID) then
			table.remove(TableToSort, Order)
			continue
		end

		if not ObjectHolder then
			PetFrame.MainFrame.ObjectHolder[PetInfo.ID].LayoutOrder = Order + (Data.Pets[PetInfo.ID].Equipped.Value and 0 or 1000) -- order + 1000 if equipped
		else
			ObjectHolder[PetInfo.ID].LayoutOrder = Order + (Data.Pets[PetInfo.ID].Equipped.Value and 0 or 1000) -- order + 1000 if equipped
		end
	end
end

local CurrentlySelected = 0

function AddPet(PetInstance, SortTable, Parent) -- Creates a pet slot
	task.wait(0.1)
	local NewPet = script.PetTemplate:Clone()

	local PetModel = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value]:Clone()
	PetModel.Parent = NewPet.Display

	local MainPart = PetModel:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	local Pos

	if not MainPart then
		warn(PetModel.Name.." does not have a MainPart, please add one by calling one of the parts 'MainPart'")

		for _,v in PetModel:GetChildren() do -- this here chooses a random part of the pet instead of the mainpart.
			if v:IsA("BasePart") then
				Pos = v.Position
				break
			end
		end
	else
		Pos = MainPart.Position
	end

	local Pos = PetModel.MainPart.Position
	local Camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	NewPet.Display.CurrentCamera = Camera
	PetModel:PivotTo(PetModel:GetPivot() * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0))
	Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(Pos.X + PetModel:GetExtentsSize().X * 1.5, Pos.Y, Pos.Z + 1), Pos)

	if not Parent then -- normal pet
		NewPet.Equipped.Visible = PetInstance.Equipped.Value

		PetInstance.Equipped.Changed:Connect(function()
			NewPet.Equipped.Visible = PetInstance.Equipped.Value

			if CurrentlySelected == tonumber(PetInstance.Name) then
				UpdateSideFrame(PetInstance)
			end

			SortInventory()
		end)

		NewPet.Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if not IsMultiDeleting then
				UpdateSideFrame(PetInstance)
			else
				if not table.find(SelectedForDelete, tonumber(PetInstance.Name)) then
					table.insert(SelectedForDelete, tonumber(PetInstance.Name))
					NewPet.Delete.Visible = true
				else
					table.remove(SelectedForDelete, table.find(SelectedForDelete, tonumber(PetInstance.Name)))
					NewPet.Delete.Visible = false
				end
			end
			Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
		end)
	end
	NewPet.Name = PetInstance.Name
	NewPet.Parent = Parent == nil and PetFrame.MainFrame.ObjectHolder or Parent

	if SortTable == nil then
		PetInventory[#PetInventory+1] = {ID = PetInstance.Name, Multiplier = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Multiplier.Value}
	else
		SortTable[#SortTable+1] = {ID = PetInstance.Name, Multiplier = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Multiplier.Value}
	end

	return NewPet
end

local PreviewFrame = UI.PreviewFrame
local DefaultSize = PreviewFrame.Size
local CurrentTarget = PreviewFrame.CurrentTarget
PreviewFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.2,0,0.2,0)

function FindClosestEgg(EggsAvailable)
	local CurrentClosest, ClosestDistance = nil, 100

	for _,Egg in EggsAvailable do
		local EggModel = workspace.Map.Eggs[Egg]
		local mag = (EggModel:GetPivot().Position-Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
		if mag <= ClosestDistance then
			CurrentClosest = EggModel
			ClosestDistance = mag
		end
	end
	return CurrentClosest
end

local IsClosing = false -- so it doesnt ruin the animation

function FindEgg()
	if not Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or not Player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") or Player.Character.Humanoid.Health == 0 then return end

	local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local EggsAvailable = {}
	local CameraRatio = ((Camera.CFrame.Position - Camera.Focus.Position).Magnitude)/11

	for _,Egg in workspace.Map.Eggs:GetChildren() do
		if Egg == nil then continue end
		if not Egg:FindFirstChild("EggModel") then warn(Egg.Name.." does not have an EggModel") end

		local mag = (Egg:GetPivot().Position-Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
		if mag <= 12 then
			EggsAvailable[#EggsAvailable + 1] = Egg.Name
		end
	end

	local SetVisibility = #EggsAvailable >= 1 -- if its 0 then its already false

	if SetVisibility then -- a egg(s) is in distance
		local Egg = #EggsAvailable > 1 and FindClosestEgg(EggsAvailable) or workspace.Map.Eggs[EggsAvailable[1]]
		local WSP = workspace.CurrentCamera:WorldToScreenPoint(Egg:GetPivot().Position)
		PreviewFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0,WSP.X,0,WSP.Y)
		CurrentTarget.Value = Egg.Name
	else
		CurrentTarget.Value = "None"
	end

	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value then
		SetVisibility = false -- if you are opening an egg itll auto close the previewframe
	end

	--// Make the previewframe visible
	if SetVisibility and not PreviewFrame.Visible then
		PreviewFrame.Visible = true
		Utilities.Tween.Tween(PreviewFrame, {Speed = 0.15}, {Size = UDim2.new(DefaultSize.X.Scale/CameraRatio, DefaultSize.X.Offset, DefaultSize.Y.Scale/CameraRatio, DefaultSize.Y.Offset)})	
	elseif not SetVisibility and PreviewFrame.Visible and not IsClosing then -- set to invisible, while is visible & isnt closing
		IsClosing = true
		Utilities.Tween.Tween(PreviewFrame, {Speed = 0.15}, {Size = UDim2.new(0.2,0,0.2,0)})	
		task.wait(0.15)
		PreviewFrame.Visible = false
		IsClosing = false
	end
end

function UpdatePreviewFrame()
	if CurrentTarget.Value ~= "None" then
		local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value
		PreviewFrame.EggInfo.EggName.Text = Egg

		if not ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg) then print(Egg.." does not have settings in ReplicatedStorage.Eggs!") return end

		local Pets, TotalWeight = {}, 0

			table.insert(Pets, {Pet.Name, Pet.Value})
		end

		table.sort(Pets, function(a,b)
			return a[2] > b[2]

		for i = 1,9 do

			Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(Pos.X + PetModel:GetExtentsSize().X * 1.5, Pos.Y, Pos.Z + 1), Pos)

--// Egg Hatching
local IsAutoOpening = false

function HatchEgg(Egg: string, Result: string, Offset:number)
	local OpeningTime = 3

	local NewViewport = script.EggViewport:Clone()
	NewViewport.Parent = UI.OpenEgg

	Player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 15
	Frames.Visible = false
	UI[GameSettings.ButtonSide.Value].Buttons.Visible = false

	local Clone = workspace.Map.Eggs[Egg].EggModel:Clone()
	Clone:ScaleTo(0.5)
	Clone.Parent = workspace

	local Rot, X, Y, Z = Instance.new("NumberValue"), Instance.new("NumberValue"), Instance.new("NumberValue"), Instance.new("NumberValue")
	Rot.Value = 30 Z.Value = -4 X.Value = 10

	local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local PL = Instance.new("PointLight")
	PL.Shadows = false PL.Range = 4 PL.Brightness *= 1.5
	PL.Parent = Clone.Egg

	Clone:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z))
	local CameraConnection1 = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		Clone:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(Rot.Value)))
	end)

	local CameraConnection2 = Camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		Clone:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(Rot.Value)))
	end)

	local TweenIn = TweenService:Create(X, TweenInfo.new(OpeningTime*0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = Offset})
	TweenIn:Play()

	local RotTweenIn = TweenService:Create(Rot, TweenInfo.new(OpeningTime*0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = 0})
	RotTweenIn:Play()

	-- add an audio for the egg flying in
	TweenIn.Completed:Wait()

	local Eggdelay = 0.075
	for i = 1,(OpeningTime * 1.5) + 1 do
		local Tween = TweenService:Create(Rot, TweenInfo.new(Eggdelay, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = 6})
		Tween:Play()
		-- add an audio for rotating here
		Tween.Completed:Wait()

		local Tween = TweenService:Create(Rot, TweenInfo.new(Eggdelay, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = -6})
		-- add an audio for rotating here
		Tween:Play()
		Tween.Completed:Wait()

		Eggdelay -= .005
	end

	CameraConnection1:Disconnect()
	CameraConnection2:Disconnect()	
	Clone:Destroy()	

	-- Now we're going to show the pet

	local PetModel = game.ReplicatedStorage.Pets[Result]:Clone()
	PetModel:ScaleTo(0.6)
	PetModel.Parent = workspace

	NewViewport.Deleted.Visible = Data.AutoDelete[Result].Value
	NewViewport.PetName.Text = Result
	NewViewport.PetName.Visible = true
	NewViewport.PetRarity.Text = game.ReplicatedStorage.Pets[Result].Settings.Rarity.Value
	NewViewport.PetRarity.Visible = true

	local PL = Instance.new("PointLight")
	PL.Shadows = false PL.Range = 4 PL.Brightness *= 2
	PL.Parent = PetModel.MainPart

	X.Value = Offset Y.Value = 0 Z.Value = -4 Rot.Value = 175
	local CameraConnection1 = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		PetModel:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Rot.Value), 0))
	end)

	local CameraConnection2 = Camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		PetModel:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Rot.Value), 0))
	end)

	task.wait(OpeningTime*0.25)

	NewViewport:TweenPosition(UDim2.new(NewViewport.Position.X.Scale, 0, NewViewport.Position.Y.Scale + 10, 0), Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, OpeningTime * 0.1)
	TweenService:Create(Y, TweenInfo.new(OpeningTime*0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = -5}):Play()
	NewViewport.Deleted.Visible = false
	NewViewport.PetName.Visible = false
	NewViewport.PetRarity.Visible = false
	task.wait(OpeningTime * 0.15)

	CameraConnection1:Disconnect()
	CameraConnection2:Disconnect()
	X:Destroy() Y:Destroy() Z:Destroy() Rot:Destroy()

	PetModel:Destroy()
	NewViewport:Destroy()

	Player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5
	UI[GameSettings.ButtonSide.Value].Buttons.Visible = true
	Frames.Visible = true	
end

function SingleEgg()
	local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value

	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg)
	if not EggInfo then return end

	if not EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then
		local Result = Remotes.Egg:InvokeServer(Egg, 1)

		if Result ~= nil then
			HatchEgg(Egg, Result[1], 0)
		end
	else
		MarketPlaceService:PromptProductPurchase(Player, EggInfo.ProductId.Value)
	end
end

function TripleEgg()
	local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value

	local Result = Remotes.Egg:InvokeServer(Egg, 3)

	if Result ~= nil then
		for i = 1,#Result do
			coroutine.wrap(function()
				local Position = (i - 2) * 3
				HatchEgg(Egg, Result[i], Position)
			end)()
		end
	end
end

local function ChooseEggAmount(Egg)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg)
	if not EggInfo then return 1 end

	local EggAmount = 1

	if ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild("TripleEgg") and not Player.Data.Gamepasses.TripleEgg.Value then 
		return EggAmount
	end -- triple egg is a gamepass that the player doesn't own, so open 1 egg

	if PlayerData.Currency.Value >= EggInfo.Cost.Value * 3 then
		EggAmount = 3
	end

	return EggAmount
end

function AutoEgg()
	if IsAutoOpening then return end

	if ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild("AutoEgg") and not Player.Data.Gamepasses.AutoEgg.Value then 
		MarketPlaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(Player, ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses.AutoEgg.Value)
		return
	end

	local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value	
	IsAutoOpening = true

	while true do
		if Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value then task.wait(0.1) continue end -- player is already opening an egg

		if CurrentTarget.Value == "None" or CurrentTarget.Value ~= Egg then
			IsAutoOpening = false
			break
		end

		local Result = Remotes.Egg:InvokeServer(Egg, ChooseEggAmount(Egg))

		if Result == nil then
			IsAutoOpening = false
			break
		end

		if #Result > 1 then
			for i = 1,#Result do
				coroutine.wrap(function()
					local Position = (i - 2) * 3
					HatchEgg(Egg, Result[i], Position)
				end)()
			end
		else
			HatchEgg(Egg, Result[1], 0)
		end

		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end

local function RearrangeTables(Pets, Rows, MaxRowCapacity)
	table.clear(Rows)
	local AmountOfRows = math.ceil(#Pets / MaxRowCapacity)
	for i = 1, AmountOfRows do
		table.insert(Rows, {})
	end
	for i, v in Pets do
		local Row = Rows[math.ceil(i / MaxRowCapacity)]
		table.insert(Row, v)
	end
end

local function GetRowWidth(Row, Pet)
	if Pet ~= nil then
		local MainPart = Pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")

		if not MainPart then print("A pet equipped does not have a part called 'MainPart'") return end

		Pet.PrimaryPart = MainPart

		local SpacingBetweenPets = Spacing - MainPart.Size.X
		local RowWidth = 0

		if #Row == 1 then
			return 0
		end

		for i, v in Row do
			if i ~= #Row then
				RowWidth += MainPart.Size.X + SpacingBetweenPets
			else
				RowWidth += MainPart.Size.X
			end
		end

		return RowWidth
	end
end

local PetAttackCooldown = 0.5
local petAttackTimers = {}

-- New: Pet targeting system
local PET_FOLLOW_DISTANCE = 50  -- Distance at which pet stops attacking and returns to follow
local PET_ATTACK_RANGE = 30     -- Maximum distance pet will chase target
local playerTargetEnemy = nil   -- Currently targeted enemy
local isPetAttacking = false    -- Whether pet is in attack mode

local petFeedbackRemote = Remotes:FindFirstChild("PetInteractionFeedback")

function PetMovement()
	if not PlayerData.ShowOtherPets.Value then
		for _, PetFolder in workspace.PlayerPets:GetChildren() do
			if PetFolder.Name == Player.Name then continue end 
			PetFolder.Parent = TempPets
		end
	else
		for _,v in TempPets:GetChildren() do
			v.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets
		end
	end

	for _, PlayerPets in workspace.PlayerPets:GetChildren() do
		local Character = Players[PlayerPets.Name].Character or Players[PlayerPets.Name].CharacterAdded:Wait()
		local HumanoidRootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

		local Pets, Rows = {}, {}		
		for _,Pet in PlayerPets:GetChildren() do
			table.insert(Pets, Pet)
		end

		RayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.PlayerPets, Character}
		local MaxRowCapacity = math.ceil(math.sqrt(#Pets))
		RearrangeTables(Pets, Rows, MaxRowCapacity)

		local enemiesFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("PetEnemies")

		for i, Pet in Pets do
			local state = Pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or "Follow"
			local petMain = Pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
			if not petMain or not petMain:IsA("BasePart") then continue end
			if state == "Stop" or Pet:GetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled") == false or state == "Sleep" or state == "Sit" then
				if state == "Sleep" then
					Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(Pet:GetPivot() * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-12), 0, 0), 0.1))
				end
				continue
			end
			if state == "Jump" then
				local jumpOffset = math.abs(math.sin(os.clock() * 5)) * 2
				local jumpTarget = Pet:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, jumpOffset, 0)
				Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(jumpTarget, 0.35))
				continue
			end
			if state == "Fly" then
				local flyTarget = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(4, 4 + math.sin(os.clock() * 2) * 0.7, 4)
				Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(flyTarget, 0.12))
				continue
			end

			local petPos = petMain.Position
			local closestEnemy, closestDist
			if enemiesFolder then
				for _, enemy in enemiesFolder:GetChildren() do
					if not enemy:IsA("Model") then continue end
					local enemyMain = enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
					local enemyHealth = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0
					if not enemyMain or enemyHealth <= 0 then continue end
					local dist = (petPos - enemyMain.Position).Magnitude
					if dist <= EnemyAggroRange and (not closestDist or dist < closestDist) then
					closestEnemy = enemy
						closestDist = dist
					end
				end
			end

			if closestEnemy and closestDist then
				local enemyMain = closestEnemy.PrimaryPart or closestEnemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
				if enemyMain then
					local direction = (enemyMain.Position - petPos)
					direction = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
					local distToEnemy = direction.Magnitude
					local targetPos
					if distToEnemy > EnemyAttackRange then
						local moveDist = math.min(distToEnemy - EnemyAttackRange + 2, distToEnemy)
						targetPos = petPos + direction.Unit * moveDist
					else
						targetPos = petPos
					end

					local RayResult = workspace:Blockcast(petMain.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, MaxClimbHeight, 0), petMain.Size, RayDirection, RayParams)
					local targetY = 0
					if RayResult then
						targetY = RayResult.Position.Y + petMain.Size.Y/2
					end

					local lookCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(targetPos.X, petPos.Y, targetPos.Z), Vector3.new(enemyMain.Position.X, petPos.Y, enemyMain.Position.Z))
					local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos.X, targetY, targetPos.Z) * lookCFrame.Rotation
					Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(targetCFrame, 0.15))

					-- Check if pet should attack (either has target or is in attack mode)
					local shouldAttack = (playerTargetEnemy == closestEnemy) or (isPetAttacking and not playerTargetEnemy)
					local distToPlayer = (petPos - HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
					
					-- Auto-disengage: if pet is too far from player, stop attacking and return to follow
					if isPetAttacking and distToPlayer > PET_FOLLOW_DISTANCE then
						isPetAttacking = false
						playerTargetEnemy = nil
						shouldAttack = false
					end
					
					-- Stop attacking if target is dead or too far
					if playerTargetEnemy then
						local targetMain = playerTargetEnemy.PrimaryPart or playerTargetEnemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
						local targetHealth = tonumber(playerTargetEnemy:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0
						if not targetMain or targetHealth <= 0 or (targetMain.Position - petPos).Magnitude > PET_ATTACK_RANGE then
							playerTargetEnemy = nil
							isPetAttacking = false
							shouldAttack = false
						end
					end

					if shouldAttack and distToEnemy <= EnemyAttackRange then
						local petId = Pet.Name
						local now = os.clock()
						if not petAttackTimers[petId] or now - petAttackTimers[petId] >= PetAttackCooldown then
							petAttackTimers[petId] = now
							if petFeedbackRemote then
								petFeedbackRemote:FireServer(petId, "Attack")
							end
							Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
						end
					end
					continue
				end
			end

			local RowIndex = math.ceil(i / MaxRowCapacity)
			local Row = Rows[RowIndex]
			local RowWidth = GetRowWidth(Row, Pet)

			local XOffset = #Row == 1 and 0 or RowWidth/2 - Pet.PrimaryPart.Size.X/2
			local X = (table.find(Row, Pet) - 1) * Spacing
			local Z = RowIndex * Spacing
			local Y = 0

			local RayResult = workspace:Blockcast(Pet.PrimaryPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, MaxClimbHeight, 0), Pet.PrimaryPart.Size, RayDirection, RayParams)

			if RayResult then
				Y = RayResult.Position.Y + Pet.PrimaryPart.Size.Y/2
			end

			local TargetCFrame = CFrame.new(HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.X, 0, HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Z) * HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Rotation * CFrame.new(X - XOffset, Y, Z)
			local LerpedCFrame = Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(TargetCFrame, 0.1)
			Pet:PivotTo(LerpedCFrame)
		end

		if petFeedbackRemote and PlayerPets.Name == Player.Name then
			local firstPet = Pets[1]
			if firstPet then
				local main = firstPet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
				if main then
					petFeedbackRemote:FireServer(firstPet.Name, "PositionUpdate", main.Position)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

--// Click-to-target system for NPC enemies
local mouse = Player:GetMouse()
mouse.Button1Down:Connect(function()
	if not UI then return end
	
	-- Check if clicking on UI element
	local guiObjects = Player.PlayerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(mouse.X, mouse.Y)
	local clickingUI = false
	for _, obj in guiObjects do
		if obj:IsA("GuiButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox") or obj:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
			clickingUI = true
			break
		end
	end
	if clickingUI then return end
	
	-- Raycast to find enemy
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(mouse.X, mouse.Y)
	local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
	raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.PlayerPets, Player.Character}
	raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	
	local raycastResult = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 1000, raycastParams)
	if raycastResult and raycastResult.Instance then
		local hitModel = raycastResult.Instance:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")
		if hitModel and hitModel.Parent == workspace.PetEnemies then
			-- Check if enemy is alive
			local enemyHealth = tonumber(hitModel:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0
			if enemyHealth > 0 then
				playerTargetEnemy = hitModel
				isPetAttacking = true
				
				-- Visual feedback for targeting
				local targetMain = hitModel.PrimaryPart or hitModel:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
				if targetMain then
					-- Create targeting indicator
					local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
					highlight.Name = "TargetHighlight"
					highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
					highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
					highlight.FillTransparency = 0.7
					highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
					highlight.Adornee = hitModel
					highlight.Parent = hitModel
					
					-- Remove old highlights
					for _, child in hitModel:GetChildren() do
						if child:IsA("Highlight") and child ~= highlight then
							child:Destroy()
						end
					end
					
					-- Auto-remove highlight when target dies or is cleared
					task.spawn(function()
						while playerTargetEnemy == hitModel and hitModel.Parent do
							task.wait(0.1)
						end
						highlight:Destroy()
					end)
				end
				
				-- Notify server of target selection
				if petFeedbackRemote then
					petFeedbackRemote:FireServer("TargetEnemy", hitModel.Name)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

function AreaDetection()
	while task.wait(0.1) do
		local Door = workspace.Map.Doors:FindFirstChild(tostring(PlayerData.BestZone.Value + 1))
		if not Door then task.wait(1) continue end -- Either max area or something went wrong

		local BoundBox = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(Door.CFrame, Door.Size + Vector3.new(2,2,2))

		for _,Part in BoundBox do
			if Part.Parent == Player.Character then
				if not Frames.Area.Visible then
					Utilities.ButtonHandler.OnClick(Frames.Area, UDim2.new(0.262,0,0.391,0))

					if ReplicatedStorage.Areas[Door.Name].Cost.Value ~= -1 then
						Frames.Area.Cost.Text = Utilities.Short.en(ReplicatedStorage.Areas[Door.Name].Cost.Value).." "..GameSettings.CurrencyName.Value
					else
						Frames.Area.Cost.Text = "Maxed"
					end
				end
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

coroutine.wrap(AreaDetection)()

function UpdateAllDoors()
	for _,Door in workspace.Map.Doors:GetChildren() do
		local IsVisible = PlayerData.BestZone.Value < tonumber(Door.Name)
		Door.Transparency = IsVisible and 0.35 or 1
		Door.CanCollide = IsVisible

		for _, Object in Door:GetDescendants() do
			if Object:IsA("TextLabel") then
				Object.TextTransparency = IsVisible and 0 or 1
			elseif Object:IsA("UIStroke") then
				Object.Transparency = IsVisible and 0 or 1
			end
		end
	end
end

function StartTrade(OtherPlayer)	
	if not TradeFrame.Visible then
		Utilities.ButtonHandler.OnClick(TradeFrame, UDim2.new(0.359, 0, 0.414, 0))
	end

	TradeFrame.PlayerList.Visible = false
	PlayerTrade.Visible = true

	PlayerTrade.OtherPlayer.PlayerName.Text = OtherPlayer
	TradeInfo.OtherPlayer = OtherPlayer

	PlayerTrade.OtherPlayer.ReadyCover.Visible = false

	--// Clear Inventories Before Loading!
	for _, Frame in PlayerTrade.LocalPlayer.Inventory:GetChildren() do if Frame:IsA("Frame") then Frame:Destroy() end end
	for _, Frame in PlayerTrade.OtherPlayer.Inventory:GetChildren() do if Frame:IsA("Frame") then Frame:Destroy() end end
	PlayerTrade.OtherPlayer.Currency.TextLabel.Text = "0"

	--// Load Inventories
	local function PetClicked(Pet) -- whenever a pet in the inventory is clicked
		Pet.Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			local Result = Remotes.Trading.ChangeOffer:InvokeServer(OtherPlayer, {OfferType = "Pet", ID = tonumber(Pet.Name)})
			print(Result)

			if Result == "Max" then 
				-- Max Storage, create a popup here
			elseif Result == "Added" then
				Pet.Equipped.Visible = true
			elseif Result == "Removed" then
				Pet.Equipped.Visible = false
			end
		end)
	end

	local SortTable1 = {}

	local function PetInfo(Player, Pet)
		local HoverUI = PlayerTrade.HoverDisplay

		Pet.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			Utilities.Dropdown.Hover(Pet, HoverUI, PlayerTrade)

			local PetInstance = Player.Data.Pets[Pet.Name]
			HoverUI.Multiplier.Text = "x"..Utilities.Short.en(ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Multiplier.Value)
			HoverUI.Rarity.Text = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Rarity.Value
			HoverUI.PetName.Text = PetInstance.PetName.Value
			HoverUI.ID.Text = "ID: "..Pet.Name
		end)
	end

	for _,v in Data.Pets:GetChildren() do -- load pets
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			local Pet = AddPet(v, SortTable1, PlayerTrade.LocalPlayer.Inventory)
			PetClicked(Pet)
			PetInfo(Player, Pet)
		end)()
	end

	SortInventory(SortTable1, PlayerTrade.LocalPlayer.Inventory)

	local SortTable2 = {}
	for _,v in Players[OtherPlayer].Data.Pets:GetChildren() do -- load pets
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			local Pet = AddPet(v, SortTable2, PlayerTrade.OtherPlayer.Inventory)
			PetInfo(Players[OtherPlayer], Pet)
		end)()
	end

	SortInventory(SortTable2, PlayerTrade.OtherPlayer.Inventory)
end

Remotes.Trading.StartTrade.OnClientInvoke = StartTrade

Remotes.Trading.TradeAction.OnClientInvoke = function(Args) -- function is ran when u add pets to a trade, add currency etc
	if Args.Option == "Cancel" then
		if TradeFrame.Visible then
			Utilities.ButtonHandler.OnClick(TradeFrame, TradeFrame.Size) --// close the trade
			PlayerTrade.Visible = false
			TradeFrame.PlayerList.Visible = true
		end
	elseif Args.Option == "Ready" then
		PlayerTrade.OtherPlayer.ReadyCover.Visible = Args.Option == "Ready" 
	elseif Args.Option == "Countdown" then
		PlayerTrade.OtherPlayer.ReadyCover.Visible = true

		if Args.Count == 0 then --// end trade
			PlayerTrade.TradeCountdown.Visible = false			

			if TradeFrame.Visible then
				Utilities.ButtonHandler.OnClick(TradeFrame, TradeFrame.Size) --// close the trade
				PlayerTrade.Visible = false
				TradeFrame.PlayerList.Visible = true
			end
		else
			PlayerTrade.TradeCountdown.Visible = true

			for i = Args.Count * 10, 1, -1 do
				if not Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value then
					PlayerTrade.TradeCountdown.Visible = false
					break
				end
				PlayerTrade.TradeCountdown.Text = (i/10).." Seconds Left.."

				task.wait(0.1)
			end	

			PlayerTrade.TradeCountdown.Text = "Processing..."			
		end
	elseif Args.Option == "CountdownEnded" then
		PlayerTrade.TradeCountdown.Visible = false
	end
end

Remotes.Trading.ChangeOffer.OnClientInvoke = function(Action, Args) -- function is ran when u add pets to a trade, add currency etc
	if Action == "PetAdded" then
		PlayerTrade.OtherPlayer.Inventory[Args].Equipped.Visible = true
	elseif Action == "PetRemoved" then
		PlayerTrade.OtherPlayer.Inventory[Args].Equipped.Visible = false
	elseif Action == "TradeTokens" then
		PlayerTrade.OtherPlayer.Currency.TextLabel.Text = Args
	end
end

		end

local GemUpgradeTemplate = Frames.GemShop.Upgrades.Template
GemUpgradeTemplate.Parent = script
GemUpgradeTemplate.Name = "GemUpgradeTemplate" -- this moves the template from the ui to the script (easier for people to edit :) 

for _,v in Gemshop:GetChildren() do
	local i = v.Name
	local NewUpgrade = GemUpgradeTemplate:Clone()
	NewUpgrade.LayoutOrder = tonumber(i)
	NewUpgrade.Name = i
	NewUpgrade.Title.Text = v.UpgradeName.Value

	local function CalcReward(Reward)
		local R = v.Reward

		if R.Exponential.Value then
			return R.DefaultReward.Value + R.IncreasePer.Value ^ Reward
		else
			return R.DefaultReward.Value + R.IncreasePer.Value * Reward
		end
	end

	local function CalcCost()
		local C = v.Price

		if C.Exponential.Value then
			return C.DefaultPrice.Value * C.IncreasePer.Value ^ PlayerData["GemUpgrade"..i].Value
		else
			return C.DefaultPrice.Value + C.IncreasePer.Value * (PlayerData["GemUpgrade"..i].Value+1)
		end
	end

	local function Update()
		local O = v.Operator.Value
		local CurrentLevel = PlayerData["GemUpgrade"..i].Value

		if CurrentLevel < v.Max.Value then
			NewUpgrade.Description.Text = O..Utilities.Short.en(CalcReward(CurrentLevel)).." > "..O..Utilities.Short.en(CalcReward(CurrentLevel+1))
			NewUpgrade.Buy.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(CalcCost())
		else
			NewUpgrade.Description.Text = O..Utilities.Short.en(CalcReward(CurrentLevel)).." > Max"
			NewUpgrade.Buy.Amount.Text = "Max"
		end
	end

	Update()
	PlayerData["GemUpgrade"..i].Changed:Connect(Update)

	NewUpgrade.Parent = Frames.GemShop.Upgrades

	NewUpgrade.Buy.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Remotes.GemUpgrade:FireServer(i)
	end)
end

--// Eggs Handler
-- View/modify eggs, costs, and pet chances.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local EggsHandler = {}

local EggsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Eggs")

function EggsHandler.AllEggs()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Egg in EggsFolder:GetChildren() do
		local Cost = Egg:FindFirstChild("Cost")
		local EggPets = {}
		local EggPetsFolder = Egg:FindFirstChild("Pets")
		if EggPetsFolder then
			for _, Pet in EggPetsFolder:GetChildren() do
				if Pet:IsA("ValueBase") then
					EggPets[#EggPets + 1] = { name = Pet.Name, chance = Pet.Value }
				end
			end
		end
		table.sort(EggPets, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Egg.Name,
			cost = Cost and Cost.Value or 0,
			isRobux = Egg:FindFirstChild("ProductId") ~= nil,
			productInfo = Egg:FindFirstChild("ProductId") and { id = Egg.ProductId.Value } or nil,
			pets = EggPets,
			petCount = #EggPets,
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
	return Result
end

function EggsHandler.SetEggCost(EggName, NewValue)
	local Egg = EggsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(EggName))
	if not Egg or not Egg:FindFirstChild("Cost") then return false, "Egg not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid cost" end
	Egg.Cost.Value = Num
	return true, "Set " .. EggName .. " cost = " .. Num
end

function EggsHandler.SetPetChance(EggName, PetName, NewValue)
	local Egg = EggsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(EggName))
	if not Egg or not Egg:FindFirstChild("Pets") then return false, "Egg not found" end
	local Pet = Egg.Pets:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not Pet then return false, "Pet not in this egg" end
	local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid chance" end
	Pet.Value = Num
	return true, "Set " .. EggName .. "." .. PetName .. " chance = " .. Num
end

return EggsHandler

--!strict
-- AuctionEngine.lua
-- Buy order matching, price history, sniping alerts

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local MessagingService = game:GetService("MessagingService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local AuctionEngine = {}
AuctionEngine.__index = AuctionEngine

-- DataStore keys
local DATASTORE_KEYS = {
	Listing = "Auction_Listing_",
	BuyOrder = "Auction_BuyOrder_",
	History = "Auction_History_",
	Watchlist = "Auction_Watchlist_",
}

-- In-memory caches
local activeListings = {}      -- [listingId] = listing
local activeBuyOrders = {}     -- [orderId] = order
local priceHistory = {}        -- [itemId][bucketKey] = {min, max, avg, volume}
local watchlists = {}          -- [playerId] = {itemId, ...}
local snipingThresholds = {}   -- [playerId][itemId] = threshold (0-1)

-- Messaging topics
local TOPICS = {
	ListingPosted = "Auction_ListingPosted",
	BuyOrderPlaced = "Auction_BuyOrderPlaced",
	BuyOrderFilled = "Auction_BuyOrderFilled",
	SnipingAlert = "Auction_SnipingAlert",
	HistoryUpdated = "Auction_HistoryUpdated",
}

-- ============================================
-- DATA MODELS
-- ============================================

export type Listing = {
	id: string,
	itemId: string,
	sellerId: number,
	price: number,
	quantity: number,
	listedAt: number,
	expiresAt: number,
	status: "active" | "filled" | "cancelled" | "expired",
}

export type BuyOrder = {
	id: string,
	itemId: string,
	buyerId: number,
	maxPrice: number,
	quantity: number,
	filled: number,
	placedAt: number,
	expiresAt: number,
	status: "open" | "partial" | "filled" | "cancelled" | "expired",
}

export type HistoryBucket = {
	minPrice: number,
	maxPrice: number,
	avgPrice: number,
	volume: number,
	timestamp: number,
}

-- ============================================
-- MATCHING ENGINE
-- ============================================

function AuctionEngine.MatchBuyOrders(listing: Listing): {filled: number, orders: {BuyOrder}}
	local matches = {}
	local remainingQty = listing.quantity
	
	-- Find compatible buy orders: same item, maxPrice >= listPrice, open/partial status
	local candidates = {}
	for _, order in activeBuyOrders do
		if order.itemId == listing.itemId
			and order.maxPrice >= listing.price
			and (order.status == "open" or order.status == "partial")
			and order.buyerId ~= listing.sellerId
			and os.time() < order.expiresAt then
			table.insert(candidates, order)
		end
	end
	
	-- Sort by price-time priority: highest maxPrice first, then earliest placed
	table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
		if a.maxPrice ~= b.maxPrice then
			return a.maxPrice > b.maxPrice
		end
		return a.placedAt < b.placedAt
	end)
	
	for _, order in candidates do
		if remainingQty <= 0 then break end
		
		local fillQty = math.min(remainingQty, order.quantity - order.filled)
		if fillQty <= 0 then continue end
		
		order.filled += fillQty
		remainingQty -= fillQty
		
		if order.filled >= order.quantity then
			order.status = "filled"
		else
			order.status = "partial"
		end
		
		table.insert(matches, {orderId = order.id, filledQty = fillQty, fillPrice = listing.price})
	end
	
	return {filled = listing.quantity - remainingQty, orders = matches}
end

-- ============================================
-- BUY ORDER MANAGEMENT
-- ============================================

function AuctionEngine.PlaceBuyOrder(buyerId: number, itemId: string, maxPrice: number, quantity: number, durationHours: number): (boolean, string?, string?)
	if maxPrice <= 0 or quantity <= 0 then
		return false, "Invalid price or quantity"
	end
	
	if durationHours < 1 or durationHours > 168 then -- max 1 week
		return false, "Duration must be 1-168 hours"
	end
	
	local orderId = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	local now = os.time()
	
	local order: BuyOrder = {
		id = orderId,
		itemId = itemId,
		buyerId = buyerId,
		maxPrice = maxPrice,
		quantity = quantity,
		filled = 0,
		placedAt = now,
		expiresAt = now + (durationHours * 3600),
		status = "open",
	}
	
	activeBuyOrders[orderId] = order
	
	-- Check for immediate matches against existing listings
	-- (In production, this would iterate active listings)
	
	-- Publish event
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.BuyOrderPlaced, {
			orderId = orderId,
			itemId = itemId,
			maxPrice = maxPrice,
			quantity = quantity,
			buyerId = buyerId,
		})
	end
	
	return true, orderId, nil
end

function AuctionEngine.CancelBuyOrder(buyerId: number, orderId: string): boolean
	local order = activeBuyOrders[orderId]
	if not order or order.buyerId ~= buyerId then return false end
	
	if order.status ~= "open" and order.status ~= "partial" then
		return false
	end
	
	order.status = "cancelled"
	activeBuyOrders[orderId] = nil
	return true
end

function AuctionEngine.GetPlayerBuyOrders(playerId: number): {BuyOrder}
	local result = {}
	for _, order in activeBuyOrders do
		if order.buyerId == playerId then
			table.insert(result, order)
		end
	end
	return result
end

-- ============================================
-- PRICE HISTORY
-- ============================================

local BUCKET_DURATIONS = {
	Hour = 3600,
	SixHour = 21600,
	Day = 86400,
	Week = 604800,
}

function AuctionEngine.GetBucketKey(bucketType: string, timestamp: number): string
	local duration = BUCKET_DURATIONS[bucketType] or BUCKET_DURATIONS.Hour
	return tostring(math.floor(timestamp / duration) * duration)
end

function AuctionEngine.RecordSale(itemId: string, price: number, quantity: number, timestamp: number?)
	timestamp = timestamp or os.time()
	
	for bucketType, duration in BUCKET_DURATIONS do
		local bucketKey = AuctionEngine.GetBucketKey(bucketType, timestamp)
		local key = itemId .. "_" .. bucketKey
		
		if not priceHistory[key] then
			priceHistory[key] = {
				minPrice = price,
				maxPrice = price,
				totalPrice = price * quantity,
				volume = quantity,
				count = 1,
				timestamp = timestamp,
			}
		else
			local bucket = priceHistory[key]
			bucket.minPrice = math.min(bucket.minPrice, price)
			bucket.maxPrice = math.max(bucket.maxPrice, price)
			bucket.totalPrice += price * quantity
			bucket.volume += quantity
			bucket.count += 1
		end
	end
end

function AuctionEngine.GetPriceHistory(itemId: string, bucketType: string, fromTimestamp: number, toTimestamp: number): {HistoryBucket}
	local results = {}
	local duration = BUCKET_DURATIONS[bucketType] or BUCKET_DURATIONS.Hour
	
	for bucketKey, data in priceHistory do
		if not string.find(bucketKey, itemId .. "_") then continue end
		if data.timestamp < fromTimestamp or data.timestamp > toTimestamp then continue end
		
		table.insert(results, {
			minPrice = data.minPrice,
			maxPrice = data.maxPrice,
			avgPrice = data.count > 0 and (data.totalPrice / data.volume) or 0,
			volume = data.volume,
			timestamp = data.timestamp,
		})
	end
	
	table.sort(results, function(a, b) return a.timestamp < b.timestamp end)
	return results
end

function AuctionEngine.GetMovingAverage(itemId: string, bucketType: string, periods: number): number
	local history = AuctionEngine.GetPriceHistory(itemId, bucketType, os.time() - periods * BUCKET_DURATIONS[bucketType], os.time())
	if #history == 0 then return 0 end
	
	local sum = 0
	for _, bucket in history do
		sum += bucket.avgPrice
	end
	return sum / #history
end

function AuctionEngine.GetCurrentPriceStats(itemId: string): {min: number, max: number, avg: number, volume: number, movingAvg7d: number}
	local now = os.time()
	local dayHistory = AuctionEngine.GetPriceHistory(itemId, "Day", now - 7 * 86400, now)
	
	if #dayHistory == 0 then
		return {min = 0, max = 0, avg = 0, volume = 0, movingAvg7d = 0}
	end
	
	local totalVolume = 0
	local weightedSum = 0
	local minPrice = math.huge
	local maxPrice = 0
	
	for _, bucket in dayHistory do
		minPrice = math.min(minPrice, bucket.minPrice)
		maxPrice = math.max(maxPrice, bucket.maxPrice)
		totalVolume += bucket.volume
		weightedSum += bucket.avgPrice * bucket.volume
	end
	
	return {
		min = minPrice == math.huge and 0 or minPrice,
		max = maxPrice,
		avg = totalVolume > 0 and (weightedSum / totalVolume) or 0,
		volume = totalVolume,
		movingAvg7d = totalVolume > 0 and (weightedSum / totalVolume) or 0,
	}
end

-- ============================================
-- SNIPING ALERTS
-- ============================================

function AuctionEngine.SetSnipingThreshold(playerId: number, itemId: string, threshold: number)
	-- threshold = discount percentage (0.15 = 15% below moving average)
	if not snipingThresholds[playerId] then snipingThresholds[playerId] = {} end
	snipingThresholds[playerId][itemId] = math.clamp(threshold, 0.01, 0.50)
end

function AuctionEngine.GetSnipingThresholds(playerId: number): {[string]: number}
	return snipingThresholds[playerId] or {}
end

function AuctionEngine.CheckSnipingAlert(listing: Listing): boolean
	local stats = AuctionEngine.GetCurrentPriceStats(listing.itemId)
	if stats.movingAvg7d == 0 then return false end
	
	local discount = 1 - (listing.price / stats.movingAvg7d)
	
	-- Check all players watching this item
	-- In practice, iterate watchlists or subscriptions
	return discount >= 0.15 -- default threshold
end

function AuctionEngine.TriggerSnipingAlert(listing: Listing, discount: number)
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.SnipingAlert, {
			itemId = listing.itemId,
			listingPrice = listing.price,
			movingAvg = AuctionEngine.GetCurrentPriceStats(listing.itemId).movingAvg7d,
			discount = discount,
			listingId = listing.id,
		})
	end
end

-- ============================================
-- WATCHLIST
-- ============================================

function AuctionEngine.AddToWatchlist(playerId: number, itemId: string)
	if not watchlists[playerId] then watchlists[playerId] = {} end
	if not table.find(watchlists[playerId], itemId) then
		table.insert(watchlists[playerId], itemId)
	end
end

function AuctionEngine.RemoveFromWatchlist(playerId: number, itemId: string)
	if watchlists[playerId] then
		local idx = table.find(watchlists[playerId], itemId)
		if idx then table.remove(watchlists[playerId], idx) end
	end
end

function AuctionEngine.GetWatchlist(playerId: number): {string}
	return watchlists[playerId] or {}
end

function AuctionEngine.GetWatchlistData(playerId: number): {{itemId: string, lowestAsk: number, avgPrice: number, volume24h: number, priceDelta24h: number}}
	local watchlist = watchlists[playerId] or {}
	local results = {}
	
	for _, itemId in watchlist do
		local stats = AuctionEngine.GetCurrentPriceStats(itemId)
		-- In production, fetch lowest ask from active listings
		table.insert(results, {
			itemId = itemId,
			lowestAsk = stats.min,
			avgPrice = stats.avg,
			volume24h = stats.volume,
			priceDelta24h = 0, -- would need previous day comparison
		})
	end
	
	return results
end

-- ============================================
-- LISTING MANAGEMENT (stubs for integration)
-- ============================================

function AuctionEngine.CreateListing(sellerId: number, itemId: string, price: number, quantity: number, durationHours: number): (boolean, string?)
	local listingId = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	local now = os.time()
	
	local listing: Listing = {
		id = listingId,
		itemId = itemId,
		sellerId = sellerId,
		price = price,
		quantity = quantity,
		listedAt = now,
		expiresAt = now + (durationHours * 3600),
		status = "active",
	}
	
	activeListings[listingId] = listing
	
	-- Check for matching buy orders
	local matches = AuctionEngine.MatchBuyOrders(listing)
	if matches.filled > 0 then
		-- Process fills
		for _, match in matches.orders do
			-- Record sale for history
			AuctionEngine.RecordSale(listing.itemId, match.fillPrice, match.filledQty)
			
			-- Notify buyer
			if RunService:IsServer() then
				MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.BuyOrderFilled, {
					orderId = match.orderId,
					itemId = listing.itemId,
					fillPrice = match.fillPrice,
					quantity = match.filledQty,
				})
			end
		end
	end
	
	-- Check sniping alerts
	if AuctionEngine.CheckSnipingAlert(listing) then
		local stats = AuctionEngine.GetCurrentPriceStats(listing.itemId)
		if stats.movingAvg7d > 0 then
			local discount = 1 - (listing.price / stats.movingAvg7d)
			AuctionEngine.TriggerSnipingAlert(listing, discount)
		end
	end
	
	-- Publish listing event
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.ListingPosted, {
			listingId = listingId,
			itemId = itemId,
			price = price,
			quantity = quantity,
			sellerId = sellerId,
		})
	end
	
	return true, listingId
end

function AuctionEngine.GetActiveListings(itemId: string?): {Listing}
	local results = {}
	for _, listing in activeListings do
		if listing.status == "active" and os.time() < listing.expiresAt then
			if not itemId or listing.itemId == itemId then
				table.insert(results, listing)
			end
		end
	end
	
	-- Sort by price ascending
	table.sort(results, function(a, b) return a.price < b.price end)
	return results
end

-- ============================================
-- BACKGROUND JOBS
-- ============================================

if RunService:IsServer() then
	-- Price history aggregation (every 5 minutes)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(300)
			
			-- Cleanup expired orders/listings
			local now = os.time()
			for id, order in activeBuyOrders do
				if now >= order.expiresAt then
					order.status = "expired"
					activeBuyOrders[id] = nil
				end
			end
			
			for id, listing in activeListings do
				if now >= listing.expiresAt then
					listing.status = "expired"
				end
			end
			
			-- Cleanup old price history (keep 90 days)
			local cutoff = os.time() - 90 * 86400
			for key, data in priceHistory do
				if data.timestamp < cutoff then
					priceHistory[key] = nil
				end
			end
			
			MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.HistoryUpdated, {timestamp = os.time()})
		end
	end)
end

return AuctionEngine

--// Auction Handler
-- View/clear auction listings.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local AuctionHandler = {}

function AuctionHandler.ClearAllListings()
	local AuctionFolder = script.Parent.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("AuctionHouse")
	if not AuctionFolder then return false, "No auction house found" end

	local Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Config)
	local Shards = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Shards"))
	local Mail = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Mail"))
	local AuctionPets = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Pets"))

	local Removed = 0
	for i = 1, Config.AUCTION_SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Expired = {}

		local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
			for Id, Listing in pairs(Old) do
				Expired[Id] = Listing
			end
			for Id in pairs(Expired) do Old[Id] = nil end
			return Old
		end)

		if Success then
			for Id, Listing in pairs(Expired) do
				Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
				local Owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Listing.owner)
				if Owner and Owner:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Owner.Loaded.Value then
					AuctionPets.Grant(Owner, Listing.petName)
				else
					Mail.Update(Listing.owner, function(MailData)
						MailData.pets[Listing.id] = { petName = Listing.petName }
						return MailData
					end)
				end
				Removed += 1
			end
		end
	end

	return true, "Cleared " .. Removed .. " listing(s)"
end

return AuctionHandler
