-- ============================================
-- EMOTE STATE MANAGEMENT
-- ============================================

local playerEmotes = {} -- [playerId] = {emoteId = true}
local emoteCooldowns = {} -- [playerId][emoteId] = lastUsedTime
local equippedEmotes = {} -- [playerId] = emoteId (for quick access)

-- ============================================
-- CORE FUNCTIONS
-- ============================================

function EmoteEngine.GetEmote(emoteId: string): Emote?
	return EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
end

function EmoteEngine.GetAllEmotes(): {Emote}
	local result = {}
	for _, emote in EMOTE_REGISTRY do
		table.insert(result, emote)
	end
	return result
end

function EmoteEngine.GetEmotesByTier(tier: string): {Emote}
	local result = {}
	for _, emote in EMOTE_REGISTRY do
		if emote.tier == tier then
			table.insert(result, emote)
		end
	end
	return result
end

function EmoteEngine.GetEmotesForPlayer(playerId: number): {Emote}
	local owned = playerEmotes[playerId] or {}
	local result = {}
	for emoteId, _ in owned do
		local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
		if emote then table.insert(result, emote) end
	end
	return result
end

function EmoteEngine.GetAvailableEmotes(): {Emote}
	-- Returns emotes that can be unlocked (not owned by anyone yet)
	-- In practice, this would filter by global unlock state
	return EmoteEngine.GetAllEmotes()
end

-- Ownership management
function EmoteEngine.GrantEmote(playerId: number, emoteId: string): boolean
	if not EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId] then return false end
	if not playerEmotes[playerId] then playerEmotes[playerId] = {} end
	playerEmotes[playerId][emoteId] = true
	return true
end

function EmoteEngine.RevokeEmote(playerId: number, emoteId: string): boolean
	if playerEmotes[playerId] then
		playerEmotes[playerId][emoteId] = nil
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function EmoteEngine.HasEmote(playerId: number, emoteId: string): boolean
	return playerEmotes[playerId] and playerEmotes[playerId][emoteId] == true
end

function EmoteEngine.GetOwnedEmotes(playerId: number): {string}
	local owned = playerEmotes[playerId] or {}
	local result = {}
	for emoteId, _ in owned do
		table.insert(result, emoteId)
	end
	return result
end

-- ============================================
-- COOLDOWN MANAGEMENT
-- ============================================

function EmoteEngine.IsOnCooldown(playerId: number, emoteId: string): boolean
	local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
	if not emote then return true end
	
	local cooldowns = emoteCooldowns[playerId]
	if not cooldowns then return false end
	
	local lastUsed = cooldowns[emoteId]
	if not lastUsed then return false end
	
	return os.clock() - lastUsed < emote.cooldown
end

function EmoteEngine.GetRemainingCooldown(playerId: number, emoteId: string): number
	local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
	if not emote then return 0 end
	
	local cooldowns = emoteCooldowns[playerId]
	if not cooldowns then return 0 end
	
	local lastUsed = cooldowns[emoteId]
	if not lastUsed then return 0 end
	
	return math.max(0, emote.cooldown - (os.clock() - lastUsed))
end

function EmoteEngine.SetCooldown(playerId: number, emoteId: string)
	if not emoteCooldowns[playerId] then emoteCooldowns[playerId] = {} end
	emoteCooldowns[playerId][emoteId] = os.clock()
end

function EmoteEngine.GetAllCooldowns(playerId: number): {[string]: number}
	local result = {}
	local cooldowns = emoteCooldowns[playerId] or {}
	local now = os.clock()
	
	for emoteId, lastUsed in cooldowns do
		local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
		if emote then
			local remaining = math.max(0, emote.cooldown - (now - lastUsed))
			if remaining > 0 then
				result[emoteId] = remaining
			end
		end
	end
	return result
end

-- ============================================
-- EQUIPPED EMOTE (quick access)
-- ============================================

function EmoteEngine.SetEquipped(playerId: number, emoteId: string?): boolean
	if emoteId and not EmoteEngine.HasEmote(playerId, emoteId) then
		return false
	end
	equippedEmotes[playerId] = emoteId
	return true
end

function EmoteEngine.GetEquipped(playerId: number): string?
	return equippedEmotes[playerId]
end

function EmoteEngine.UseEquipped(playerId: number): boolean
	local emoteId = equippedEmotes[playerId]
	if not emoteId then return false end
	return EmoteEngine.TriggerEmote(playerId, emoteId)
end

-- ============================================
-- EMOTE EXECUTION
-- ============================================

function EmoteEngine.TriggerEmote(playerId: number, emoteId: string, position: Vector3?): boolean
	local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
	if not emote then return false end
	
	-- Check ownership
	if not EmoteEngine.HasEmote(playerId, emoteId) then
		return false
	end
	
	-- Check cooldown
	if EmoteEngine.IsOnCooldown(playerId, emoteId) then
		return false
	end
	
	-- Check anti-spam (max 3 emotes per 10 seconds)
	local recentCount = 0
	local now = os.clock()
	for _, lastUsed in pairs(emoteCooldowns[playerId] or {}) do
		if now - lastUsed < 10 then recentCount += 1 end
	end
	if recentCount >= 3 then return false end
	
	-- Set cooldown
	EmoteEngine.SetCooldown(playerId, emoteId)
	
	-- Trigger animation on server (replicates to nearby clients)
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		EmoteEngine._PlayAnimationOnServer(playerId, emoteId)
	else
		EmoteEngine._PlayAnimationOnClient(playerId, emoteId)
	end
	
	return true
end

function EmoteEngine._PlayAnimationOnServer(playerId: number, emoteId: string)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerById(playerId)
	if not player then return end
	
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then return end
	
	local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
	if not emote then return end
	
	-- Load and play animation
	local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not animator then return end
	
	local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.AnimationId = emote.animationId
	animation.Priority = emote.animationPriority
	
	local track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
	track:Play()
	
	-- Stop after duration (if not looping)
	if emote.duration > 0 then
		task.delay(emote.duration, function()
			track:Stop()
		end)
	end
	
	-- Replicate to nearby clients via remote
	-- (In practice, use a RemoteEvent to fire clients in radius)
	
	-- Trigger VFX at pet position
	local pet = EmoteEngine._GetEquippedPet(player)
	if pet then
		-- Fire client event for VFX
	end
end

function EmoteEngine._PlayAnimationOnClient(playerId: number, emoteId: string)
	-- Client-side animation playback
	local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
	if not emote then return end
	
	-- If local player, play on their character
	if playerId == Players.LocalPlayer.UserId then
		local character = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		if character then
			local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if humanoid then
				local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
				if animator then
					local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
					animation.AnimationId = emote.animationId
					animation.Priority = emote.animationPriority
					local track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
					track:Play()
					if emote.duration > 0 then
						task.delay(emote.duration, function() track:Stop() end)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	-- Play VFX at pet
	if position then
		-- Play VFX effects
	end
end

function EmoteEngine._GetEquippedPet(player: Player): Model?
	-- Find player's equipped pet
	local playerPets = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerPets")
	if not playerPets then return nil end
	
	local folder = playerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if not folder then return nil end
	
	for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do
		if pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") == "Follow" then
			return pet
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- ============================================
-- CHAT TRIGGER PARSING
-- ============================================

local EMOTE_PREFIXES = {"/e ", "/emote ", "/em "}

function EmoteEngine.ParseChatMessage(message: string): string?
	message = message:lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") -- trim
	
	for _, prefix in EMOTE_PREFIXES do
		if message:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
			local emoteName = message:sub(#prefix + 1):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
			return emoteName
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function EmoteEngine.HandleChatMessage(playerId: number, message: string): boolean
	local emoteName = EmoteEngine.ParseChatMessage(message)
	if not emoteName then return false end
	
	-- Try exact match first
	local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteName]
	if emote and EmoteEngine.HasEmote(playerId, emoteName) then
		return EmoteEngine.TriggerEmote(playerId, emoteName)
	end
	
	-- Try fuzzy match (partial)
	for id, emote in EMOTE_REGISTRY do
		if id:find(emoteName, 1, true) and EmoteEngine.HasEmote(playerId, id) then
			return EmoteEngine.TriggerEmote(playerId, id)
		end
	end
	
	return false
end

-- ============================================
-- UNLOCK CONDITIONS
-- ============================================

function EmoteEngine.CheckUnlockCondition(playerId: number, emoteId: string): boolean
	local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
	if not emote then return false end
	
	if emote.tier == "Starter" then return true end
	if emote.tier == "Shop" then
		if emote.gamepassId then
			-- Check gamepass ownership
			return game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):UserOwnsGamepassAsync(Players:GetPlayerByUserId(playerId), emote.gamepassId)
		end
		return false
	end
	
	if emote.tier == "Progression" then
		-- Check rebirth count from PlayerData
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(playerId)
		if player then
			local rebirths = player.Data and player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirths.Value or 0
			local required = tonumber(emote.unlockCondition:match("%d+"))
			return required and rebirths >= required
		end
	end
	
	if emote.tier == "Collection" then
		-- Check unique pet count
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(playerId)
		if player then
			local uniquePets = 0
			local folder = workspace.PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
			if folder then
				for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do
									if pet:GetAttribute("PetName") then uniquePets += 1 end
							end
						end
			local required = tonumber(emote.unlockCondition:match("%d+"))
			return required and uniquePets >= required
		end
	end
	
	if emote.tier == "Event" then
		-- Check event participation flag
		return false -- Would check event participation data
	end
	
	if emote.tier == "Prestige" then
		-- Check leaderboard rank or max rebirth
		return false
	end
	
	return false
end

function EmoteEngine.CheckAndGrantUnlocks(playerId: number): {string}
	local granted = {}
	for emoteId, emote in EMOTE_REGISTRY do
		if not EmoteEngine.HasEmote(playerId, emoteId) and EmoteEngine.CheckUnlockCondition(playerId, emoteId) then
			EmoteEngine.GrantEmote(playerId, emoteId)
			table.insert(granted, emoteId)
		end
	end
	return granted
end

-- ============================================
-- EMOTE WHEEL (UI Helper)
-- ============================================

function EmoteEngine.GetEmoteWheelData(playerId: number): {{id: string, name: string, icon: string, cooldown: number, owned: boolean}}
	local result = {}
	for _, emote in EMOTE_REGISTRY do
		local owned = EmoteEngine.HasEmote(playerId, emote.id)
		local cd = EmoteEngine.GetRemainingCooldown(playerId, emote.id)
		table.insert(result, {
			id = emote.id,
			name = emote.name,
			icon = EmoteEngine._GetEmoteIcon(emote.id),
			cooldown = cd,
			owned = owned,
			equipped = equippedEmotes[playerId] == emote.id,
		})
	end
	return result
end

function EmoteEngine._GetEmoteIcon(emoteId: string): string
	local icons = {
		wave = "👋", sit = "🪑", dance = "💃",
		flex = "💪", sleep = "😴", happy = "😄",
		royal = "🤴", spooky = "👻", festive = "🎉",
		winter = "❄️", halloween = "🎃", anniversary = "🎂",
		legend = "🏆", mythic = "🌟", cosmic = "🌌",
		vip = "👑", supporter = "❤️",
	}
	return icons[emoteId] or "✨"
end

-- ============================================
-- SERVER INITIALIZATION
-- ============================================

if RunService:IsServer() then
	-- Auto-grant starter emotes on join
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		task.wait(1)
		for emoteId, emote in EMOTE_REGISTRY do
			if emote.tier == "Starter" then
				EmoteEngine.GrantEmote(player.UserId, emoteId)
			end
		end
		EmoteEngine.CheckAndGrantUnlocks(player.UserId)
	end)
	
	-- Chat listener
	Players.PlayerChatted:Connect(function(message, recipient)
		-- message is the Chat message object in newer Roblox
		local text = typeof(message) == "string" and message or message.Text
		local speaker = typeof(message) == "string" and recipient or message.TextSource
		if speaker then
			EmoteEngine.HandleChatMessage(speaker.UserId, text)
		end
	end)
end

return EmoteEngine

--// Pets Handler
-- View all pets, give/remove pets, edit pet settings.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PetsHandler = {}

local PetsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Pets")

function PetsHandler.AllPets()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Pet in PetsFolder:GetChildren() do
		local Settings = Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings")
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Pet.Name,
			rarity = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Rarity")) and Settings.Rarity.Value or "?",
			multiplier = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Multiplier")) and Settings.Multiplier.Value or 1,
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
	return Result
end

function PetsHandler.PetInfo(PetName)
	local Pet = PetsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not Pet then return nil end
	local Settings = Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings")
	return {
		name = Pet.Name,
		rarity = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Rarity")) and Settings.Rarity.Value or "?",
		multiplier = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Multiplier")) and Settings.Multiplier.Value or 1,
	}
end

function PetsHandler.SetPetSetting(PetName, SettingName, NewValue)
	local Pet = PetsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not Pet then return false, "Pet not found" end
	local Settings = Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings")
	local Value = Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild(tostring(SettingName))
	if not Value then return false, "Pet setting not found" end
	if Value:IsA("IntValue") or Value:IsA("NumberValue") then
		local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
		if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid number" end
		Value.Value = Num
	elseif Value:IsA("StringValue") then
		Value.Value = tostring(NewValue)
	elseif Value:IsA("BoolValue") then
		Value.Value = (NewValue == true or NewValue == "true")
	else
		return false, "Unsupported value type"
	end
	return true, "Set " .. PetName .. "." .. SettingName .. " = " .. tostring(NewValue)
end

function PetsHandler.GrantPet(Player, PetName)
	local PetModel = PetsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not PetModel then return false, "Pet not found in ReplicatedStorage" end

	local PetTemplate = ReplicatedStorage.Assets:FindFirstChild("PetTemplate")
	if not PetTemplate then return false, "PetTemplate not found" end

	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Id
	repeat
		Id = tostring(math.random(1, 999999999))
	until not Folder:FindFirstChild(Id)

	local NewPet = PetTemplate:Clone()
	NewPet.Name = Id
	NewPet.PetName.Value = tostring(PetName)
	NewPet.Equipped.Value = false
	NewPet.Parent = Folder
	return true, "Gave " .. PetName .. " to " .. Player.Name
end

function PetsHandler.DeleteAllPets(Player)
	if not Player or not Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then return false, "Player not found" end
	local PetMultipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.PetMultipliers)

	local Count = 0
	for _, Pet in Player.Data.Pets:GetChildren() do
		if Pet.Equipped.Value then
			PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
		end
		Pet:Destroy()
		Count += 1
	end
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = 0

	local WorkspaceFolder = workspace.PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(Player.Name)
	if WorkspaceFolder then
		for _, Pet in WorkspaceFolder:GetChildren() do
			Pet:Destroy()
		end
	end
	return true, "Deleted " .. Count .. " pet(s) from " .. Player.Name
end

function PetsHandler.DeleteSpecificPet(Player, PetId)
	if not Player or not Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Pet = Player.Data.Pets:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetId))
	if not Pet then return false, "Pet not found" end
	local PetMultipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.PetMultipliers)

	if Pet.Equipped.Value then
		PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
		Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = math.max(Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value - 1, 0)
	end
	local PetName = Pet.PetName.Value
	Pet:Destroy()
	return true, "Deleted pet " .. PetName
end

return PetsHandler

	-- Progress bar for auto-dismiss

		local progress = Instance.new("Frame")
		progress.Name = "Progress"
		progress.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3)
		progress.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
		progress.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		progress.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 140, 220)
		progress.BorderSizePixel = 0
		progress.Parent = template
		
		local progressTween = game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(progress, TweenInfo.new(data.autoDismiss, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
		})
		progressTween:Play()
	end
	
	-- Close button
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 4)
	closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeBtn.Text = "✕"
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeBtn.TextSize = 12
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 165, 190)
	closeBtn.Parent = template
	
	closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		dismissToast(data.id)
	end)
	
	-- Swipe to dismiss
	local startX = 0
	template.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			startX = input.Position.X
		end
	end)
	
	template.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			local deltaX = input.Position.X - startX
			if deltaX > 80 then -- swiped right
				dismissToast(data.id)
			end
		end
	end)
	
	-- Entrance animation
	template.Position = UDim2.new(1, 400, 0, 0)
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(template, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	}):Play()
	
	return template
end

local function dismissToast(id: string)
	local toast = toastContainer:FindFirstChild("Toast_" .. id)
	if toast then
		game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(toast, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
			Position = UDim2.new(1, 400, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1
		}):Play()
		task.wait(0.2)
		toast:Destroy()
		activeToasts[id] = nil
	end

	-- This would update badges on menu icons

-- Core send function
function NotificationSystem.Send(player, data)
	-- Server-side: publish to player's topic
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		local message = {
			id = game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false),
			type = data.type,
			title = data.title,
			body = data.body,
			icon = data.icon,
			sound = data.sound,
			actions = data.actions,
			autoDismiss = data.autoDismiss,
			priority = data.priority,
			timestamp = os.time(),
		}
		
		-- Check deduplication
		local dedupKey = data.type .. "_" .. (data.targetId or "")
		if recentNotifications[dedupKey] and os.time() - recentNotifications[dedupKey] < DEDUP_WINDOW then
			return -- Suppressed duplicate
		end
		recentNotifications[dedupKey] = os.time()
		
		-- Check settings
		if not settings[data.type] then return end
		if settings.DoNotDisturb then return end
		
		-- Publish
		MessagingService:PublishAsync(MESSAGING_TOPIC .. "_" .. player.UserId, message)
		return
	end
	
	-- Client-side: receive from server
	NotificationSystem._ReceiveFromServer(data)
end

function NotificationSystem._ReceiveFromServer(data)
	-- Check deduplication
	local dedupKey = data.type .. "_" .. (data.targetId or "")
	if recentNotifications[dedupKey] and os.time() - recentNotifications[dedupKey] < DEDUP_WINDOW then
		return
	end
	recentNotifications[dedupKey] = os.time()
	
	-- Check settings
	if not settings[data.type] then return end
	if settings.DoNotDisturb then return end
	
	-- Play sound
	if data.sound then
		local AudioEffects = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.AudioEffects)
		AudioEffects.PlayPreset(data.sound)
	end
	
	-- Create UI
	local typeConfig = NOTIFICATION_TYPES[data.type]
	local channel = data.channel or typeConfig.channel
	
	if channel == "Toast" then
		if #activeToasts >= maxToasts then
			-- Remove oldest
			local oldestId = next(activeToasts)
			if oldestId then dismissToast(oldestId) end
		end
		
		local toast = createToast(data)
		toast.Parent = toastContainer
		activeToasts[data.id] = toast
		
		if data.autoDismiss then
			task.delay(data.autoDismiss, function()
				dismissToast(data.id)
			end)
		end
		
	elseif channel == "Banner" then
		createBanner(data)
	elseif channel == "Modal" then
		-- Create modal dialog
		NotificationSystem._ShowModal(data)
	elseif channel == "Badge" then
		updateBadge(data.type, 1)
	end
end

function NotificationSystem._ShowModal(data)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "Modal_" .. data.id
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 250)
	frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 32)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Parent = gui
	
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
	corner.Parent = frame
	
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Parent = frame
	
	-- Darken background
	local overlay = Instance.new("Frame")
	overlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
	overlay.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex - 1
	overlay.Parent = gui
	
	-- Content
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 40)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = data.title
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 24
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	title.Parent = frame
	
	local body = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 80)
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 70)
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Text = data.body
	body.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	body.TextSize = 16
	body.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 215, 235)
	body.TextWrapped = true
	body.Parent = frame
	
	-- Action buttons
	if data.actions then
		for i, action in data.actions do
			local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
			btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 40)
			btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20 + (i - 1) * 170, 180)
			btn.BackgroundColor3 = i == 1 and Color3.fromRGB(55, 140, 220) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 70, 90)
			btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
			btn.Text = action.text
			btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			btn.TextSize = 14
			btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			btn.Parent = frame
			
			local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
			btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
			btnCorner.Parent = btn
			
			btn.Activated:Connect(function()
				if action.callback then action.callback() end
				overlay:Destroy()
				frame:Destroy()
			end)
		end
	end
	
	-- Close button
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32)
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 10)
	closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeBtn.Text = "✕"
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeBtn.TextSize = 18
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 165, 190)
	closeBtn.Parent = frame
	
	closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		overlay:Destroy()
		frame:Destroy()
	end)
	
	-- Entrance
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 250)
	}):Play()
end

-- Settings
function NotificationSystem.UpdateSettings(newSettings)
	for k, v in newSettings do
		settings[k] = v
	end
end

function NotificationSystem.GetSettings()
	return settings
end

-- Offline queue handling
function NotificationSystem.QueueOffline(playerId, data)
	if not pendingOffline[playerId] then
		pendingOffline[playerId] = {}
	end
	table.insert(pendingOffline[playerId], data)
end

function NotificationSystem.DeliverOffline(playerId)
	local queue = pendingOffline[playerId]
	if queue then
		for _, data in queue do
			NotificationSystem._ReceiveFromServer(data)
		end
		pendingOffline[playerId] = nil
	end
end

-- Initialize
initMessaging()

-- Cleanup old dedup entries periodically
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(60)
		local now = os.time()
		for key, timestamp in recentNotifications do
			if now - timestamp > DEDUP_WINDOW * 2 then
				recentNotifications[key] = nil
			end
		end
	end
end)

return NotificationSystem

		tierWeights = {1 = 20, 2 = 30, 3 = 30, 4 = 15, 5 = 5},
	},
	Legendary = {
		slots = {min = 3, max = 3},
		tierWeights = {1 = 10, 2 = 20, 3 = 30, 4 = 30, 5 = 10},
	},
}

-- ============================================
-- TALENT ENGINE CORE
-- ============================================

function TalentEngine.GetTalent(talentId: string): Talent?
	return TALENT_REGISTRY[talentId]
end

function TalentEngine.GetAllTalents(): {Talent}
	local result = {}
	for _, talent in TALENT_REGISTRY do
		table.insert(result, talent)
	end
	return result
end

function TalentEngine.GetTalentsByCategory(category: string): {Talent}
	local result = {}
	for _, talent in TALENT_REGISTRY do
		if talent.category == category then
			table.insert(result, talent)
		end
	end
	return result
end

function TalentEngine.GetTalentsByTier(tier: number): {Talent}
	local result = {}
	for _, talent in TALENT_REGISTRY do
		if talent.tier == tier then
			table.insert(result, talent)
		end
	end
	return result
end

-- Weighted random selection
function TalentEngine.RollTalents(rarity: string): {{id: string, locked: boolean}}
	local config = RARITY_CONFIG[rarity] or RARITY_CONFIG.Common
	local slotCount = math.random(config.slots.min, config.slots.max)
	local results = {}
	
	-- Build weighted pool per tier
	local tierPools = {}
	for tier = 1, 5 do
		tierPools[tier] = {}
		for _, talent in TALENT_REGISTRY do
			if talent.tier == tier then
				table.insert(tierPools[tier], talent.id)
			end
		end
	end
	
	for i = 1, slotCount do
		-- Pick tier based on rarity weights
		local tier = TalentEngine._PickWeighted(config.tierWeights)
		local pool = tierPools[tier]
		
		if #pool > 0 then
			local talentId = pool[math.random(1, #pool)]
			table.insert(results, {id = talentId, locked = false})
		end
	end
	
	return results
end

function TalentEngine._PickWeighted(weights: {[number]: number}): number
	local total = 0
	for _, w in weights do total += w end
	
	local roll = math.random(1, total)
	local cumulative = 0
	for tier, weight in weights do
		cumulative += weight
		if roll <= cumulative then
			return tier
		end
	end
	return 1
end

-- Re-roll a specific slot
export type RerollResult = {
	success: boolean,
	newTalentId: string?,
	error: string?,
	cost: number,
}

function TalentEngine.RerollTalent(petData: {Talents: {{id: string, locked: boolean}}}, slotIndex: number, petRarity: string): RerollResult
	local config = RARITY_CONFIG[petRarity] or RARITY_CONFIG.Common
	local slot = petData.Talents[slotIndex]
	
	if not slot then
		return {success = false, error = "Invalid slot index", cost = 0}
	end
	
	if slot.locked then
		return {success = false, error = "Slot is locked", cost = 0}
	end
	
	-- Calculate cost
	local slotCount = #petData.Talents
	local baseCost = 500 * (1.5 ^ (slotIndex - 1))
	local cost = math.floor(baseCost * (1 + (#petData.Talents - config.slots.min) * 0.5))
	
	-- Roll new talent from same tier distribution
	local tier = TalentEngine._PickWeighted(config.tierWeights)
	local tierPool = {}
	for _, talent in TALENT_REGISTRY do
		if talent.tier == tier then
			table.insert(tierPool, talent.id)
		end
	end
	
	if #tierPool == 0 then
		return {success = false, error = "No talents available", cost = 0}
	end
	
	local newTalentId = tierPool[math.random(1, #tierPool)]
	
	return {
		success = true,
		newTalentId = newTalentId,
		cost = cost,
	}
end

-- Lock/unlock talent slot
function TalentEngine.LockTalent(petData: {Talents: {{id: string, locked: boolean}}}, slotIndex: number, lock: boolean): boolean
	local slot = petData.Talents[slotIndex]
	if not slot then return false end
	
	slot.locked = lock
	return true
end

-- Calculate re-roll cost
function TalentEngine.GetRerollCost(petData: {Talents: {{id: string, locked: boolean}}}, slotIndex: number, petRarity: string): number
	local config = RARITY_CONFIG[petRarity] or RARITY_CONFIG.Common
	local baseCost = 500 * (1.5 ^ (slotIndex - 1))
	return math.floor(baseCost * (1 + (#petData.Talents - config.slots.min) * 0.5))
end

-- ============================================
-- TALENT APPLICATION ENGINE
-- ============================================

export type StatModifiers = {
	[multiplicative: string]: number,  -- multipliers (stack multiplicatively)
	[additive: string]: number,        -- flat additions
	[flat: string]: number,            -- flat values
	[chance: string]: number,          -- percentage chances
}

function TalentEngine.CalculateModifiers(petData: {Talents: {{id: string, locked: boolean}}}, baseStats: StatModifiers?): StatModifiers
	local modifiers: StatModifiers = {}
	
	-- Initialize with base stats
	if baseStats then
		for k, v in baseStats do
			modifiers[k] = v
		end
	end
	
	for _, slot in petData.Talents do
		local talent = TALENT_REGISTRY[slot.id]
		if not talent then continue end
		
		local effect = talent.effect
		local stat = effect.stat
		local value = effect.value
		
		if effect.type == "Multiply" then
			modifiers[stat] = (modifiers[stat] or 1) * value
		elseif effect.type == "Add" then
			modifiers[stat] = (modifiers[stat] or 0) + value
		elseif effect.type == "Flat" then
			modifiers[stat] = value
		elseif effect.type == "Chance" then
			modifiers[stat] = (modifiers[stat] or 0) + value
		end
	end
	
	return modifiers
end

function TalentEngine.ApplyToPetMultipliers(petData: {Talents: {{id: string, locked: boolean}}}, petMultipliers: any)
	local modifiers = TalentEngine.CalculateModifiers(petData)
	
	-- Apply to PetMultipliers module (integration point)
	for stat, value in modifiers do
		if petMultipliers[stat] then
			if type(petMultipliers[stat]) == "number" then
				petMultipliers[stat] = petMultipliers[stat] * value
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Get talent display info for UI
function TalentEngine.GetTalentDisplayInfo(talentId: string): {name: string, description: string, tier: number, category: string, icon: string}
	local talent = TALENT_REGISTRY[talentId]
	if not talent then
		return {name = "Unknown", description = "", tier = 1, category = "Unknown", icon = "?"}
	end
	
	return {
		name = talent.name,
		description = talent.description,
		tier = talent.tier,
		category = talent.category,
		icon = TalentEngine._GetCategoryIcon(talent.category),
	}
end

function TalentEngine._GetCategoryIcon(category: string): string
	local icons = {
		Hatching = "🥚",
		Combat = "⚔️",
		Movement = "🏃",
		Economy = "💰",
		Utility = "🔧",
	}
	return icons[category] or "✨"
end

-- Validation
function TalentEngine.ValidateTalents(petData: {Talents: {{id: string, locked: boolean}}}): boolean
	for _, slot in petData.Talents do
		if not TALENT_REGISTRY[slot.id] then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

-- Get all talents for a category (for UI filtering)
function TalentEngine.GetTalentsForUI(): {{category: string, talents: {Talent}}}
	local categories = {"Hatching", "Combat", "Movement", "Economy", "Utility"}
	local result = {}
	
	for _, cat in categories do
		local talents = TalentEngine.GetTalentsByCategory(cat)
		table.sort(talents, function(a, b) return a.tier < b.tier end)
		table.insert(result, {category = cat, talents = talents})
	end
	
	return result
end

return TalentEngine

--!strict
-- LeaderboardEngine.lua
-- Seasonal leaderboards with snapshots, ranks, and rewards

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local MessagingService = game:GetService("MessagingService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LeaderboardEngine = {}
LeaderboardEngine.__index = LeaderboardEngine

-- DataStores
local SEASON_STORE = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("SeasonLeaderboards")
local SNAPSHOT_STORE = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("SeasonSnapshots")
local REWARDS_STORE = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("SeasonRewards")

-- Messaging
local TOPICS = {
	SeasonReset = "Leaderboard_SeasonReset",
	RewardClaimed = "Leaderboard_RewardClaimed",
	ScoreUpdate = "Leaderboard_ScoreUpdate",
}

-- ============================================
-- SEASON CONFIGURATION
-- ============================================

export type SeasonConfig = {
	id: string,
	name: string,
	type: "weekly" | "monthly",
	startTime: number,
	endTime: number,
	categories: {SeasonCategory},
	rewards: {[string]: SeasonRewards}, -- tier -> rewards
}

export type SeasonCategory = {
	id: string,
	name: string,
	metric: string, -- DataStore key for scoring
	weight: number, -- for tiebreaking
}

export type SeasonRewards = {
	-- tier: "top1" | "top3" | "top10" | "top25" | "top50" | "participation"
	gems: number,
	title: string?,
	titleDuration: number?, -- seconds
	petId: string?,
	auraId: string?,
	trailId: string?,
	badgeId: string?,
	cosmeticCrate: string?,
}

-- Default season configuration
local DEFAULT_CATEGORIES: {SeasonCategory} = {
	{id = "clicks", name = "Click Master", metric = "total_clicks", weight = 1.0},
	{id = "hatches", name = "Hatch Champion", metric = "eggs_hatched", weight = 1.0},
	{id = "gold", name = "Gold Tycoon", metric = "gold_earned", weight = 1.0},
	{id = "collection", name = "Pet Collector", metric = "unique_pets", weight = 1.0},
	{id = "combat", name = "Combat Veteran", metric = "enemies_defeated", weight = 1.0},
	{id = "trading", name = "Trade Baron", metric = "trade_volume", weight = 1.0},
}

local WEEKLY_REWARDS = {
	top1 = {gems = 50000, title = "Weekly Champion", titleDuration = 604800, petId = "golden_egg", auraId = "golden_glow"},
	top3 = {gems = 20000, title = "Silver Contender", titleDuration = 604800, petId = "silver_egg"},
	top10 = {gems = 10000, title = "Bronze Challenger", titleDuration = 604800},
	top25 = {gems = 5000},
	top50 = {gems = 2000},
	participation = {gems = 500},
}

local MONTHLY_REWARDS = {
	top1 = {gems = 200000, title = "Monthly Legend", titleDuration = 2592000, petId = "legendary_exclusive", auraId = "legendary_aura", trailId = "cosmic_trail"},
	top3 = {gems = 100000, title = "Monthly Elite", titleDuration = 2592000, petId = "epic_exclusive", trailId = "elite_trail"},
	top10 = {gems = 50000, title = "Monthly Rising Star", titleDuration = 2592000, petId = "rare_exclusive"},
	top25 = {gems = 20000, cosmeticCrate = "monthly_elite_crate"},
	top50 = {gems = 10000},
	participation = {gems = 5000},
}

-- Active season state
local currentSeason: {config: any, active: boolean} = {active = false}
local categoryScores = {} -- [categoryId][playerId] = score

-- ============================================
-- SEASON MANAGEMENT
-- ============================================

function LeaderboardEngine.GetCurrentSeason(): {config: any, active: boolean}?
	return currentSeason.active and currentSeason or nil
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetTimeRemaining(): number
	if not currentSeason.active then return 0 end
	return math.max(0, currentSeason.config.endTime - os.time())
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetSeasonProgress(): number
	if not currentSeason.active then return 0 end
	local elapsed = os.time() - currentSeason.config.startTime
	local total = currentSeason.config.endTime - currentSeason.config.startTime
	return math.clamp(elapsed / total, 0, 1)
end

function LeaderboardEngine.StartSeason(config: {type: string, categories: {SeasonCategory}?, rewards: any?})
	local now = os.time()
	local duration = config.type == "monthly" and 2592000 or 604800
	
	local seasonConfig = {
		id = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
		name = config.type .. "_season_" .. os.date("%Y_%m_%d", now),
		type = config.type,
		startTime = now,
		endTime = now + duration,
		categories = config.categories or DEFAULT_CATEGORIES,
		rewards = config.rewards or (config.type == "monthly" and MONTHLY_REWARDS or WEEKLY_REWARDS),
	}
	
	currentSeason = {config = seasonConfig, active = true}
	categoryScores = {}
	
	-- Initialize category scores
	for _, cat in seasonConfig.categories do
		categoryScores[cat.id] = {}
	end
	
	-- Schedule reset
	task.delay(duration, function()
		LeaderboardEngine.ResetSeason()
	end)
	
	-- Broadcast season start
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync("Leaderboard_SeasonStart", {
			seasonId = seasonConfig.id,
			type = seasonConfig.type,
			endTime = seasonConfig.endTime,
			categories = seasonConfig.categories,
		})
	end
	
	return seasonConfig
end

function LeaderboardEngine.ResetSeason()
	if not currentSeason.active then return end
	
	local seasonId = currentSeason.config.id
	
	-- Snapshot all category scores
	for catId, scores in categoryScores do
		local snapshotKey = "Snapshot_" .. seasonId .. "_" .. catId
		local data = {}
		
		-- Convert to array of {playerId, score}
		local entries = {}
		for playerId, score in scores do
			table.insert(entries, {playerId = playerId, score = score})
		end
		
		-- Sort by score descending
		table.sort(entries, function(a, b) return a.score > b.score end)
		
		-- Store top 10000
		local topEntries = {}
		for i = 1, math.min(10000, #entries) do
			table.insert(topEntries, entries[i])
		end
		
		-- Save snapshot
		local success = pcall(function()
			SNAPSHOT_STORE:SetAsync(snapshotKey, topEntries)
		end)
		
		if not success then
			warn("LeaderboardEngine: Failed to save snapshot for " .. catId)
		end
	end
	
	-- Calculate and queue rewards
	LeaderboardEngine._QueueRewards(seasonId)
	
	-- Broadcast reset
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync("Leaderboard_SeasonReset", {
			seasonId = seasonId,
			timestamp = os.time(),
		})
	end
	
	-- Clear scores
	categoryScores = {}
	currentSeason.active = false
end

function LeaderboardEngine._QueueRewards(seasonId: string)
	local config = currentSeason.config
	if not config then return end
	
	for catId, _ in categoryScores do
		local snapshotKey = "Snapshot_" .. seasonId .. "_" .. catId
		local success, snapshot = pcall(function()
			return SNAPSHOT_STORE:GetAsync(snapshotKey)
		end)
		
		if not success or not snapshot then continue end
		
		-- Determine tier cutoffs
		local total = #snapshot
		local cutoffs = {
			top1 = math.ceil(total * 0.01),
			top3 = math.ceil(total * 0.03),
			top10 = math.ceil(total * 0.10),
			top25 = math.ceil(total * 0.25),
			top50 = math.ceil(total * 0.50),
		}
		
		for rank, entry in ipairs(snapshot) do
			local tier = "participation"
			if rank <= cutoffs.top1 then tier = "top1"
			elseif rank <= cutoffs.top3 then tier = "top3"
			elseif rank <= cutoffs.top10 then tier = "top10"
			elseif rank <= cutoffs.top25 then tier = "top25"
			elseif rank <= cutoffs.top50 then tier = "top50"
			end
			
			local rewards = config.rewards[tier] or config.rewards.participation
			
			-- Queue reward for player
			local rewardKey = "Reward_" .. seasonId .. "_" .. entry.playerId
			local rewardData = {
				seasonId = seasonId,
				category = catId,
				rank = rank,
				tier = tier,
				rewards = rewards,
				claimed = false,
				timestamp = os.time(),
			}
			
			pcall(function()
				REWARDS_STORE:UpdateAsync(rewardKey, function(old)
					if old then return old end -- Don't overwrite
					return rewardData
				end)
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- ============================================
-- SCORING
-- ============================================

function LeaderboardEngine.AddScore(playerId: number, metric: string, amount: number)
	if not currentSeason.active then return end
	
	-- Find category for this metric
	local categoryId = nil
	for _, cat in currentSeason.config.categories do
		if cat.metric == metric then
			categoryId = cat.id
			break
		end
	end
	
	if not categoryId then return end
	
	if not categoryScores[categoryId] then
		categoryScores[categoryId] = {}
	end
	
	categoryScores[categoryId][playerId] = (categoryScores[categoryId][playerId] or 0) + amount
	
	-- Broadcast update (throttled)
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		MessagingService:PublishAsync(TOPICS.ScoreUpdate, {
			playerId = playerId,
			category = categoryId,
			newScore = categoryScores[categoryId][playerId],
			delta = amount,
		})
	end
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetScore(playerId: number, categoryId: string): number
	return categoryScores[categoryId] and categoryScores[categoryId][playerId] or 0
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetAllScores(categoryId: string): {playerId: number}
	return categoryScores[categoryId] or {}
end

-- ============================================
-- LEADERBOARD QUERIES
-- ============================================

function LeaderboardEngine.GetLeaderboard(categoryId: string, limit: number?): {{rank: number, playerId: number, score: number}}
	local scores = categoryScores[categoryId] or {}
	local limit = limit or 100
	
	local entries = {}
	for playerId, score in scores do
		table.insert(entries, {playerId = playerId, score = score})
	end
	
	table.sort(entries, function(a, b)
		if a.score ~= b.score then return a.score > b.score end
		return a.playerId < b.playerId
	end)
	
	local results = {}
	for i = 1, math.min(limit, #entries) do
		table.insert(results, {rank = i, playerId = entries[i].playerId, score = entries[i].score})
	end
	
	return results
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetPlayerRank(playerId: number, categoryId: string): number?
	local leaderboard = LeaderboardEngine.GetLeaderboard(categoryId, 10000)
	for _, entry in leaderboard do
		if entry.playerId == playerId then
			return entry.rank
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetPlayerSnapshot(playerId: number): {category: string, rank: number, score: number}
	local result = {}
	for catId, _ in categoryScores do
		local rank = LeaderboardEngine.GetPlayerRank(playerId, catId)
		if rank then
			table.insert(result, {
				category = catId,
				rank = rank,
				score = categoryScores[catId][playerId] or 0,
			})
		end
	end
	return result
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetSeasonSnapshot(seasonId: string, categoryId: string): {{playerId: number, score: number}}
	local snapshotKey = "Snapshot_" .. seasonId .. "_" .. categoryId
	local success, data = pcall(function()
		return SNAPSHOT_STORE:GetAsync(snapshotKey)
	end)
	return success and data or {}
end

-- ============================================
-- REWARDS
-- ============================================

function LeaderboardEngine.GetPendingRewards(playerId: number): {{seasonId: string, category: string, rank: number, tier: string, rewards: any, claimed: boolean}}
	local results = {}
	
	-- Scan recent seasons (last 5)
	for i = 0, 4 do
		local seasonTime = os.time() - i * 604800 -- approximate
		-- In production, would track season IDs properly
	end
	
	-- For now, scan all reward keys for this player
	-- In production, maintain an index
	return results
end

function LeaderboardEngine.ClaimReward(playerId: number, seasonId: string, categoryId: string): (boolean, any?)
	local rewardKey = "Reward_" .. seasonId .. "_" .. playerId
	local success, rewardData = pcall(function()
		return REWARDS_STORE:UpdateAsync(rewardKey, function(old)
			if not old or old.claimed then return old end
			old.claimed = true
			return old
		end)
	end
	
	if success and rewardData and not rewardData.claimed then
		return true, rewardData.rewards
	end
	return false, nil
end

function LeaderboardEngine.GetSeasonHistory(limit: number?): {{seasonId: string, type: string, startTime: number, endTime: number}}
	-- Would query snapshot store for season history
	return {}
end

-- ============================================
-- ANTI-CHEAT
-- ============================================

local scoreHistory = {} -- [playerId][category] = {timestamp, delta}

function LeaderboardEngine.ValidateScoreDelta(playerId: number, categoryId: string, delta: number): boolean
	if delta <= 0 then return false end
	if delta > 10000 then return false end -- Sanity cap
	
	local history = scoreHistory[playerId] and scoreHistory[playerId][categoryId] or {}
	table.insert(history, {time = os.time(), delta = delta})
	
	-- Keep last 100 entries
	if #history > 100 then table.remove(history, 1) end
	
	if not scoreHistory[playerId] then scoreHistory[playerId] = {} end
	scoreHistory[playerId][categoryId] = history
	
	-- Check rate: max 1000 per minute
	local recent = 0
	local now = os.time()
	for _, entry in history do
		if now - entry.time < 60 then
			recent += entry.delta
		end
	end
	
	if recent > 10000 then
		-- Flag for review
		if RunService:IsServer() then
			MessagingService:PublishAsync("Leaderboard_CheatFlag", {
				playerId = playerId,
				category = categoryId,
				recentScore = recent,
				reason = "Excessive score rate",
			})
		end
		return false
	end
	
	-- Statistical outlier detection (simplified)
	if #history > 20 then
		local sum = 0
		for _, e in history do sum += e.delta end
		local avg = sum / #history
		local variance = 0
		for _, e in history do variance += (e.delta - avg)^2 end
		local stdDev = math.sqrt(variance / #history)
		
		if delta > avg + 4 * stdDev then
			-- Flag as outlier
			if RunService:IsServer() then
				MessagingService:PublishAsync("Leaderboard_CheatFlag", {
					playerId = playerId,
					category = categoryId,
					delta = delta,
					avg = avg,
					stdDev = stdDev,
					reason = "Statistical outlier",
				})
			end
		end
	end
	
	return true
end

-- ============================================
-- INITIALIZATION
-- ============================================

if RunService:IsServer() then
	-- Auto-start weekly season on Mondays
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			local now = os.time()
			local nextMonday = now + ((1 - os.date("*t", now).wday) % 7) * 86400
			if nextMonday <= now then nextMonday += 604800 end
			local waitTime = nextMonday - now
			
			task.wait(waitTime)
			LeaderboardEngine.StartSeason({type = "weekly"})
			
			-- Monthly on 1st
			task.wait(2592000 - 604800) -- ~3 weeks
			LeaderboardEngine.StartSeason({type = "monthly"})
		end
	end)
end

return LeaderboardEngine

--// Auction House Pets
-- Pet lifecycle helpers shared by the auction handlers: granting a new pet
-- into a player's inventory and generating unique pet IDs.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Multipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Multipliers)

local Pets = {}

function Pets.GenerateId(Player)
	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Id
	repeat
		Id = math.random(1, 999999999)
	until not Folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(Id))
	return Id
end

function Pets.GetMaxStorage(Player)
	return Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player)
end

function Pets.Grant(Player, PetName)
	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local MaxStorage = Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player)
	if #Folder:GetChildren() >= MaxStorage then return false end

	local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
	NewPet.Name = Pets.GenerateId(Player)
	NewPet.PetName.Value = PetName
	NewPet.Equipped.Value = false
	NewPet.Parent = Folder
	return true
end

return Pets

--!strict
-- PetInteractionClient - Modern Responsive Pet Panel
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local feedback = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("PetInteractionFeedback")
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

--// Theme
local THEME = {
	Background = Color3.fromRGB(12, 16, 24),
	Panel = Color3.fromRGB(20, 26, 38),
	PanelSecondary = Color3.fromRGB(26, 34, 48),
	Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(60, 80, 110),
	Primary = Color3.fromRGB(55, 140, 220),
	Success = Color3.fromRGB(60, 180, 100),
	Warning = Color3.fromRGB(230, 170, 60),
	Danger = Color3.fromRGB(220, 65, 75),
	Text = Color3.fromRGB(240, 245, 255),
	Muted = Color3.fromRGB(160, 175, 200),
	Movement = Color3.fromRGB(50, 160, 190),
	Combat = Color3.fromRGB(220, 70, 70),
	Care = Color3.fromRGB(230, 150, 50),
	Utility = Color3.fromRGB(120, 140, 160),
}

--// Responsive sizing
local viewportSize = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
local minDim = math.min(viewportSize.X, viewportSize.Y)
local scale = math.clamp(minDim / 800, 0.7, 1.15)
local PANEL_W = math.floor(380 * scale)
local PANEL_H = math.floor(520 * scale)
local BTN_SIZE = math.floor(72 * scale)

--// Cleanup existing
local existing = playerGui:FindFirstChild("PetInteractionUI")
if existing then existing:Destroy() end

--// Main GUI
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "PetInteractionUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.DisplayOrder = 30
gui.Parent = playerGui

--// Panel
local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.Name = "PetPanel"
panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_W, PANEL_H)
panel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
panel.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Panel
panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
panel.Visible = false
panel.Parent = gui

local panelCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
panelCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16 * scale)
panelCorner.Parent = panel

local panelStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
panelStroke.Color = THEME.Stroke
panelStroke.Thickness = 1.5
panelStroke.Transparency = 0.4
panelStroke.Parent = panel

local panelGlow = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
panelGlow.Name = "Glow"
panelGlow.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.06, 1.06)
panelGlow.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-0.03, -0.03)
panelGlow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
panelGlow.Image = "rbxassetid://5028857084"
panelGlow.ImageColor3 = THEME.Primary
panelGlow.ImageTransparency = 0.92
panelGlow.ZIndex = -1
panelGlow.Parent = panel

local panelScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
panelScale.Scale = 0.85
panelScale.Parent = panel

local function tweenOpen()
	TweenService:Create(panelScale, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
end

local function tweenClose()
	TweenService:Create(panelScale, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Scale = 0.85}):Play()
end

panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
	if panel.Visible then
		tweenOpen()
	else
		tweenClose()
	end
end)

--// Header
local header = Instance.new("Frame")
header.Name = "Header"
header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 56 * scale)
header.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.PanelSecondary
header.BorderSizePixel = 0
header.Parent = panel

local headerCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
headerCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12 * scale)
headerCorner.Parent = header

local petIcon = Instance.new("TextLabel")
petIcon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32 * scale, 32 * scale)
petIcon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16 * scale, 12 * scale)
petIcon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
petIcon.Text = "PET"
petIcon.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
petIcon.TextSize = math.floor(18 * scale)
petIcon.TextColor3 = THEME.Primary
petIcon.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
petIcon.Parent = header

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Name = "PetName"
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -120 * scale, 0, 28 * scale)
title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(56 * scale, 14 * scale)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "PET"
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = math.floor(20 * scale)
title.TextColor3 = THEME.Text
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.Parent = header

local stateBadge = Instance.new("Frame")
stateBadge.Name = "StateBadge"
stateBadge.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(90 * scale, 24 * scale)
stateBadge.Position = UDim2.new(1, -100 * scale, 0, 16 * scale)
stateBadge.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Success
stateBadge.BorderSizePixel = 0
stateBadge.Parent = header

local badgeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
badgeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8 * scale)
badgeCorner.Parent = stateBadge

local stateLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
stateLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
stateLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
stateLabel.Text = "FOLLOW"
stateLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
stateLabel.TextSize = math.floor(11 * scale)
stateLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 255, 230)
stateLabel.Parent = stateBadge

local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeBtn.Name = "Close"
closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32 * scale, 32 * scale)
closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40 * scale, 0, 12 * scale)
closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Danger
closeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
closeBtn.Text = "X"
closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
closeBtn.TextSize = math.floor(16 * scale)
closeBtn.TextColor3 = THEME.Text
closeBtn.Parent = header

local closeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
closeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10 * scale)
closeCorner.Parent = closeBtn

local closeStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
closeStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 130)
closeStroke.Thickness = 1
closeStroke.Transparency = 0.3
closeStroke.Parent = closeBtn

closeBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
	TweenService:Create(closeBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 80, 90)}):Play()
end)
closeBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
	TweenService:Create(closeBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Danger}):Play()
end)
closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	tweenClose()
	task.wait(0.2)
	panel.Visible = false
end)

--// Preview Section
local previewSection = Instance.new("Frame")
previewSection.Name = "PreviewSection"
previewSection.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 140 * scale)
previewSection.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.PanelSecondary
previewSection.BorderSizePixel = 0
previewSection.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 64 * scale)
previewSection.Parent = panel

local previewCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
previewCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12 * scale)
previewCorner.Parent = previewSection

local previewPlaceholder = Instance.new("Frame")
previewPlaceholder.Name = "Preview"
previewPlaceholder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100 * scale, 100 * scale)
previewPlaceholder.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20 * scale, 20 * scale)
previewPlaceholder.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Background
previewPlaceholder.BorderSizePixel = 0
previewPlaceholder.Parent = previewSection

local previewCorner2 = Instance.new("UICorner")
previewCorner2.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12 * scale)
previewCorner2.Parent = previewPlaceholder

local previewLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
previewLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
previewLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
previewLabel.Text = "PET\n3D"
previewLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
previewLabel.TextSize = math.floor(16 * scale)
previewLabel.TextColor3 = THEME.Muted
previewLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
previewLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
previewLabel.Parent = previewPlaceholder

--// Needs Section
local needsSection = Instance.new("Frame")
needsSection.Name = "NeedsSection"
needsSection.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32 * scale, 0, 100 * scale)
needsSection.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16 * scale, 168 * scale)
needsSection.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.PanelSecondary
needsSection.BorderSizePixel = 0
needsSection.Parent = panel

local needsCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
needsCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12 * scale)
needsCorner.Parent = needsSection

local function makeNeedBar(name, yScale, color, icon)
	local container = Instance.new("Frame")
	container.Name = name .. "Container"
	container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36 * scale)
	container.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, needsSection.Size.Y.Offset * yScale)
	container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	container.Parent = needsSection

	local iconLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	iconLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24 * scale, 24 * scale)
	iconLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12 * scale, 6 * scale)
	iconLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	iconLabel.Text = icon
	iconLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	iconLabel.TextSize = math.floor(14 * scale)
	iconLabel.TextColor3 = color
	iconLabel.Parent = container

	local track = Instance.new("Frame")
	track.Name = "Track"
	track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -80 * scale, 0, 8 * scale)
	track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(44 * scale, 14 * scale)
	track.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Background
	track.BorderSizePixel = 0
	track.Parent = container

	local trackCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	trackCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	trackCorner.Parent = track

	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.Name = "Fill"
	fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.75, 1)
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = color
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.Parent = track

	local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	fillCorner.Parent = fill

	local valueLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	valueLabel.Name = "Value"
	valueLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(50 * scale, 20 * scale)
	valueLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -8 * scale, 0, 8 * scale)
	valueLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	valueLabel.Text = "85%"
	valueLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	valueLabel.TextSize = math.floor(13 * scale)
	valueLabel.TextColor3 = THEME.Muted
	valueLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	valueLabel.Parent = container

	return fill, valueLabel
end

local moodFill, moodValue = makeNeedBar("Mood", 0, THEME.Warning, "M")
local hungerFill, hungerValue = makeNeedBar("Hunger", 0.52, THEME.Success, "H")

--// Actions Section
local actionsSection = Instance.new("Frame")
actionsSection.Name = "ActionsSection"
actionsSection.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32 * scale, 0, 160 * scale)
actionsSection.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16 * scale, 278 * scale)
actionsSection.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.PanelSecondary
actionsSection.BorderSizePixel = 0
actionsSection.Parent = panel

local actionsCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
actionsCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12 * scale)
actionsCorner.Parent = actionsSection

local actionsTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
actionsTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16 * scale, 0, 24 * scale)
actionsTitle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16 * scale, 10 * scale)
actionsTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
actionsTitle.Text = "ACTIONS"
actionsTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
actionsTitle.TextSize = math.floor(12 * scale)
actionsTitle.TextColor3 = THEME.Muted
actionsTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
actionsTitle.Parent = actionsSection

local gridLayout = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
gridLayout.Parent = actionsSection
gridLayout.CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(BTN_SIZE, BTN_SIZE * 0.72)
gridLayout.CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8 * scale, 8 * scale)
gridLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
gridLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
gridLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
gridLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
actionsSection.LayoutOrder = 1

local buttonMap = {}
local activeButton = nil

local actionButtons = {
	{cmd = "Follow", color = THEME.Success, hover = Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 120), icon = "FOLLOW"},
	{cmd = "Attack", color = THEME.Combat, hover = Color3.fromRGB(240, 90, 100), icon = "ATK"},
	{cmd = "Sit", color = THEME.Care, hover = Color3.fromRGB(250, 180, 80), icon = "SIT"},
	{cmd = "Feed", color = THEME.Care, hover = Color3.fromRGB(250, 180, 80), icon = "FEED"},
	{cmd = "Jump", color = THEME.Movement, hover = Color3.fromRGB(70, 190, 220), icon = "JUMP"},
	{cmd = "Fly", color = THEME.Movement, hover = Color3.fromRGB(70, 190, 220), icon = "FLY"},
	{cmd = "Sleep", color = THEME.Care, hover = Color3.fromRGB(250, 180, 80), icon = "SLEEP"},
	{cmd = "Scavenge", color = THEME.Utility, hover = Color3.fromRGB(150, 170, 190), icon = "SEARCH"},
}

local function makeActionButton(config)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Name = config.cmd .. "Btn"
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = config.color
	btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	btn.Text = ""
	btn.Parent = actionsSection

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10 * scale)
	corner.Parent = btn

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	stroke.Thickness = 1
	stroke.Transparency = 0.5
	stroke.Parent = btn

	local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(
		Color3.fromRGB(
			math.min(255, math.floor(config.color.R * 255 * 1.15)),
			math.min(255, math.floor(config.color.G * 255 * 1.15)),
			math.min(255, math.floor(config.color.B * 255 * 1.15))
		),
		config.color
	)
	gradient.Rotation = 90
	gradient.Parent = btn

	local icon = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	icon.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
	icon.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 4 * scale)
	icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	icon.Text = config.icon
	icon.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	icon.TextSize = math.floor(BTN_SIZE * 0.22)
	icon.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	icon.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
	icon.Parent = btn

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.35, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.6, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = config.cmd
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	label.TextSize = math.floor(BTN_SIZE * 0.14)
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 225, 235)
	label.Parent = btn

	local glow = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	glow.Name = "Glow"
	glow.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.25, 1.25)
	glow.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-0.125, -0.125)
	glow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	glow.Image = "rbxassetid://5028857084"
	glow.ImageColor3 = config.color
	glow.ImageTransparency = 1
	glow.ZIndex = -1
	glow.Parent = btn

	btn:SetAttribute("BaseColor", config.color)
	btn:SetAttribute("HoverColor", config.hover)

	btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = config.hover}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {Transparency = 0.15}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(glow, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {ImageTransparency = 0.7}):Play()
	end)
	btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = config.color}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {Transparency = 0.5}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(glow, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {ImageTransparency = 1}):Play()
	end)
	btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.08), {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BTN_SIZE * 0.94, BTN_SIZE * 0.94 * 0.72)}):Play()
	end)
	btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
		TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BTN_SIZE, BTN_SIZE * 0.72)}):Play()
	end)
	btn.Activated:Connect(function()
		if currentPetId then
			feedback:FireServer(currentPetId, config.cmd)
		end
	end)

	buttonMap[config.cmd] = btn
	return btn
end

for _, config in ipairs(actionButtons) do
	makeActionButton(config)
end

--// Footer
local footer = Instance.new("Frame")
footer.Name = "Footer"
footer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32 * scale, 0, 44 * scale)
footer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16 * scale, PANEL_H - 64 * scale)
footer.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.PanelSecondary
footer.BorderSizePixel = 0
footer.Parent = panel

local footerCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
footerCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12 * scale)
footerCorner.Parent = footer

local inventoryBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
inventoryBtn.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
inventoryBtn.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Primary
inventoryBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
inventoryBtn.Text = "INVENTORY"
inventoryBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
inventoryBtn.TextSize = math.floor(14 * scale)
inventoryBtn.TextColor3 = THEME.Text
inventoryBtn.Parent = footer

local invCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
invCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10 * scale)
invCorner.Parent = inventoryBtn

local invStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
invStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 170, 255)
invStroke.Thickness = 1
invStroke.Transparency = 0.3
invStroke.Parent = inventoryBtn

inventoryBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
	TweenService:Create(inventoryBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 160, 240)}):Play()
end)
inventoryBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
	TweenService:Create(inventoryBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Primary}):Play()
end)
inventoryBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	if currentPetId then feedback:FireServer(currentPetId, "Inventory") end
end)

--// State
local currentPetId = nil
local hideToken = 0
local visibleActions = {
	Pet = true, Inventory = true, Stop = true, Follow = true, Sit = true,
	Sleep = true, Jump = true, Fly = true, Feed = true, Attack = true,
	Scavenge = true,
}

local stateColors = {
	Stop = {bg = THEME.Danger, text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 200)},
	Follow = {bg = THEME.Success, text = Color3.fromRGB(220, 255, 230)},
	Sit = {bg = THEME.Care, text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 180)},
	Sleep = {bg = THEME.PanelSecondary, text = Color3.fromRGB(210, 190, 255)},
	Jump = {bg = THEME.Movement, text = Color3.fromRGB(180, 230, 255)},
	Fly = {bg = THEME.Movement, text = Color3.fromRGB(180, 230, 255)},
}

--// Show / Update
local function updatePetInfo(data)
	currentPetId = data.petId or currentPetId
	title.Text = string.upper(tostring(data.petName or "PET"))

	local state = tostring(data.state or "Follow")
	stateLabel.Text = state

	local stateColor = stateColors[state] or stateColors.Follow
	TweenService:Create(stateBadge, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {BackgroundColor3 = stateColor.bg}):Play()
	stateLabel.TextColor3 = stateColor.text

	local mood = math.clamp(tonumber(data.mood) or 0, 0, 100)
	local hunger = math.clamp(tonumber(data.hunger) or 0, 0, 100)

	moodFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(mood / 100, 1)
	hungerFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(hunger / 100, 1)
	moodValue.Text = math.floor(mood) .. "%"
	hungerValue.Text = math.floor(hunger) .. "%"

	local moodColor = mood >= 70 and Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 120) or mood >= 35 and Color3.fromRGB(245, 180, 60) or Color3.fromRGB(235, 70, 70)
	moodFill.BackgroundColor3 = moodColor

	local targetBtn = buttonMap[state]
	if targetBtn then
		local base = targetBtn:GetAttribute("BaseColor")
		TweenService:Create(targetBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {BackgroundColor3 = base}):Play()
	end

	if not panel.Visible then
		panel.Visible = true
	end
	hideToken += 1
	local token = hideToken
	task.delay(12, function()
		if token == hideToken then
			tweenClose()
			task.wait(0.2)
			panel.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end

feedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
	if data.action == "Needs" then
		if panel.Visible and data.petId and data.petId == currentPetId then
			updatePetInfo(data)
		end
		return
	end
	if not visibleActions[data.action] then return end
	updatePetInfo(data)
	if data.action == "Inventory" then
		local frames = playerGui:FindFirstChild("GameUI") and playerGui.GameUI:FindFirstChild("Frames")
		local petFrame = frames and frames:FindFirstChild("Pets")
		if petFrame then
			petFrame.Visible = true
			local blocker = petFrame:FindFirstChild("SideFrameBlocker")
			if blocker then blocker.Visible = true end
		end
	end
end)

--// Pet Needs Billboards (simplified)
local petNeedsBillboards = {}
local function createPetNeedsBillboard(pet)
	if not pet:IsA("Model") or petNeedsBillboards[pet] then return end
	local adornee = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet.PrimaryPart or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if not adornee then return end

	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	billboard.Name = "PetNeedsBillboard"
	billboard.Adornee = adornee
	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboard.LightInfluence = 0
	billboard.MaxDistance = 15
	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 70)
	billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, math.max(adornee.Size.Y + 2, 3.5), 0)
	billboard.Parent = pet

	local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
	bg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	bg.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Panel
	bg.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	bg.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bg.Parent = billboard

	local bgCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	bgCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	bgCorner.Parent = bg

	local outline = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	outline.Color = THEME.Stroke
	outline.Thickness = 1
	outline.Transparency = 0.3
	outline.Parent = bg

	local moodLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	moodLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 14)
	moodLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 6)
	moodLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	moodLabel.Text = "Mood 0%"
	moodLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	moodLabel.TextSize = 12
	moodLabel.TextColor3 = THEME.Warning
	moodLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	moodLabel.Parent = bg

	local hungerLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	hungerLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 14)
	hungerLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 26)
	hungerLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hungerLabel.Text = "Hunger 0%"
	hungerLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	hungerLabel.TextSize = 12
	hungerLabel.TextColor3 = THEME.Success
	hungerLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	hungerLabel.Parent = bg

	local function update()
		local mood = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Mood")) or 0, 0, 100)
		local hunger = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Hunger")) or 0, 0, 100)
		moodLabel.Text = "Mood  " .. math.floor(mood) .. "%"
		hungerLabel.Text = "Hunger  " .. math.floor(hunger) .. "%"
	end

	pet:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Mood"):Connect(update)
	pet:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Hunger"):Connect(update)
	pet.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
		if not parent then petNeedsBillboards[pet] = nil end
	end)
	petNeedsBillboards[pet] = billboard
	update()
end

local playerPets = workspace:WaitForChild("PlayerPets")
local function inspectPetFolder(folder)
	for _, pet in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do createPetNeedsBillboard(pet) end
	folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(pet) task.defer(createPetNeedsBillboard, pet) end)
end
for _, folder in ipairs(playerPets:GetChildren()) do
	if folder.Name == player.Name then inspectPetFolder(folder) end
end
playerPets.ChildAdded:Connect(function(folder)
	if folder.Name == player.Name then inspectPetFolder(folder) end
end)

local function refreshInteractionPanel()
	if currentPetId then
		local folder = playerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
		local pet = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(currentPetId)
		if pet then
			updatePetInfo({
				petId = pet.Name,
				petName = pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or pet.Name,
				mood = pet:GetAttribute("Mood"),
				hunger = pet:GetAttribute("Hunger"),
				state = pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or "Follow",
			})
		end
	end
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.delay(1, refreshInteractionPanel) end)
playerGui.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
	if child.Name == "GameUI" then task.defer(refreshInteractionPanel) end
end)
