--!strict
-- EmoteEngine.lua
-- Chat-triggered pet emotes with unlock system, cooldowns, and animation playback

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local EmoteEngine = {}
EmoteEngine.__index = EmoteEngine

-- ============================================
-- EMOTE DEFINITIONS
-- ============================================

export type Emote = {
	id: string,
	name: string,
	description: string,
	animationId: string,
	animationPriority: Enum.AnimationPriority,
	duration: number,
	cooldown: number,
	tier: "Starter" | "Progression" | "Collection" | "Event" | "Prestige" | "Shop",
	unlockCondition: string,
	price: number?, -- Robux or gems for Shop tier
	gamepassId: number?, -- for Shop tier
}

local EMOTE_REGISTRY: {[string]: Emote} = {
	-- STARTER (everyone has these)
	wave = {
		id = "wave", name = "Wave", description = "Friendly wave",
		animationId = "rbxassetid://WaveAnimation", animationPriority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,
		duration = 2.5, cooldown = 5, tier = "Starter", unlockCondition = "Default", price = nil,
	},
	sit = {
		id = "sit", name = "Sit", description = "Take a seat",
		animationId = "rbxassetid://SitAnimation", animationPriority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,
		duration = 3, cooldown = 8, tier = "Starter", unlockCondition = "Default", price = nil,
	},
	dance = {
		id = "dance", name = "Dance", description = "Show your moves",
		animationId = "rbxassetid://DanceAnimation", animationPriority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,
		duration = 4, cooldown = 10, tier = "Starter", unlockCondition = "Default", price = nil,
	},
	
	-- PROGRESSION (rebirth milestones)
	flex = {
		id = "flex", name = "Flex", description = "Show off your strength",
		animationId = "rbxassetid://FlexAnimation", animationPriority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,
		duration = 3, cooldown = 8, tier = "Progression", unlockCondition = "Rebirth 5", price = nil,
	},
	sleep = {
		id = "sleep", name = "Sleep", description = "Take a nap",
		animationId = "rbxassetid://SleepAnimation", animationPriority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle,
		duration = 0, cooldown = 15, tier = "Progression", unlockCondition = "Rebirth 15", price = nil,
	},
	happy = {
		id = "happy", name = "Happy", description = "Jump for joy",
		animationId = "rbxassetid://HappyAnimation", animationPriority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,
		duration = 3, cooldown = 8, tier = "Progression", unlockCondition = "Rebirth 30", price = nil,
	},
	
	-- COLLECTION (pet count milestones)
	royal = {
		id = "royal", name = "Royal Bow", description = "Bow like royalty",
		animationId = "rbxassetid://RoyalBowAnimation", animationPriority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,
		duration = 4, cooldown = 15, tier = "Collection", unlockCondition = "Own 50 unique pets", price = nil,
	},
	spooky = {
		id = "spooky", name = "Spooky", description = "Spooky scare",
		animationId = "rbxassetid://SpookyAnimation", animationPriority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,
		duration = 3, cooldown = 10, tier = "Collection", unlockCondition = "Own 100 unique pets", price = nil,
	},
	festive = {
		id = "festive", name = "Festive", description = "Celebrate!",
		animationId = "rbxassetid://FestiveAnimation", animationPriority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,
		duration = 3.5, cooldown = 12, tier = "Collection", unlockCondition = "Own 200 unique pets", price = nil,
	},
	
	-- EVENT (world event participation)
	winter = {
		id = "winter", name = "Winter Cheer", description = "Holiday spirit",
		animationId = "rbxassetid://WinterAnimation", animationPriority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,
		duration = 3, cooldown = 10, tier = "Event", unlockCondition = "Winter Event 2024", price = nil,
	},
	halloween = {
		id = "halloween", name = "Spooky Dance", description = "Skeleton dance",
		animationId = "rbxassetid://HalloweenAnimation", animationPriority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,
		duration = 3.5, cooldown = 12, tier = "Event", unlockCondition = "Halloween Event 2024", price = nil,
	},
	anniversary = {
		id = "anniversary", name = "Anniversary", description = "Celebrate the anniversary",
		animationId = "rbxassetid://AnniversaryAnimation", animationPriority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,
		duration = 4, cooldown = 15, tier = "Event", unlockCondition = "Anniversary Event", price = nil,
	},
	
	-- PRESTIGE (top leaderboard / max rebirth)
	legend = {
		id = "legend", name = "Legendary", description = "Ascend to legend status",
		animationId = "rbxassetid://LegendAnimation", animationPriority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,
		duration = 5, cooldown = 20, tier = "Prestige", unlockCondition = "Top 1% Leaderboard", price = nil,
	},
	mythic = {
		id = "mythic", name = "Mythic", description = "Beyond legend",
		animationId = "rbxassetid://MythicAnimation", animationPriority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,
		duration = 5, cooldown = 20, tier = "Prestige", unlockCondition = "Max Rebirth", price = nil,
	},
	cosmic = {
		id = "cosmic", name = "Cosmic", description = "Transcend reality",
		animationId = "rbxassetid://CosmicAnimation", animationPriority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,
		duration = 6, cooldown = 30, tier = "Prestige", unlockCondition = "All Achievements", price = nil,
	},
	
	-- SHOP (Robux/gamepass)
	vip = {
		id = "vip", name = "VIP", description = "VIP exclusive emote",
		animationId = "rbxassetid://VIPAnimation", animationPriority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,
		duration = 3, cooldown = 8, tier = "Shop", unlockCondition = "Gamepass", price = 499, gamepassId = 123456,
	},
	supporter = {
		id = "supporter", name = "Supporter", description = "Thank you for supporting!",
		animationId = "rbxassetid://SupporterAnimation", animationPriority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,
		duration = 3, cooldown = 10, tier = "Shop", unlockCondition = "Gamepass", price = 199, gamepassId = 123457,
	},
}

-- ============================================
-- EMOTE STATE MANAGEMENT
-- ============================================

local playerEmotes = {} -- [playerId] = {emoteId = true}
local emoteCooldowns = {} -- [playerId][emoteId] = lastUsedTime
local equippedEmotes = {} -- [playerId] = emoteId (for quick access)

-- ============================================
-- CORE FUNCTIONS
-- ============================================

function EmoteEngine.GetEmote(emoteId: string): Emote?
	return EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
end

function EmoteEngine.GetAllEmotes(): {Emote}
	local result = {}
	for _, emote in EMOTE_REGISTRY do
		table.insert(result, emote)
	end
	return result
end

function EmoteEngine.GetEmotesByTier(tier: string): {Emote}
	local result = {}
	for _, emote in EMOTE_REGISTRY do
		if emote.tier == tier then
			table.insert(result, emote)
		end
	end
	return result
end

function EmoteEngine.GetEmotesForPlayer(playerId: number): {Emote}
	local owned = playerEmotes[playerId] or {}
	local result = {}
	for emoteId, _ in owned do
		local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
		if emote then table.insert(result, emote) end
	end
	return result
end

function EmoteEngine.GetAvailableEmotes(): {Emote}
	-- Returns emotes that can be unlocked (not owned by anyone yet)
	-- In practice, this would filter by global unlock state
	return EmoteEngine.GetAllEmotes()
end

-- Ownership management
function EmoteEngine.GrantEmote(playerId: number, emoteId: string): boolean
	if not EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId] then return false end
	if not playerEmotes[playerId] then playerEmotes[playerId] = {} end
	playerEmotes[playerId][emoteId] = true
	return true
end

function EmoteEngine.RevokeEmote(playerId: number, emoteId: string): boolean
	if playerEmotes[playerId] then
		playerEmotes[playerId][emoteId] = nil
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function EmoteEngine.HasEmote(playerId: number, emoteId: string): boolean
	return playerEmotes[playerId] and playerEmotes[playerId][emoteId] == true
end

function EmoteEngine.GetOwnedEmotes(playerId: number): {string}
	local owned = playerEmotes[playerId] or {}
	local result = {}
	for emoteId, _ in owned do
		table.insert(result, emoteId)
	end
	return result
end

-- ============================================
-- COOLDOWN MANAGEMENT
-- ============================================

function EmoteEngine.IsOnCooldown(playerId: number, emoteId: string): boolean
	local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
	if not emote then return true end
	
	local cooldowns = emoteCooldowns[playerId]
	if not cooldowns then return false end
	
	local lastUsed = cooldowns[emoteId]
	if not lastUsed then return false end
	
	return os.clock() - lastUsed < emote.cooldown
end

function EmoteEngine.GetRemainingCooldown(playerId: number, emoteId: string): number
	local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
	if not emote then return 0 end
	
	local cooldowns = emoteCooldowns[playerId]
	if not cooldowns then return 0 end
	
	local lastUsed = cooldowns[emoteId]
	if not lastUsed then return 0 end
	
	return math.max(0, emote.cooldown - (os.clock() - lastUsed))
end

function EmoteEngine.SetCooldown(playerId: number, emoteId: string)
	if not emoteCooldowns[playerId] then emoteCooldowns[playerId] = {} end
	emoteCooldowns[playerId][emoteId] = os.clock()
end

function EmoteEngine.GetAllCooldowns(playerId: number): {[string]: number}
	local result = {}
	local cooldowns = emoteCooldowns[playerId] or {}
	local now = os.clock()
	
	for emoteId, lastUsed in cooldowns do
		local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
		if emote then
			local remaining = math.max(0, emote.cooldown - (now - lastUsed))
			if remaining > 0 then
				result[emoteId] = remaining
			end
		end
	end
	return result
end

-- ============================================
-- EQUIPPED EMOTE (quick access)
-- ============================================

function EmoteEngine.SetEquipped(playerId: number, emoteId: string?): boolean
	if emoteId and not EmoteEngine.HasEmote(playerId, emoteId) then
		return false
	end
	equippedEmotes[playerId] = emoteId
	return true
end

function EmoteEngine.GetEquipped(playerId: number): string?
	return equippedEmotes[playerId]
end

function EmoteEngine.UseEquipped(playerId: number): boolean
	local emoteId = equippedEmotes[playerId]
	if not emoteId then return false end
	return EmoteEngine.TriggerEmote(playerId, emoteId)
end

-- ============================================
-- EMOTE EXECUTION
-- ============================================

function EmoteEngine.TriggerEmote(playerId: number, emoteId: string, position: Vector3?): boolean
	local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
	if not emote then return false end
	
	-- Check ownership
	if not EmoteEngine.HasEmote(playerId, emoteId) then
		return false
	end
	
	-- Check cooldown
	if EmoteEngine.IsOnCooldown(playerId, emoteId) then
		return false
	end
	
	-- Check anti-spam (max 3 emotes per 10 seconds)
	local recentCount = 0
	local now = os.clock()
	for _, lastUsed in pairs(emoteCooldowns[playerId] or {}) do
		if now - lastUsed < 10 then recentCount += 1 end
	end
	if recentCount >= 3 then return false end
	
	-- Set cooldown
	EmoteEngine.SetCooldown(playerId, emoteId)
	
	-- Trigger animation on server (replicates to nearby clients)
	if RunService:IsServer() then
		EmoteEngine._PlayAnimationOnServer(playerId, emoteId)
	else
		EmoteEngine._PlayAnimationOnClient(playerId, emoteId)
	end
	
	return true
end

function EmoteEngine._PlayAnimationOnServer(playerId: number, emoteId: string)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerById(playerId)
	if not player then return end
	
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then return end
	
	local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
	if not emote then return end
	
	-- Load and play animation
	local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not animator then return end
	
	local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.AnimationId = emote.animationId
	animation.Priority = emote.animationPriority
	
	local track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
	track:Play()
	
	-- Stop after duration (if not looping)
	if emote.duration > 0 then
		task.delay(emote.duration, function()
			track:Stop()
		end)
	end
	
	-- Replicate to nearby clients via remote
	-- (In practice, use a RemoteEvent to fire clients in radius)
	
	-- Trigger VFX at pet position
	local pet = EmoteEngine._GetEquippedPet(player)
	if pet then
		-- Fire client event for VFX
	end
end

function EmoteEngine._PlayAnimationOnClient(playerId: number, emoteId: string)
	-- Client-side animation playback
	local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
	if not emote then return end
	
	-- If local player, play on their character
	if playerId == Players.LocalPlayer.UserId then
		local character = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		if character then
			local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if humanoid then
				local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
				if animator then
					local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
					animation.AnimationId = emote.animationId
					animation.Priority = emote.animationPriority
					local track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
					track:Play()
					if emote.duration > 0 then
						task.delay(emote.duration, function() track:Stop() end)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	-- Play VFX at pet
	if position then
		-- Play VFX effects
	end
end

function EmoteEngine._GetEquippedPet(player: Player): Model?
	-- Find player's equipped pet
	local playerPets = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerPets")
	if not playerPets then return nil end
	
	local folder = playerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if not folder then return nil end
	
	for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do
		if pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") == "Follow" then
			return pet
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- ============================================
-- CHAT TRIGGER PARSING
-- ============================================

local EMOTE_PREFIXES = {"/e ", "/emote ", "/em "}

function EmoteEngine.ParseChatMessage(message: string): string?
	message = message:lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") -- trim
	
	for _, prefix in EMOTE_PREFIXES do
		if message:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
			local emoteName = message:sub(#prefix + 1):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
			return emoteName
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function EmoteEngine.HandleChatMessage(playerId: number, message: string): boolean
	local emoteName = EmoteEngine.ParseChatMessage(message)
	if not emoteName then return false end
	
	-- Try exact match first
	local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteName]
	if emote and EmoteEngine.HasEmote(playerId, emoteName) then
		return EmoteEngine.TriggerEmote(playerId, emoteName)
	end
	
	-- Try fuzzy match (partial)
	for id, emote in EMOTE_REGISTRY do
		if id:find(emoteName, 1, true) and EmoteEngine.HasEmote(playerId, id) then
			return EmoteEngine.TriggerEmote(playerId, id)
		end
	end
	
	return false
end

-- ============================================
-- UNLOCK CONDITIONS
-- ============================================

function EmoteEngine.CheckUnlockCondition(playerId: number, emoteId: string): boolean
	local emote = EMOTE_REGISTRY[emoteId]
	if not emote then return false end
	
	if emote.tier == "Starter" then return true end
	if emote.tier == "Shop" then
		if emote.gamepassId then
			-- Check gamepass ownership
			return game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):UserOwnsGamepassAsync(Players:GetPlayerByUserId(playerId), emote.gamepassId)
		end
		return false
	end
	
	if emote.tier == "Progression" then
		-- Check rebirth count from PlayerData
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(playerId)
		if player then
			local rebirths = player.Data and player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirths.Value or 0
			local required = tonumber(emote.unlockCondition:match("%d+"))
			return required and rebirths >= required
		end
	end
	
	if emote.tier == "Collection" then
		-- Check unique pet count
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(playerId)
		if player then
			local uniquePets = 0
			local folder = workspace.PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
			if folder then
				for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do
									if pet:GetAttribute("PetName") then uniquePets += 1 end
							end
						end
			local required = tonumber(emote.unlockCondition:match("%d+"))
			return required and uniquePets >= required
		end
	end
	
	if emote.tier == "Event" then
		-- Check event participation flag
		return false -- Would check event participation data
	end
	
	if emote.tier == "Prestige" then
		-- Check leaderboard rank or max rebirth
		return false
	end
	
	return false
end

function EmoteEngine.CheckAndGrantUnlocks(playerId: number): {string}
	local granted = {}
	for emoteId, emote in EMOTE_REGISTRY do
		if not EmoteEngine.HasEmote(playerId, emoteId) and EmoteEngine.CheckUnlockCondition(playerId, emoteId) then
			EmoteEngine.GrantEmote(playerId, emoteId)
			table.insert(granted, emoteId)
		end
	end
	return granted
end

-- ============================================
-- EMOTE WHEEL (UI Helper)
-- ============================================

function EmoteEngine.GetEmoteWheelData(playerId: number): {{id: string, name: string, icon: string, cooldown: number, owned: boolean}}
	local result = {}
	for _, emote in EMOTE_REGISTRY do
		local owned = EmoteEngine.HasEmote(playerId, emote.id)
		local cd = EmoteEngine.GetRemainingCooldown(playerId, emote.id)
		table.insert(result, {
			id = emote.id,
			name = emote.name,
			icon = EmoteEngine._GetEmoteIcon(emote.id),
			cooldown = cd,
			owned = owned,
			equipped = equippedEmotes[playerId] == emote.id,
		})
	end
	return result
end

function EmoteEngine._GetEmoteIcon(emoteId: string): string
	local icons = {
		wave = "👋", sit = "🪑", dance = "💃",
		flex = "💪", sleep = "😴", happy = "😄",
		royal = "🤴", spooky = "👻", festive = "🎉",
		winter = "❄️", halloween = "🎃", anniversary = "🎂",
		legend = "🏆", mythic = "🌟", cosmic = "🌌",
		vip = "👑", supporter = "❤️",
	}
	return icons[emoteId] or "✨"
end

-- ============================================
-- SERVER INITIALIZATION
-- ============================================

if RunService:IsServer() then
	-- Auto-grant starter emotes on join
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		task.wait(1)
		for emoteId, emote in EMOTE_REGISTRY do
			if emote.tier == "Starter" then
				EmoteEngine.GrantEmote(player.UserId, emoteId)
			end
		end
		EmoteEngine.CheckAndGrantUnlocks(player.UserId)
	end)
	
	-- Chat listener
	Players.PlayerChatted:Connect(function(message, recipient)
		-- message is the Chat message object in newer Roblox
		local text = typeof(message) == "string" and message or message.Text
		local speaker = typeof(message) == "string" and recipient or message.TextSource
		if speaker then
			EmoteEngine.HandleChatMessage(speaker.UserId, text)
		end
	end)
end

return EmoteEngine

local Views = {}

local function MakeScroll(Parent, Position, Size)
	local Scroll = New("ScrollingFrame", {
		Size = Size,
		Position = Position,
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		ScrollBarThickness = 5,
	}, Parent)
	New("UIListLayout", {
		Padding = UDim.new(0, 8),
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
	}, Scroll)
	return Scroll
end

local function SetupPetViewport(Viewport, PetName)
	local PetModel = ReplicatedStorage.Pets:FindFirstChild(PetName)
	if not PetModel then return end

	local Clone = PetModel:Clone()
	Clone.Parent = Viewport

	local MainPart = Clone:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	if not MainPart then
		MainPart = Clone:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart")
	end
	if not MainPart then return end

	local Camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	Viewport.CurrentCamera = Camera

	local Pos = MainPart.Position
	local Size = Clone:GetExtentsSize()
	Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(Pos.X + Size.X * 1.5, Pos.Y, Pos.Z + 1), Pos)
end

local function PetRarity(PetName)
	local Pet = ReplicatedStorage.Pets:FindFirstChild(PetName)
	if Pet and Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings") and Pet.Settings:FindFirstChild("Rarity") then
		return Pet.Settings.Rarity.Value
	end
	return "?"
end

--!strict
-- AudioEffects.lua
-- Layered sound effects with pitch variation, spatial audio, and pooling

local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local AudioEffects = {}
AudioEffects.__index = AudioEffects

local soundPool = {}
local MAX_POOL = 50
local soundGroups = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function getSound(): Sound
	for _, sound in soundPool do
		if not sound.IsPlaying and sound.Parent then
			return sound
		end
	end
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Parent = SoundService
	table.insert(soundPool, sound)
	return sound
end

local function playAtPosition(soundId: string, position: Vector3, volume: number, pitch: number, parent: Instance?)
	local sound = getSound()
	sound.SoundId = soundId
	sound.Volume = volume
	sound.Pitch = pitch
	sound.PlayOnRemove = false
	sound.Looped = false
	sound.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.Linear
	sound.MaxDistance = 100
	sound.Parent = parent or workspace
	sound.Position = position
	sound:Play()
	
	sound.Ended:Connect(function()
		sound.Parent = SoundService
	end)
	
	return sound
end

function AudioEffects.PlayGlobal(soundId: string, volume: number?, pitch: number?)
	local sound = getSound()
	sound.SoundId = soundId
	sound.Volume = volume or 1
	sound.Pitch = pitch or 1
	sound.Parent = SoundService
	sound:Play()
	sound.Ended:Connect(function()
		sound.Parent = SoundService
	end)
	return sound
end

function AudioEffects.PlayAt(soundId: string, position: Vector3, volume: number?, pitch: number?)
	return playAtPosition(soundId, position, volume or 1, pitch or 1)
end

function AudioEffects.PlayOnPart(soundId: string, part: BasePart, volume: number?, pitch: number?)
	return playAtPosition(soundId, part.Position, volume or 1, pitch or 1, part)
end

function AudioEffects.PlayLayered(layers: {{soundId: string, volume: number?, pitch: number?, delay: number?}}, position: Vector3?)
	for _, layer in layers do
		task.delay(layer.delay or 0, function()
			if position then
				AudioEffects.PlayAt(layer.soundId, position, layer.volume, layer.pitch)
			else
				AudioEffects.PlayGlobal(layer.soundId, layer.volume, layer.pitch)
			end
		end)
	end
end

function AudioEffects.PlayWithPitchVariation(soundId: string, position: Vector3, baseVolume: number, basePitch: number, pitchVariance: number)
	local pitch = basePitch + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * pitchVariance
	AudioEffects.PlayAt(soundId, position, baseVolume, pitch)
end

function AudioEffects.StopAll()
	for _, sound in soundPool do
		sound:Stop()
		sound.Parent = SoundService
	end
end

--// Economy Handler
-- Economy-wide statistics and bulk currency operations.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local EconomyHandler = {}

function EconomyHandler.GetStats()
	local TotalCurrency = 0
	local TotalGems = 0
	local TotalRebirths = 0
	local TotalEggs = 0
	local TotalPets = 0
	local PlayerCount = 0
	local TopCurrency = nil
	local TopGems = nil
	local TopRebirths = nil

	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local Data = Player:FindFirstChild("Data")
		if Data then
			local PD = Data.PlayerData
			local C = PD.Currency.Value
			local G = PD.Currency2.Value
			local R = PD.Rebirth.Value
			local E = PD.EggsHatched.Value
			local P = #Data.Pets:GetChildren()

			TotalCurrency += C
			TotalGems += G
			TotalRebirths += R
			TotalEggs += E
			TotalPets += P
			PlayerCount += 1

			if not TopCurrency or C > TopCurrency.value then
				TopCurrency = { name = Player.Name, value = C }
			end
			if not TopGems or G > TopGems.value then
				TopGems = { name = Player.Name, value = G }
			end
			if not TopRebirths or R > TopRebirths.value then
				TopRebirths = { name = Player.Name, value = R }
			end
		end
	end

	return {
		totalCurrency = TotalCurrency,
		totalGems = TotalGems,
		totalRebirths = TotalRebirths,
		totalEggsHatched = TotalEggs,
		totalPets = TotalPets,
		playerCount = PlayerCount,
		avgCurrency = PlayerCount > 0 and math.round(TotalCurrency / PlayerCount) or 0,
		avgGems = PlayerCount > 0 and math.round(TotalGems / PlayerCount) or 0,
		topCurrency = TopCurrency,
		topGems = TopGems,
		topRebirths = TopRebirths,
	}
end

function EconomyHandler.GiveAllCurrency(Amount)
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	local Count = 0
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += Num
			Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += Num
			Count += 1
		end
	end
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " currency to " .. Count .. " players"
end

function EconomyHandler.GiveAllGems(Amount)
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	local Count = 0
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Num
			Count += 1
		end
	end
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " gems to " .. Count .. " players"
end

return EconomyHandler

--// Admin Dashboard Logs
-- In-memory audit log buffer. Every admin action is recorded here.

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)

local Logs = {}
local Buffer = {}

function Logs.Add(AdminName, Action, Target, Details)
	local Entry = {
		timestamp = os.time(),
		admin = AdminName or "?",
		action = Action or "?",
		target = Target or "",
		details = Details or "",
	}
	table.insert(Buffer, Entry)

	-- trim oldest if over limit
	while #Buffer > Config.MAX_LOGS do
		table.remove(Buffer, 1)
	end

	return Entry
end

function Logs.Get(Count)
	local N = math.min(Count or #Buffer, #Buffer)
	local Result = {}
	for i = #Buffer, math.max(1, #Buffer - N + 1), -1 do
		Result[#Result + 1] = Buffer[i]
	end
	return Result
end

function Logs.Clear()
	table.clear(Buffer)
	return true
end

function Logs.Count()
	return #Buffer
end

return Logs

-- ============================================

-- ============================================

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if not processed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.G then
		emoteWheel:Toggle()
	end
end)

-- ============================================
-- EFFECT TRIGGER HANDLER
-- ============================================

Remotes.Effect_Trigger.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(effectName, position, intensity, params)
	-- Camera effects
	if CameraEffects.Presets[effectName] then
		CameraEffects.Presets[effectName]()
	elseif effectName == "Shake" then
		CameraEffects.Shake(nil, intensity and {intensity = intensity, duration = 0.3, frequency = 30})
	elseif effectName == "PunchZoom" then
		CameraEffects.PunchZoom(intensity or 10, 0.3)
	end

	-- Screen effects
	if ScreenEffects.Presets[effectName] then
		ScreenEffects.Presets[effectName]()
	elseif effectName == "Flash" then
		ScreenEffects.Flash(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 0.1)
	elseif effectName == "ChromaticAberration" then
		ScreenEffects.ChromaticAberration(intensity or 1, 0.5)
	end

	-- VFX
	if VFXEffects.Presets[effectName] then
		VFXEffects.Presets[effectName](position)
	end

	-- Audio
	if AudioEffects.Presets[effectName] then
		AudioEffects.PlayPreset(effectName, position)
	end
end)

-- ============================================
- NOTIFICATION SYSTEM SETUP
-- ============================================

-- Request settings from server
Remotes.Notification_RequestSettings:FireServer()

Remotes.Notification_RequestSettings.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(settings)
	for k, v in settings do
		NotificationSystem.UpdateSettings({[k] = v})
	end
end)

-- Listen for notification events from server
Remotes.Notification_SendToClient.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	NotificationSystem._ReceiveFromServer(data)
end)

-- ============================================
- EMOTE CHAT HANDLING
-- ============================================

-- Handle chat messages for emote triggers
if game:GetService("TextChatService").ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
	game:GetService("TextChatService").MessageReceived:Connect(function(message)
		if message.TextSource then
			local playerId = message.TextSource.UserId
			if playerId == player.UserId then
				EmoteEngine.HandleChatMessage(playerId, message.Text)
			end
		end
	else
		-- Legacy chat
		Players.PlayerChatted:Connect(function(message, recipient)
			EmoteEngine.HandleChatMessage(message, player.UserId)
		end)
	end
end

- TALENT PANEL INTEGRATION
-- ============================================

-- ============================================
- LEADERBOARD UI HOOKS
-- ============================================

getgenv().LeaderboardClient = {

-- ============================================

--!strict
-- ToastStack.lua
-- Manages a stack of toast notifications with smooth animations

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local ToastStack = {}
ToastStack.__index = ToastStack

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
	maxVisible = 3,
	animationDuration = 0.3,
	swipeToDismiss = true,
	position = "top-right",
	toastWidth = 350,
	toastHeight = 70,
	padding = 8,
}

function ToastStack.new(config)
	local self = setmetatable({}, ToastStack)
	self.config = setmetatable(config or {}, {__index = DEFAULT_CONFIG})
	self.toasts = {}
	self.container = nil
	self:_createContainer()
	return self
end

function ToastStack:_createContainer()
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "ToastStack"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.DisplayOrder = 200
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.Parent = playerGui

	local container = Instance.new("Frame")
	container.Name = "Container"
	container.Size = UDim2.new(0, self.config.toastWidth, 1, -20)
	container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
	container.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -10)
	container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	container.Parent = gui

	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, self.config.padding)
	layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
	layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
	layout.Parent = container

	self.container = container
	self.gui = gui
end

function ToastStack:Push(data)
	data.id = data.id or game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false)
	data.autoDismiss = data.autoDismiss or 8
	data.timestamp = os.time()

	-- Remove oldest if at capacity
	if #self.toasts >= self.config.maxVisible then
		self:Pop()
	end

	local toast = self:_createToast(data)
	toast.Parent = self.container
	table.insert(self.toasts, 1, {id = data.id, frame = toast, data = data})

	if data.autoDismiss then
		task.delay(data.autoDismiss, function()
			self:Dismiss(data.id)
		end)
	end

	return data.id
end

function ToastStack:_createToast(data)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "Toast_" .. data.id
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, self.config.toastHeight)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 26, 38)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.ClipsDescendants = true

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	corner.Parent = frame

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
	stroke.Thickness = 1.5
	stroke.Transparency = 0.4
	stroke.Parent = frame

	-- Icon
	local icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36)
	icon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 17)
	icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	icon.Image = data.icon or ""
	icon.Parent = frame

	-- Title
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 24)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 8)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = data.title
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 14
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 245, 255)
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Parent = frame

	-- Body
	local body = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 18)
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 32)
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Text = data.body
	body.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	body.TextSize = 12
	body.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 195, 220)
	body.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	body.TextWrapped = true
	body.Parent = frame

	-- Progress bar
	if data.autoDismiss then
		local progress = Instance.new("Frame")
		progress.Name = "Progress"
		progress.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3)
		progress.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
		progress.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		progress.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 140, 220)
		progress.BorderSizePixel = 0
		progress.Parent = frame

		local progressTween = game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(progress, TweenInfo.new(data.autoDismiss, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
		})
		progressTween:Play()
	end

	-- Close button
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 4)
	closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeBtn.Text = "✕"
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeBtn.TextSize = 12
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 165, 190)
	closeBtn.Parent = frame

	closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		self:Dismiss(data.id)
	end)

	-- Swipe to dismiss
	if self.config.swipeToDismiss then
		local startX = 0
		frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				startX = input.Position.X
			end
		end)

		frame.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				local deltaX = input.Position.X - startX
				if deltaX > 80 then
					self:Dismiss(data.id)
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	-- Entrance animation
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(1, 400, 0, 0)
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(self.config.animationDuration, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	}):Play()

	return frame
end

function ToastStack:Dismiss(id)
	for i, toast in ipairs(self.toasts) do
		if toast.id == id then
			local frame = toast.frame
			game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
				Position = UDim2.new(1, 400, 0, 0),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1
			}):Play()
			task.wait(0.2)
			frame:Destroy()
			table.remove(self.toasts, i)
			break
		end
	end
end

function ToastStack:Pop()
	if #self.toasts > 0 then
		self:Dismiss(self.toasts[#self.toasts].id)
	end
end

function ToastStack:Clear()
	for _, toast in self.toasts do
		toast.frame:Destroy()
	end
	self.toasts = {}
end

function ToastStack:Destroy()
	self:Clear()
	self.gui:Destroy()
end

return ToastStack

--!strict
-- Chart.lua
-- Price history chart rendering using CanvasDraw-like approach with UI frames

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Chart = {}
Chart.__index = Chart

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
	width = 400,
	height = 200,
	margin = {top = 20, right = 20, bottom: 30, left = 50},
	gridColor = Color3.fromRGB(40, 50, 70),
	gridStrokeTransparency = 0.5,
	lineColor = Color3.fromRGB(80, 170, 255),
	lineThickness = 2,
	fillColor = Color3.fromRGB(80, 170, 255),
	fillTransparency = 0.85,
	pointColor = Color3.fromRGB(80, 170, 255),
	pointRadius = 4,
	textColor = Color3.fromRGB(160, 175, 200),
	textSize = 11,
	font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
	animationDuration = 0.5,
}

function Chart.new(parent, config)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Chart)
	self.config = setmetatable(config or {}, {__index = DEFAULT_CONFIG})
	self.frame = nil
	self.canvas = nil
	self.points = {}
	self:_createFrame(parent)
	return self
end

function Chart:_createFrame(parent)
	self.frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	self.frame.Name = "PriceChart"
	self.frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.width, self.config.height)
	self.frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 30)
	self.frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	self.frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	self.frame.Parent = parent

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = self.frame

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 80, 110)
	stroke.Thickness = 1
	stroke.Transparency = 0.5
	stroke.Parent = self.frame

	-- Canvas for drawing
	self.canvas = Instance.new("Frame")
	self.canvas.Name = "Canvas"
	self.canvas.Size = UDim2.new(1, -self.config.margin.left - self.config.margin.right, 1, -self.config.margin.top - self.config.margin.bottom)
	self.canvas.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.margin.left, self.config.margin.top)
	self.canvas.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	self.canvas.ClipsDescendants = true
	self.canvas.Parent = self.frame

	-- Y-axis labels container
	self.yLabels = Instance.new("Frame")
	self.yLabels.Name = "YLabels"
	self.yLabels.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.margin.left - 5, self.config.height - self.config.margin.top - self.config.margin.bottom)
	self.yLabels.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, self.config.margin.top)
	self.yLabels.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	self.yLabels.Parent = self.frame

	-- X-axis labels container
	self.xLabels = Instance.new("Frame")
	self.xLabels.Name = "XLabels"
	self.xLabels.Size = UDim2.new(1, -self.config.margin.left - self.config.margin.right, 0, 20)
	self.xLabels.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.margin.left, self.config.height - self.config.margin.bottom)
	self.xLabels.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	self.xLabels.Parent = self.frame

	-- Chart title
	self.titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	self.titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 20)
	self.titleLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 2)
	self.titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	self.titleLabel.Text = ""
	self.titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	self.titleLabel.TextSize = 14
	self.titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 215, 235)
	self.titleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	self.titleLabel.Parent = self.frame

	-- Stats panel
	self.statsFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
	self.statsFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30)
	self.statsFrame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -35)
	self.statsFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	self.statsFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	self.statsFrame.Parent = self.frame

	local statsLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	statsLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	statsLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
	statsLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 15)
	statsLayout.Parent = self.statsFrame
end

function Chart:SetTitle(title: string)
	self.titleLabel.Text = title
end

function Chart:SetData(points: {{x: number, y: number, timestamp: number}})
	-- points: array of {x (timestamp), y (price), timestamp}
	-- x can be sequential index or timestamp
	self.points = points
	self:_render()
end

function Chart:_render()
	if #self.points < 2 then return end

	-- Clear existing
	for _, child in self.canvas:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("Frame") or child:IsA("ImageLabel") then child:Destroy() end
	end
	for _, child in self.yLabels:GetChildren() do child:Destroy() end
	for _, child in self.xLabels:GetChildren() do child:Destroy() end
	for _, child in self.statsFrame:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("TextLabel") then child:Destroy() end
	end

	-- Calculate bounds
	local minY = math.huge
	local maxY = -math.huge
	for _, p in self.points do
		minY = math.min(minY, p.y)
		maxY = math.max(maxY, p.y)
	end

	local padding = (maxY - minY) * 0.1
	if padding == 0 then padding = maxY * 0.1 end
	minY = minY - padding
	maxY = maxY + padding

	local chartWidth = self.config.width - self.config.margin.left - self.config.margin.right
	local chartHeight = self.config.height - self.config.margin.top - self.config.margin.bottom

	-- Y-axis labels (5 ticks)
	for i = 0, 4 do
		local value = maxY - (maxY - minY) * (i / 4)
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.margin.left - 5, 20)
		label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, (i / 4) * chartHeight - 10)
		label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Text = self:_formatNumber(value)
		label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		label.TextSize = self.config.textSize
		label.TextColor3 = self.config.textColor
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
		label.Parent = self.yLabels
	end

	-- Draw grid lines
	for i = 0, 4 do
		local y = (i / 4) * chartHeight
		local line = Instance.new("Frame")
		line.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1)
		line.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y)
		line.BackgroundColor3 = self.config.gridColor
		line.BackgroundTransparency = self.config.gridStrokeTransparency
		line.BorderSizePixel = 0
		line.ZIndex = 1
		line.Parent = self.canvas
	end

	-- Calculate points
	local screenPoints = {}
	for i, p in ipairs(self.points) do
		local x = (i - 1) / (#self.points - 1) * chartWidth
		local y = (1 - (p.y - minY) / (maxY - minY)) * chartHeight
		table.insert(screenPoints, {x = x, y = y, value = p.y, timestamp = p.timestamp})
	end

	-- Draw fill area
	if #screenPoints >= 2 then
		-- Create fill using multiple rectangles (approximation)
		for i = 1, #screenPoints - 1 do
			local p1 = screenPoints[i]
			local p2 = screenPoints[i + 1]
			local width = p2.x - p1.x
			local avgY = (p1.y + p2.y) / 2
			local height = chartHeight - avgY

			local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
			fill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
			fill.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p1.x, avgY)
			fill.BackgroundColor3 = self.config.fillColor
			fill.BackgroundTransparency = self.config.fillTransparency
			fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
			fill.ZIndex = 2
			fill.Parent = self.canvas
		end
	end

	-- Draw line
	for i = 1, #screenPoints - 1 do
		local p1 = screenPoints[i]
		local p2 = screenPoints[i + 1]
		
		local distance = math.sqrt((p2.x - p1.x)^2 + (p2.y - p1.y)^2)
		local angle = math.atan2(p2.y - p1.y, p2.x - p1.x)
		
		local line = Instance.new("Frame")
		line.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(distance, self.config.lineThickness)
		line.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p1.x, p1.y)
		line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		line.Rotation = math.deg(angle)
		line.BackgroundColor3 = self.config.lineColor
		line.BorderSizePixel = 0
		line.ZIndex = 3
		line.Parent = self.canvas
	end

	-- Draw points
	for i, p in ipairs(screenPoints) do
		local point = Instance.new("Frame")
		point.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.pointRadius * 2, self.config.pointRadius * 2)
		point.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.x - self.config.pointRadius, p.y - self.config.pointRadius)
		point.BackgroundColor3 = self.config.pointColor
		point.BorderSizePixel = 0
		point.ZIndex = 4
		point.Parent = self.canvas

		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		corner.Parent = point

		-- Hover tooltip
		point.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			self:_showTooltip(p)
		end)
		point.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			self:_hideTooltip()
		end)
	end

	-- X-axis labels (5 ticks)
	for i = 0, 4 do
		local idx = math.floor(i / 4 * (#self.points - 1)) + 1
		local p = self.points[idx]
		local x = (i / 4) * (self.config.width - self.config.margin.left - self.config.margin.right)
		
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 18)
		label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x - 40, 0)
		label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Text = os.date("%m/%d", p.timestamp)
		label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		label.TextSize = self.config.textSize - 1
		label.TextColor3 = self.config.textColor
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		label.Parent = self.xLabels
	end

	-- Stats panel
	if #self.points > 0 then
		local current = self.points[#self.points].y
		local change = #self.points > 1 and current - self.points[1].y or 0
		local changePct = self.points[1].y ~= 0 and (change / self.points[1].y * 100) or 0

		local stats = {
			{"Current", self:_formatPrice(current)},
			{"Change", string.format("%s%.2f%%", change >= 0 and "+" or "", changePct)},
			{"24h High", self:_formatPrice(math.max(table.unpack(self:_getYValues())))},
			{"24h Low", self:_formatPrice(math.min(table.unpack(self:_getYValues())))},
		}

		for _, stat in stats do
			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20)
			label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
			label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			label.Text = stat[1] .. ": " .. stat[2]
			label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
			label.TextSize = 11
			label.TextColor3 = stat[1] == "Change" and (change >= 0 and Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)) or Color3.fromRGB(160, 175, 200)
			label.Parent = self.statsFrame
		end
	end
end

function Chart:_getYValues()
	local values = {}
	for _, p in self.points do table.insert(values, p.y) end
	return values
end

function Chart:_formatNumber(num: number): string
	if num >= 1e9 then return string.format("%.1fB", num / 1e9)
	elseif num >= 1e6 then return string.format("%.1fM", num / 1e6)
	elseif num >= 1e3 then return string.format("%.1fK", num / 1e3)
	else return string.format("%.0f", num) end
end

function Chart:_formatPrice(num: number): string
	return self:_formatNumber(num)
end

function Chart:_showTooltip(point)
	-- Tooltip implementation
end

function Chart:_hideTooltip()
	-- Hide tooltip
end

function Chart:Update(points)
	self.points = points
	self:_render()
end

function Chart:Destroy()
	self.frame:Destroy()
end

return Chart

-- Modal.lua
-- Modal dialog system for blocking interactions

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Modal = {}
Modal.__index = Modal

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
	animationDuration = 0.3,
	backgroundDim = 0.5,
	blocking = true,
	maxWidth = 500,
	maxHeight = 400,
}

function Modal.new(config)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Modal)
	self.config = setmetatable(config or {}, {__index = DEFAULT_CONFIG})
	self.activeModals = {}
	self.gui = nil
	return self
end

function Modal:_createGui()
	if self.gui then return end
	
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "ModalSystem"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.DisplayOrder = 300
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.Parent = playerGui

	self.gui = gui
end

function Modal:Show(data)
	self:_createGui()
	
	data.id = data.id or game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false)
	
	-- Create overlay
	local overlay = Instance.new("Frame")
	overlay.Name = "Overlay_" .. data.id
	overlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	overlay.ZIndex = 200
	overlay.Parent = self.gui
	
	-- Modal frame
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "Modal_" .. data.id
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 32)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.ZIndex = 201
	frame.Parent = self.gui
	
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
	corner.Parent = frame
	
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Parent = frame
	
	-- Title
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 40)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = data.title
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 24
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	title.ZIndex = 202
	title.Parent = frame
	
	-- Body
	local body = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 80)
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 70)
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Text = data.body
	body.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	body.TextSize = 16
	body.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 215, 235)
	body.TextWrapped = true
	body.ZIndex = 202
	body.Parent = frame
	
	-- Action buttons
	if data.actions then
		for i, action in ipairs(data.actions) do
			local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
			btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 40)
			btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20 + (i - 1) * 170, 180)
			btn.BackgroundColor3 = i == 1 and Color3.fromRGB(55, 140, 220) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 70, 90)
			btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
			btn.Text = action.text
			btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			btn.TextSize = 14
			btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			btn.ZIndex = 202
			btn.Parent = frame
			
			local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
			btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
			btnCorner.Parent = btn
			
			btn.Activated:Connect(function()
				if action.callback then action.callback() end
				self:Dismiss(data.id)
			end)
		end
	end
	
	-- Close button
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32)
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 10)
	closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeBtn.Text = "✕"
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeBtn.TextSize = 18
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 165, 190)
	closeBtn.ZIndex = 202
	closeBtn.Parent = frame
	
	closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		self:Dismiss(data.id)
	end)
	
	-- Store modal
	self.activeModals[data.id] = {frame = frame, overlay = overlay}
	
	-- Entrance animation
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(overlay, TweenInfo.new(self.config.animationDuration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1 - self.config.backgroundDim
	}):Play()
	
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(self.config.animationDuration, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.maxWidth, self.config.maxHeight)
	}):Play()
	
	return data.id
end

function Modal:Dismiss(id)
	local modal = self.activeModals[id]
	if not modal then return end
	
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(modal.overlay, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1
	}):Play()
	
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(modal.frame, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	}):Play()
	
	task.wait(0.2)
	modal.overlay:Destroy()
	modal.frame:Destroy()
	self.activeModals[id] = nil
end

function Modal:DismissAll()
	for id, _ in self.activeModals do
		self:Dismiss(id)
	end
end

function Modal:Destroy()
	self:DismissAll()
	if self.gui then self.gui:Destroy() end
end

return Modal

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules
local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"]
if GameSettings.GameType.Value ~= "Collector" then return end

local CurrenyDrop = ServerStorage.CurrencyDrop

local Multipliers = require(Modules.Multipliers)

function SpawnObject(v)
	if #v:GetChildren() < GameSettings.MaxDrops.Value then
		local NewDrop = CurrenyDrop:Clone()

		local X,Y,Z = math.random(v.Size.X) - v.Size.X/2 + v.Position.X, v.Position.Y + 5, math.random(v.Size.Z) - v.Size.Z/2 + v.Position.Z
		local RandomPosition = Vector3.new(X,Y,Z)

		NewDrop.Position = RandomPosition 
		NewDrop.Parent = v

		local Hit = false

		NewDrop.Touched:Connect(function(HitPart)
			if Hit then return end

			if HitPart.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
				Hit = true
				local Character = HitPart.Parent
				local Player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Character)
				Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
				Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
				NewDrop:Destroy()
			end			
		end)

		NewDrop.CanCollide = true
		task.wait(2.5)

		pcall(function()
			NewDrop.Anchored = true
			NewDrop.CanCollide = false
		end)
	end
end

while task.wait(1) do
	for _,Area in workspace.Map.CollectAreas:GetChildren() do
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			SpawnObject(Area)
		end)()
	end
end

--[[ This Script Handles Admin Commands

Current Commands:
/givestats Player Stat Amount
/givepet PlayerName PetName

]]

local ADMINS = {
	3791434058, -- Put userids here. If you are the owner of the game this is not required
	
}



--------- Main Script ---------

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local AdminFunctions = require(script.AdminFunctions)

function Main(Player) -- this code is called for each player joining
	if not AdminFunctions.IsPlayerAdmin(Player, ADMINS) then return end -- player is not an admin if this returns false
	
	Player.Chatted:Connect(function(Message)
		local SplittedMessage = string.split(Message, " ")
		local Command = string.lower(SplittedMessage[1] or "")
		local PlayerName = SplittedMessage[2] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[2]) or ""
		local Arg1 = SplittedMessage[3] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[3]) or ""
		local Arg2 = SplittedMessage[4] and string.lower(SplittedMessage[4]) or ""
		
		if Command == "/gm" then
			Player:SetAttribute("IsGM", not (Player:GetAttribute("IsGM") == true))
		elseif Command == "/givestats" then -- /givestats PlayerName StatName Amount
			local TargetPlayer = AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
			if TargetPlayer == nil then return end -- no player exists
			
			if Arg1 == string.lower(ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"].CurrencyName.Value) then
				Arg1 = "currency"
			end
			
			local Stat = AdminFunctions.FindStatFromStatName(TargetPlayer, Arg1)
			if Stat == nil then return end -- stat does not exist
			
			if Stat:IsA("IntValue") or Stat:IsA("NumberValue") then
				Arg2 = tonumber(Arg2)
				if Arg2 == nil then return end
				
				Stat.Value = Arg2 -- set the stat to Arg2 if it's a number
			elseif Stat:IsA("BoolValue") then
				Stat.Value = Arg1 == "true" and true or false -- make it true if you put in True or true and the rest if false	
			elseif Stat:IsA("StringValue") then
				Stat.Value = Arg1
			end
		elseif Command == "/givepet" then -- /givepet PlayerName PetName
			local TargetPlayer = AdminFunctions.FindPlayerFromName(PlayerName)
			if TargetPlayer == nil then return end -- no player exists

			local Pet = AdminFunctions.FindPetFromPetName(TargetPlayer, Arg1)
			if Pet == nil then return end -- pet does not exist

			local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = AdminFunctions.RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
			NewPet.PetName.Value = Pet.Name
			NewPet.Parent = TargetPlayer.Data.Pets
		end
	end)
end

local function removeTag(character)
	if not character then return end
	local existing = character:FindFirstChild(tagName)
	if existing then existing:Destroy() end
	local glow = character:FindFirstChild(glowName)
	if glow then glow:Destroy() end
end

local function addTag(character)
	if not character then return end

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

--// Variables
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Trading

local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules

local PetMultipliers = require(Modules.PetMultipliers)
local Multipliers = require(Modules.Multipliers)

local TradeOffers = {} -- table with trade offers of the players inside

Remotes.RequestTrade.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Player2)
	--// Player has clicked on "Send Trade" button
	Player2 = game.Players:FindFirstChild(Player2)

	if not Player2:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player2.Loaded.Value then return "Player has not loaded" end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value or Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return "Player is in trade" end
	-- You can also add requirements here for trading, such as 250 eggs opened

	--// Make a button pop up in their ui
	Remotes.RequestTrade:InvokeClient(Player2, Player.Name)	
end

Remotes.StartTrade.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Player2)
	--// Starting trade
	Player2 = game.Players:FindFirstChild(Player2)

	if not Player2:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player2.Loaded.Value then return end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value or Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return end

	Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = true
	Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = true

	TradeOffers[Player.Name] = {TradeTokens = 0, Pets = {}} -- creates the inventory during the trade
	TradeOffers[Player2.Name] = {TradeTokens = 0, Pets = {}}

	Remotes.StartTrade:InvokeClient(Player2,Player.Name) -- player 2 knows the trade started
	return true
end

Remotes.ChangeOffer.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Player2, Args)
	Player2 = game.Players:FindFirstChild(Player2)
	
	if Args.OfferType == "Pet" then
		if not TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets[Args.ID] then
			if Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player2) <= #Player2.Data.Pets:GetChildren() + #TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets then return "Max" end
			TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets[Args.ID] = 1
			Remotes.ChangeOffer:InvokeClient(Player2,"PetAdded", Args.ID)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
			return "Added"
		else
			TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets[Args.ID] = nil
			Remotes.ChangeOffer:InvokeClient(Player2, "PetRemoved", Args.ID)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
			return "Removed"
		end
	elseif Args.OfferType == "TradeTokens" then
		if tonumber(Args.Amount) and tonumber(Args.Amount) >= 0 then
			if not Player.Data.PlayerData:FindFirstChild("Currency2") then return end -- 
			if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value < tonumber(Args.Amount) then return end -- not enough tokens

			TradeOffers[Player.Name].TradeTokens = tonumber(Args.Amount)
			Remotes.ChangeOffer:InvokeClient(Player2, "TradeTokens", tonumber(Args.Amount))
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
		end
	end
end

Remotes.TradeAction.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Player2, Args)
	Player2 = game.Players:FindFirstChild(Player2)

	if Args.Option == "Cancel" then
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = false
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
		TradeOffers[Player.Name] = nil -- remove all trade data to free up space
		TradeOffers[Player2.Name] = nil -- remove all trade data, if the player left it does not matter as it should still be removed

		if Player2 then -- incase the player left, you dont edit the data. If they did not, edit the data
			Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = false
			Player2.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
			Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Cancel"})
		end

		return true
	elseif Args.Option == "Ready" then
		if not Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value then -- makes player ready
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = true

			if Player2.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value then -- both are ready
				local Active = true

				--// Countdown Timer
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Countdown", Count = 3})
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player, {Option = "Countdown", Count = 3})
				
				local function BothReady()
					return Player2.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value and Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value
				end
				
				local function CancelCountdown()
					Active = false 
					Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "CountdownEnded"})
					Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player, {Option = "CountdownEnded"})
				end
				
				for i = 10, 1, -1 do
					if not BothReady() then 
						CancelCountdown()
						break 
					end
					task.wait(0.3)	
				end
				
				if not BothReady() then
					CancelCountdown()
				end
			
				if not Active then return end
				
				print("Completing Trade")
				CompleteTrade(Player, Player2)
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Countdown", Count = 0})
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player, {Option = "Countdown", Count = 0})
			else
				Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Ready"})
				return "Ready"
			end
		else --// unready
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
			Remotes.TradeAction:InvokeClient(Player2, {Option = "Unready"})
			return "Unready"
		end		
	end
end

function UnequipPet(Player, Pet)
	if not Pet.Equipped.Value then return end -- Already unequipped
	Pet.Equipped.Value = false
	PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

function LoadEquipped(Player)
	local EquippedPets = PetMultipliers.Multipliers[Player.Name]

	for PetId, Value in EquippedPets do
		local PetModel = workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:FindFirstChild(PetId)

		if not PetModel then
			local PetInstance = Player.Data.Pets[PetId]
			local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value]:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = PetId

			for _, Part in NewPet:GetChildren() do
				if Part:IsA("BasePart") then
					Part.Anchored = true
				end
			end

			local Billboard = script.BillboardGui:Clone()
			Billboard.PetName.Text = PetInstance.PetName.Value
			Billboard.PetRarity.Text = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Rarity.Value
			Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, NewPet.MainPart.Size.Y, 0)
			Billboard.Parent = NewPet

			NewPet:PivotTo(Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame)			
			NewPet.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]
		end
	end

	for _,PlayerPet in workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:GetChildren() do
		if not EquippedPets[tonumber(PlayerPet.Name)] then
			PlayerPet:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

function CompleteTrade(Player, Player2)
	Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = false
	Player2.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value = false
	Player.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false
	Player2.NonSaveValues.IsReady.Value = false

	--// Player 1 to Player 2
	for i, v in TradeOffers[Player.Name].Pets do
		local ClonedPet = Player.Data.Pets[i]

		if ClonedPet.Equipped.Value then
			UnequipPet(Player, ClonedPet)
		end
		
		ClonedPet.Parent = Player2.Data.Pets
	end

	--// Player 2 to Player 1
	for i, v in TradeOffers[Player2.Name].Pets do
		local ClonedPet = Player2.Data.Pets[i]

		if ClonedPet.Equipped.Value then
			UnequipPet(Player2, ClonedPet)
		end

		ClonedPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets
	end
	
	LoadEquipped(Player)
	LoadEquipped(Player2)

	if Player.Data.PlayerData:FindFirstChild("Currency2") then -- like gems or smth exist
		Player2.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += TradeOffers[Player.Name].TradeTokens - TradeOffers[Player2.Name].TradeTokens -- for example u get 400 u give 150
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += TradeOffers[Player2.Name].TradeTokens - TradeOffers[Player.Name].TradeTokens
	end
end

--[[
Code system originally made by Croissant God, on roblox @DemonicMakesGames
]]

local Codes = {
	["100CASH"] = {100, "Currency"}, -- Put in amount, then the stat name
	["100DIAMONDS"] = {100, "Diamonds"},
	["3REBIRTHS"] = {3, "Rebirths"},
	["Scarecrow"] = {"Pumpkin"}, -- Put in pet name
}



--------- Main Script ---------

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

--// Functions
function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1, 20000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(Chance)) then
		return RandomID(Folder)
	end
	return Chance
end

--// Variables
local CodeStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("CodesStore")

--// Main
ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.RedeemCode.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, Code)
	if not Codes[Code] then return end -- code doesnt exist

	local isRedeemed = CodeStore:GetAsync(Code.."_"..tostring(Player.UserId))
	
	if isRedeemed then return end -- Already redeemed
	
	if type(Codes[Code][1]) == "number" then -- Stat
		if Codes[Code][2] == "Diamonds" then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Codes[Code][1]
		elseif Codes[Code][2] == "Currency" then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += Codes[Code][1]
			Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += Codes[Code][1]
		elseif Codes[Code][2] == "Rebirths" then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value += Codes[Code][1]
		else
			return
		end
	else -- Pet
		if ReplicatedStorage.Pets:FindFirstChild(Codes[Code][1]) == nil then warn("Error: "..Codes[Code][1].." Does not exist") return end -- Pet doesn't exist
		local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
		NewPet.Name = RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
		NewPet.PetName.Value = Codes[Code][1]
		NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets
	end
	CodeStore:SetAsync(Code.."_"..tostring(Player.UserId), true)
end)

--// Eggs Handler
-- View/modify eggs, costs, and pet chances.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local EggsHandler = {}

local EggsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Eggs")

function EggsHandler.AllEggs()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Egg in EggsFolder:GetChildren() do
		local Cost = Egg:FindFirstChild("Cost")
		local EggPets = {}
		local EggPetsFolder = Egg:FindFirstChild("Pets")
		if EggPetsFolder then
			for _, Pet in EggPetsFolder:GetChildren() do
				if Pet:IsA("ValueBase") then
					EggPets[#EggPets + 1] = { name = Pet.Name, chance = Pet.Value }
				end
			end
		end
		table.sort(EggPets, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Egg.Name,
			cost = Cost and Cost.Value or 0,
			isRobux = Egg:FindFirstChild("ProductId") ~= nil,
			productInfo = Egg:FindFirstChild("ProductId") and { id = Egg.ProductId.Value } or nil,
			pets = EggPets,
			petCount = #EggPets,
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
	return Result
end

function EggsHandler.SetEggCost(EggName, NewValue)
	local Egg = EggsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(EggName))
	if not Egg or not Egg:FindFirstChild("Cost") then return false, "Egg not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid cost" end
	Egg.Cost.Value = Num
	return true, "Set " .. EggName .. " cost = " .. Num
end

function EggsHandler.SetPetChance(EggName, PetName, NewValue)
	local Egg = EggsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(EggName))
	if not Egg or not Egg:FindFirstChild("Pets") then return false, "Egg not found" end
	local Pet = Egg.Pets:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not Pet then return false, "Pet not in this egg" end
	local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid chance" end
	Pet.Value = Num
	return true, "Set " .. EggName .. "." .. PetName .. " chance = " .. Num
end

return EggsHandler

--[[
	This script handles the client. 
	
	Contents:
	- ClickButton
	- Overlay (Currency counter)
	- Popups
	- Close Buttons of Frames
	- Buttons on the side
	- Settings
	- Rebirth
	- Shop
	- Pet Inventory
	- Egg Preview (Frame that shows the price etc)
	- Egg Hatching
	- Pet Follow
	- Areas
	- Trading
	- Gem Shop
	- Codes
	- Stats
	- Functions
	
	Only edit if you know what you're doing!
]]

--// Services
local MarketPlaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Loading
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
repeat wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil

if Player.Parent == nil then return end

--// Variables
local Data = Player.Data
local PlayerData = Data.PlayerData

local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"]
local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules

local PetMultipliers = require(Modules.PetMultipliers)
local Multipliers = require(Modules.Multipliers)
local Utilities = require(Modules.Utilities)

local UI = Player.PlayerGui:WaitForChild("GameUI")
local Frames = UI.Frames

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes

--// Clicker
if GameSettings.GameType.Value == "Clicker" then
	Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(UI.Clicker)

	UI.Clicker.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Remotes.Clicker:FireServer()
		Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
	end)

	if GameSettings.ClickingAnywhere.Value then
		UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input, Processed)
			if Processed then return end
			if Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end -- not a left mouse click
			Remotes.Clicker:FireServer()
			Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
		end)
	end
end

--// Overlay
local CurrencySide = UI[GameSettings.CurrencySide.Value]
CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(PlayerData.Currency.Value)
PlayerData.Currency.Changed:Connect(function()
	CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(PlayerData.Currency.Value)
end)

CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel2.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(PlayerData.Currency2.Value)
PlayerData.Currency2.Changed:Connect(function()
	CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel2.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(PlayerData.Currency2.Value)
end)


--// Popups
local CurrencyOld = PlayerData.Currency.Value
PlayerData.Currency.Changed:Connect(function(NewValue)
	task.spawn(function()
		if NewValue > CurrencyOld then
			local NewPopup = script.Popup:Clone()
			NewPopup.Size = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
			NewPopup.Currency.Image = CurrencySide.CurrencyLabel.Currency.Image
			NewPopup.Amount.Text = "+"..Utilities.Short.en(NewValue - CurrencyOld)
			NewPopup.Position = UDim2.new(math.random(40, 60) / 100, 0, math.random(40, 60) / 100, 0) -- sets it in a random position in the middle square
			NewPopup.Parent = UI.Popups
			NewPopup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0.176,0,0.105,0), Enum.EasingDirection.In, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.5)
			task.wait(1)
			NewPopup:TweenPosition(CurrencySide.Position, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 2)
			NewPopup:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0.1,0,0.05,0), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 2)
			task.wait(1.4)
			NewPopup:Destroy()
		end
	end)

	CurrencyOld = NewValue
end)

--// Frames
local BaseSize = {}
for _,Frame in Frames:GetChildren() do
	if not Frame:IsA("Frame") then continue end
	if Frame:GetAttribute("Keep") then continue end

	BaseSize[Frame.Name] = Frame.Size

	if Frame:FindFirstChild("Close") then
		Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(Frame.Close)
		Frame.Close.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			Utilities.ButtonHandler.OnClick(Frame, UDim2.new(0,0,0,0))
			Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
		end)
	end
end

--// Buttons
local ButtonSide = UI[GameSettings.ButtonSide.Value]
for _,Button in ButtonSide.Buttons:GetChildren() do
	if not Button:IsA("Frame") then continue end
	if Button:GetAttribute("AuctionButton") then continue end

	Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(Button)
	Button.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Utilities.ButtonHandler.OnClick(UI.Frames[Button.Name], BaseSize[Button.Name])
		Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
	end)
end

--// Settings
local SettingsScroll = Frames.Settings.ObjectHolder

-- Music Setting
local MusicSetting = SettingsScroll.Music
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(MusicSetting.Toggle.On)
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(MusicSetting.Toggle.Off)

MusicSetting.Toggle.On.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Setting:FireServer("Music", true)
	Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
end)

MusicSetting.Toggle.Off.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Setting:FireServer("Music", false)
	Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
end)

SoundService.Music.PlaybackSpeed = PlayerData.Music.Value and 1 or 0
PlayerData.Music.Changed:Connect(function()
	SoundService.Music.PlaybackSpeed = PlayerData.Music.Value and 1 or 0
end)

-- ShowOtherPets
local ShowOtherPetsSetting = SettingsScroll.ShowOtherPets
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(ShowOtherPetsSetting.Toggle.On)
Utilities.ButtonAnimations.Create(ShowOtherPetsSetting.Toggle.Off)

ShowOtherPetsSetting.Toggle.On.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Setting:FireServer("ShowOtherPets", true)
	Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
end)

ShowOtherPetsSetting.Toggle.Off.Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Setting:FireServer("ShowOtherPets", false)
	Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
end)

function SortInventory(SortTable, ObjectHolder)
	local TableToSort = SortTable ~= nil and SortTable or PetInventory -- so it can differentiate between trade and normal inventories

	table.sort(TableToSort, function(a,b)
		if not a or not b then return end

		if a.Multiplier ~= b.Multiplier then
			return a.Multiplier > b.Multiplier
		else
			return a.ID > b.ID
		end
	end)

	for Order,PetInfo in TableToSort do
		if not Data.Pets:FindFirstChild(PetInfo.ID) then
			table.remove(TableToSort, Order)
			continue
		end

		if not ObjectHolder then
			PetFrame.MainFrame.ObjectHolder[PetInfo.ID].LayoutOrder = Order + (Data.Pets[PetInfo.ID].Equipped.Value and 0 or 1000) -- order + 1000 if equipped
		else
			ObjectHolder[PetInfo.ID].LayoutOrder = Order + (Data.Pets[PetInfo.ID].Equipped.Value and 0 or 1000) -- order + 1000 if equipped
		end
	end
end

local CurrentlySelected = 0

function AddPet(PetInstance, SortTable, Parent) -- Creates a pet slot
	task.wait(0.1)
	local NewPet = script.PetTemplate:Clone()

	local PetModel = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value]:Clone()
	PetModel.Parent = NewPet.Display

	local MainPart = PetModel:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	local Pos

	if not MainPart then
		warn(PetModel.Name.." does not have a MainPart, please add one by calling one of the parts 'MainPart'")

		for _,v in PetModel:GetChildren() do -- this here chooses a random part of the pet instead of the mainpart.
			if v:IsA("BasePart") then
				Pos = v.Position
				break
			end
		end
	else
		Pos = MainPart.Position
	end

	local Pos = PetModel.MainPart.Position
	local Camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	NewPet.Display.CurrentCamera = Camera
	PetModel:PivotTo(PetModel:GetPivot() * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0))
	Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(Pos.X + PetModel:GetExtentsSize().X * 1.5, Pos.Y, Pos.Z + 1), Pos)

	if not Parent then -- normal pet
		NewPet.Equipped.Visible = PetInstance.Equipped.Value

		PetInstance.Equipped.Changed:Connect(function()
			NewPet.Equipped.Visible = PetInstance.Equipped.Value

			if CurrentlySelected == tonumber(PetInstance.Name) then
				UpdateSideFrame(PetInstance)
			end

			SortInventory()
		end)

		NewPet.Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if not IsMultiDeleting then
				UpdateSideFrame(PetInstance)
			else
				if not table.find(SelectedForDelete, tonumber(PetInstance.Name)) then
					table.insert(SelectedForDelete, tonumber(PetInstance.Name))
					NewPet.Delete.Visible = true
				else
					table.remove(SelectedForDelete, table.find(SelectedForDelete, tonumber(PetInstance.Name)))
					NewPet.Delete.Visible = false
				end
			end
			Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
		end)
	end
	NewPet.Name = PetInstance.Name
	NewPet.Parent = Parent == nil and PetFrame.MainFrame.ObjectHolder or Parent

	if SortTable == nil then
		PetInventory[#PetInventory+1] = {ID = PetInstance.Name, Multiplier = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Multiplier.Value}
	else
		SortTable[#SortTable+1] = {ID = PetInstance.Name, Multiplier = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Multiplier.Value}
	end

	return NewPet
end

function UpdateSideFrame(PetInstance) -- PetInstance is the folder in Player.Pets
	CurrentlySelected = tonumber(PetInstance.Name)
	PetFrame.SideFrameBlocker.Visible = false

	SideFrame.Title.Text = PetInstance.PetName.Value
	SideFrame.Equip.Title.Text = PetInstance.Equipped.Value and "Unequip" or "Equip"
	SideFrame.Equip.BackgroundColor3 = PetInstance.Equipped.Value and Color3.fromRGB(36, 136, 2) or Color3.fromRGB(56, 218, 3) 

	if SideFrame.Display:FindFirstChild("PetModel") then
		SideFrame.Display.PetModel:Destroy()
	end

	local PetModel = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value]:Clone()
	PetModel.Name = "PetModel"
	PetModel.Parent = SideFrame.Display

	local Pos = PetModel.MainPart.Position
	local Camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	SideFrame.Display.CurrentCamera = Camera
	PetModel:PivotTo(PetModel:GetPivot() * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0))
	Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(Pos.X + PetModel:GetExtentsSize().X * 1.5, Pos.Y, Pos.Z + 1), Pos)

	SideFrame.Multiplier.Amount.Text = "x"..Utilities.Short.en(ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Multiplier.Value)
end
