--// Egg Preview
local PreviewFrame = UI.PreviewFrame
local DefaultSize = PreviewFrame.Size
local CurrentTarget = PreviewFrame.CurrentTarget
PreviewFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.2,0,0.2,0)

function FindClosestEgg(EggsAvailable)
	local CurrentClosest, ClosestDistance = nil, 100

	for _,Egg in EggsAvailable do
		local EggModel = workspace.Map.Eggs[Egg]
		local mag = (EggModel:GetPivot().Position-Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
		if mag <= ClosestDistance then
			CurrentClosest = EggModel
			ClosestDistance = mag
		end
	end
	return CurrentClosest
end

local IsClosing = false -- so it doesnt ruin the animation

function FindEgg()
	if not Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or not Player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") or Player.Character.Humanoid.Health == 0 then return end

	local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local EggsAvailable = {}
	local CameraRatio = ((Camera.CFrame.Position - Camera.Focus.Position).Magnitude)/11

	for _,Egg in workspace.Map.Eggs:GetChildren() do
		if Egg == nil then continue end
		if not Egg:FindFirstChild("EggModel") then warn(Egg.Name.." does not have an EggModel") end

		local mag = (Egg:GetPivot().Position-Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
		if mag <= 12 then
			EggsAvailable[#EggsAvailable + 1] = Egg.Name
		end
	end

	local SetVisibility = #EggsAvailable >= 1 -- if its 0 then its already false

	if SetVisibility then -- a egg(s) is in distance
		local Egg = #EggsAvailable > 1 and FindClosestEgg(EggsAvailable) or workspace.Map.Eggs[EggsAvailable[1]]
		local WSP = workspace.CurrentCamera:WorldToScreenPoint(Egg:GetPivot().Position)
		PreviewFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0,WSP.X,0,WSP.Y)
		CurrentTarget.Value = Egg.Name
	else
		CurrentTarget.Value = "None"
	end

	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value then
		SetVisibility = false -- if you are opening an egg itll auto close the previewframe
	end

	--// Make the previewframe visible
	if SetVisibility and not PreviewFrame.Visible then
		PreviewFrame.Visible = true
		Utilities.Tween.Tween(PreviewFrame, {Speed = 0.15}, {Size = UDim2.new(DefaultSize.X.Scale/CameraRatio, DefaultSize.X.Offset, DefaultSize.Y.Scale/CameraRatio, DefaultSize.Y.Offset)})	
	elseif not SetVisibility and PreviewFrame.Visible and not IsClosing then -- set to invisible, while is visible & isnt closing
		IsClosing = true
		Utilities.Tween.Tween(PreviewFrame, {Speed = 0.15}, {Size = UDim2.new(0.2,0,0.2,0)})	
		task.wait(0.15)
		PreviewFrame.Visible = false
		IsClosing = false
	end
end

function UpdatePreviewFrame()
	if CurrentTarget.Value ~= "None" then
		local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value
		PreviewFrame.EggInfo.EggName.Text = Egg

		if not ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg) then print(Egg.." does not have settings in ReplicatedStorage.Eggs!") return end

		local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]

		local IsRobuxEgg = EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId")
		if IsRobuxEgg then
			PreviewFrame.EggInfo.Price.Text = "Costs \u{E002}"..Utilities.Short.en(EggInfo.Cost.Value)
		else
			PreviewFrame.EggInfo.Price.Text = "Costs "..Utilities.Short.en(EggInfo.Cost.Value)
		end

		PreviewFrame.Buttons.Triple.Visible = not IsRobuxEgg
		PreviewFrame.Buttons.Auto.Visible = not IsRobuxEgg

		--// This part gets the pet chances
		local Pets, TotalWeight = {}, 0

		for _, Pet in EggInfo.Pets:GetChildren() do
			table.insert(Pets, {Pet.Name, Pet.Value})
		end

		table.sort(Pets, function(a,b)
			return a[2] > b[2]
		end)

		local BaseChance = Pets[1][2] -- this is the most common pet

		local LuckMultiplier = Multipliers.GetLuckMultiplier(Player)

		for _,v in Pets do
			local Chance = math.min(v[2] * LuckMultiplier, BaseChance) -- so if the easiest pet is 70%, all pets will go towards 70% 
			TotalWeight += Chance
			v[2] = Chance
		end

		for i = 1,9 do
			local PetInfo = Pets[i]
			local PetSlot = PreviewFrame.PetChances.List["Pet"..i]
			PetSlot.Visible = PetInfo ~= nil

			if PetInfo == nil then continue end

			PetSlot.Rarity.Text = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInfo[1]].Settings.Rarity.Value
			PetSlot.Percentage.Text = Utilities.Short.en(100/TotalWeight * PetInfo[2]).."%"
			PetSlot.Delete.Visible = Data.AutoDelete[PetInfo[1]].Value
			PetSlot.PetName.Value = PetInfo[1]

			local PetModel = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInfo[1]]:Clone()
			PetModel.Parent = PetSlot.Pet

			local Pos = PetModel.MainPart.Position
			local Camera = Instance.new("Camera")
			PetSlot.Pet.CurrentCamera = Camera
			PetModel:PivotTo(PetModel:GetPivot() * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0))
			Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(Pos.X + PetModel:GetExtentsSize().X * 1.5, Pos.Y, Pos.Z + 1), Pos)
		end
	end
end

--// Egg Hatching
local IsAutoOpening = false

function HatchEgg(Egg: string, Result: string, Offset:number)
	local OpeningTime = 3

	local NewViewport = script.EggViewport:Clone()
	NewViewport.Parent = UI.OpenEgg

	Player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 15
	Frames.Visible = false
	UI[GameSettings.ButtonSide.Value].Buttons.Visible = false

	local Clone = workspace.Map.Eggs[Egg].EggModel:Clone()
	Clone:ScaleTo(0.5)
	Clone.Parent = workspace

	local Rot, X, Y, Z = Instance.new("NumberValue"), Instance.new("NumberValue"), Instance.new("NumberValue"), Instance.new("NumberValue")
	Rot.Value = 30 Z.Value = -4 X.Value = 10

	local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local PL = Instance.new("PointLight")
	PL.Shadows = false PL.Range = 4 PL.Brightness *= 1.5
	PL.Parent = Clone.Egg

	Clone:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z))
	local CameraConnection1 = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		Clone:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(Rot.Value)))
	end)

	local CameraConnection2 = Camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		Clone:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(Rot.Value)))
	end)

	local TweenIn = TweenService:Create(X, TweenInfo.new(OpeningTime*0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = Offset})
	TweenIn:Play()

	local RotTweenIn = TweenService:Create(Rot, TweenInfo.new(OpeningTime*0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = 0})
	RotTweenIn:Play()

	-- add an audio for the egg flying in
	TweenIn.Completed:Wait()

	local Eggdelay = 0.075
	for i = 1,(OpeningTime * 1.5) + 1 do
		local Tween = TweenService:Create(Rot, TweenInfo.new(Eggdelay, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = 6})
		Tween:Play()
		-- add an audio for rotating here
		Tween.Completed:Wait()

		local Tween = TweenService:Create(Rot, TweenInfo.new(Eggdelay, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = -6})
		-- add an audio for rotating here
		Tween:Play()
		Tween.Completed:Wait()

		Eggdelay -= .005
	end

	CameraConnection1:Disconnect()
	CameraConnection2:Disconnect()	
	Clone:Destroy()	

	-- Now we're going to show the pet

	local PetModel = game.ReplicatedStorage.Pets[Result]:Clone()
	PetModel:ScaleTo(0.6)
	PetModel.Parent = workspace

	NewViewport.Deleted.Visible = Data.AutoDelete[Result].Value
	NewViewport.PetName.Text = Result
	NewViewport.PetName.Visible = true
	NewViewport.PetRarity.Text = game.ReplicatedStorage.Pets[Result].Settings.Rarity.Value
	NewViewport.PetRarity.Visible = true

	local PL = Instance.new("PointLight")
	PL.Shadows = false PL.Range = 4 PL.Brightness *= 2
	PL.Parent = PetModel.MainPart

	X.Value = Offset Y.Value = 0 Z.Value = -4 Rot.Value = 175
	local CameraConnection1 = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		PetModel:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Rot.Value), 0))
	end)

	local CameraConnection2 = Camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(function()
		local X, Y, Z = X.Value, Y.Value, Z.Value
		PetModel:PivotTo(Camera:GetRenderCFrame()*CFrame.new(X,Y,Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Rot.Value), 0))
	end)

	task.wait(OpeningTime*0.25)

	NewViewport:TweenPosition(UDim2.new(NewViewport.Position.X.Scale, 0, NewViewport.Position.Y.Scale + 10, 0), Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, OpeningTime * 0.1)
	TweenService:Create(Y, TweenInfo.new(OpeningTime*0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Value = -5}):Play()
	NewViewport.Deleted.Visible = false
	NewViewport.PetName.Visible = false
	NewViewport.PetRarity.Visible = false
	task.wait(OpeningTime * 0.15)

	CameraConnection1:Disconnect()
	CameraConnection2:Disconnect()
	X:Destroy() Y:Destroy() Z:Destroy() Rot:Destroy()

	PetModel:Destroy()
	NewViewport:Destroy()

	Player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5
	UI[GameSettings.ButtonSide.Value].Buttons.Visible = true
	Frames.Visible = true	
end

Remotes.Egg.OnClientInvoke = HatchEgg

function SingleEgg()
	local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value

	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg)
	if not EggInfo then return end

	if not EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then
		local Result = Remotes.Egg:InvokeServer(Egg, 1)

		if Result ~= nil then
			HatchEgg(Egg, Result[1], 0)
		end
	else
		MarketPlaceService:PromptProductPurchase(Player, EggInfo.ProductId.Value)
	end
end

function TripleEgg()
	local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value

	local Result = Remotes.Egg:InvokeServer(Egg, 3)

	if Result ~= nil then
		for i = 1,#Result do
			coroutine.wrap(function()
				local Position = (i - 2) * 3
				HatchEgg(Egg, Result[i], Position)
			end)()
		end
	end
end

local function ChooseEggAmount(Egg)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg)
	if not EggInfo then return 1 end

	local EggAmount = 1

	if ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild("TripleEgg") and not Player.Data.Gamepasses.TripleEgg.Value then 
		return EggAmount
	end -- triple egg is a gamepass that the player doesn't own, so open 1 egg

	if PlayerData.Currency.Value >= EggInfo.Cost.Value * 3 then
		EggAmount = 3
	end

	return EggAmount
end

function AutoEgg()
	if IsAutoOpening then return end

	if ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild("AutoEgg") and not Player.Data.Gamepasses.AutoEgg.Value then 
		MarketPlaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(Player, ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses.AutoEgg.Value)
		return
	end

	local Egg = CurrentTarget.Value	
	IsAutoOpening = true

	while true do
		if Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value then task.wait(0.1) continue end -- player is already opening an egg

		if CurrentTarget.Value == "None" or CurrentTarget.Value ~= Egg then
			IsAutoOpening = false
			break
		end

		local Result = Remotes.Egg:InvokeServer(Egg, ChooseEggAmount(Egg))

		if Result == nil then
			IsAutoOpening = false
			break
		end

		if #Result > 1 then
			for i = 1,#Result do
				coroutine.wrap(function()
					local Position = (i - 2) * 3
					HatchEgg(Egg, Result[i], Position)
				end)()
			end
		else
			HatchEgg(Egg, Result[1], 0)
		end

		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end

--// Pet Follow
-- Credits to azypro777 for helping out with this part!
local Spacing, PetSize, MaxClimbHeight = 5, 3, 6

local RayParams = RaycastParams.new()
local RayDirection = Vector3.new(0, -500, 0)

local TempPets = Instance.new("Folder")
TempPets.Name = "PlayerPets"
TempPets.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function RearrangeTables(Pets, Rows, MaxRowCapacity)
	table.clear(Rows)
	local AmountOfRows = math.ceil(#Pets / MaxRowCapacity)
	for i = 1, AmountOfRows do
		table.insert(Rows, {})
	end
	for i, v in Pets do
		local Row = Rows[math.ceil(i / MaxRowCapacity)]
		table.insert(Row, v)
	end
end

local function GetRowWidth(Row, Pet)
	if Pet ~= nil then
		local MainPart = Pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")

		if not MainPart then print("A pet equipped does not have a part called 'MainPart'") return end

		Pet.PrimaryPart = MainPart

		local SpacingBetweenPets = Spacing - MainPart.Size.X
		local RowWidth = 0

		if #Row == 1 then
			return 0
		end

		for i, v in Row do
			if i ~= #Row then
				RowWidth += MainPart.Size.X + SpacingBetweenPets
			else
				RowWidth += MainPart.Size.X
			end
		end

		return RowWidth
	end
end

local EnemyAggroRange = 28
local EnemyAttackRange = 6
local PetAttackCooldown = 0.5
local petAttackTimers = {}

local petFeedbackRemote = Remotes:FindFirstChild("PetInteractionFeedback")

function PetMovement()
	if not PlayerData.ShowOtherPets.Value then
		for _, PetFolder in workspace.PlayerPets:GetChildren() do
			if PetFolder.Name == Player.Name then continue end 
			PetFolder.Parent = TempPets
		end
	else
		for _,v in TempPets:GetChildren() do
			v.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets
		end
	end

	for _, PlayerPets in workspace.PlayerPets:GetChildren() do
		local Character = Players[PlayerPets.Name].Character or Players[PlayerPets.Name].CharacterAdded:Wait()
		local HumanoidRootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

		local Pets, Rows = {}, {}		
		for _,Pet in PlayerPets:GetChildren() do
			table.insert(Pets, Pet)
		end

		RayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.PlayerPets, Character}
		local MaxRowCapacity = math.ceil(math.sqrt(#Pets))
		RearrangeTables(Pets, Rows, MaxRowCapacity)

		local enemiesFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("PetEnemies")

		for i, Pet in Pets do
			local state = Pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or "Follow"
			local petMain = Pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
			if not petMain or not petMain:IsA("BasePart") then continue end
			if state == "Stop" or Pet:GetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled") == false or state == "Sleep" or state == "Sit" then
				if state == "Sleep" then
					Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(Pet:GetPivot() * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-12), 0, 0), 0.1))
				end
				continue
			end
			if state == "Jump" then
				local jumpOffset = math.abs(math.sin(os.clock() * 5)) * 2
				local jumpTarget = Pet:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, jumpOffset, 0)
				Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(jumpTarget, 0.35))
				continue
			end
			if state == "Fly" then
				local flyTarget = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(4, 4 + math.sin(os.clock() * 2) * 0.7, 4)
				Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(flyTarget, 0.12))
				continue
			end

			local petPos = petMain.Position
			local closestEnemy, closestDist
			if enemiesFolder then
				for _, enemy in enemiesFolder:GetChildren() do
					if not enemy:IsA("Model") then continue end
					local enemyMain = enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
					local enemyHealth = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0
					if not enemyMain or enemyHealth <= 0 then continue end
					local dist = (petPos - enemyMain.Position).Magnitude
					if dist <= EnemyAggroRange and (not closestDist or dist < closestDist) then
					closestEnemy = enemy
						closestDist = dist
					end
				end
			end

			if closestEnemy and closestDist then
				local enemyMain = closestEnemy.PrimaryPart or closestEnemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
				if enemyMain then
					local direction = (enemyMain.Position - petPos)
					direction = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
					local distToEnemy = direction.Magnitude
					local targetPos
					if distToEnemy > EnemyAttackRange then
						local moveDist = math.min(distToEnemy - EnemyAttackRange + 2, distToEnemy)
						targetPos = petPos + direction.Unit * moveDist
					else
						targetPos = petPos
					end

					local RayResult = workspace:Blockcast(petMain.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, MaxClimbHeight, 0), petMain.Size, RayDirection, RayParams)
					local targetY = 0
					if RayResult then
						targetY = RayResult.Position.Y + petMain.Size.Y/2
					end

					local lookCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(targetPos.X, petPos.Y, targetPos.Z), Vector3.new(enemyMain.Position.X, petPos.Y, enemyMain.Position.Z))
					local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos.X, targetY, targetPos.Z) * lookCFrame.Rotation
					Pet:PivotTo(Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(targetCFrame, 0.15))

					if distToEnemy <= EnemyAttackRange then
						local petId = Pet.Name
						local now = os.clock()
						if not petAttackTimers[petId] or now - petAttackTimers[petId] >= PetAttackCooldown then
							petAttackTimers[petId] = now
							if petFeedbackRemote then
								petFeedbackRemote:FireServer(petId, "Attack")
							end
							Utilities.Audio.PlayAudio("Click")
						end
					end
					continue
				end
			end

			local RowIndex = math.ceil(i / MaxRowCapacity)
			local Row = Rows[RowIndex]
			local RowWidth = GetRowWidth(Row, Pet)

			local XOffset = #Row == 1 and 0 or RowWidth/2 - Pet.PrimaryPart.Size.X/2
			local X = (table.find(Row, Pet) - 1) * Spacing
			local Z = RowIndex * Spacing
			local Y = 0

			local RayResult = workspace:Blockcast(Pet.PrimaryPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, MaxClimbHeight, 0), Pet.PrimaryPart.Size, RayDirection, RayParams)

			if RayResult then
				Y = RayResult.Position.Y + Pet.PrimaryPart.Size.Y/2
			end

			local TargetCFrame = CFrame.new(HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.X, 0, HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Z) * HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Rotation * CFrame.new(X - XOffset, Y, Z)
			local LerpedCFrame = Pet:GetPivot():Lerp(TargetCFrame, 0.1)
			Pet:PivotTo(LerpedCFrame)
		end

		if petFeedbackRemote and PlayerPets.Name == Player.Name then
			local firstPet = Pets[1]
			if firstPet then
				local main = firstPet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
				if main then
					petFeedbackRemote:FireServer(firstPet.Name, "PositionUpdate", main.Position)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

	local function CalcReward(Reward)
		local R = v.Reward

		if R.Exponential.Value then
			return R.DefaultReward.Value + R.IncreasePer.Value ^ Reward
		else
			return R.DefaultReward.Value + R.IncreasePer.Value * Reward
		end
	end

	local function CalcCost()
		local C = v.Price

		if C.Exponential.Value then
			return C.DefaultPrice.Value * C.IncreasePer.Value ^ PlayerData["GemUpgrade"..i].Value
		else
			return C.DefaultPrice.Value + C.IncreasePer.Value * (PlayerData["GemUpgrade"..i].Value+1)

		local CurrentLevel = PlayerData["GemUpgrade"..i].Value

			NewUpgrade.Description.Text = O..Utilities.Short.en(CalcReward(CurrentLevel)).." > "..O..Utilities.Short.en(CalcReward(CurrentLevel+1))
			NewUpgrade.Buy.Amount.Text = Utilities.Short.en(CalcCost())
		else
			NewUpgrade.Description.Text = O..Utilities.Short.en(CalcReward(CurrentLevel)).." > Max"
			NewUpgrade.Buy.Amount.Text = "Max"
		end
	end

	Update()
	PlayerData["GemUpgrade"..i].Changed:Connect(Update)

--// Admin Dashboard — Server Entry Point
-- Creates remotes, gates every call behind admin check + permissions + cooldown,
-- logs all actions, and dispatches to the Actions module.

--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Modules
local Config = require(script.Config)
local Actions = require(script.Actions)
local Logs = require(script.Logs)
local AdminFunctions = require(script.Parent.AdminHandler.AdminFunctions)

--// Remotes
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local RemoteFolder = Remotes:FindFirstChild("AdminDashboard")
if not RemoteFolder then
	RemoteFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	RemoteFolder.Name = "AdminDashboard"
	RemoteFolder.Parent = Remotes
end

local function CreateRemote(Name, ClassName)
	local Existing = RemoteFolder:FindFirstChild(Name)
	if Existing then return Existing end
	local NewRemote = Instance.new(ClassName)
	NewRemote.Name = Name
	NewRemote.Parent = RemoteFolder
	return NewRemote
end

local AdminCheck = CreateRemote("AdminCheck", "RemoteFunction")
local AdminRemote = CreateRemote("AdminRemote", "RemoteFunction")
local AdminNotify = CreateRemote("AdminNotify", "RemoteEvent")

--// Role resolution
local function GetRole(Player)
	-- Check explicit UserId list first
	local ExplicitRole = Config.ADMINS[Player.UserId]
	if ExplicitRole then return ExplicitRole end

	-- Check group rank
	local IsGroupGame = game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.Group
	if IsGroupGame then
		local Rank = Player:GetRankInGroup(game.CreatorId)
		if Rank >= Config.GROUP_RANK_MIN then
			return "Admin"
		end
	end

	-- Check if creator
	if game.CreatorId == Player.UserId then
		return "Owner"
	end

	return nil
end

local function HasPermission(Role, Permission)
	if not Role then return false end
	local RoleDef = Config.ROLES[Role]
	if not RoleDef then return false end
	for _, Perm in RoleDef.permissions do
		if Perm == "*" or Perm == Permission then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

--// Rate limiting
local Cooldowns = {}

local function CanUse(Player)
	local Now = os.clock()
	if Now - (Cooldowns[Player.UserId] or 0) < Config.COOLDOWN then return false end
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = Now
	return true
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = nil
end)

--// Admin check (used by client to verify access)
AdminCheck.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	local Role = GetRole(Player)
	return Role ~= nil
end

--// Dispatch
AdminRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Action, ...)
	local Args = { ... }

	-- Auth
	local Role = GetRole(Player)
	if not Role then
		return "Not an admin"
	end

	-- Rate limit (skip for read-only queries)
	local ReadActions = {
		getPlayers = true, getPlayerData = true, getPets = true,
		getEggs = true, getSettings = true, getAreas = true,
		getGemShop = true, getEconomyStats = true, getCodes = true,
		getServerInfo = true, getServerStats = true, getLogs = true,
	}
	if not ReadActions[Action] and not CanUse(Player) then
		return "Slow down"
	end

	if type(Action) ~= "string" then return "Invalid action" end

	-- Announce (handled here for direct remote access)
	if Action == "announce" then
		if not HasPermission(Role, "server_announce") then return "No permission" end
		local Message = tostring(...)
		if Message == "" then return "No message" end
		AdminNotify:FireAllClients("announce", Message)
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, "announce", "all", Message)
		return "Announced"
	end

	-- Get admin role from remote args
	if Action == "getAdminRole" then
		return Role
	end

	-- Permission check per action
	local ActionPerms = {
		getPlayers = "players_view", getPlayerData = "players_view",
		setCurrency = "players_edit", giveCurrency = "players_edit",
		setGems = "players_edit", giveGems = "players_edit",
		setRebirths = "players_edit", setZone = "players_edit",
		setGemUpgrade = "players_edit", toggleGamepass = "players_edit",
		kick = "players_kick",
		getPets = "pets_view", givePet = "pets_give",
		deleteAllPets = "pets_delete", deletePet = "pets_delete",
		setPetSetting = "pets_edit",
		getEggs = "eggs_view", setEggCost = "eggs_edit", setEggPetChance = "eggs_edit",
		getSettings = "settings_view", setSetting = "settings_edit",
		getAreas = "settings_view", setAreaCost = "settings_edit",
		getGemShop = "settings_view",
		getEconomyStats = "economy_view", giveAllCurrency = "economy_edit", giveAllGems = "economy_edit",
		clearListings = "economy_edit",
		getCodes = "codes_view",
		getServerInfo = "logs_view", getServerStats = "logs_view",
		getLogs = "logs_view", clearLogs = "logs_view",
		shutdown = "server_shutdown",
	}
	local RequiredPerm = ActionPerms[Action]
	if RequiredPerm and not HasPermission(Role, RequiredPerm) then
		return "No permission"
	end

	-- Execute
	local Success, Result, Message = pcall(Actions.Handle, Action, ...)
	if not Success then
		warn("[AdminDashboard] Action '" .. Action .. "' errored: " .. tostring(Result))
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, Action, "", "ERROR: " .. tostring(Result))
		return false, "Server error"
	end

	-- Log non-read actions
	if not ReadActions[Action] then
		Logs.Add(Player.Name, Action, tostring(Args[1] or ""), tostring(Message or Result))
	end

	return Result, Message
end

local selectedPetId

	local folder = data:FindFirstChild("Accessories")
	local value = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	return value and value:IsA("BoolValue") and value.Value
end

local function redrawAccessories()
	for _, child in list:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") then child:Destroy() end
	end
	for name, info in pairs(accessoryData) do
		local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
		button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 54)
		button.AutoButtonColor = true
		button.BorderSizePixel = 0
		button.BackgroundColor3 = owned(name) and Color3.fromRGB(48, 95, 78) or Color3.fromRGB(55, 60, 70)
		button.Text = (owned(name) and "EQUIP  " or "LOCKED  ") .. info.DisplayName .. "\n" .. info.Rarity .. " • " .. info.Source
		button.TextColor3 = owned(name) and Color3.fromRGB(235, 255, 240) or Color3.fromRGB(165, 175, 190)
		button.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
		button.TextSize = 14
		button.TextWrapped = true
		button.Parent = list
		corner(button, 8)
		button.Activated:Connect(function()
			if owned(name) and selectedPetId then
				accessoryAction:FireServer("Equip", {PetId = selectedPetId, Accessory = name})
				selectedText.Text = "Equipped " .. info.DisplayName .. " on pet " .. selectedPetId
			end
		end)
	end
	task.defer(function() list.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y) end)
end

local function refreshSelectedPet()
	local newest
	for _, pet in pets:GetChildren() do
		if pet:IsA("Folder") then newest = pet end
	end
	if newest then
		selectedPetId = newest.Name
		selectedText.Text = "Selected pet: " .. tostring(newest.PetName.Value)
		accessoryPanel.Visible = true
	end
end

local currentState
local function updateEvent(state)
	currentState = state
	if type(state) ~= "table" or not state.Active then
		banner.Visible = false
		return
	end
	banner.Visible = true
	eventTitle.Text = state.Name or "WORLD EVENT"
	description.Text = state.Description or ""
	local progress = tonumber(state.ObjectiveProgress) or 0
	local target = math.max(1, tonumber(state.ObjectiveTarget) or 1)
	objective.Text = string.format("%s  %d / %d", state.ObjectiveText or "Shared objective", progress, target)
	participation.Text = state.ObjectiveCompleted and "Objective complete! Rewards will be granted when the event ends." or "Contribute to earn the completion reward."
	participation.TextColor3 = state.ObjectiveCompleted and Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 110) or Color3.fromRGB(145, 220, 175)
	fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(progress / target, 0, 1), 1)
end

stateChanged.OnClientEvent:Connect(updateEvent)
for _, name in {"Active", "Description", "EndsAt", "ObjectiveText", "ObjectiveProgress", "ObjectiveTarget", "ObjectiveCompleted"} do
	worldEvents:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name):Connect(function()
		local state = currentState or {}
		state.Active = worldEvents:GetAttribute("Active")
		state.Name = worldEvents:GetAttribute("Name")
		state.Description = worldEvents:GetAttribute("Description")
		state.EndsAt = worldEvents:GetAttribute("EndsAt")
		state.ObjectiveText = worldEvents:GetAttribute("ObjectiveText")
		state.ObjectiveProgress = worldEvents:GetAttribute("ObjectiveProgress")
		state.ObjectiveTarget = worldEvents:GetAttribute("ObjectiveTarget")
		state.ObjectiveCompleted = worldEvents:GetAttribute("ObjectiveCompleted") == true
		updateEvent(state)
	end)
end

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(1) do
		if currentState and currentState.Active then
			local remaining = math.max(0, (tonumber(currentState.EndsAt) or 0) - os.time())
			countdown.Text = string.format("%02d:%02d", math.floor(remaining / 60), remaining % 60)
			if remaining <= 0 then banner.Visible = false end
		end
	end
end)

pets.ChildAdded:Connect(refreshSelectedPet)

	if child.Name == "Accessories" then
		for _, value in child:GetChildren() do value.Changed:Connect(redrawAccessories) end
		redrawAccessories()
	end
end)
local accessories = data:FindFirstChild("Accessories")
if accessories then
	for _, value in accessories:GetChildren() do value.Changed:Connect(redrawAccessories) end
end
refreshSelectedPet()
redrawAccessories()

--!strict

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- SQUEEZE STUDIO
-- Roblox AI WebSync Plugin
-- Version: 6.0.0
--
-- MUST BE A REAL ROBLOX STUDIO PLUGIN SCRIPT.
--
-- Features:
--  • Toolbar button
--  • DockWidget
--  • Automatic connection
--  • HTTP permission test
--  • Script Injection / ScriptEditorService test
--  • Studio project information
--  • Script count
--  • Pending changes
--  • Sync All
--  • Script create/update/delete
--  • Instance create/update/delete
--  • Property changes
--  • ACK
--  • Verification
--  • Automatic reconnect
--  • Permission diagnostics
--
-- IMPORTANT:
-- Roblox permissions cannot be enabled programmatically.
-- The plugin can only trigger the required operation and
-- report that Studio is asking for permission.
----------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------
-- SERVICES
------------------------------------------------------------

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local ScriptEditorService = game:GetService("ScriptEditorService")
local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")

------------------------------------------------------------
-- CONFIG
------------------------------------------------------------

	PLUGIN_NAME = "Squeeze",
	VERSION = "6.0.0",

	-- CHANGE THIS
	BACKEND_URL = "https://squeezeai.vercel.app/api/studio",

	-- Optional local bridge.

	LOCAL_BRIDGE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:32145",

	HEALTH_ENDPOINT = "/health",
	AUTO_CONNECT_ENDPOINT = "/auto-connect",
	HEARTBEAT_ENDPOINT = "/heartbeat",
	PULL_ENDPOINT = "/files/pull",

}

------------------------------------------------------------

	status: string,

	lastHeartbeat: number,
	lastSync: number,

	pendingChanges: number,

	httpBackend: boolean,
	httpLocalBridge: boolean,
	scriptEditorRead: boolean,
	scriptEditorWrite: boolean,
	instanceWrite: boolean,
	changeHistory: boolean,
}

------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------
-- HTTP REQUEST
------------------------------------------------------------

local function request(
	baseURL: string,
	method: string,
	endpoint: string,
	body: any?
): (boolean, any?)
	local url =
		baseURL
		.. endpoint

	local headers = {
		["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
		["X-Squeeze-Plugin"] = CONFIG.VERSION,
	}

	if session.token ~= "" then
		headers["Authorization"] =
			"Bearer " .. session.token
	end

	local encodedBody: string? = nil

	if body ~= nil then
		local encodeOK, encoded =
			pcall(function()
				return HttpService:JSONEncode(body)
			end)

		if not encodeOK then
			return false, {
				code = "JSON_ENCODE_FAILED",
				message = tostring(encoded),
			}
		end

		encodedBody = encoded
	end

	local requestOK, response =
		pcall(function()
			return HttpService:RequestAsync({
				Url = url,
				Method = method,
				Headers = headers,
				Body = encodedBody,
			})
		end)

	if not requestOK then
		return false, {
			code = "REQUEST_FAILED",
			message = tostring(response),
		}
	end

	if response.StatusCode == 401 then
		return false, {
			code = "UNAUTHORIZED",
			message = "HTTP 401 Unauthorized.",
		}
	end

	if response.StatusCode == 403 then
		return false, {
			code = "FORBIDDEN",
			message = "HTTP 403 Forbidden.",
		}
	end

	if not response.Success then
		return false, {
			code =
				"HTTP_"
				.. tostring(response.StatusCode),
			message =
				tostring(response.Body),
		}
	end

	if response.Body == nil
		or response.Body == ""
	then
		return true, {}
	end

	local decodeOK, decoded =
		pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(
				response.Body
			)
		end)

	if not decodeOK then
		return false, {
			code = "INVALID_JSON",
			message =
				"Backend returned non-JSON data.",
		}
	end

	return true, decoded
end

local function autoConnect(): boolean
	if destroyed or busy then
		return false
	end

	busy = true

	setStatus(
		"Connecting...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	addLog(
		"Starting automatic Studio connection...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
			"POST",
			CONFIG.AUTO_CONNECT_ENDPOINT,
			{
				placeId =
				game.PlaceId,

				universeId =
				game.GameId,

				placeName =
				game.Name,

				pluginVersion =
				CONFIG.VERSION,
			}
		)

	if not ok then
		setStatus(
			"Backend Connection Error",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			"Auto-connect failed: "
				.. tostring(
					data
					and data.message
					or "Unknown"
				),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		busy = false
		return false
	end

	if not data
		or data.success ~= true
	then
		setStatus(
			"Auto-connect Rejected",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			"Backend rejected this Studio session.",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		busy = false
		return false
	end

	session.token =
		tostring(
			data.token
			or ""
		)

	session.sessionId =
		tostring(
			data.sessionId
			or ""
		)

	session.projectId =
		tostring(
			data.projectId
			or ""
		)

	session.projectName =
		tostring(
			data.projectName
			or game.Name
		)

	session.pendingChanges =
		typeof(data.pendingChangesCount)
		== "number"
		and data.pendingChangesCount
		or 0

	session.connected = true
	session.lastHeartbeat = os.clock()

	setStatus(
		"Connected",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	addLog(
		"✓ Studio connected automatically.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	addLog(
		"Project: "
			.. session.projectName,
		COLORS.TEXT
	)

	addLog(
		"Place ID: "
			.. tostring(game.PlaceId),
		COLORS.MUTED
	)

	updateUI()

	busy = false

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- HEARTBEAT
------------------------------------------------------------

local function startHeartbeat()
	if heartbeatRunning then
		return
	end

	heartbeatRunning = true

	task.spawn(function()
		while not destroyed
			and session.token ~= ""
		do
			task.wait(
				CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL
			)

			if destroyed then
				break
			end

			local ok, data =
				request(
					CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
					"POST",
					CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_ENDPOINT,
					{
						placeId =
						game.PlaceId,

						universeId =
						game.GameId,

						placeName =
						game.Name,

						pluginVersion =
						CONFIG.VERSION,
					}
				)

			if ok then
				session.connected = true
				session.lastHeartbeat = os.clock()

				if data
					and typeof(
						data.pendingChangesCount
					) == "number"
				then
					session.pendingChanges =
						data.pendingChangesCount
				end

				setStatus(
					"Connected",
					COLORS.GREEN
				)

				updateUI()
			elseif data
				and data.code == "UNAUTHORIZED"
			then
				session.token = ""
				session.connected = false

				setStatus(
					"Session Expired",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				addLog(
					"Session expired. Reconnecting...",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				break
			else
				session.connected = false

				setStatus(
					"Offline",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				addLog(
					"Heartbeat failed.",
					COLORS.RED
				)
			end
		end

		heartbeatRunning = false
	end)
end

local function startReconnectLoop()
	if reconnectRunning then
		return
	end

	reconnectRunning = true

	task.spawn(function()
		while not destroyed do
			task.wait(
				CONFIG.RECONNECT_INTERVAL
			)

			if destroyed then
				break
			end

			if not session.connected then
				local success =
					autoConnect()

				if success then
					startHeartbeat()
				end
			end
		end

		reconnectRunning = false
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PATH RESOLUTION
------------------------------------------------------------

local function cleanScriptName(
	name: string
): string
	return name
		:gsub("%.server%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.client%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.plugin%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.lua$", "")
end

local function resolvePath(
	path: string
): Instance?
	local normalized =
		path:gsub("^/", "")

	local parts =
		string.split(
			normalized,
			"/"
		)

	local current: Instance = game

	for index, part in ipairs(parts) do
		if index == 1
			and part == "game"
		then
			continue
		end

		local name =
			cleanScriptName(part)

		local child =
			current:FindFirstChild(name)

		if not child then
			return nil
		end

		current = child
	end

	return current
end

local function resolveParent(
	path: string
): (Instance?, string)
	local normalized =
		path:gsub("^/", "")

	local parts =
		string.split(
			normalized,
			"/"
		)

	if #parts == 0 then
		return nil, ""
	end

	local name =
		cleanScriptName(
			parts[#parts]
		)

	local current: Instance = game

	for index = 1, #parts - 1 do
		local part = parts[index]

		if index == 1
			and part == "game"
		then
			continue
		end

		local child =
			current:FindFirstChild(
				cleanScriptName(part)
			)

		if not child then
			return nil, name
		end

		current = child
	end

	return current, name
end

	if not ok then

	end

	return true, nil
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- APPLY SCRIPT
------------------------------------------------------------

local function applyScriptChange(
	change: Change
): (boolean, string?)
	local path =
		tostring(
			change.path
			or ""
		)

	local action =
		string.lower(
			tostring(
				change.operation
				or change.action
				or "update"
			)
		)

	local className =
		tostring(
			change.className
			or "Script"
		)

	local source =
		tostring(
			change.source
			or ""
		)

	local parent, name =
		resolveParent(path)

	if not parent then
		return false,
			"Parent not found: "
			.. path
	end

	local existing =
		parent:FindFirstChild(name)

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- DELETE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if action == "delete"
		or action == "deletefile"
	then
		if existing then
			existing:Destroy()
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- CLASS
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if className ~= "Script"
		and className ~= "LocalScript"
		and className ~= "ModuleScript"
	then
		return false,
			"Unsupported class: "
			.. className
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- CREATE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	local target:
		LuaSourceContainer

	if existing then
		if not existing:IsA(
			"LuaSourceContainer"
			) then
			return false,
				"Existing object is not a script."
		end

		if existing.ClassName
			~= className
		then
			return false,
				"Class mismatch."
		end

		target =
			existing :: LuaSourceContainer
	else
		local created =
			Instance.new(
				className
			)

		created.Name = name
		created.Parent = parent

		target =
			created :: LuaSourceContainer
	end

	ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint(
		"Squeeze Before Script Update"
	)

	local ok, err =
		writeScriptSource(
			target,
			source
		)

	if not ok then
		return false, err
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- VERIFY
	--------------------------------------------------------

	local readOK, actual =
		readScriptSource(target)

	if not readOK then
		return false,
			"Unable to read back script."
	end

	if actual ~= source then
		return false,
			"Script verification failed."
	end

	ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint(
		"Squeeze Script Updated"
	)

	return true, nil
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- INSTANCE OPERATION
------------------------------------------------------------

local function applyInstanceChange(
	change: Change
): (boolean, string?)
	if not permissions.instanceWrite then
		return false,
			"Studio Instance write permission is unavailable."
	end

	local operation =
		string.lower(
			tostring(
				change.operation
				or change.action
				or ""
			)
		)

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- CREATE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "createinstance" then
		local className =
			tostring(
				change.className
				or "Folder"
			)

		local name =
			tostring(
				change.name
				or ""
			)

		local parentPath =
			tostring(
				change.parentPath
				or "Workspace"
			)

		local parent =
			resolvePath(
				parentPath
			)

		if not parent then
			return false,
				"Parent not found: "
				.. parentPath
		end

		if name == "" then
			return false,
				"Instance name is required."
		end

		if parent:FindFirstChild(name) then
			return false,
				"Instance already exists: "
				.. parentPath
				.. "/"
				.. name
		end

		local ok, result =
			pcall(function()
				local instance =
				Instance.new(
					className
				)

				instance.Name =
				name

				if change.properties then
					for property, value in
						pairs(change.properties)
					do
						(instance :: any)[property] =
						value
					end
				end

				if change.attributes then
					for attribute, value in
						pairs(change.attributes)
					do
						instance:SetAttribute(
							attribute,
							value
						)
					end
				end

				instance.Parent =
				parent

				return instance
			end)

		if not ok then
			return false,
				tostring(result)
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- DELETE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "deleteinstance" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return true, nil
		end

		target:Destroy()

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- RENAME
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "renameinstance" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local newName =
			tostring(
				change.newName
				or change.name
				or ""
			)

		if newName == "" then
			return false,
				"New name is required."
		end

		target.Name =
			newName

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- MOVE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "moveinstance" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local parentPath =
			tostring(
				change.newParentPath
				or ""
			)

		local newParent =
			resolvePath(
				parentPath
			)

		if not newParent then
			return false,
				"New parent not found."
		end

		target.Parent =
			newParent

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- PROPERTY
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "setproperty" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local property =
			tostring(
				change.property
				or ""
			)

		if property == "" then
			return false,
				"Property is required."
		end

		local ok, err =
			pcall(function()
				(target :: any)[property] =
				change.value
			end)

		if not ok then
			return false,
				tostring(err)
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- ATTRIBUTE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "setattribute" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local attribute =
			tostring(
				change.attribute
				or ""
			)

		if attribute == "" then
			return false,
				"Attribute is required."
		end

		target:SetAttribute(
			attribute,
			change.value
		)

		return true, nil
	end

	return false,
		"Unsupported Studio operation: "
		.. operation
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- VERIFY INSTANCE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function verifyChange(
	change: Change
): (boolean, string?)
	local operation =
		string.lower(
			tostring(
				change.operation
				or change.action
				or ""
			)
		)

	if operation == "deleteinstance"
		or operation == "delete"
	then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		if resolvePath(path) == nil then
			return true, nil
		end

		return false,
			"Object still exists."
	end

	if operation == "createinstance" then
		local parentPath =
			tostring(
				change.parentPath
				or "Workspace"
			)

		local name =
			tostring(
				change.name
				or ""
			)

		local parent =
			resolvePath(
				parentPath
			)

		if not parent then
			return false,
				"Parent missing during verification."
		end

		local target =
			parent:FindFirstChild(name)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Created instance was not found."
		end

		if change.className
			and target.ClassName
			~= change.className
		then
			return false,
				"Class verification failed."
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	local path =
		tostring(
			change.path
			or ""
		)

	local target =
		resolvePath(path)

	if not target then
		return false,
			"Target not found during verification."
	end

	return true, nil
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- ACK
------------------------------------------------------------

local function acknowledge(
	change: Change,
	success: boolean,
	errorMessage: string?
)
	local id =
		tostring(
			change.changeId
			or change.eventId
			or ""
		)

	request(
		CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
		"POST",
		CONFIG.ACK_ENDPOINT,
		{
			changeId = id,
			eventId =
				change.eventId
				or id,

			status =
				success
				and "applied"
				or "failed",

			verified =
				success,

			errorMessage =
				errorMessage,
		}
	)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- SYNC
------------------------------------------------------------

local function syncAll()
	if busy then
		return
	end

	if not session.connected
		or session.token == ""
	then
		addLog(
			"Studio is not connected. No changes were made.",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return
	end

	if not permissions.httpBackend then
		addLog(
			"Backend HTTP permission is not available.",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return
	end

	busy = true

	setStatus(
		"Syncing",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	syncButton.Text =
		"Syncing..."

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
			"GET",
			CONFIG.PULL_ENDPOINT,
			nil
		)

	if not ok then
		addLog(
			"Queue request failed: "
				.. tostring(
					data
					and data.message
					or "Unknown"
				),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		busy = false
		syncButton.Text =
			"Sync All"

		return
	end

	local changes =
		data
		and data.changes

	if typeof(changes) ~= "table" then
		changes = {}
	end

	pendingChanges =
		changes :: {Change}

	session.pendingChanges =
		#pendingChanges

	updateUI()

	if #pendingChanges == 0 then
		addLog(
			"✓ Nothing pending.",
			COLORS.GREEN
		)

		setStatus(
			"Connected",
			COLORS.GREEN
		)

		busy = false
		syncButton.Text =
			"Sync All"

		return
	end

	local total =
		#pendingChanges

	local applied = 0
	local failed = 0

	addLog(
		"Found "
			.. tostring(total)
			.. " pending change(s).",
		COLORS.TEXT
	)

	for index, change in ipairs(
		pendingChanges
		) do
		local operation =
			string.lower(
				tostring(
					change.operation
					or change.action
					or ""
				)
			)

		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or change.name
				or change.changeId
				or "Unknown"
			)

		addLog(
			string.format(
				"[%d/%d] %s",
				index,
				total,
				path
			),
			COLORS.MUTED
		)

		local success = false
		local errorMessage: string?

		if operation == "createinstance"
			or operation == "deleteinstance"
			or operation == "renameinstance"
			or operation == "moveinstance"
			or operation == "setproperty"
			or operation == "setattribute"
		then
			success, errorMessage =
				applyInstanceChange(
					change
				)
		else
			success, errorMessage =
				applyScriptChange(
					change
				)
		end

		if success then
			local verified,
				verifyError =
				verifyChange(
					change
				)

			if not verified then
				success = false
				errorMessage =
					verifyError
			end
		end

		acknowledge(
			change,
			success,
			errorMessage
		)

		if success then
			applied += 1

			addLog(
				"✓ Applied + verified: "
					.. path,
				COLORS.GREEN
			)
		else
			failed += 1

			addLog(
				"✗ Failed: "
					.. path
					.. " | "
					.. tostring(
						errorMessage
					),
				COLORS.RED
			)
		end
	end

	session.pendingChanges =
		math.max(
			0,
			total - applied
		)

	session.lastSync =
		os.clock()

	if failed == 0 then
		setStatus(
			"Connected",
			COLORS.GREEN
		)

		addLog(
			string.format(
				"✓ Sync completed: %d/%d verified.",
				applied,
				total
			),
			COLORS.GREEN
		)
	else
		setStatus(
			"Sync Error",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			string.format(
				"⚠ %d/%d applied. %d failed.",
				applied,
				total,
				failed
			),
			COLORS.YELLOW
		)
	end

	updateUI()

	syncButton.Text =
		"Sync All"

	busy = false
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- BUTTONS
------------------------------------------------------------

toolbarButton.Click:Connect(function()
	widget.Enabled =
		not widget.Enabled
end)

permissionsButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	task.spawn(function()
		checkAllPermissions()
	end)
end)

syncButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	task.spawn(function()
		syncAll()
	end)
end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- STARTUP
------------------------------------------------------------

addLog(
	"Squeeze Studio Plugin initialized.",
	COLORS.TEXT
)

addLog(
	"Running permission diagnostics...",
	COLORS.BLUE
)

updateUI()

task.spawn(function()
	task.wait(0.5)

	checkAllPermissions()

	if permissions.httpBackend then
		local connected =
			autoConnect()

		if connected then
			startHeartbeat()
		end
	end
end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- AUTO RECONNECT
------------------------------------------------------------

startReconnectLoop()

------------------------------------------------------------
-- UNLOAD
------------------------------------------------------------

plugin.Unloading:Connect(function()
	destroyed = true

	if session.token ~= "" then
		pcall(function()
			request(
				CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
				"POST",
				CONFIG.DISCONNECT_ENDPOINT,
				{
					reason = "Plugin unloaded",
				}
			)
		end)
	end

	session.token = ""
	session.connected = false
end)

print(
	"[Squeeze Studio] v"
		.. CONFIG.VERSION
		.. " loaded."
)

--!strict
-- ToastStack.lua
-- Manages a stack of toast notifications with smooth animations

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local ToastStack = {}
ToastStack.__index = ToastStack

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
	maxVisible = 3,
	animationDuration = 0.3,
	swipeToDismiss = true,
	position = "top-right",
	toastWidth = 350,
	toastHeight = 70,
	padding = 8,
}

function ToastStack.new(config)
	local self = setmetatable({}, ToastStack)
	self.config = setmetatable(config or {}, {__index = DEFAULT_CONFIG})
	self.toasts = {}
	self.container = nil
	self:_createContainer()
	return self
end

function ToastStack:_createContainer()
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "ToastStack"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.DisplayOrder = 200
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.Parent = playerGui

	local container = Instance.new("Frame")
	container.Name = "Container"
	container.Size = UDim2.new(0, self.config.toastWidth, 1, -20)
	container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
	container.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -10)
	container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	container.Parent = gui

	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, self.config.padding)
	layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
	layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
	layout.Parent = container

	self.container = container
	self.gui = gui
end

function ToastStack:Push(data)
	data.id = data.id or game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false)
	data.autoDismiss = data.autoDismiss or 8
	data.timestamp = os.time()

	-- Remove oldest if at capacity
	if #self.toasts >= self.config.maxVisible then
		self:Pop()
	end

	local toast = self:_createToast(data)
	toast.Parent = self.container
	table.insert(self.toasts, 1, {id = data.id, frame = toast, data = data})

	if data.autoDismiss then
		task.delay(data.autoDismiss, function()
			self:Dismiss(data.id)
		end)
	end

	return data.id
end

function ToastStack:_createToast(data)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "Toast_" .. data.id
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, self.config.toastHeight)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 26, 38)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.ClipsDescendants = true

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	corner.Parent = frame

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
	stroke.Thickness = 1.5
	stroke.Transparency = 0.4
	stroke.Parent = frame

	-- Icon
	local icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36)
	icon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 17)
	icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	icon.Image = data.icon or ""
	icon.Parent = frame

	-- Title
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 24)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 8)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = data.title
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 14
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 245, 255)
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Parent = frame

	-- Body
	local body = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 18)
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 32)
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Text = data.body
	body.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	body.TextSize = 12
	body.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 195, 220)
	body.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	body.TextWrapped = true
	body.Parent = frame

	-- Progress bar
	if data.autoDismiss then
		local progress = Instance.new("Frame")
		progress.Name = "Progress"
		progress.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3)
		progress.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
		progress.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		progress.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 140, 220)
		progress.BorderSizePixel = 0
		progress.Parent = frame

		local progressTween = game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(progress, TweenInfo.new(data.autoDismiss, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
		})
		progressTween:Play()
	end

	-- Close button
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 4)
	closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	closeBtn.Text = "✕"
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeBtn.TextSize = 12
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 165, 190)
	closeBtn.Parent = frame

	closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		self:Dismiss(data.id)
	end)

	-- Swipe to dismiss
	if self.config.swipeToDismiss then
		local startX = 0
		frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				startX = input.Position.X
			end
		end)

		frame.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				local deltaX = input.Position.X - startX
				if deltaX > 80 then
					self:Dismiss(data.id)
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	-- Entrance animation
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(1, 400, 0, 0)
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(self.config.animationDuration, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	}):Play()

	return frame
end

function ToastStack:Dismiss(id)
	for i, toast in ipairs(self.toasts) do
		if toast.id == id then
			local frame = toast.frame
			game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
				Position = UDim2.new(1, 400, 0, 0),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1
			}):Play()
			task.wait(0.2)
			frame:Destroy()
			table.remove(self.toasts, i)
			break
		end
	end
end

function ToastStack:Pop()
	if #self.toasts > 0 then
		self:Dismiss(self.toasts[#self.toasts].id)
	end
end

function ToastStack:Clear()
	for _, toast in self.toasts do
		toast.frame:Destroy()
	end
	self.toasts = {}
end

function ToastStack:Destroy()
	self:Clear()
	self.gui:Destroy()
end

return ToastStack

local DS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Main = {}

local Cache = Instance.new("Folder")
Cache.Name = "Cache"
Cache.Parent = game.ServerStorage

local UserIds = Instance.new("Folder")
UserIds.Name = "UserIds"
UserIds.Parent = Cache

local Names = Instance.new("Folder")
Names.Name = "Names"
Names.Parent = Cache

local Modules = RS.Modules
local Short = require(Modules.Utilities).Short

local DataSave = RS["Game Settings"].DataSave.Value

function Main.GetNameFromUserId(Id)
	local Cached = Cache.UserIds:FindFirstChild(tostring(Id))

	if Cached then
		return tostring(Cached.Value)
	else
		local new
		pcall(function()
			new = game:GetService("Players"):GetNameFromUserIdAsync(Id)
		end)
		if new then
			local x = Instance.new("StringValue")
			x.Name = tostring(Id)
			x.Value = tostring(new)
			x.Parent = Cache.UserIds

			if not Cache.Names:FindFirstChild(tostring(new)) then
				local y = Instance.new("IntValue")
				y.Name = tostring(new)
				y.Value = tonumber(Id)
				y.Parent = Cache.Names
			end

			return tostring(new)
		end
	end

	return nil
end

local function EncodeNumber(Number)
	Number += 1
	Number = math.log10(Number)
	Number *= 270000000000
	Number = math.round(Number)
	return Number
end

local function DecodeNumber(Number)
	Number /= 270000000000
	Number = 10 ^ Number
	Number -= 1
	Number = math.round(Number)
	return Number
end

function Main.UploadLeaderboardStats(Player, Info)
	if Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value then
		local Stat = Player.Data[Info.Folder][Info.Stat].Value
		Stat = EncodeNumber(Stat)
		local Datastore = DS:GetOrderedDataStore(Info.Datastore..DataSave)
		Datastore:SetAsync(Player.UserId, Stat)
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
end

function Main.UpdateLeaderboard(Leaderboard, Info)
	local Leaderboard = workspace.Map.Leaderboards[Leaderboard]

	local Datastore = DS:GetOrderedDataStore(Info.Datastore..DataSave)
	local GetData = Datastore:GetSortedAsync(false, 100)
	local GetCurrent = GetData:GetCurrentPage()

	task.wait()

	local Sort = Leaderboard.SurfaceGui.MainFrame.Players.Scroll

	for Rank,Data in GetCurrent do
		local LBInstance = Sort:FindFirstChild(tostring(Rank))
		LBInstance.Visible = true
		LBInstance.Rank.Text = "#"..Rank
		local Username = Main.GetNameFromUserId(Data.key)
		if Username == nil then Username = "Failed to load" end
		LBInstance.PlrName.Text = Username 
		LBInstance.PlayerIcon.Image = game.Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(Data.key, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size420x420)
		local Amount = Data.value
		Amount = Short.en(DecodeNumber(Amount))
		LBInstance.Amount.Text = Amount
	end	
end

function Main.Setup(Module)
	for _,Leaderboard in workspace.Map.Leaderboards:GetChildren() do
		if not Module[Leaderboard.Name] then continue end -- lb doesnt exist anymore

--// Pets Handler
-- View all pets, give/remove pets, edit pet settings.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PetsHandler = {}

local PetsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Pets")

function PetsHandler.AllPets()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Pet in PetsFolder:GetChildren() do
		local Settings = Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings")
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			name = Pet.Name,
			rarity = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Rarity")) and Settings.Rarity.Value or "?",
			multiplier = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Multiplier")) and Settings.Multiplier.Value or 1,
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end)
	return Result
end

function PetsHandler.PetInfo(PetName)
	local Pet = PetsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not Pet then return nil end
	local Settings = Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings")
	return {
		name = Pet.Name,
		rarity = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Rarity")) and Settings.Rarity.Value or "?",
		multiplier = (Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild("Multiplier")) and Settings.Multiplier.Value or 1,
	}
end

function PetsHandler.SetPetSetting(PetName, SettingName, NewValue)
	local Pet = PetsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not Pet then return false, "Pet not found" end
	local Settings = Pet:FindFirstChild("Settings")
	local Value = Settings and Settings:FindFirstChild(tostring(SettingName))
	if not Value then return false, "Pet setting not found" end
	if Value:IsA("IntValue") or Value:IsA("NumberValue") then
		local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
		if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid number" end
		Value.Value = Num
	elseif Value:IsA("StringValue") then
		Value.Value = tostring(NewValue)
	elseif Value:IsA("BoolValue") then
		Value.Value = (NewValue == true or NewValue == "true")
	else
		return false, "Unsupported value type"
	end
	return true, "Set " .. PetName .. "." .. SettingName .. " = " .. tostring(NewValue)
end

function PetsHandler.GrantPet(Player, PetName)
	local PetModel = PetsFolder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetName))
	if not PetModel then return false, "Pet not found in ReplicatedStorage" end

	local PetTemplate = ReplicatedStorage.Assets:FindFirstChild("PetTemplate")
	if not PetTemplate then return false, "PetTemplate not found" end

	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Id
	repeat
		Id = tostring(math.random(1, 999999999))
	until not Folder:FindFirstChild(Id)

	local NewPet = PetTemplate:Clone()
	NewPet.Name = Id
	NewPet.PetName.Value = tostring(PetName)
	NewPet.Equipped.Value = false
	NewPet.Parent = Folder
	return true, "Gave " .. PetName .. " to " .. Player.Name
end

function PetsHandler.DeleteAllPets(Player)
	if not Player or not Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then return false, "Player not found" end
	local PetMultipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.PetMultipliers)

	local Count = 0
	for _, Pet in Player.Data.Pets:GetChildren() do
		if Pet.Equipped.Value then
			PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
		end
		Pet:Destroy()
		Count += 1
	end
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = 0

	local WorkspaceFolder = workspace.PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(Player.Name)
	if WorkspaceFolder then
		for _, Pet in WorkspaceFolder:GetChildren() do
			Pet:Destroy()
		end
	end
	return true, "Deleted " .. Count .. " pet(s) from " .. Player.Name
end

function PetsHandler.DeleteSpecificPet(Player, PetId)
	if not Player or not Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then return false, "Player not found" end
	local Pet = Player.Data.Pets:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetId))
	if not Pet then return false, "Pet not found" end
	local PetMultipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.PetMultipliers)

	if Pet.Equipped.Value then
		PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
		Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = math.max(Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value - 1, 0)
	end
	local PetName = Pet.PetName.Value
	Pet:Destroy()
	return true, "Deleted pet " .. PetName
end

return PetsHandler

--// Economy Handler
-- Economy-wide statistics and bulk currency operations.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local EconomyHandler = {}

function EconomyHandler.GetStats()
	local TotalCurrency = 0
	local TotalGems = 0
	local TotalRebirths = 0
	local TotalEggs = 0
	local TotalPets = 0
	local PlayerCount = 0
	local TopCurrency = nil
	local TopGems = nil
	local TopRebirths = nil

	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local Data = Player:FindFirstChild("Data")
		if Data then
			local PD = Data.PlayerData
			local C = PD.Currency.Value
			local G = PD.Currency2.Value
			local R = PD.Rebirth.Value
			local E = PD.EggsHatched.Value
			local P = #Data.Pets:GetChildren()

			TotalCurrency += C
			TotalGems += G
			TotalRebirths += R
			TotalEggs += E
			TotalPets += P
			PlayerCount += 1

			if not TopCurrency or C > TopCurrency.value then
				TopCurrency = { name = Player.Name, value = C }
			end
			if not TopGems or G > TopGems.value then
				TopGems = { name = Player.Name, value = G }
			end
			if not TopRebirths or R > TopRebirths.value then
				TopRebirths = { name = Player.Name, value = R }
			end
		end
	end

	return {
		totalCurrency = TotalCurrency,
		totalGems = TotalGems,
		totalRebirths = TotalRebirths,
		totalEggsHatched = TotalEggs,
		totalPets = TotalPets,
		playerCount = PlayerCount,
		avgCurrency = PlayerCount > 0 and math.round(TotalCurrency / PlayerCount) or 0,
		avgGems = PlayerCount > 0 and math.round(TotalGems / PlayerCount) or 0,
		topCurrency = TopCurrency,
		topGems = TopGems,
		topRebirths = TopRebirths,
	}
end

function EconomyHandler.GiveAllCurrency(Amount)
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	local Count = 0
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += Num
			Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += Num
			Count += 1
		end
	end
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " currency to " .. Count .. " players"
end

function EconomyHandler.GiveAllGems(Amount)
	local Num = tonumber(Amount)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid amount" end
	local Count = 0
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if Player:FindFirstChild("Data") then
			Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Num
			Count += 1
		end
	end
	return true, "Gave " .. Num .. " gems to " .. Count .. " players"
end

return EconomyHandler

--// Services
local MarketPlaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables

local GamepassFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses

function GetGamepassFromID(ID)
	for _, Gamepass in GamepassFolder:GetChildren() do
		if Gamepass.Value == ID then
			return Gamepass
		end
	end
	return nil
end

MarketPlaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(Player, Gamepass, Succes)
	if not Succes then return end

	local GamepassType = GetGamepassFromID(Gamepass)
	if GamepassType == nil then return end -- Gamepass does not exist in the game!	

	local GP = Player.Data.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild(GamepassType.Name)
	if not GP then warn("Gamepass: "..GamepassType.Name.." does not exist in Player.Data.Gamepasses! Edit Datastore.Datastore.Values to add it!") return end

	GP.Value = true
end)

local function GetPet(SelectedEgg)
	local TotalWeight = 0
	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		TotalWeight += v.Value
	end

	local Chance = Random.new():NextNumber(0.0001,TotalWeight)
	local Counter = 0

	for _,v in SelectedEgg:GetChildren() do
		Counter += v.Value
		if Counter >= Chance then
			return v.Name
		end
	end
end

local function GetRobuxEgg(Player, Egg)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]
	local ChosenPet = GetPet(EggInfo.Pets)
	if ChosenPet ~= nil then
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = true
		coroutine.wrap(function()
			task.wait(3)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = false
		end)()
		ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Egg:InvokeClient(Player, Egg, ChosenPet, 0)
		return ChosenPet
	end
end

function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end


MarketPlaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(ReceiptInfo)
	local Player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(ReceiptInfo.PlayerId)

	for _, EggInfo in ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:GetChildren() do
		if not EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then continue end

		if tonumber(EggInfo.ProductId.Value) == ReceiptInfo.ProductId then
			local PetChosen = GetRobuxEgg(Player, EggInfo.Name)	-- this selects a random pet from the egg

			--// Create Pet
			local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
			NewPet.PetName.Value = PetChosen
			NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets

			return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
		end
	end	
end

--// Services
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

--// Modules
local Config = require(script.Config)
local Mail = require(script.Mail)
local Pets = require(script.Pets)
local Shards = require(script.Shards)

--// State
local Cooldowns = {} -- [userId] = last action time

--// Remotes
local RemoteFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes:FindFirstChild("AuctionHouse")
if not RemoteFolder then
	RemoteFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	RemoteFolder.Name = "AuctionHouse"
	RemoteFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes
end

local function CreateRemote(Name, ClassName)
	local Existing = RemoteFolder:FindFirstChild(Name)
	if Existing then return Existing end

	local NewRemote = Instance.new(ClassName)
	NewRemote.Name = Name
	NewRemote.Parent = RemoteFolder
	return NewRemote
end

local ListPetRemote = CreateRemote("ListPet", "RemoteFunction")
local CancelRemote = CreateRemote("CancelListing", "RemoteFunction")
local BuyRemote = CreateRemote("BuyPet", "RemoteFunction")
local GetListingsRemote = CreateRemote("GetListings", "RemoteFunction")
local GetMyListingsRemote = CreateRemote("GetMyListings", "RemoteFunction")
local GetMailRemote = CreateRemote("GetMail", "RemoteFunction")
local ClaimMailRemote = CreateRemote("ClaimMail", "RemoteFunction")
local AuctionNotice = CreateRemote("AuctionNotice", "RemoteEvent")

--// Pet Return
local function ReturnListing(Listing)
	local Owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Listing.owner)

	if Owner and Owner:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Owner.Loaded.Value then
		if Pets.Grant(Owner, Listing.petName) then
			AuctionNotice:FireClient(Owner, "petReturned", Listing.petName)
			return
		end
	end

	Mail.Update(Listing.owner, function(MailData)
		MailData.pets[Listing.petId] = { petName = Listing.petName }
		return MailData
	end)

	if Owner then
		AuctionNotice:FireClient(Owner, "petReturned", Listing.petName)
	end
end

--// Rate Limiting
local function CheckCooldown(Player)
	local Last = Cooldowns[Player.UserId] or 0
	local Now = os.clock()
	if Now - Last < Config.COOLDOWN then return false end
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = Now
	return true
end

--// Expiry Sweep
local function SweepExpired()
	local Now = os.time()
	local AnyRemoved = false

	for i = 1, Config.SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Expired = {}

		local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
			for Id, Listing in Old do
				if Listing.expiresAt <= Now and not Expired[Id] then
					Expired[Id] = Listing
				end
			end
			for Id in Expired do Old[Id] = nil end
			return Old
		end)

		if Success then
			for Id, Listing in Expired do
				Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
				ReturnListing(Listing)
				AnyRemoved = true
			end
		end
	end

	if AnyRemoved then
		AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")
	end
end

--// Remote Handlers
ListPetRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, PetId, Price)
	if type(PetId) ~= "number" or type(Price) ~= "number" then return "Invalid input" end
	if not Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player.Loaded.Value then return "Not loaded" end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return "In a trade" end
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	Price = math.floor(Price)
	if Price < 1 or Price > Config.MAX_PRICE then return "Invalid price" end

	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Pet = Folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(PetId))
	if not Pet then return "Pet not found" end
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then return "Unequip the pet first" end

	local Active = 0
	for _, Listing in Shards.GetAll() do
		if Listing.owner == Player.UserId then Active += 1 end
	end
	if Active >= Config.MAX_ACTIVE_LISTINGS then return "Max active listings" end

	local Listing = {
		id = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
		owner = Player.UserId,
		ownerName = Player.Name,
		petId = PetId,
		petName = Pet.PetName.Value,
		price = Price,
		listedAt = os.time(),
		expiresAt = os.time() + Config.LISTING_DURATION,
	}

	local Key = Shards.GetOwnerShard(Player.UserId)
	local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
		Old[Listing.id] = Listing
		return Old
	end)

	if not Success then return "Try again" end

	Pet:Destroy()
	Shards.AddToCache(Listing, Key)
	AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")
	return Listing.id
end

CancelRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, ListingId)
	if type(ListingId) ~= "string" then return "Invalid input" end
	if not Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player.Loaded.Value then return "Not loaded" end
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	local Listing = Shards.GetListing(ListingId)
	if not Listing then return "Not found" end
	if Listing.owner ~= Player.UserId then return "Not your listing" end

	local Key = Shards.GetShardOf(ListingId)
	local Removed = false

	local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
		if Old[ListingId] and not Removed then
			Old[ListingId] = nil
			Removed = true
		end
		return Old
	end)

	if not Success then return "Try again" end
	if not Removed then return "Already gone" end

	Shards.RemoveFromCache(ListingId)

	AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")

	if Pets.Grant(Player, Listing.petName) then
		return "Returned"
	else
		local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
		MailData.pets[Listing.petId] = { petName = Listing.petName }
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
		return "Mailed"
	end
end

BuyRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, ListingId)
	if type(ListingId) ~= "string" then return "Invalid input" end
	if not Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not Player.Loaded.Value then return "Not loaded" end
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsTrading.Value then return "In a trade" end
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	local Listing = Shards.GetListing(ListingId)
	if not Listing then return "Not available" end
	if Listing.owner == Player.UserId then return "You own this listing" end

	if #Player.Data.Pets:GetChildren() >= Pets.GetMaxStorage(Player) then return "Inventory full" end
	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value < Listing.price then return "Not enough gems" end

	local Key = Shards.GetShardOf(ListingId)
	local Purchased = nil

	local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
		local Target = Old[ListingId]
		if not Target then return Old end
		if Target.owner == Player.UserId then return Old end
		Old[ListingId] = nil
		if Purchased == nil then Purchased = Target end
		return Old
	end)

	if not Success then return "Try again" end
	if not Purchased then return "Sold already" end

	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value < Purchased.price then
		ReturnListing(Purchased)
		return "Not enough gems"
	end

	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value -= Purchased.price

	if not Pets.Grant(Player, Purchased.petName) then
		local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
		MailData.pets[Purchased.id] = { petName = Purchased.petName }
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
	end

	Shards.RemoveFromCache(ListingId)

	AuctionNotice:FireAllClients("listingsChanged")

	local Seller = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Purchased.owner)
	if Seller and Seller:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Seller.Loaded.Value then
		Seller.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += Purchased.price
		AuctionNotice:FireClient(Seller, "sold", Purchased.price)
	else
		Mail.Update(Purchased.owner, function(MailData)
			MailData.gems = (MailData.gems or 0) + Purchased.price
			return MailData
		end)
	end

	return "Purchased"
end

GetListingsRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Page)
	Page = (type(Page) == "number" and math.max(1, math.floor(Page))) or 1
	local Now = os.time()
	local List = {}

	for _, Listing in Shards.GetAll() do
		if Listing.expiresAt > Now then
			List[#List + 1] = Listing
		end
	end

	table.sort(List, function(A, B)
		return A.expiresAt < B.expiresAt
	end)

	local Start = (Page - 1) * Config.PAGE_SIZE + 1
	local Result = {}
	for i = Start, math.min(Start + Config.PAGE_SIZE - 1, #List) do
		local L = List[i]
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			id = L.id,
			ownerId = L.owner,
			ownerName = L.ownerName,
			petName = L.petName,
			price = L.price,
			timeLeft = L.expiresAt - Now,
		}
	end

	return { listings = Result, total = #List }
end

GetMyListingsRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	local Now = os.time()
	local List = {}

	for _, Listing in Shards.GetAll() do
		if Listing.owner == Player.UserId then
			List[#List + 1] = {
				id = Listing.id,
				petName = Listing.petName,
				price = Listing.price,
				timeLeft = Listing.expiresAt - Now,
			}
		end
	end

	table.sort(List, function(A, B)
		return A.timeLeft < B.timeLeft
	end)

	return List
end

GetMailRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
	local PetsList = {}

	for Id, PetInfo in MailData.pets do
		PetsList[#PetsList + 1] = { id = Id, petName = PetInfo.petName }
	end

	return { gems = MailData.gems, pets = PetsList }
end

ClaimMailRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(Player)
	if not CheckCooldown(Player) then return "Slow down" end

	local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)
	local GemsToGive = MailData.gems
	local PetsToReturn = {}
	for Id, PetInfo in MailData.pets do PetsToReturn[Id] = PetInfo end

	MailData.gems = 0
	MailData.pets = {}
	Mail.Save(Player.UserId)

	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += GemsToGive

	local Granted = 0
	local Failed = {}
	for Id, PetInfo in PetsToReturn do
		if Pets.Grant(Player, PetInfo.petName) then
			Granted += 1
		else
			Failed[Id] = PetInfo
		end
	end

	if next(Failed) then
		MailData.pets = Failed
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
	end

	return { gems = GemsToGive, granted = Granted, failed = 0 }
end

--// Join / Leave
local function OnPlayerJoined(Player)
	repeat task.wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil
	if Player.Parent == nil then return end

	local MailData = Mail.Get(Player.UserId)

	if MailData.gems > 0 then
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += MailData.gems
		MailData.gems = 0
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
		AuctionNotice:FireClient(Player, "sold", 0)
	end

	if next(MailData.pets) then
		local Failed = {}
		for Id, PetInfo in MailData.pets do
			if Pets.Grant(Player, PetInfo.petName) then
				-- granted
			else
				Failed[Id] = PetInfo
			end
		end
		MailData.pets = Failed
		Mail.Save(Player.UserId)
		if not next(Failed) then
			AuctionNotice:FireClient(Player, "petReturned", "pet")
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(OnPlayerJoined)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.UserId] = nil
	Mail.Flush(Player.UserId)
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Mail.Flush(Player.UserId)
	end
end)

--// Startup
Shards.RebuildCache()
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(Config.SWEEP_INTERVAL)
		Shards.RebuildCache()
		SweepExpired()
	end
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
