local WorldEvents = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("WorldEvents")
local StateChanged = WorldEvents:WaitForChild("StateChanged")
local WorldEventService = require(game:GetService("ServerScriptService"):WaitForChild("WorldEventService"))

local DEFAULT_EVENT_DURATION = 180
local DEFAULT_INTERVAL_MULTIPLIER = 0.65
local DEFAULT_SPAWN_MULTIPLIER = 1.5
local DEFAULT_REWARD_MULTIPLIER = 2
local DEFAULT_HEALTH_MULTIPLIER = 1.25

local function giveCurrency(player, amount)
	local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local playerData = data and data:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
	local currency = playerData and playerData:FindFirstChild("Currency")
	if currency then currency.Value += amount end
end

WorldEventService.SetRewardCallback(function(player, reward, exclusivePet, exclusiveEgg)
	local multiplier = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier")) or 1
	local finalReward = math.floor(reward * multiplier)
	giveCurrency(player, finalReward)
	player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventReward", finalReward)
	player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventRewardCycle", WorldEventService.GetState().Cycle)
	if exclusivePet ~= "" then player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventExclusivePet", exclusivePet) end
	if exclusiveEgg ~= "" then player:SetAttribute("LastWorldEventExclusiveEgg", exclusiveEgg) end
end)

local function normalizeDuration(value)
	return math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(value) or DEFAULT_EVENT_DURATION), 30, 900)
end

local function beginDynamicEvent()
	local events = {
		{
			Name = "Pet Rush",
			Description = "Defeat enemy pets together before time runs out.",
			ObjectiveType = "DefeatEnemies",
			ObjectiveText = "Defeat 25 enemy pets as a community.",
			ObjectiveTarget = 25,
			ObjectiveReward = 250,
			ExclusivePet = "Event Rush Pet",
			SpawnMultiplier = DEFAULT_SPAWN_MULTIPLIER,
			SpawnIntervalMultiplier = DEFAULT_INTERVAL_MULTIPLIER,
			RewardMultiplier = DEFAULT_REWARD_MULTIPLIER,
			HealthMultiplier = DEFAULT_HEALTH_MULTIPLIER,
		},
		{
			Name = "Golden Paws",
			Description = "Scavenge together to fill the golden paw meter.",
			ObjectiveType = "Scavenge",
			ObjectiveText = "Scavenge 40 times as a community.",
			ObjectiveTarget = 40,
			ObjectiveReward = 350,
			ExclusiveEgg = "Golden Paws Egg",
			SpawnMultiplier = 1.2,
			SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 0.85,
			RewardMultiplier = 3,
			HealthMultiplier = 1,
		},
		{
			Name = "Wild Companions",
			Description = "Collectables and enemy encounters are boosted.",
			ObjectiveType = "Collect",
			ObjectiveText = "Collect 50 world items as a community.",
			ObjectiveTarget = 50,
			ObjectiveReward = 500,
			ExclusivePet = "Wild Companion",
			SpawnMultiplier = 2,
			SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 0.5,
			RewardMultiplier = 1.75,
			HealthMultiplier = 1.5,
		},
	}
	local selected = events[math.random(1, #events)]
	selected.Duration = normalizeDuration(DEFAULT_EVENT_DURATION + math.random(-45, 60))
	WorldEventService.Start(selected)
end

WorldEvents:SetAttribute("StateVersion", 3)
StateChanged.OnServerEvent:Connect(function() end)

WorldEventService.Publish()
task.delay(10, beginDynamicEvent)

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(1) do
		local state = WorldEventService.GetState()
		if state.Active and os.time() >= state.EndsAt then
			WorldEventService.End()
			task.delay(math.random(30, 60), beginDynamicEvent)
		end
	end
end)

--// ============================================================
--// Admin Dashboard Client v4 — Premium Dark UI
--// Opens with /admin chat command. Server-verified.
--// ============================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TS = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

repeat task.wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil
if Player.Parent == nil then return end

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 15)
if not Remotes then return end
local RF = Remotes:WaitForChild("AdminDashboard", 15)
if not RF then return end
local AdminCheck = RF:WaitForChild("AdminCheck", 10)
local AdminRemote = RF:WaitForChild("AdminRemote", 10)
if not AdminCheck or not AdminRemote then return end
local AdminNotify = RF:WaitForChild("AdminNotify", 10)

local OK, IsAdmin = pcall(function() return AdminCheck:InvokeServer() end)
if not OK or not IsAdmin then return end

--// ============================================================
--// Theme
--// ============================================================
local Th = {
	Bg          = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 18),
	Surface     = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 28),
	Surface2    = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 32),
	Card        = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 38),
	CardHover   = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 50),
	Input       = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 24),
	Accent      = Color3.fromRGB(108, 72, 220),
	AccentHover = Color3.fromRGB(130, 94, 240),
	AccentDim   = Color3.fromRGB(60, 38, 140),
	Green       = Color3.fromRGB(40, 190, 90),
	GreenDim    = Color3.fromRGB(24, 110, 52),
	Red         = Color3.fromRGB(220, 55, 55),
	RedHover    = Color3.fromRGB(240, 75, 75),
	RedDim      = Color3.fromRGB(140, 35, 35),
	Orange      = Color3.fromRGB(240, 170, 40),
	Yellow      = Color3.fromRGB(235, 210, 60),
	Text        = Color3.fromRGB(225, 225, 235),
	Sub         = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 165),
	Muted       = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 100),
	Border      = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 48),
	BorderLight = Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 60),
	Online      = Color3.fromRGB(40, 200, 100),
	Offline     = Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 110),
}

--// ============================================================
--// Helpers
--// ============================================================
local function Inst(Class: string, Props: {[string]: any}, Parent: Instance?): Instance
	local I = Instance.new(Class)
	for K, V in pairs(Props) do I[K] = V end
	if Parent then I.Parent = Parent end
	return I
end

local function RC(F, R) Inst("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R or 6)}, F) end
local function RS(F, Col) Inst("UIStroke", {Color = Col or Th.Border, Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.3}, F) end
local function RP(F, T, B, L, R)
	Inst("UIPadding", {
		PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, T or 4),
		PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, B or 4),
		PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, L or 6),
		PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, R or 6),
	}, F)
end

local function Lbl(P, Text, Col, Sz, Pos)
	local L = Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Col or Th.Text, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = Sz or UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 16),
		Position = Pos or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
	}, P)
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 14}, L)
	return L
end

local function Btn(P, Text, Fn, Col, Sz, Pos)
	local BC = Col or Th.Accent
	local B = Inst("TextButton", {
		Text = Text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text, BackgroundColor3 = BC,
		AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = Sz or UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 28),
		Position = Pos or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
	}, P)
	RC(B, 6)
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 12}, B)
	B.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = BC:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.15)}):Play()
	end)
	B.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = BC}):Play()
	end)
	if Fn then B.MouseButton1Click:Connect(Fn) end
	return B
end

local function Txt(P: Instance, Ph: string?, Sz: UDim2?, Pos: UDim2?): TextBox
	local B = Inst("TextBox", {
		PlaceholderText = Ph or "", Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text, PlaceholderColor3 = Th.Muted,
		BackgroundColor3 = Th.Input, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ClearTextOnFocus = false,
		Size = Sz or UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0, 28),
		Position = Pos or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
	}, P) :: TextBox
	RC(B, 6)
	RP(B, 2, 2, 8, 8)
	RS(B)
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 12}, B)
	return B
end

local function Scr(P, Sz, Pos)
	local S = Inst("ScrollingFrame", {
		Size = Sz or UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		Position = Pos or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ScrollBarThickness = 2,
		ScrollBarImageColor3 = Th.AccentDim,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
	}, P)
	Inst("UIListLayout", {SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)}, S)
	RP(S, 4, 4, 4, 4)
	return S
end

local function Card(P, H, Ord)
	local F = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, H or 36),
		BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		LayoutOrder = Ord or 0,
	}, P)
	RC(F, 6)
	RS(F, Th.Border)
	return F
end

local function StatCard(P, Title, Value, Ord)
	local F = Card(P, 46, Ord)
	RP(F, 6, 6, 10, 10)
	Lbl(F, Title, Th.Sub, UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, 11), UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.06))
	Lbl(F, tostring(Value), Th.Text, UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, 16), UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.44))
	return F
end

local function ARow(P, Title, Ph, Btns, Ord)
	local F = Card(P, 40, Ord)
	RP(F, 4, 4, 8, 8)
	Lbl(F, Title, Th.Text, UDim2.new(0.28, 0, 0, 13), UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.1))
	local Box = Txt(F, Ph, UDim2.new(0.26, 0, 0, 28), UDim2.fromScale(0.32, 0.08))
	local N = #Btns
	local Gap = 4
	local BW = (0.34 * F.AbsoluteSize.X - Gap * (N - 1)) / N
	BW = math.max(BW / F.AbsoluteSize.X, 0.08)
	local X = 0.62
	for _, S in Btns do
		local LS = S
		Btn(F, LS.text, function() LS.click(Box) end, LS.color, UDim2.new(BW, -2, 0, 28), UDim2.new(X, 0, 0.06, 0))
		X += BW + Gap / F.AbsoluteSize.X
	end
	return F, Box
end

local function DangerRow(P, Title, Fn, Ord)
	local F = Card(P, 36, Ord)
	RP(F, 4, 4, 8, 8)
	Btn(F, Title, function() Fn(F) end, Th.Red, UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 0, 26), UDim2.new(0.32, 0, 0.08, 0))
	return F
end

local function SectionHdr(P, Text, Ord)
	Lbl(P, Text, Th.Accent, UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 20), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)).LayoutOrder = Ord or 0
end

local function EmptyState(P, Icon, Title, Desc)
	local Holder = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		LayoutOrder = 0,
	}, P)
	Inst("UIListLayout", {
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
		VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
		Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
	}, Holder)
	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Icon, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 30,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Th.Muted,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36), LayoutOrder = 1,
	}, Holder)
	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Title, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 14,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Th.Sub,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), LayoutOrder = 2,
	}, Holder)
	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Desc, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 11,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Th.Muted,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.75, 0, 0, 16), LayoutOrder = 3,
		TextWrapped = true,
	}, Holder)
	return Holder
end

--// ============================================================
--// Toast
--// ============================================================
local ToastId = 0
local function Toast(Msg, Type)
	ToastId += 1
	local MyId = ToastId
	local Col = Type == "error" and Th.Red or Type == "warning" and Th.Orange or Th.Green
	local Icon = Type == "error" and "✕  " or Type == "warning" and "⚠  " or "✓  "

	local T = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 38),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, -0.08, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Th.Surface,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ZIndex = 600,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	}, SG)
	RC(T, 8)
	RS(T, Col)

	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Icon .. tostring(Msg), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = Col, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.new(0.04, 0, 0.15, 0),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		ZIndex = 601,
	}, T)

	TS:Create(T, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.04, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0}):Play()
	task.delay(3, function()
		if ToastId == MyId then
			TS:Create(T, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, -0.08, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
			task.delay(0.3, function() T:Destroy() end)
		end
	end)
end

--// ============================================================
--// Confirm Modal
--// ============================================================
local function Confirm(Title, Msg, BtnText, Callback)
	local Overlay = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
		ZIndex = 500,
	}, SG)

	local Modal = Inst("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 340, 0, 190),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ZIndex = 501,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	}, Overlay)
	RC(Modal, 12)
	RS(Modal, Th.BorderLight)

	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Title, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 16,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 24), Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 502,
	}, Modal)

	Inst("TextLabel", {
		Text = Msg, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = Th.Sub, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 50), Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 46),
		TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, ZIndex = 502,
	}, Modal)

	local CancelBtn = Inst("TextButton", {
		Text = "Cancel", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text, BackgroundColor3 = Th.Border,
		AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 34), Position = UDim2.new(1, -184, 1, -54),
		ZIndex = 502,
	}, Modal)
	RC(CancelBtn, 6)

	local ConfirmBtn = Inst("TextButton", {
		Text = BtnText or "Confirm", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = Th.Text, BackgroundColor3 = Th.Red,
		AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 34), Position = UDim2.new(1, -96, 1, -54),
		ZIndex = 502,
	}, Modal)
	RC(ConfirmBtn, 6)

	local function Close()
		TS:Create(Modal, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
		TS:Create(Overlay, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
		task.delay(0.2, function() Overlay:Destroy() end)
	end

	CancelBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(Close)
	ConfirmBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Callback()
		Close()
	end)

	TS:Create(Modal, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart), {BackgroundTransparency = 0}):Play()
end

--// ============================================================
--// Remote wrappers
--// ============================================================
local function Req(Action, ...)
	local A = table.pack(...)
	local OK, R, M = pcall(function() return AdminRemote:InvokeServer(Action, table.unpack(A)) end)
	if not OK then Toast("Error: " .. tostring(R), "error") return nil end
	if type(R) == "string" then Toast(M or R, R:find("Error") and "error" or "success")
	elseif type(R) == "boolean" and M then Toast(M, R and "success" or "error") end
	return R
end

local function ReqS(Action, ...)
	local A = table.pack(...)
	local OK, R = pcall(function() return AdminRemote:InvokeServer(Action, table.unpack(A)) end)
	return OK and R or nil
end

--// ============================================================
--// Main Window
--// ============================================================
local SG = Inst("ScreenGui", {
	Name = "AdminDashboard", ResetOnSpawn = false,
	ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
	DisplayOrder = 100, IgnoreGuiInset = true,
}, Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))

local WIN_W, WIN_H = 840, 540
local SideW = 144

local Main = Inst("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.new(0, WIN_W, 0, WIN_H),
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
	Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
	BackgroundColor3 = Th.Bg,
	BorderSizePixel = 0,
	Visible = false,
}, SG)
RC(Main, 12)
RS(Main, Th.Border)

-- Title bar
local TitleH = 38
local TitleBar = Inst("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, TitleH),
	BackgroundColor3 = Th.Surface,
	BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, Main)
RC(TitleBar, 12)

Inst("TextLabel", {
	Text = "⚡ Admin Panel", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 15,
	TextColor3 = Th.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, 18), Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 0),
	TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
	ZIndex = 2,
}, TitleBar)

Inst("TextLabel", {
	Text = "v4.0", Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 11,
	TextColor3 = Th.Muted, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 2),
	ZIndex = 2,
}, TitleBar)

local CloseBtn = Inst("TextButton", {
	Text = "✕", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 14,
	TextColor3 = Th.Sub, BackgroundColor3 = Th.RedDim,
	AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 26), Position = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 6),
	ZIndex = 2,
}, TitleBar)
RC(CloseBtn, 6)
CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Main.Visible = false end)
CloseBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() TS:Create(CloseBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Th.Red}):Play() end)
CloseBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() TS:Create(CloseBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Th.RedDim}):Play() end)

-- Sidebar
local Sidebar = Inst("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.new(0, SideW, 1, -TitleH),
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, TitleH),
	BackgroundColor3 = Th.Surface,
	BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, Main)

local TabBar = Inst("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
}, Sidebar)
Inst("UIListLayout", {
	SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
	Padding = UDim.new(0, 2),
	HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
}, TabBar)
RP(TabBar, 6, 6, 6, 6)

-- Content
local Content = Inst("Frame", {
	Size = UDim2.new(1, -SideW - 2, 1, -TitleH - 2),
	Position = UDim2.new(0, SideW + 2, 0, TitleH + 2),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1,
}, Main)

--// ============================================================
--// Tab System
--// ============================================================
local Tabs = {}
local TabSide = {}
local TabRefresh = {}
local CurTab = "Players"
local TabBtns = {}

local function ShowTab(Name)
	CurTab = Name
	for N, F in pairs(Tabs) do F.Visible = (N == Name) end
	for N, F in pairs(TabSide) do F.Visible = (N == Name) end
	for N, B in pairs(TabBtns) do
		if N == Name then
			B.BackgroundColor3 = Th.Accent
			B.TextColor3 = Th.Text
		else
			B.BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card
			B.TextColor3 = Th.Sub
		end
	end
	if TabRefresh[Name] then pcall(TabRefresh[Name]) end
end

local TabOrder = 0
local function AddTab(Name, Ord)
	TabOrder += 1
	local OrdVal = Ord or TabOrder

	local B = Inst("TextButton", {
		Text = Name, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextScaled = true,
		TextColor3 = Th.Sub, BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card,
		AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, 30),
		LayoutOrder = OrdVal,
	}, TabBar)
	RC(B, 6)
	Inst("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 11}, B)
	B.Name = Name
	TabBtns[Name] = B

	B.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		if CurTab ~= Name then
			TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {BackgroundColor3 = Th.CardHover}):Play()
		end
	end)
	B.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		if CurTab ~= Name then
			TS:Create(B, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {BackgroundColor3 = Th.Card}):Play()
		end
	end)
	B.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() ShowTab(Name) end)

	local S = Scr(Content, UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0))
	S.Visible = false
	Tabs[Name] = S
	return S
end

--// Clear helper
local function Clear(P: Instance?)
	if not P then return end
	for _, Child in P:GetChildren() do
		if not Child:IsA("UIListLayout") and not Child:IsA("UIPadding") and not Child:IsA("UICorner") and not Child:IsA("UIStroke") then
			Child:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

	for _, I in ipairs(List) do

		{text = "Set", click = function(B) Req("setZone", SelName, B.Text) RefreshPR() end, color = Th.Accent},

		local TS2 = pcall(os.date, "%H:%M:%S", L.timestamp) and os.date("%H:%M:%S", L.timestamp) or "?"

		Lbl(R, L.target, Th.Sub, UDim2.new(0.48, 0, 0, 11), UDim2.fromScale(0.52, 0.08))
		Ord += 1
	end
	DangerRow(LogsS, "Clear Logs", function() Req("clearLogs") RefreshLogs() end, 999)
end

if AdminNotify then

				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 91,

end

--!strict

--[[
    Lemonade-Style Roblox Studio WebSync Plugin
    --------------------------------------------
    Features:
    • Adds a button to the Plugins toolbar
    • Opens a dockable "Connect" window
    • Connect / Disconnect
    • Connection indicator
    • Project status
    • Prompt count
    • WebSync last sync
    • Backend pairing request
    • Basic heartbeat
    • Logs toggle

--------------------------------------------------

-- PROJECT

--------------------------------------------------
-- SYNC
--------------------------------------------------

statusLabel.TextSize = 13
statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
statusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
statusLabel.Parent = infoPanel

--------------------------------------------------
-- BOTTOM CONTROLS
--------------------------------------------------

logsButton.Text = "Logs Off"
logsButton.TextColor3 = COLORS.SUBTEXT
logsButton.TextSize = 12
logsButton.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
logsButton.Parent = bottom

local logsCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
logsCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
logsCorner.Parent = logsButton

--------------------------------------------------
-- HELPERS
--------------------------------------------------

local function log(...)
	if not logsEnabled then
		return
	end

	print("[Lemonade WebSync]", ...)
end

local function setStatus(
	text: string,
	color: Color3,
	dotColor: Color3
)
	statusLabel.Text = "Status: " .. text
	statusLabel.TextColor3 = color

	statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = dotColor
end

local function setConnectedState(state: boolean)
	connected = state

	if state then
		connectButton.Text = "Disconnect"
		statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.GREEN

		setStatus(
			"Connected",
			COLORS.GREEN,
			COLORS.GREEN
		)
	else
		connectButton.Text = "Connect"
		statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.RED

		setStatus(
			"Offline",
			COLORS.RED,
			COLORS.RED
		)
	end
end

local function updateLastSync()
	lastSyncText = os.date("%X")

	syncLabel.Text = "Web sync: " .. lastSyncText
end

local function getProjectName(): string
	local gameName = game:GetAttribute("GameName")

	if typeof(gameName) == "string" and gameName ~= "" then
		return gameName
	end

	return game.Name
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- HTTP HELPER
--------------------------------------------------

local function request(
	method: string,
	path: string,
	body: any?
): (boolean, any?)

	local url = CONFIG.BACKEND_URL .. path

	local requestData = {
		Url = url,
		Method = method,
		Headers = {
			["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
		},
	}

	if sessionToken then
		requestData.Headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " .. sessionToken
	end

	if body ~= nil then
		requestData.Body = HttpService:JSONEncode(body)
	end

	local success, response = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:RequestAsync(requestData)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("[Lemonade WebSync] HTTP error:", response)
		return false, nil
	end

	if not response.Success then
		warn(
			"[Lemonade WebSync] HTTP status:",
			response.StatusCode,
			response.StatusMessage
		)

		return false, response
	end

	local decoded = nil

	if response.Body and response.Body ~= "" then
		local decodeSuccess, result = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(response.Body)
		end)

		if decodeSuccess then
			decoded = result
		end
	end

	return true, decoded
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- CONNECT
--------------------------------------------------

local function connectToBackend()

	if connecting then
		return
	end

	if connected then
		return
	end

	connecting = true

	connectButton.Text = "Connecting..."
	setStatus(
		"Connecting...",
		COLORS.YELLOW,
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	log("Connecting to backend...")

	local success, response = request(
		"POST",
		CONFIG.CONNECT_ENDPOINT,
		{
			projectName = getProjectName(),
			placeId = game.PlaceId,
			universeId = game.GameId,
			pluginVersion = "2.3",
			studioName = "Roblox Studio",
		}
	)

	if success and response then

		sessionToken = response.token
		projectId = response.projectId

		if typeof(response.prompts) == "number" then
			promptCount = response.prompts
			promptsLabel.Text = "Prompts: " .. tostring(promptCount)
		end

		setConnectedState(true)
		updateLastSync()

		projectLabel.Text =
			"Project: " ..
			(response.projectName or "ok")

		log("Connected successfully.")
	else

		setConnectedState(false)

		connectButton.Text = "Connect"

		warn(
			"[Lemonade WebSync] Failed to connect."
		)
	end

	connecting = false
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- DISCONNECT
--------------------------------------------------

local function disconnectFromBackend()

	if not connected then
		return
	end

	log("Disconnecting...")

	request(
		"POST",
		CONFIG.DISCONNECT_ENDPOINT,
		{
			projectId = projectId,
		}
	)

	sessionToken = nil
	projectId = nil

	setConnectedState(false)

	log("Disconnected.")
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- HEARTBEAT
--------------------------------------------------

task.spawn(function()

	while true do

		task.wait(CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL)

		if connected and sessionToken then

			local success = request(
				"POST",
				CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_ENDPOINT,
				{
					projectId = projectId,
					projectName = getProjectName(),
					placeId = game.PlaceId,
				}
			)

			if success then
				updateLastSync()
			else
				warn(
					"[Lemonade WebSync] Heartbeat failed."
				)
			end
		end
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- PLUGIN BUTTON
--------------------------------------------------

toolbarButton.Click:Connect(function()

	widget.Enabled = not widget.Enabled

	if widget.Enabled then
		log("Widget opened.")
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- CLOSE BUTTON
--------------------------------------------------

closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	widget.Enabled = false
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- CONNECT BUTTON
--------------------------------------------------

connectButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	if connected then
		disconnectFromBackend()
	else
		connectToBackend()
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- LOG TOGGLE
--------------------------------------------------

logsButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	logsEnabled = not logsEnabled

	if logsEnabled then
		logsButton.Text = "Logs On"
	else
		logsButton.Text = "Logs Off"
	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- INITIAL UI
--------------------------------------------------

projectLabel.Text = "Project: " .. getProjectName()
promptsLabel.Text = "Prompts: 0"
syncLabel.Text = "Web sync: Never"

setConnectedState(false)

--------------------------------------------------
-- SELECTION DEBUG
--------------------------------------------------

Selection.SelectionChanged:Connect(function()

	if not connected then
		return
	end

	local selected = Selection:Get()

	log(
		"Selection changed:",
		#selected
	)

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- STARTUP
--------------------------------------------------

print("========================================")
print("[Lemonade WebSync] Plugin Loaded")
print("Project:", getProjectName())
print("PlaceId:", game.PlaceId)
print("========================================")

local stages = {{0.2, "Connecting to world..."}, {0.45, "Loading pets and companions..."}, {0.7, "Preparing areas and events..."}, {0.9, "Applying settings..."}, {1, "Ready"}}

--// Settings Handler
-- View/edit Game Settings, Areas, Gem Shop, and related configuration.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local SettingsHandler = {}

local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Game Settings")

function SettingsHandler.AllGameSettings()
	local Result = {}
	for _, Value in GameSettings:GetChildren() do
		if Value:IsA("ValueBase") then
			Result[Value.Name] = { value = Value.Value, className = Value.ClassName }
		end
	end
	return Result
end

function SettingsHandler.SetSetting(Name, NewValue)
	local Setting = GameSettings:FindFirstChild(tostring(Name))
	if not Setting then return false, "Unknown setting" end
	if Setting:IsA("IntValue") or Setting:IsA("NumberValue") then
		local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
		if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid number" end
		Setting.Value = Num
	elseif Setting:IsA("BoolValue") then
		Setting.Value = (NewValue == true or NewValue == "true")
	elseif Setting:IsA("StringValue") then
		Setting.Value = tostring(NewValue)
	else
		return false, "Unsupported value type"
	end
	return true, "Set " .. Name .. " = " .. tostring(Setting.Value)
end

function SettingsHandler.AllAreas()
	local Areas = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Areas")
	if not Areas then return {} end
	local Result = {}
	for _, Area in Areas:GetChildren() do
		local Cost = Area:FindFirstChild("Cost")
		Result[#Result + 1] = { name = Area.Name, cost = Cost and Cost.Value or 0 }
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return tonumber(A.name) < tonumber(B.name) end)
	return Result
end

function SettingsHandler.SetAreaCost(AreaName, NewValue)
	local Areas = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Areas")
	if not Areas then return false, "No areas" end
	local Area = Areas:FindFirstChild(tostring(AreaName))
	if not Area or not Area:FindFirstChild("Cost") then return false, "Area not found" end
	local Num = tonumber(NewValue)
	if Num == nil then return false, "Invalid cost" end
	Area.Cost.Value = Num
	return true, "Set area " .. AreaName .. " cost = " .. Num
end

function SettingsHandler.AllGemShop()
	local GemShop = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GemShop")
	if not GemShop then return {} end
	local Result = {}
	for _, Upgrade in GemShop:GetChildren() do
		local Reward = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Reward")
		local Price = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Price")
		local MaxVal = Upgrade:FindFirstChild("Max")
		local UpgName = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("UpgradeName") and Reward.UpgradeName.Value or Upgrade.Name
		local DefaultReward = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("DefaultReward") and Reward.DefaultReward.Value or 0
		local IncreasePerR = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("IncreasePer") and Reward.IncreasePer.Value or 0
		local ExpR = Reward and Reward:FindFirstChild("Exponential") and Reward.Exponential.Value or false
		local DefaultPrice = Price and Price:FindFirstChild("DefaultPrice") and Price.DefaultPrice.Value or 0
		local IncreasePerP = Price and Price:FindFirstChild("IncreasePer") and Price.IncreasePer.Value or 0
		local ExpP = Price and Price:FindFirstChild("Exponential") and Price.Exponential.Value or false
		Result[#Result + 1] = {
			id = Upgrade.Name,
			name = UpgName,
			max = MaxVal and MaxVal.Value or 0,
			reward = { default = DefaultReward, increasePer = IncreasePerR, exponential = ExpR },
			price = { default = DefaultPrice, increasePer = IncreasePerP, exponential = ExpP },
		}
	end
	return Result
end

return SettingsHandler

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local PlayerPets = Workspace:WaitForChild("PlayerPets")
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local Feedback = Remotes:WaitForChild("PetInteractionFeedback")

local prompts = {}
local cooldowns = {}
local states = {}
local needs = {}
local connectedPets = {}

local Commands = {
	Stop = true, Follow = true, Sit = true, Sleep = true,
	Jump = true, Fly = true, Pet = true, Feed = true,
	Inventory = true,
}

local AURA_RADIUS = 35
local AURA_UPDATE_INTERVAL = 1
local AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER = 1
local AURA_MAX_MULTIPLIER = 1.35

local function getNeeds(pet)
	if not needs[pet] then
		needs[pet] = {
			mood = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Mood")) or 75, 0, 100),
			hunger = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Hunger")) or 75, 0, 100),
		}
	end
	return needs[pet]
end

local function send(player, action, message, pet)
	local stats = pet and getNeeds(pet)
	Feedback:FireClient(player, {
		action = action,
		message = message,
		petId = pet and pet.Name or nil,
		petName = pet and pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or nil,
		mood = stats and stats.mood or nil,
		hunger = stats and stats.hunger or nil,
		state = pet and pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or nil,
	})
end

local function effect(pet, color, burst)
	local mainPart = pet and pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	if not mainPart or not mainPart:IsA("BasePart") then return end
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 0.7
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35, 0.7)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 8)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = mainPart
	emitter:Emit(burst or 12)
	task.delay(1.2, function()
		if emitter.Parent then emitter:Destroy() end
	end)
end

local function clearPet(pet)
	local prompt = prompts[pet]
	if prompt then prompt:Destroy() end
	prompts[pet] = nil
	states[pet] = nil
	needs[pet] = nil
	connectedPets[pet] = nil
end

local function setNeeds(pet, stats)
	stats.mood = math.clamp(stats.mood, 0, 100)
	stats.hunger = math.clamp(stats.hunger, 0, 100)
	pet:SetAttribute("Mood", stats.mood)
	pet:SetAttribute("Hunger", stats.hunger)
end

local function setState(pet, state)
	states[pet] = state
	pet:SetAttribute("PetInteractionState", state)
	pet:SetAttribute("PetMovementToken", (tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("PetMovementToken")) or 0) + 1)
	if state == "Stop" then
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetJumpEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFlyEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSitEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSleepEnabled", false)
	else
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled", state == "Follow")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetJumpEnabled", state == "Jump")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFlyEnabled", state == "Fly")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSitEnabled", state == "Sit")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSleepEnabled", state == "Sleep")
	end
end

local function getOwnerId(pet)
	local ownerId = pet:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")
	return typeof(ownerId) == "number" and ownerId or nil
end

local function canInteract(player, pet)
	if not pet or not pet:IsDescendantOf(PlayerPets) then return false end
	if getOwnerId(pet) ~= player.UserId then return false end
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local mainPart = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	if not root or not mainPart or not mainPart:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
	return (root.Position - mainPart.Position).Magnitude <= 18
end

local function interact(player, pet, action)
	if not Commands[action] or not canInteract(player, pet) then
		if Commands[action] and pet then send(player, "Denied", "Move closer to your pet to interact.", pet) end
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if cooldowns[pet] and now - cooldowns[pet] < 0.45 then return end
	cooldowns[pet] = now
	local stats = getNeeds(pet)

	if action == "Stop" then
		setState(pet, "Stop")
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 130), 12)
		send(player, "Stop", "Your pet stopped and will stay in place.", pet)
	elseif action == "Pet" then
		stats.mood += 8
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 220), 16)
		send(player, "Pet", "You petted " .. tostring(pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or "your pet") .. ".", pet)
	elseif action == "Feed" then
		stats.hunger += 20
		stats.mood += 3
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 80), 14)
		send(player, "Feed", "Your pet enjoyed a snack.", pet)
	elseif action == "Stop" or action == "Follow" or action == "Sit" or action == "Sleep" or action == "Jump" or action == "Fly" then
		setState(pet, action)
		if action == "Sleep" then stats.mood += 5 end
		if action == "Jump" then stats.mood += 2 end
		local color = action == "Sleep" and Color3.fromRGB(120, 150, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255)
		effect(pet, color, action == "Fly" and 22 or 12)
		send(player, action, "Pet behavior set to " .. action .. ".", pet)
	elseif action == "Inventory" then
		send(player, "Inventory", "Pet inventory opened.", pet)
	end
	setNeeds(pet, stats)
end

local function setupPet(pet)
	if not pet:IsA("Model") then return end
	local ownerFolder = pet.Parent
	local owner = ownerFolder and Players:FindFirstChild(ownerFolder.Name)
	if not owner then return end
	local mainPart = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if not mainPart or not mainPart:IsA("BasePart") then return end

	pet:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", owner.UserId)
	local data = owner:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local petData = data and data:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	local petNameValue = petData and petData:FindFirstChild(pet.Name)
	local petName = pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or (petNameValue and petNameValue:FindFirstChild("PetName") and petNameValue.PetName.Value) or pet.Name
	pet:SetAttribute("PetName", petName)
	local initialState = pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or "Follow"
	if initialState == "Follow" or initialState == "Stop" or initialState == "Sit" or initialState == "Sleep" or initialState == "Jump" or initialState == "Fly" then
		setState(pet, states[pet] or initialState)
	else
		setState(pet, "Follow")
	end
	setNeeds(pet, getNeeds(pet))

	if prompts[pet] then return end
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.Name = "PetInteractionPrompt"
	prompt.ActionText = "Interact"
	prompt.ObjectText = petName
	prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.15
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 14
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Parent = mainPart
	prompts[pet] = prompt
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		interact(player, pet, "Pet")
	end)
end

local function watchFolder(folder)
	for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do task.defer(setupPet, pet) end
	folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(pet) task.defer(setupPet, pet) end)
	folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(clearPet)
end

for _, folder in PlayerPets:GetChildren() do watchFolder(folder) end
PlayerPets.ChildAdded:Connect(watchFolder)

Feedback.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, petId, action)
	if type(petId) ~= "string" or type(action) ~= "string" then return end
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	local pet = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(petId)
	interact(player, pet, action)
end)

local function getMoodPet(player)
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if not folder then return nil end
	local bestPet, bestMood
	for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do
		if pet:IsA("Model") then
			local main = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			if main then
				local mood = math.clamp(tonumber(getNeeds(pet).mood) or 0, 0, 100)
				if not bestMood or mood > bestMood then bestPet, bestMood = pet, mood end
			end
		end
	end
	return bestPet, bestMood
end

local function updateMoodAuras()
	local playerData = {}
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local pet, mood = getMoodPet(player)
		playerData[player] = {root = root, pet = pet, mood = mood or 0, auraSource = false}
		player:SetAttribute("MoodAuraActive", false)
		player:SetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier", AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER)
		player:SetAttribute("MoodAuraSourceUserId", nil)
	end

	for source, sourceInfo in pairs(playerData) do
		if sourceInfo.root and sourceInfo.pet and sourceInfo.mood >= 60 then
			local radius = tonumber(source:GetAttribute("MoodAuraRadius")) or AURA_RADIUS
			local multiplier = math.clamp(1 + (sourceInfo.mood / 100) * 0.35, AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER, AURA_MAX_MULTIPLIER)
			local affected = 0
			for target, targetInfo in pairs(playerData) do
				if targetInfo.root and (targetInfo.root.Position - sourceInfo.root.Position).Magnitude <= radius then
					local current = tonumber(target:GetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier")) or AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER
					if multiplier > current then
						target:SetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier", multiplier)
						target:SetAttribute("MoodAuraActive", true)
						target:SetAttribute("MoodAuraSourceUserId", source.UserId)
					end
					affected += 1
				end
			end
			if affected > 0 then sourceInfo.auraSource = true end
		end
	end
end

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(10) do
		for pet, stats in pairs(needs) do
			if pet.Parent then
				stats.hunger -= 1
				stats.mood -= stats.hunger < 20 and 2 or 1
				setNeeds(pet, stats)
				local owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(getOwnerId(pet) or 0)
				if owner then send(owner, "Needs", "", pet) end
			end
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(AURA_UPDATE_INTERVAL) do
		updateMoodAuras()
	end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if folder then
		for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do clearPet(pet) end
	end
end)

--!strict
-- EmoteWheel.lua
-- Radial emote selection wheel for quick access

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local EmoteWheel = {}
EmoteWheel.__index = EmoteWheel

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
	radius = 150,
	buttonSize = 70,
	maxButtons = 8,
	openKey = Enum.KeyCode.G,
	animationDuration = 0.25,
}

function EmoteWheel.new(config)
	local self = setmetatable({}, EmoteWheel)
	self.config = setmetatable(config or {}, {__index = DEFAULT_CONFIG})
	self.isOpen = false
	self.buttons = {}
	self.gui = nil
	self.emoteEngine = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.EmoteEngine)
	return self
end

function EmoteWheel:_createGui()
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "EmoteWheel"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.DisplayOrder = 250
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.Parent = playerGui

	local wheel = Instance.new("Frame")
	wheel.Name = "Wheel"
	wheel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.radius * 2, self.config.radius * 2)
	wheel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	wheel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	wheel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	wheel.Visible = false
	wheel.Parent = gui

	-- Center hub
	local center = Instance.new("Frame")
	center.Name = "Center"
	center.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 80)
	center.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	center.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	center.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 26, 38)
	center.BorderSizePixel = 0
	center.Parent = wheel

	local centerCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	centerCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	centerCorner.Parent = center

	local centerStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	centerStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
	centerStroke.Thickness = 2
	centerStroke.Transparency = 0.3
	centerStroke.Parent = center

	local centerLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	centerLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	centerLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	centerLabel.Text = "EMOTES"
	centerLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	centerLabel.TextSize = 12
	centerLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 175, 200)
	centerLabel.Parent = center

	self.wheel = wheel
	self.gui = gui
end

function EmoteWheel:Toggle()
	if self.isOpen then
		self:Close()
	else
		self:Open()
	end
end

function EmoteWheel:Open()
	if self.isOpen then return end
	self.isOpen = true
	self.wheel.Visible = true
	self:_updateButtons()
	
	self.wheel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(self.wheel, TweenInfo.new(self.config.animationDuration, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.radius * 2, self.config.radius * 2)
	}):Play()
	
	-- Listen for close
	self._closeConnection = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if not processed and (input.KeyCode == self.config.openKey or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then
			self:Close()
		end
	end)
end

function EmoteWheel:Close()
	if not self.isOpen then return end
	self.isOpen = false
	
	if self._closeConnection then
		self._closeConnection:Disconnect()
		self._closeConnection = nil
	end
	
	game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(self.wheel, TweenInfo.new(self.config.animationDuration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	}):Play()
	
	task.wait(self.config.animationDuration)
	self.wheel.Visible = false
end

function EmoteWheel:_updateButtons()
	-- Clear old buttons
	for _, btn in self.buttons do
		btn:Destroy()
	end
	self.buttons = {}

	local ownedEmotes = self.emoteEngine.GetOwnedEmotes(player.UserId)
	local emotesToShow = {}
	
	for _, emoteId in ipairs(ownedEmotes) do
		local emote = self.emoteEngine.GetEmote(emoteId)
		if emote then
			table.insert(emotesToShow, emote)
		end
	end
	
	if #emotesToShow == 0 then
		-- Show placeholder
		local frame = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		frame.Text = "No emotes unlocked"
		frame.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		frame.TextSize = 16
		frame.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 165, 190)
		frame.Parent = self.wheel
		return
	end

	-- Limit to max buttons
	local angleStep = (2 * math.pi) / math.min(#emotesToShow, self.config.maxButtons)
	local startAngle = -math.pi / 2

	for i, emote in ipairs(emotesToShow) do
		if i > self.config.maxButtons then break end
		
		local angle = startAngle + (i - 1) * angleStep
		local x = self.config.radius * 0.7 * math.cos(angle)
		local y = self.config.radius * 0.7 * math.sin(angle)

		local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
		btn.Name = emote.id
		btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.buttonSize, self.config.buttonSize)
		btn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.radius + x, self.config.radius + y)
		btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 34, 48)
		btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
		btn.Text = ""
		btn.Parent = self.wheel

		local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
		btnCorner.Parent = btn

		local btnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		btnStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
		btnStroke.Thickness = 1.5
		btnStroke.Transparency = 0.4
		btnStroke.Parent = btn

		local icon = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		icon.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.7)
		icon.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.15, 0.1)
		icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		icon.Text = self.emoteEngine._GetEmoteIcon(emote.id)
		icon.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		icon.TextSize = 28
		icon.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		icon.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
		icon.Parent = btn

		local name = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		name.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.3)
		name.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.7)
		name.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		name.Text = emote.name
		name.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
		name.TextSize = 10
		name.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 215, 230)
		name.TextWrapped = true
		name.Parent = btn

		-- Cooldown overlay
		local cooldownOverlay = Instance.new("Frame")
		cooldownOverlay.Name = "CooldownOverlay"
		cooldownOverlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		cooldownOverlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

		local overlayCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

		local cdText = Instance.new("TextLabel")

		cdText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		cdText.TextSize = 16
		cdText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

		btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {

			}):Play()
		end)
		btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {

			}):Play()
		end)

		btn.Activated:Connect(function()
			if self.emoteEngine.TriggerEmote(player.UserId, emote.id) then
				self:Close()
			end
		end)

		-- Cooldown update
		task.spawn(function()
			while btn.Parent do
				local cd = self.emoteEngine.GetRemainingCooldown(player.UserId, emote.id)
				if cd > 0 then
					cooldownOverlay.Visible = true
					cdText.Text = string.format("%.1fs", cd)
				else
					cooldownOverlay.Visible = false
				end
				task.wait(0.1)
			end
		end)

		table.insert(self.buttons, btn)
	end
end

--// Auction House Pets
-- Pet lifecycle helpers shared by the auction handlers: granting a new pet
-- into a player's inventory and generating unique pet IDs.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Multipliers = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Multipliers)

local Pets = {}

function Pets.GenerateId(Player)
	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local Id
	repeat
		Id = math.random(1, 999999999)
	until not Folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(Id))
	return Id
end

function Pets.GetMaxStorage(Player)
	return Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player)
end

function Pets.Grant(Player, PetName)
	local Folder = Player.Data.Pets
	local MaxStorage = Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player)
	if #Folder:GetChildren() >= MaxStorage then return false end

	local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
	NewPet.Name = Pets.GenerateId(Player)
	NewPet.PetName.Value = PetName
	NewPet.Equipped.Value = false
	NewPet.Parent = Folder
	return true
end

return Pets

--// Auction House Shards
-- Owns the DataStore connection, listing shards, and the in-memory listing cache.
-- Listings are spread across N shards (by owner for writes, hash for lookups) to
-- avoid single-key throttling on the DataStore.

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)

local Shards = {}

local AuctionStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.DATASTORE_NAME)

--// State
local Listings = {} -- [listingId] = listing
local ListingShard = {} -- [listingId] = shard key

--// Shard Helpers
function Shards.GetShardKey(ListingId)
	local Hash = 0
	for i = 1, #ListingId do
		Hash = (Hash * 31 + string.byte(ListingId, i)) % 2147483647
	end
	return "L_" .. (Hash % Config.SHARD_COUNT + 1)
end

function Shards.GetOwnerShard(UserId)
	return "L_" .. (UserId % Config.SHARD_COUNT + 1)
end

function Shards.ReadShard(ShardKey)
	local Success, Data = pcall(function()
		return AuctionStore:GetAsync(ShardKey)
	end)

	if Success and type(Data) == "table" then
		return Data
	end
	return nil
end

function Shards.UpdateShard(ShardKey, Updater)
	local Success, Data = pcall(function()
		return AuctionStore:UpdateAsync(ShardKey, function(Old)
			Old = (type(Old) == "table" and Old) or {}
			return Updater(Old)
		end)
	end)

	return Success, Data
end

function Shards.RebuildCache()
	local NewListings = {}
	local NewShard = {}
	local CarryOver = {}

	for i = 1, Config.SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Data = Shards.ReadShard(Key)

		if Data then
			for Id, Listing in Data do
				NewListings[Id] = Listing
				NewShard[Id] = Key
			end
		else
			CarryOver[Key] = true
		end
	end

	for Id, Key in ListingShard do
		if CarryOver[Key] and NewListings[Id] == nil then
			NewListings[Id] = Listings[Id]
			NewShard[Id] = Key
		end
	end

	Listings = NewListings
	ListingShard = NewShard
end

--// Cache Access
function Shards.GetAll()
	return Listings
end

function Shards.GetListing(Id)
	return Listings[Id]
end

function Shards.AddToCache(Listing, Key)
	Listings[Listing.id] = Listing
	ListingShard[Listing.id] = Key
end

function Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
	Listings[Id] = nil
	ListingShard[Id] = nil
end

function Shards.GetShardOf(Id)
	return ListingShard[Id] or Shards.GetShardKey(Id)
end

function Shards.GetStore()
	return AuctionStore
end

return Shards

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local PlayerPets = Workspace:WaitForChild("PlayerPets")
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local Feedback = Remotes:WaitForChild("PetInteractionFeedback")

local prompts = {}
local cooldowns = {}
local states = {}
local needs = {}
local connectedPets = {}

local Commands = {
	Stop = true, Follow = true, Sit = true, Sleep = true,
	Jump = true, Fly = true, Pet = true, Feed = true,
	Inventory = true,
}

local AURA_RADIUS = 35
local AURA_UPDATE_INTERVAL = 1
local AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER = 1
local AURA_MAX_MULTIPLIER = 1.35

local function getNeeds(pet)
	if not needs[pet] then
		needs[pet] = {
			mood = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Mood")) or 75, 0, 100),
			hunger = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Hunger")) or 75, 0, 100),
		}
	end
	return needs[pet]
end

local function send(player, action, message, pet)
	local stats = pet and getNeeds(pet)
	Feedback:FireClient(player, {
		action = action,
		message = message,
		petId = pet and pet.Name or nil,
		petName = pet and pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or nil,
		mood = stats and stats.mood or nil,
		hunger = stats and stats.hunger or nil,
		state = pet and pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or nil,
	})
end

local function effect(pet, color, burst)
	local mainPart = pet and pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	if not mainPart or not mainPart:IsA("BasePart") then return end
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 0.7
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35, 0.7)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 8)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = mainPart
	emitter:Emit(burst or 12)
	task.delay(1.2, function()
		if emitter.Parent then emitter:Destroy() end
	end)
end

local function clearPet(pet)
	local prompt = prompts[pet]
	if prompt then prompt:Destroy() end
	prompts[pet] = nil
	states[pet] = nil
	needs[pet] = nil
	connectedPets[pet] = nil
end

local function setNeeds(pet, stats)
	stats.mood = math.clamp(stats.mood, 0, 100)
	stats.hunger = math.clamp(stats.hunger, 0, 100)
	pet:SetAttribute("Mood", stats.mood)
	pet:SetAttribute("Hunger", stats.hunger)
end

local function setState(pet, state)
	states[pet] = state
	pet:SetAttribute("PetInteractionState", state)
	pet:SetAttribute("PetMovementToken", (tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("PetMovementToken")) or 0) + 1)
	if state == "Stop" then
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetJumpEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFlyEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSitEnabled", false)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSleepEnabled", false)
	else
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled", state == "Follow")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetJumpEnabled", state == "Jump")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFlyEnabled", state == "Fly")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSitEnabled", state == "Sit")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetSleepEnabled", state == "Sleep")
	end
end

local function getOwnerId(pet)
	local ownerId = pet:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")
	return typeof(ownerId) == "number" and ownerId or nil
end

local function canInteract(player, pet)
	if not pet or not pet:IsDescendantOf(PlayerPets) then return false end
	if getOwnerId(pet) ~= player.UserId then return false end
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local mainPart = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	if not root or not mainPart or not mainPart:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
	return (root.Position - mainPart.Position).Magnitude <= 18
end

local function interact(player, pet, action)
	if not Commands[action] or not canInteract(player, pet) then
		if Commands[action] and pet then send(player, "Denied", "Move closer to your pet to interact.", pet) end
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if cooldowns[pet] and now - cooldowns[pet] < 0.45 then return end
	cooldowns[pet] = now
	local stats = getNeeds(pet)

	if action == "Stop" then
		setState(pet, "Stop")
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 130), 12)
		send(player, "Stop", "Your pet stopped and will stay in place.", pet)
	elseif action == "Pet" then
		stats.mood += 8
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 220), 16)
		send(player, "Pet", "You petted " .. tostring(pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or "your pet") .. ".", pet)
	elseif action == "Feed" then
		stats.hunger += 20
		stats.mood += 3
		effect(pet, Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 80), 14)
		send(player, "Feed", "Your pet enjoyed a snack.", pet)
	elseif action == "Stop" or action == "Follow" or action == "Sit" or action == "Sleep" or action == "Jump" or action == "Fly" then
		setState(pet, action)
		if action == "Sleep" then stats.mood += 5 end
		if action == "Jump" then stats.mood += 2 end
		local color = action == "Sleep" and Color3.fromRGB(120, 150, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255)
		effect(pet, color, action == "Fly" and 22 or 12)
		send(player, action, "Pet behavior set to " .. action .. ".", pet)
	elseif action == "Inventory" then
		send(player, "Inventory", "Pet inventory opened.", pet)
	end
	setNeeds(pet, stats)
end

local function setupPet(pet)
	if not pet:IsA("Model") then return end
	local ownerFolder = pet.Parent
	local owner = ownerFolder and Players:FindFirstChild(ownerFolder.Name)
	if not owner then return end
	local mainPart = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if not mainPart or not mainPart:IsA("BasePart") then return end

	pet:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", owner.UserId)
	local data = owner:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local petData = data and data:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	local petNameValue = petData and petData:FindFirstChild(pet.Name)
	local petName = pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or (petNameValue and petNameValue:FindFirstChild("PetName") and petNameValue.PetName.Value) or pet.Name
	pet:SetAttribute("PetName", petName)
	local initialState = pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or "Follow"
	if initialState == "Follow" or initialState == "Stop" or initialState == "Sit" or initialState == "Sleep" or initialState == "Jump" or initialState == "Fly" then
		setState(pet, states[pet] or initialState)
	else
		setState(pet, "Follow")
	end
	setNeeds(pet, getNeeds(pet))

	if prompts[pet] then return end
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.Name = "PetInteractionPrompt"
	prompt.ActionText = "Interact"
	prompt.ObjectText = petName
	prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.15
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 14
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Parent = mainPart
	prompts[pet] = prompt
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		interact(player, pet, "Pet")
	end)
end

local function watchFolder(folder)
	for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do task.defer(setupPet, pet) end
	folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(pet) task.defer(setupPet, pet) end)
	folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(clearPet)
end

for _, folder in PlayerPets:GetChildren() do watchFolder(folder) end
PlayerPets.ChildAdded:Connect(watchFolder)

Feedback.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, petId, action)
	if type(petId) ~= "string" or type(action) ~= "string" then return end
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	local pet = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(petId)
	interact(player, pet, action)
end)

local function getMoodPet(player)
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if not folder then return nil end
	local bestPet, bestMood
	for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do
		if pet:IsA("Model") then
			local main = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			if main then
				local mood = math.clamp(tonumber(getNeeds(pet).mood) or 0, 0, 100)
				if not bestMood or mood > bestMood then bestPet, bestMood = pet, mood end
			end
		end
	end
	return bestPet, bestMood
end

local function updateMoodAuras()
	local playerData = {}
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local pet, mood = getMoodPet(player)
		playerData[player] = {root = root, pet = pet, mood = mood or 0, auraSource = false}
		player:SetAttribute("MoodAuraActive", false)
		player:SetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier", AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER)
		player:SetAttribute("MoodAuraSourceUserId", nil)
	end

	for source, sourceInfo in pairs(playerData) do
		if sourceInfo.root and sourceInfo.pet and sourceInfo.mood >= 60 then
			local radius = tonumber(source:GetAttribute("MoodAuraRadius")) or AURA_RADIUS
			local multiplier = math.clamp(1 + (sourceInfo.mood / 100) * 0.35, AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER, AURA_MAX_MULTIPLIER)
			local affected = 0
			for target, targetInfo in pairs(playerData) do
				if targetInfo.root and (targetInfo.root.Position - sourceInfo.root.Position).Magnitude <= radius then
					local current = tonumber(target:GetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier")) or AURA_MIN_MULTIPLIER
					if multiplier > current then
						target:SetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier", multiplier)
						target:SetAttribute("MoodAuraActive", true)
						target:SetAttribute("MoodAuraSourceUserId", source.UserId)
					end
					affected += 1
				end
			end
			if affected > 0 then sourceInfo.auraSource = true end
		end
	end
end

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(10) do
		for pet, stats in pairs(needs) do
			if pet.Parent then
				stats.hunger -= 1
				stats.mood -= stats.hunger < 20 and 2 or 1
				setNeeds(pet, stats)
				local owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(getOwnerId(pet) or 0)
				if owner then send(owner, "Needs", "", pet) end
			end
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(AURA_UPDATE_INTERVAL) do
		updateMoodAuras()
	end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if folder then
		for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do clearPet(pet) end
	end
end)

--// Auction Handler
-- View/clear auction listings.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local AuctionHandler = {}

function AuctionHandler.ClearAllListings()
	local AuctionFolder = script.Parent.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("AuctionHouse")
	if not AuctionFolder then return false, "No auction house found" end

	local Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Config)
	local Shards = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Shards"))
	local Mail = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Mail"))
	local AuctionPets = require(AuctionFolder:WaitForChild("Pets"))

	local Removed = 0
	for i = 1, Config.AUCTION_SHARD_COUNT do
		local Key = "L_" .. i
		local Expired = {}

		local Success = Shards.UpdateShard(Key, function(Old)
			for Id, Listing in pairs(Old) do
				Expired[Id] = Listing
			end
			for Id in pairs(Expired) do Old[Id] = nil end
			return Old
		end)

		if Success then
			for Id, Listing in pairs(Expired) do
				Shards.RemoveFromCache(Id)
				local Owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(Listing.owner)
				if Owner and Owner:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Owner.Loaded.Value then
					AuctionPets.Grant(Owner, Listing.petName)
				else
					Mail.Update(Listing.owner, function(MailData)
						MailData.pets[Listing.id] = { petName = Listing.petName }
						return MailData
					end)
				end
				Removed += 1
			end
		end
	end

	return true, "Cleared " .. Removed .. " listing(s)"
end

return AuctionHandler

			rewardType = IsPet and "pet" or "currency",

			rewardTarget = Reward[2] or nil,
		}
	end
	table.sort(Result, function(A, B) return A.code < B.code end)
	return Result
end

local Enemies = Workspace:FindFirstChild("PetEnemies") or Instance.new("Folder")
Enemies.Name = "PetEnemies"
Enemies.Parent = Workspace
local WorldEvents = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("WorldEvents")
local WorldEventService = require(game:GetService("ServerScriptService"):WaitForChild("WorldEventService"))

local MAX_ENEMIES_PER_PLAYER = 6

local DEFAULTS = {
	EnemySpawnEnabled = true,
	EnemySpawnInterval = 6,
	EnemySpawnChance = 1,
	EnemyMaxCount = MAX_ENEMIES_PER_PLAYER,
