local AREA_CONFIG = {
	Spawn = {Health = 35, Damage = 5, Speed = 4.5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 92, 92)},
	Candy = {Health = 55, Damage = 7, Speed = 5.5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 190)},
	Tech = {Health = 80, Damage = 10, Speed = 6.5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 190, 255)},
	Desert = {Health = 100, Damage = 12, Speed = 5.5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(240, 175, 75)},
	Ocean = {Health = 120, Damage = 14, Speed = 7, Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 170, 255)},
	Volcano = {Health = 160, Damage = 18, Speed = 6, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 35)},
	Winter = {Health = 140, Damage = 16, Speed = 5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255)},
}

local cooldowns = {}
local scavenged = {}
local playerEnemies = {}
local lastSpawn = {}
local enemyAttackCooldowns = {}
local comboState = {}
local enemyMotion = {}
local enemyTemplateNames
local clientPetPositions = {}
local MOVEMENT_TICK = 1 / 60
local STEERING_RESPONSE = 12
local ROTATION_RESPONSE = 14
local ROAM_SPEED_MULTIPLIER = 0.45
local ATTACK_LOCK_DURATION = 0.72

local function moveSmoothly(enemy, targetPosition, targetLookPosition, speed, deltaTime, jumping)
	local current = enemy:GetPivot()
	local currentPosition = current.Position
	local flatTarget = Vector3.new(targetPosition.X, currentPosition.Y, targetPosition.Z)
	local offset = flatTarget - currentPosition
	local distance = offset.Magnitude
	local maxStep = speed * deltaTime
	local alpha = math.clamp(STEERING_RESPONSE * deltaTime, 0, 1)
	local desiredVelocity = distance > 0.05 and offset.Unit * math.min(speed, distance / math.max(deltaTime, 0.001)) or Vector3.zero
	local currentVelocity = enemy:GetAttribute("MovementVelocity")
	local velocity = typeof(currentVelocity) == "Vector3" and currentVelocity:Lerp(desiredVelocity, alpha) or desiredVelocity
	enemy:SetAttribute("MovementVelocity", velocity)
	local displacement = velocity * deltaTime
	if displacement.Magnitude > maxStep then displacement = displacement.Unit * maxStep end
	local nextPosition = currentPosition + displacement
	local groundY = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("GroundY"))
	if groundY then nextPosition = Vector3.new(nextPosition.X, groundY, nextPosition.Z) end
	local jumpOffset = jumping and math.sin(math.clamp((os.clock() - (enemyMotion[enemy].jumpStart or os.clock())) / 0.55, 0, 1) * math.pi) * 1.4 or 0
	nextPosition += Vector3.new(0, jumpOffset, 0)
	local lookPosition = Vector3.new(targetLookPosition.X, nextPosition.Y, targetLookPosition.Z)
	local lookDirection = lookPosition - nextPosition
	local targetCFrame = lookDirection.Magnitude > 0.05 and CFrame.lookAt(nextPosition, lookPosition) or CFrame.new(nextPosition)
	local rotationAlpha = math.clamp(ROTATION_RESPONSE * deltaTime, 0, 1)
	enemy:PivotTo(current:Lerp(targetCFrame, rotationAlpha))
	return distance
end

local function stopSmoothly(enemy, deltaTime)
	local velocity = enemy:GetAttribute("MovementVelocity")
	if typeof(velocity) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local nextVelocity = velocity:Lerp(Vector3.zero, math.clamp(STEERING_RESPONSE * deltaTime, 0, 1))
	enemy:SetAttribute("MovementVelocity", nextVelocity)
end

local enemyTemplateNames = {"Mouse", "Bee", "Lizard", "Desert Mouse", "Ocean Dog", "Volcano Bunny", "Frozen Dog"}

local function tell(player, action, message, pet)
	Feedback:FireClient(player, {
		action = action,
		message = message,
		petId = pet and pet.Name or nil,
		petName = pet and pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or nil,
		mood = pet and pet:GetAttribute("Mood") or nil,
		hunger = pet and pet:GetAttribute("Hunger") or nil,
		state = pet and pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or nil,
	})
end

local function combat(player, kind, data)
	data = data or {}
	data.kind = kind
	CombatFeedback:FireClient(player, data)
end

local function burst(position, color, count, scale)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.one
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = Workspace
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 0.9
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.5)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(7, 16)
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	emitter.Parent = part
	emitter:Emit(count or 20)
	Debris:AddItem(part, scale or 1)
end

local function ownerPet(player, petId)
	if type(petId) ~= "string" then return end
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	local pet = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(petId)
	if not pet or pet:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") ~= player.UserId then return end
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local main = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if not root or not main or (root.Position - main.Position).Magnitude > 22 then return end
	return pet
end

local function giveGold(player, amount)
	local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local playerData = data and data:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
	local currency = playerData and playerData:FindFirstChild("Currency")
	if not currency then return false end
	currency.Value += amount
	return true
end

local function getEnemyNear(position, radius)
	local best, distance
	for _, enemy in Enemies:GetChildren() do
		local main = enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		local health = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("Health"))
		if main and health and health > 0 then
			local current = (main.Position - position).Magnitude
			if current <= radius and (not distance or current < distance) then
				best, distance = enemy, current
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function getActivePet(player)
	local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if not folder then return nil end
	local best
	for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do
		if pet:IsA("Model") then
			local main = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			if main and pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") ~= "Stop" and (tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("PetHealth")) or 100) > 0 then
				best = pet
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function getPetMain(pet)
	local main = pet and (pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet.PrimaryPart or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true))
	return main and main:IsA("BasePart") and main or nil
end

local function hitboxParts(cframe, size, excluded)
	local params = OverlapParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
	return Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cframe, size, params)
end

local function attackPet(enemy, pet, player)
	local now = os.clock()
	local motion = enemyMotion[enemy] or {}
	enemyMotion[enemy] = motion
	if motion.attackLockUntil and now < motion.attackLockUntil then return end
	if enemyAttackCooldowns[enemy] and now - enemyAttackCooldowns[enemy] < 1.65 then return end
	local enemyMain = enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	local petMain = getPetMain(pet)
	if not enemyMain or not petMain then return end
	local distance = (enemyMain.Position - petMain.Position).Magnitude
	if distance > (tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("AttackRange")) or 5.5) + 1 then return end
	local facing = CFrame.lookAt(enemyMain.Position, petMain.Position)
	local parts = hitboxParts(facing * CFrame.new(0, 0, -2.3), Vector3.new(6, 5, 6), {enemy})
	local valid = false
	for _, part in parts do
		if part:IsDescendantOf(pet) then valid = true break end
	end
	if not valid then return end
	enemyAttackCooldowns[enemy] = now
	motion.attackLockUntil = now + ATTACK_LOCK_DURATION
	enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Attacking")
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackTarget", pet.Name)
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackStartedAt", now)
	local damage = math.max(1, tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("AttackDamage")) or 5)
	local health = math.max(0, (tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("PetHealth")) or 100) - damage)
	pet:SetAttribute("PetHealth", health)
	pet:SetAttribute("LastEnemyAttack", now)
	combat(player, "EnemyHit", {position = petMain.Position, damage = damage, enemy = enemy.Name})
	tell(player, "EnemyAttack", "An enemy pet attacked " .. tostring(pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or "your pet") .. " for " .. math.floor(damage) .. ".", pet)
	burst(petMain.Position, Color3.fromRGB(235, 75, 75), 18, 1)
	if health <= 0 then
		pet:SetAttribute("PetHealth", 100)
		pet:SetAttribute("PetInteractionState", "Stop")
		pet:SetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled", false)
		combat(player, "PetKnockedOut", {position = petMain.Position, text = "KNOCKED OUT!"})
		tell(player, "PetDefeated", "Your pet was knocked out and needs a moment to recover.", pet)
		task.delay(6, function()
			if pet.Parent then
				pet:SetAttribute("PetHealth", 100)
				pet:SetAttribute("PetInteractionState", "Follow")
				pet:SetAttribute("PetFollowEnabled", true)
				combat(player, "PetRecovered", {position = getPetMain(pet) and getPetMain(pet).Position})
			end
		end)
	end
end

local boundsForZone

local function setMotion(enemy, moving, jumping)
	if enemy:GetAttribute("Moving") ~= moving then enemy:SetAttribute("Moving", moving) end
	if enemy:GetAttribute("Jumping") ~= jumping then enemy:SetAttribute("Jumping", jumping) end
end

local function updateEnemy(enemy, deltaTime)
	local targetUserId = enemy:GetAttribute("OwnerTarget")
	if typeof(targetUserId) ~= "number" then return end
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(targetUserId)
	local pet = player and getActivePet(player)
	local enemyMain = enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	local petMain = getPetMain(pet)
	local character = player and player.Character
	local playerRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not player or not enemyMain then return end
	local motion = enemyMotion[enemy] or {nextRoam = 0, roamTarget = nil, nextJump = os.clock() + math.random(2, 5), jumpUntil = 0, attackLockUntil = 0}
	enemyMotion[enemy] = motion
	local now = os.clock()
	
	local petPos = clientPetPositions[player.UserId]
	local followTarget = petPos or (playerRoot and playerRoot.Position)
	
	if motion.attackLockUntil and now < motion.attackLockUntil then
		if followTarget then
			local look = Vector3.new(followTarget.X, enemyMain.Position.Y, followTarget.Z)
			if (look - enemyMain.Position).Magnitude > 0.05 then enemy:PivotTo(enemy:GetPivot():Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(enemy:GetPivot().Position, look), math.clamp(ROTATION_RESPONSE * deltaTime, 0, 1))) end
		end
		stopSmoothly(enemy, deltaTime)
		setMotion(enemy, false, false)
		return
	end
	if enemy:GetAttribute("AIState") == "Attacking" then
		enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Chasing")
	end
	local targetDistance = followTarget and (enemyMain.Position - followTarget).Magnitude or math.huge
	local stopDistance = 7
	if petMain then
		local petDistance = (enemyMain.Position - petMain.Position).Magnitude
		local attackRange = math.max(4, tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("AttackRange")) or 5)
		if petDistance <= attackRange then
			stopSmoothly(enemy, deltaTime)
			setMotion(enemy, false, false)
			enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Attacking")
			attackPet(enemy, pet, player)
			return
		end
	end
	if enemy:GetAttribute("AIState") == "Attacking" then enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Chasing") end
	if followTarget and targetDistance < 26 then
		enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Chasing")
		local speed = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("MoveSpeed")) or 5
		local jumping = now < motion.jumpUntil
		local distance = moveSmoothly(enemy, followTarget, followTarget, speed, deltaTime, jumping)
		setMotion(enemy, distance > stopDistance + 0.15, jumping)
	else
		enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Roaming")
		if now >= motion.nextRoam or not motion.roamTarget then
			local zoneCenter = enemyMain.Position
			local zone = Workspace.Map and Workspace.Map:FindFirstChild(tostring(enemy:GetAttribute("ZoneName")))
			local low, high = zone and boundsForZone(zone)
			if low and high then
				zoneCenter = Vector3.new(math.random(math.floor(low.X), math.floor(high.X)), enemyMain.Position.Y, math.random(math.floor(low.Z), math.floor(high.Z)))
			else
				zoneCenter += Vector3.new(math.random(-14, 14), 0, math.random(-14, 14))
			end
			motion.roamTarget = zoneCenter
			motion.nextRoam = now + math.random(3, 7)
		end
		local speed = (tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("MoveSpeed")) or 5) * ROAM_SPEED_MULTIPLIER
		local jumping = now < motion.jumpUntil
		local distance = moveSmoothly(enemy, motion.roamTarget, motion.roamTarget, speed, deltaTime, jumping)
		if distance > 2 then
			setMotion(enemy, true, jumping)
		else
			stopSmoothly(enemy, deltaTime)
			setMotion(enemy, false, false)
		end
	end
	if now >= motion.nextJump and (enemy:GetAttribute("Moving") == true or petPos ~= nil) then
		motion.jumpStart = now
		motion.jumpUntil = now + 0.55
		motion.nextJump = now + math.random(3, 6)
		setMotion(enemy, true, true)
		combat(player, "EnemyJump", {position = enemyMain.Position, enemy = enemy.Name})
	end
end

local function attack(player, pet)
	local main = getPetMain(pet)
	if not main then return end
	local enemy = getEnemyNear(main.Position, 32)
	if not enemy then tell(player, "Attack", "No enemy pet is close enough.", pet) return end
	local now = os.clock()
	local key = player.UserId
	if cooldowns[key] and now - cooldowns[key] < 0.48 then return end
	cooldowns[key] = now
	local state = comboState[key] or {count = 0, last = 0}
	state.count = now - state.last <= 1.4 and (state.count % 4) + 1 or 1
	state.last = now
	comboState[key] = state
	local enemyMain = enemy.PrimaryPart or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	local facing = CFrame.lookAt(main.Position, enemyMain.Position)
	local parts = hitboxParts(facing * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3.1), Vector3.new(7, 6, 8), {pet, player.Character})
	local valid = false
	for _, part in parts do
		if part:IsDescendantOf(enemy) then valid = true break end
	end
	if not valid then
		combat(player, "Whiff", {position = main.Position, combo = state.count})
		return
	end
	local baseDamage = 10 * (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier")) or 1)
	local damage = math.floor(baseDamage * (1 + state.count * 0.18))
	local health = math.max(0, (tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0) - damage)
	enemy:SetAttribute("Health", health)
	enemy:SetAttribute("LastHitBy", player.UserId)
	combat(player, "PetHit", {position = enemyMain.Position, damage = damage, combo = state.count, enemy = enemy.Name})
	burst(enemyMain.Position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 70), 24, 1)
	if health <= 0 then
		local reward = tonumber(enemy:GetAttribute("GoldReward")) or 10
		giveGold(player, reward)
		WorldEventService.AddContribution(player, 1, "DefeatEnemies")
		combat(player, "EnemyDefeated", {position = enemyMain.Position, reward = reward, combo = state.count, text = "DEFEATED!"})
		tell(player, "Attack", "Your pet defeated an enemy and found " .. reward .. " gold.", pet)
		enemy:Destroy()
	else
		tell(player, "Attack", "Your pet attacked for " .. math.floor(damage) .. " damage.", pet)
	end
end

local function scavenge(player, pet)
	local key = pet:GetDebugId()
	if scavenged[key] and os.clock() - scavenged[key] < 20 then
		tell(player, "Scavenge", "This pet needs a little time before scavenging again.", pet)
		return
	end
	scavenged[key] = os.clock()
	local amount = math.floor(math.random(5, 25) * (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("MoodAuraMultiplier")) or 1))
	if giveGold(player, amount) then
		WorldEventService.AddContribution(player, 1, "Scavenge")
		local main = getPetMain(pet)
		if main then burst(main.Position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 70), 16, 1) end
		tell(player, "Scavenge", "Your pet scavenged " .. amount .. " gold.", pet)
	end
end

local function chooseTemplate(zone)
	local petFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	if not petFolder then return nil end
	local configured = zone and zone:GetAttribute("EnemyTemplate")
	if type(configured) == "string" then
		local template = petFolder:FindFirstChild(configured)
		if template and template:IsA("Model") then return template end
	end
	local available = {}
	for _, name in ipairs(enemyTemplateNames) do
		local template = petFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
		if template and template:IsA("Model") then table.insert(available, template) end
	end
	return #available > 0 and available[math.random(1, #available)] or nil
end

boundsForZone = function(zone)
	local minVector, maxVector
	for _, item in zone:GetDescendants() do
		if item:IsA("BasePart") then
			local half = item.Size * 0.5
			local low = item.Position - half
			local high = item.Position + half
			minVector = minVector and Vector3.new(math.min(minVector.X, low.X), math.min(minVector.Y, low.Y), math.min(minVector.Z, low.Z)) or low
			maxVector = maxVector and Vector3.new(math.max(maxVector.X, high.X), math.max(maxVector.Y, high.Y), math.max(maxVector.Z, high.Z)) or high
		end
	end
	return minVector, maxVector
end

local function zoneAt(position)
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	if not map then return nil end
	for _, zone in map:GetChildren() do
		if zone:IsA("Folder") or zone:IsA("Model") then
			local minVector, maxVector = boundsForZone(zone)
			if minVector and position.X >= minVector.X and position.X <= maxVector.X and position.Z >= minVector.Z and position.Z <= maxVector.Z then return zone end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function eventValue(name, default)
	local value = WorldEvents:GetAttribute(name)
	return typeof(value) == "number" and value or default
end

local function readSetting(player, zone, name)
	local value = player:GetAttribute(name)
	if value == nil and zone then value = zone:GetAttribute(name) end
	if value == nil then value = DEFAULTS[name] end
	return value
end

local function configureSettings(player)
	for name, value in pairs(DEFAULTS) do
		if player:GetAttribute(name) == nil then player:SetAttribute(name, value) end
	end
end

local function configureEnemy(enemy, ownerTarget, zone)
	local main = enemy:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if not main then enemy:Destroy() return nil end
	local area = AREA_CONFIG[zone and zone.Name] or AREA_CONFIG.Spawn
	local health = math.max(1, (tonumber(readSetting(ownerTarget, zone, "EnemyHealth")) or area.Health) * eventValue("HealthMultiplier", 1))
	local goldMin = math.max(0, (tonumber(readSetting(ownerTarget, zone, "EnemyGoldMin")) or DEFAULTS.EnemyGoldMin) * eventValue("RewardMultiplier", 1))
	local goldMax = math.max(goldMin, (tonumber(readSetting(ownerTarget, zone, "EnemyGoldMax")) or DEFAULTS.EnemyGoldMax) * eventValue("RewardMultiplier", 1))
	enemy.PrimaryPart = main
	enemy:SetAttribute("IsPetEnemy", true)
	enemy:SetAttribute("OwnerTarget", ownerTarget.UserId)
	enemy:SetAttribute("ZoneName", zone and zone.Name or "Unzoned")
	enemy:SetAttribute("Health", health)
	enemy:SetAttribute("MaxHealth", health)
	enemy:SetAttribute("GoldReward", math.random(goldMin, goldMax))
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackDamage", area.Damage)
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackRange", 5.5)
	enemy:SetAttribute("MoveSpeed", area.Speed)
	enemy:SetAttribute("CombatColor", area.Color)
	for _, descendant in enemy:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
			descendant.Anchored = true
			descendant.CanCollide = false
			descendant.CanTouch = false
		end
	end
	enemy:SetAttribute("MovementVelocity", Vector3.zero)
	enemy:SetAttribute("AIState", "Spawning")
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackTarget", "")
	enemy:SetAttribute("AttackStartedAt", 0)
	return enemy
end

local function getCollectAreaPosition(position)
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	local collectAreas = map and map:FindFirstChild("CollectAreas")
	if not collectAreas then return position end
	local closestPoint, closestDistance
	for _, areaPart in collectAreas:GetChildren() do
		if areaPart:IsA("BasePart") then
			local localPosition = areaPart.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
			local halfSize = areaPart.Size * 0.5
			local clamped = Vector3.new(
				math.clamp(localPosition.X, -halfSize.X + 3, halfSize.X - 3),
				0,
				math.clamp(localPosition.Z, -halfSize.Z + 3, halfSize.Z - 3)
			)
			local candidate = areaPart.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(clamped)
			local distance = (candidate - position).Magnitude
			if not closestDistance or distance < closestDistance then
				closestPoint, closestDistance = candidate, distance
			end
		end
	end
	return closestPoint or position
end

local function getAnyCollectAreaPosition(referencePosition)
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	local collectAreas = map and map:FindFirstChild("CollectAreas")
	if not collectAreas then return nil end
	local candidates = {}
	for _, areaPart in collectAreas:GetChildren() do
		if areaPart:IsA("BasePart") and areaPart.Size.X > 8 and areaPart.Size.Z > 8 then
			table.insert(candidates, areaPart)
		end
	end
	if #candidates == 0 then return nil end
	local areaPart = candidates[math.random(1, #candidates)]
	local halfSize = areaPart.Size * 0.5
	local localPosition = Vector3.new(
		math.random(math.floor(-halfSize.X + 4), math.floor(halfSize.X - 4)),
		0,
		math.random(math.floor(-halfSize.Z + 4), math.floor(halfSize.Z - 4))
	)
	return areaPart.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(localPosition)
end

local function placeEnemyOnGround(enemy, horizontalPosition, referenceY, character)
	local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
	rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character, enemy, Enemies}
	rayParams.IgnoreWater = false
	local origin = Vector3.new(horizontalPosition.X, math.max(referenceY + 80, horizontalPosition.Y + 80), horizontalPosition.Z)
	local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -240, 0), rayParams)
	if not result then return false end
	local pivot = enemy:GetPivot()
	enemy:PivotTo(CFrame.new(horizontalPosition.X, result.Position.Y + 0.1, horizontalPosition.Z) * pivot.Rotation)
	local boxCFrame, boxSize = enemy:GetBoundingBox()
	local bottomOffset = boxCFrame.Position.Y - boxSize.Y * 0.5 - enemy:GetPivot().Position.Y
	enemy:PivotTo(enemy:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, 0.1 - bottomOffset, 0))
	local groundedPivot = enemy:GetPivot()
	enemy:SetAttribute("GroundY", groundedPivot.Position.Y)
	return true
end

local function spawnNearPlayer(player)
	local enemies = playerEnemies[player] or {}
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end
	local zone = zoneAt(root.Position)
	local spawnMultiplier = eventValue("SpawnMultiplier", 1)
	local configuredMax = tonumber(readSetting(player, zone, "EnemyMaxCount")) or MAX_ENEMIES_PER_PLAYER
	local maxCount = math.clamp(math.floor(configuredMax * spawnMultiplier), 0, MAX_ENEMIES_PER_PLAYER)
	if readSetting(player, zone, "EnemySpawnEnabled") ~= true or #enemies >= maxCount then return end
	if math.random() > math.clamp((tonumber(readSetting(player, zone, "EnemySpawnChance")) or 1) * math.min(spawnMultiplier, 2), 0, 1) then return end
	local template = chooseTemplate(zone)
	if not template then return end
	local enemy = configureEnemy(template:Clone(), player, zone)
	if not enemy then return end
	enemy.Name = "PetEnemy_Player_" .. player.UserId .. "_" .. math.random(1000, 9999)
	local minDistance = math.max(8, tonumber(readSetting(player, zone, "EnemySpawnMinDistance")) or 24)
	local maxDistance = math.max(minDistance, tonumber(readSetting(player, zone, "EnemySpawnMaxDistance")) or 34)
	local frontDirection = Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	if frontDirection.Magnitude < 0.01 then frontDirection = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) else frontDirection = frontDirection.Unit end
	local rightDirection = Vector3.new(-frontDirection.Z, 0, frontDirection.X)
	local distance = math.random(math.floor(minDistance), math.floor(maxDistance))
	local sideOffset = math.random(-8, 8)
	local spawnPosition = root.Position + frontDirection * distance + rightDirection * sideOffset
	spawnPosition = getCollectAreaPosition(spawnPosition)
	if not placeEnemyOnGround(enemy, spawnPosition, root.Position.Y, character) then
		local fallbackPosition = getAnyCollectAreaPosition(root.Position)
		if not fallbackPosition or not placeEnemyOnGround(enemy, fallbackPosition, root.Position.Y, character) then
			enemy:Destroy()
			return
		end
	end
	enemy.Parent = Enemies
	table.insert(enemies, enemy)
	playerEnemies[player] = enemies
	combat(player, "EnemySpawned", {position = enemy.PrimaryPart.Position, enemy = enemy.Name, zone = enemy:GetAttribute("ZoneName")})
	enemy.Destroying:Connect(function()
		enemyAttackCooldowns[enemy] = nil
		local list = playerEnemies[player]
		if list then for index, current in ipairs(list) do if current == enemy then table.remove(list, index) break end end end
	end)
end

local function setupPlayer(player)
	configureSettings(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		for _, enemy in ipairs(playerEnemies[player] or {}) do if enemy.Parent then enemy:Destroy() end end
		playerEnemies[player] = {}
		lastSpawn[player] = 0
		comboState[player.UserId] = nil
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do setupPlayer(player) end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	for _, enemy in ipairs(playerEnemies[player] or {}) do if enemy.Parent then enemy:Destroy() end end
	playerEnemies[player] = nil
	lastSpawn[player] = nil
	cooldowns[player.UserId] = nil
	comboState[player.UserId] = nil
	clientPetPositions[player.UserId] = nil
end)

	local pet = ownerPet(player, petId)
	if not pet then return end
	if action == "Attack" then attack(player, pet) elseif action == "Scavenge" then scavenge(player, pet) end
end)

Feedback.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, petId, action, extra)

		clientPetPositions[player.UserId] = extra
	end

local function autoAttackPets()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local folder = PlayerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
		if not folder then continue end
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then continue end
		for _, pet in folder:GetChildren() do
			if not pet:IsA("Model") then continue end
			local state = pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState")
			if state ~= "Follow" then continue end
			local petMain = getPetMain(pet)
			if not petMain then continue end
			local enemy = getEnemyNear(petMain.Position, 32)
			if enemy then
				attack(player, pet)
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(0.5) do
		autoAttackPets()
	end
end)

local movementAccumulator = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	movementAccumulator += dt
	if movementAccumulator < MOVEMENT_TICK then return end
	local stepDelta = movementAccumulator
	movementAccumulator = 0
	for _, enemy in Enemies:GetChildren() do
		if enemy:IsA("Model") and enemy.Parent then updateEnemy(enemy, stepDelta) end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(2) do
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			local character = player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				local zone = zoneAt(root.Position)
				local interval = math.max(2, (tonumber(readSetting(player, zone, "EnemySpawnInterval")) or DEFAULTS.EnemySpawnInterval) * eventValue("SpawnIntervalMultiplier", 1))
				if os.clock() - (lastSpawn[player] or 0) >= interval then
					lastSpawn[player] = os.clock()
					spawnNearPlayer(player)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local combatFeedback = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("PetCombatFeedback")
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "PetCombatEffects"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.DisplayOrder = 80
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function worldPosition(position)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera or typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return nil end
	local screen, visible = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(position)
	return visible and Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) or nil
end

local function textBurst(position, text, color, size)
	local point = worldPosition(position)
	if not point then return end
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(point.X, point.Y)
	label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, size or 42)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = color
	label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 28)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.1
	label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	label.TextSize = size or 30
	label.Parent = gui
	local target = label.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(math.random(-25, 25), -85)
	local tween = TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = target, TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1})
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Connect(function() label:Destroy() end)
end

local function burst(position, color, count)
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.one
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 1
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.45)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(8, 18)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = part
	emitter:Emit(count or 26)
	Debris:AddItem(part, 1)
end

local function ring(position, color)
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent = part
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/ring_main.dds"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	emitter.LightEmission = 1
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(0, 0)
	emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 5)})
	emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Parent = attachment
	emitter:Emit(1)
	Debris:AddItem(part, 1)
end

local function playKillSound(position)
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local soundPart = Instance.new("Part")
	soundPart.Anchored = true
	soundPart.CanCollide = false
	soundPart.Transparency = 1
	soundPart.Size = Vector3.one
	soundPart.Position = position
	soundPart.Parent = workspace
	local killSound = Instance.new("Sound")
	killSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://138903578"
	killSound.Volume = 0.6
	killSound.Parent = soundPart
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		killSound:Play()
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("Failed to play kill sound:", err)
	end
	killSound.Ended:Connect(function()
		soundPart:Destroy()
	end)
	Debris:AddItem(soundPart, 2)
end

local function playAttackAnimation()
	local controller = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("AnimationController")
	if controller then
		local ok, module = pcall(require, controller)
		if ok and module and module.Play then
			module.Play("Punching Animation")
		end
	end
end

combatFeedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
	local kind = data.kind
	if kind == "PetHit" then
		playAttackAnimation()
		textBurst(data.position, "-" .. tostring(data.damage), Color3.fromRGB(255, 238, 120), 32)
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.3, 0), "COMBO x" .. tostring(data.combo), Color3.fromRGB(255, 145, 65), 22)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 65), 30)
		ring(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 80))
	elseif kind == "EnemyHit" then
		textBurst(data.position, "-" .. tostring(data.damage), Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 100), 30)
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0), "ENEMY ATTACK!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120), 19)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65), 24)
	elseif kind == "EnemyDefeated" then
		textBurst(data.position, tostring(data.text or "DEFEATED!"), Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 28)
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0), "+" .. tostring(data.reward or 0) .. " GOLD", Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 80), 20)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 55)
		ring(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170))
		playKillSound(data.position)
	elseif kind == "PetKnockedOut" then
		textBurst(data.position, tostring(data.text or "KNOCKED OUT!"), Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80), 27)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60), 40)
	elseif kind == "PetRecovered" then
		textBurst(data.position, "RECOVERED!", Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 22)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 170), 22)
	elseif kind == "EnemySpawned" then
		textBurst(data.position, string.upper(tostring(data.zone or "ENEMY")), Color3.fromRGB(150, 210, 255), 18)
	elseif kind == "EnemyJump" then
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
			humanoid.Jump = false
		end
		local controller = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("AnimationController")
		if controller then
			local ok, module = pcall(require, controller)
			if ok and module and module.Play then module.Play("Double Jump Backflip Animation") end
		end
		textBurst(data.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), "JUMP!", Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255), 19)
		burst(data.position, Color3.fromRGB(120, 210, 255), 16)
	elseif kind == "Whiff" then
		playAttackAnimation()
		textBurst(data.position, "MISS", Color3.fromRGB(190, 200, 220), 20)
	end
end)

--!strict
-- TalentPanel.lua
-- Pet talent inspection and re-roll UI

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local TalentPanel = {}
TalentPanel.__index = TalentPanel

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local TalentEngine = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.TalentEngine)

local DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
	width = 400,
	height = 500,
	animationDuration = 0.3,
}

function TalentPanel.new(config)
	local self = setmetatable({}, TalentPanel)
	self.config = setmetatable(config or {}, {__index = DEFAULT_CONFIG})
	self.gui = nil
	self.currentPet = nil
	self.slotFrames = {}
	return self
end

function TalentPanel:_createGui()
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "TalentPanel"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.DisplayOrder = 220
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.Parent = playerGui

	local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
	panel.Name = "Panel"
	panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.config.width, self.config.height)
	panel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 18, 28)
	panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
	panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
	panel.Visible = false
	panel.Parent = gui

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
	corner.Parent = panel

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Transparency = 0.3
	stroke.Parent = panel

	local panelScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	panelScale.Scale = 0.85
	panelScale.Parent = panel

	local function tweenOpen()
		game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(panelScale, TweenInfo.new(self.config.animationDuration, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
	end

	local function tweenClose()
		game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(panelScale, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Scale = 0.85}):Play()
	end

	panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if panel.Visible then tweenOpen() else tweenClose() end
	end)

	-- Header
	local header = Instance.new("Frame")
	header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60)
	header.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 30)
	header.BorderSizePixel = 0
	header.Parent = panel

	local headerCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	headerCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
	headerCorner.Parent = header

	local headerStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	headerStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 130, 200)
	headerStroke.Thickness = 1
	headerStroke.Transparency = 0.3
	headerStroke.Parent = header

	-- Close button
	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32)
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 14)
	closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 80)
	closeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	closeBtn.Text = "✕"
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeBtn.TextSize = 16
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	closeBtn.Parent = header

	local closeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	closeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	closeCorner.Parent = closeBtn

	closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		self:Close()
	end)

	-- Title
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 1, 0)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 0)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = "PET TALENTS"
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextSize = 20
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.Parent = header

	-- Talent slots container
	local slotsContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
	slotsContainer.Name = "SlotsContainer"
	slotsContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, -80)
	slotsContainer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 70)
	slotsContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	slotsContainer.Parent = panel

	local slotsLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	slotsLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 16)
	slotsLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
	slotsLayout.Parent = slotsContainer

	self.panel = panel
	self.panelScale = panelScale
	self.slotsContainer = slotsContainer
	self.gui = gui
end

function TalentPanel:Open(petData)
	if not self.gui then self:_createGui() end
	
	self.currentPet = petData
	self.panel.Visible = true
	self:_renderTalents(petData)
end

function TalentPanel:_renderTalents(petData)
	for _, child in self.slotsContainer:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("Frame") then child:Destroy() end
	end
	self.slotFrames = {}

	local talents = petData.Talents or {}
	
	for slotIndex, slot in ipairs(talents) do
		local talent = TalentEngine.GetTalent(slot.id)
		local frame = self:_createTalentSlot(slotIndex, talent, slot)
		frame.Parent = self.slotsContainer
		self.slotFrames[slotIndex] = frame
	end

	-- Reroll info
	if #talents > 0 then
		local infoFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
		infoFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
		infoFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		infoFrame.Parent = self.slotsContainer

		local infoText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		infoText.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		infoText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		infoText.Text = "Select a slot to re-roll • Locked slots cannot be re-rolled"
		infoText.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		infoText.TextSize = 12
		infoText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 175, 200)
		infoText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		infoText.Parent = infoFrame
	end
end

function TalentPanel:_createTalentSlot(slotIndex, talent, slot)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "TalentSlot_" .. slotIndex
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 100)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 26, 38)
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
	corner.Parent = frame

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 80, 110)
	stroke.Thickness = 1
	stroke.Transparency = 0.5
	stroke.Parent = frame

	if not talent then
		-- Empty slot
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.Text = "Empty Slot " .. slotIndex
		label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		label.TextSize = 14
		label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 120, 150)
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		label.Parent = frame
		return frame
	end

	-- Tier badge
	local tierColors = {
		[1] = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150),
		[2] = Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 100),
		[3] = Color3.fromRGB(100, 150, 255),
		[4] = Color3.fromRGB(200, 100, 255),
		[5] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50),
	}

	local tierBadge = Instance.new("Frame")
	tierBadge.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 24)
	tierBadge.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12)
	tierBadge.BackgroundColor3 = tierColors[talent.tier] or Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
	tierBadge.BorderSizePixel = 0
	tierBadge.Parent = frame

	local tierBadgeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	tierBadgeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	tierBadgeCorner.Parent = tierBadge

	local tierLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	tierLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	tierLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	tierLabel.Text = "T" .. talent.tier
	tierLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	tierLabel.TextSize = 12
	tierLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	tierLabel.Parent = tierBadge

	-- Category icon
	local iconLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	iconLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
	iconLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 12)
	iconLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	iconLabel.Text = self:_getCategoryIcon(talent.category)
	iconLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	iconLabel.TextSize = 16
	iconLabel.Parent = frame

	-- Talent name
	local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 24)
	nameLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 12)
	nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	nameLabel.Text = talent.name
	nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	nameLabel.TextSize = 16
	nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	nameLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	nameLabel.Parent = frame

	-- Description
	local descLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	descLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 30)
	descLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 36)
	descLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	descLabel.Text = talent.description
	descLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	descLabel.TextSize = 13
	descLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 195, 220)
	descLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	descLabel.TextWrapped = true
	descLabel.Parent = frame

	-- Lock toggle
	local lockBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	lockBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 32)
	lockBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0, 12)
	lockBtn.BackgroundColor3 = slot.locked and Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 80) or Color3.fromRGB(80, 180, 120)
	lockBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	lockBtn.Text = slot.locked and "UNLOCK" or "LOCK"
	lockBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	lockBtn.TextSize = 12
	lockBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	lockBtn.Parent = frame

	local lockCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	lockCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	lockCorner.Parent = lockBtn

	lockBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		local newLocked = not slot.locked
		slot.locked = newLocked
		lockBtn.Text = newLocked and "UNLOCK" or "LOCK"
		lockBtn.BackgroundColor3 = newLocked and Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 80) or Color3.fromRGB(80, 180, 120)
	end)

	-- Reroll button
	local rerollBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	rerollBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 32)
	rerollBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0, 52)
	rerollBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 140, 220)
	rerollBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	rerollBtn.Text = "REROLL"
	rerollBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	rerollBtn.TextSize = 12
	rerollBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	rerollBtn.Parent = frame

	local rerollCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	rerollCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	rerollCorner.Parent = rerollBtn

	if slot.locked then
		rerollBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
		rerollBtn.Text = "LOCKED"
	end

	rerollBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
		if slot.locked then return end
		self:_requestReroll(slotIndex)
	end)

	-- Reroll cost label
	local cost = ReplicatedStorage.Modules.TalentEngine.GetRerollCost(petData, slotIndex, petData.Rarity or "Common")
	local costLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	costLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 20)
	costLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -92, 1, -22)
	costLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	costLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	costLabel.Text = "Cost: " .. cost .. " 💎"
	costLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	costLabel.TextSize = 11
	costLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 100)
	costLabel.Parent = frame

	return frame
end

function TalentPanel:_getCategoryIcon(category: string): string
	local icons = {
		Hatching = "🥚",
		Combat = "⚔️",
		Movement = "🏃",
		Economy = "💰",
		Utility = "🔧",
	}
	return icons[category] or "✨"
end

function TalentPanel:_requestReroll(slotIndex)
	if not self.currentPet then return end
	
	-- In practice, fire server remote
	local result = ReplicatedStorage.Modules.TalentEngine.RerollTalent(
		self.currentPet, slotIndex, self.currentPet.Rarity or "Common"
	)
	
	if result.success and result.newTalentId then
		-- Update local data
		self.currentPet.Talents[slotIndex].id = result.newTalentId
		self.currentPet.Talents[slotIndex].locked = false
		self:_renderTalents(self.currentPet)
	else
		-- Show error
	end
end

function TalentPanel:Close()
	if self.panel then
		self.panel.Visible = false
	end
end

function TalentPanel:Show(petData)
	if not self.gui then self:_createGui() end
	self:Open(petData)
end

function TalentPanel:Destroy()
	if self.gui then self.gui:Destroy() end
end

return TalentPanel

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local WorldEvents = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("WorldEvents")
local StateChanged = WorldEvents:WaitForChild("StateChanged")

local Service = {}
local state = {
	Active = false,
	Name = "",
	Description = "",
	EndsAt = 0,
	SpawnMultiplier = 1,
	SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 1,
	RewardMultiplier = 1,
	HealthMultiplier = 1,
	Cycle = 0,
	ObjectiveType = "",
	ObjectiveText = "",
	ObjectiveTarget = 0,
	ObjectiveProgress = 0,
	ObjectiveReward = 0,
	ObjectiveCompleted = false,
	ExclusivePet = "",
	ExclusiveEgg = "",
}
local participants = {}
local rewardedCycle = {}
local rewardCallback

local function snapshot()
	local copy = {}
	for key, value in pairs(state) do copy[key] = value end
	return copy
end

local function publish()
	for key, value in pairs(state) do WorldEvents:SetAttribute(key, value) end
	StateChanged:FireAllClients(snapshot())
end

local function setPlayerAttributes(player)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventActive", state.Active)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventName", state.Name)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventEndsAt", state.EndsAt)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventRewardMultiplier", state.RewardMultiplier)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventSpawnMultiplier", state.SpawnMultiplier)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveProgress", state.ObjectiveProgress)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveTarget", state.ObjectiveTarget)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventObjectiveCompleted", state.ObjectiveCompleted)
	player:SetAttribute("WorldEventParticipant", participants[player.UserId] == state.Cycle)
end

function Service.SetRewardCallback(callback)
	rewardCallback = callback
end

function Service.GetState()
	return snapshot()
end

function Service.Start(config)
	state.Active = true
	state.Name = config.Name
	state.Description = config.Description
	state.EndsAt = os.time() + math.clamp(math.floor(config.Duration or 180), 30, 900)
	state.SpawnMultiplier = config.SpawnMultiplier or 1
	state.SpawnIntervalMultiplier = config.SpawnIntervalMultiplier or 1
	state.RewardMultiplier = config.RewardMultiplier or 1
	state.HealthMultiplier = config.HealthMultiplier or 1
	state.ObjectiveType = config.ObjectiveType or "DefeatEnemies"
	state.ObjectiveText = config.ObjectiveText or "Complete the shared objective."
	state.ObjectiveTarget = math.max(1, math.floor(config.ObjectiveTarget or 100))
	state.ObjectiveProgress = 0
	state.ObjectiveReward = math.max(0, math.floor(config.ObjectiveReward or 100))
	state.ObjectiveCompleted = false
	state.ExclusivePet = config.ExclusivePet or ""
	state.ExclusiveEgg = config.ExclusiveEgg or ""
	state.Cycle += 1
	participants = {}
	rewardedCycle = {}
	publish()
end

function Service.AddContribution(player, amount, contributionType)
	if not state.Active or state.ObjectiveCompleted or not player or not player.Parent then return false end
	if contributionType and contributionType ~= state.ObjectiveType then return false end
	local safeAmount = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0), 0, 25)
	if safeAmount <= 0 then return false end
	local before = state.ObjectiveProgress
	state.ObjectiveProgress = math.min(state.ObjectiveTarget, before + safeAmount)
	participants[player.UserId] = state.Cycle
	if state.ObjectiveProgress >= state.ObjectiveTarget then
		state.ObjectiveCompleted = true
	end
	setPlayerAttributes(player)
	publish()
	return state.ObjectiveProgress > before
end

local function rewardParticipants()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if participants[player.UserId] == state.Cycle and not rewardedCycle[player.UserId] then
			rewardedCycle[player.UserId] = true
			if rewardCallback then rewardCallback(player, state.ObjectiveReward, state.ExclusivePet, state.ExclusiveEgg) end
		end
	end
end

function Service.End()
	if not state.Active then return end
	local completed = state.ObjectiveCompleted or state.ObjectiveProgress >= state.ObjectiveTarget
	if completed then rewardParticipants() end
	state.Active = false
	state.Name = ""
	state.Description = completed and "Objective complete! Contributors received rewards." or "The event ended before the objective was completed."
	state.EndsAt = 0
	state.SpawnMultiplier = 1
	state.SpawnIntervalMultiplier = 1
	state.RewardMultiplier = 1
	state.HealthMultiplier = 1
	state.ObjectiveType = ""
	state.ObjectiveText = ""
	state.ObjectiveTarget = 0
	state.ObjectiveProgress = 0
	state.ObjectiveReward = 0
	state.ObjectiveCompleted = completed
	state.ExclusivePet = ""
	state.ExclusiveEgg = ""
	state.Cycle += 1
	publish()
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	task.defer(function()
		setPlayerAttributes(player)
		StateChanged:FireClient(player, snapshot())
	end)
end)

Service.Publish = publish
return Service

--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

--[[
  VisualFeedbackHandler
  Location: StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts
  Setup:
  1. Create a RemoteEvent in ReplicatedStorage.Remotes named "CollectEvent"
  2. Ensure a ParticleEmitter is parented to a TemplatePart inside ReplicatedStorage or a custom folder.
]]

local CONFIG = {
	BURST_COUNT = 15,
	LIFETIME = 1.5,
	COLOR_SEQUENCE = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
	PART_NAME = "CollectionBurstTemplate"
}

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local CollectEvent = Remotes:WaitForChild("CollectEvent") :: RemoteEvent

-- Cache the particle template for performance
local function createBurstTemplate(): ParticleEmitter
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Name = CONFIG.PART_NAME
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.0)
	emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
	emitter.Color = CONFIG.COLOR_SEQUENCE
	emitter.Enabled = false
	return emitter
end

local BURST_TEMPLATE = createBurstTemplate()

--[[
  Plays the visual feedback at a specific position.
]]
local function playCollectionBurst(position: Vector3)
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		local container = Instance.new("Part")
		container.Anchored = true
		container.CanCollide = false
		container.Transparency = 1
		container.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
		container.Position = position
		container.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

		local emitter = BURST_TEMPLATE:Clone()
		emitter.Parent = container
		emitter:Emit(CONFIG.BURST_COUNT)

		-- Schedule cleanup to prevent memory leaks
		Debris:AddItem(container, CONFIG.LIFETIME)
	end)

	if not success then
		warn("[VisualFeedback] Failed to render burst: ", result)
	end
end

-- Listen for server-confirmed collections
local connection = CollectEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(position: Vector3)
	if typeof(position) == "Vector3" then
		playCollectionBurst(position)
	end
end)

-- Memory Management on script destruction
local function onAncestryChanged()
	if not script:IsDescendantOf(game) then
		connection:Disconnect()
		BURST_TEMPLATE:Destroy()
	end
end

script.AncestryChanged:Connect(onAncestryChanged)

print("⚡ [Squeeze Studio] VisualFeedbackHandler initialized.")

--// Admin Dashboard Logs
-- In-memory audit log buffer. Every admin action is recorded here.

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)

local Logs = {}
local Buffer = {}

function Logs.Add(AdminName, Action, Target, Details)
	local Entry = {
		timestamp = os.time(),
		admin = AdminName or "?",
		action = Action or "?",
		target = Target or "",
		details = Details or "",
	}
	table.insert(Buffer, Entry)

	-- trim oldest if over limit
	while #Buffer > Config.MAX_LOGS do
		table.remove(Buffer, 1)
	end

	return Entry
end

function Logs.Get(Count)
	local N = math.min(Count or #Buffer, #Buffer)
	local Result = {}
	for i = #Buffer, math.max(1, #Buffer - N + 1), -1 do
		Result[#Result + 1] = Buffer[i]
	end
	return Result
end

function Logs.Clear()
	table.clear(Buffer)
	return true
end

function Logs.Count()
	return #Buffer
end

return Logs

local systemFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DayNightSystem")

local START_TIME = 8
local cycleEnabled = true
local currentClockTime = START_TIME

systemFolder:SetAttribute("CycleEnabled", cycleEnabled)
systemFolder:SetAttribute("ClockTime", currentClockTime)
Lighting.ClockTime = currentClockTime

local function setCycleEnabled(enabled: boolean)
	cycleEnabled = enabled
	systemFolder:SetAttribute("CycleEnabled", cycleEnabled)
end

	if typeof(requestedState) == "boolean" then
		setCycleEnabled(requestedState)
	else
		setCycleEnabled(not cycleEnabled)
	end
	print(string.format("[DayNightSystem] %s set cycle %s", player.Name, cycleEnabled and "On" or "Off"))

	player:SetAttribute("DayNightCycleEnabled", cycleEnabled)

end

	if not cycleEnabled then

	Lighting.ClockTime = currentClockTime
	systemFolder:SetAttribute("ClockTime", currentClockTime)
end)

			math.min(255, math.floor(config.color.R * 255 * 1.15)),
			math.min(255, math.floor(config.color.G * 255 * 1.15)),

	end)

			feedback:FireServer(currentPetId, config.cmd)

	buttonMap[config.cmd] = btn

inventoryBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
inventoryBtn.TextSize = math.floor(14 * scale)
inventoryBtn.TextColor3 = THEME.Text
inventoryBtn.Parent = footer

invStroke.Transparency = 0.3
invStroke.Parent = inventoryBtn

inventoryBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
	TweenService:Create(inventoryBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 160, 240)}):Play()
end)
inventoryBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
	TweenService:Create(inventoryBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Primary}):Play()
end)
inventoryBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	if currentPetId then feedback:FireServer(currentPetId, "Inventory") end
end)

--// State
local currentPetId = nil
local hideToken = 0
local visibleActions = {
	Pet = true, Inventory = true, Stop = true, Follow = true, Sit = true,
	Sleep = true, Jump = true, Fly = true, Feed = true, Attack = true,
	Scavenge = true,
}

local stateColors = {
	Stop = {bg = THEME.Danger, text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 200)},
	Follow = {bg = THEME.Success, text = Color3.fromRGB(220, 255, 230)},
	Sit = {bg = THEME.Care, text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 180)},
	Sleep = {bg = THEME.PanelSecondary, text = Color3.fromRGB(210, 190, 255)},
	Jump = {bg = THEME.Movement, text = Color3.fromRGB(180, 230, 255)},
	Fly = {bg = THEME.Movement, text = Color3.fromRGB(180, 230, 255)},
}

--// Show / Update
local function updatePetInfo(data)
	currentPetId = data.petId or currentPetId
	title.Text = string.upper(tostring(data.petName or "PET"))

	local state = tostring(data.state or "Follow")
	stateLabel.Text = state

	local stateColor = stateColors[state] or stateColors.Follow
	TweenService:Create(stateBadge, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {BackgroundColor3 = stateColor.bg}):Play()
	stateLabel.TextColor3 = stateColor.text

	local mood = math.clamp(tonumber(data.mood) or 0, 0, 100)
	local hunger = math.clamp(tonumber(data.hunger) or 0, 0, 100)

	moodFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(mood / 100, 1)
	hungerFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(hunger / 100, 1)
	moodValue.Text = math.floor(mood) .. "%"
	hungerValue.Text = math.floor(hunger) .. "%"

	local moodColor = mood >= 70 and Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 120) or mood >= 35 and Color3.fromRGB(245, 180, 60) or Color3.fromRGB(235, 70, 70)
	moodFill.BackgroundColor3 = moodColor

	local targetBtn = buttonMap[state]
	if targetBtn then
		local base = targetBtn:GetAttribute("BaseColor")
		TweenService:Create(targetBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {BackgroundColor3 = base}):Play()
	end

	if not panel.Visible then
		panel.Visible = true
	end
	hideToken += 1
	local token = hideToken
	task.delay(12, function()
		if token == hideToken then
			tweenClose()
			task.wait(0.2)
			panel.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end

feedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
	if data.action == "Needs" then
		if panel.Visible and data.petId and data.petId == currentPetId then
			updatePetInfo(data)
		end
		return
	end
	if not visibleActions[data.action] then return end
	updatePetInfo(data)
	if data.action == "Inventory" then
		local frames = playerGui:FindFirstChild("GameUI") and playerGui.GameUI:FindFirstChild("Frames")
		local petFrame = frames and frames:FindFirstChild("Pets")
		if petFrame then
			petFrame.Visible = true
			local blocker = petFrame:FindFirstChild("SideFrameBlocker")
			if blocker then blocker.Visible = true end
		end
	end
end)

--// Pet Needs Billboards (simplified)
local petNeedsBillboards = {}
local function createPetNeedsBillboard(pet)
	if not pet:IsA("Model") or petNeedsBillboards[pet] then return end
	local adornee = pet:FindFirstChild("MainPart") or pet.PrimaryPart or pet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if not adornee then return end

	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	billboard.Name = "PetNeedsBillboard"
	billboard.Adornee = adornee
	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboard.LightInfluence = 0
	billboard.MaxDistance = 15
	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 70)
	billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, math.max(adornee.Size.Y + 2, 3.5), 0)
	billboard.Parent = pet

	local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
	bg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	bg.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Panel
	bg.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	bg.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bg.Parent = billboard

	local bgCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	bgCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	bgCorner.Parent = bg

	local outline = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	outline.Color = THEME.Stroke
	outline.Thickness = 1
	outline.Transparency = 0.3
	outline.Parent = bg

	local moodLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	moodLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 14)
	moodLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 6)
	moodLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	moodLabel.Text = "Mood 0%"
	moodLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	moodLabel.TextSize = 12
	moodLabel.TextColor3 = THEME.Warning
	moodLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	moodLabel.Parent = bg

	local hungerLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	hungerLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 14)
	hungerLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 26)
	hungerLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hungerLabel.Text = "Hunger 0%"
	hungerLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	hungerLabel.TextSize = 12
	hungerLabel.TextColor3 = THEME.Success
	hungerLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	hungerLabel.Parent = bg

	local function update()
		local mood = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Mood")) or 0, 0, 100)
		local hunger = math.clamp(tonumber(pet:GetAttribute("Hunger")) or 0, 0, 100)
		moodLabel.Text = "Mood  " .. math.floor(mood) .. "%"
		hungerLabel.Text = "Hunger  " .. math.floor(hunger) .. "%"
	end

	pet:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Mood"):Connect(update)
	pet:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Hunger"):Connect(update)
	pet.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
		if not parent then petNeedsBillboards[pet] = nil end
	end)
	petNeedsBillboards[pet] = billboard
	update()
end

local playerPets = workspace:WaitForChild("PlayerPets")
local function inspectPetFolder(folder)
	for _, pet in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do createPetNeedsBillboard(pet) end
	folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(pet) task.defer(createPetNeedsBillboard, pet) end)
end
for _, folder in ipairs(playerPets:GetChildren()) do
	if folder.Name == player.Name then inspectPetFolder(folder) end
end
playerPets.ChildAdded:Connect(function(folder)
	if folder.Name == player.Name then inspectPetFolder(folder) end
end)

local function refreshInteractionPanel()
	if currentPetId then
		local folder = playerPets:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
		local pet = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(currentPetId)
		if pet then
			updatePetInfo({
				petId = pet.Name,
				petName = pet:GetAttribute("PetName") or pet.Name,
				mood = pet:GetAttribute("Mood"),
				hunger = pet:GetAttribute("Hunger"),
				state = pet:GetAttribute("PetInteractionState") or "Follow",
			})
		end
	end
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.delay(1, refreshInteractionPanel) end)
playerGui.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
	if child.Name == "GameUI" then task.defer(refreshInteractionPanel) end
end)

buttonCorner.Parent = toggleButton

local function refresh()
	local enabled = systemFolder:GetAttribute("CycleEnabled")
	if typeof(enabled) ~= "boolean" then
		enabled = true
	end

	status.Text = enabled and "Automatic cycle" or "Time paused"
	toggleButton.Text = enabled and "PAUSE" or "RESUME"
	toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and Color3.fromRGB(52, 132, 92) or Color3.fromRGB(76, 92, 135)
end

toggleButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	local enabled = systemFolder:GetAttribute("CycleEnabled")
	toggleCycle:FireServer(not (typeof(enabled) == "boolean" and enabled))
end)

systemFolder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CycleEnabled"):Connect(refresh)
refresh()
