--// Services
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local GameSettings = ReplicatedStorage["Game Settings"]
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local Modules = ReplicatedStorage.Modules

local Multipliers = require(Modules.Multipliers)
local PetMultipliers = require(Modules.PetMultipliers)

local Cooldowns = {}

--// Script

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false

	local PetFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	PetFolder.Name = Player.Name
	PetFolder.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets

	repeat wait() until Player:FindFirstChild("Loaded") and Player.Loaded.Value or Player.Parent == nil
	if Player.Parent == nil then return end

	LoadEquipped(Player)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
	Cooldowns[Player.Name] = nil
	workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:Destroy()
end)

-- Clicker
Remotes.Clicker.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player)
	if GameSettings.GameType.Value ~= "Clicker" then return end

	if Cooldowns[Player.Name] == false then
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = true
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
		Player.Data.PlayerData.TotalCurrency.Value += 1 * Multipliers.CurrencyMultiplier(Player)
		task.wait(0.08)
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false
	end
end)

-- Music
Remotes.Setting.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, SettingName, Toggled)
	Player.Data.PlayerData[SettingName].Value = Toggled
end)

-- Rebirth
function Rebirth(Player) -- this will run the action when you passed all requirements for rebirthing
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value = 0
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value += 1
	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value += 10 -- gems
end

Remotes.Rebirth.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player)
	if Cooldowns[Player.Name] == false then
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = true	
		if GameSettings.RebirthType.Value == "Linear" then
			if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value >= GameSettings.RebirthBasePrice.Value * (Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value + 1) then
				Rebirth(Player)
			end
		else
			if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value >= GameSettings.RebirthBasePrice.Value * (GameSettings.RebirthMultiplier.Value + 1.25) ^ Player.Data.PlayerData.Rebirth.Value then
				Rebirth(Player)
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.08)
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false
	end
end)

-- Pet
function LoadEquipped(Player)
	local EquippedPets = PetMultipliers.Multipliers[Player.Name]

	for PetId, Value in EquippedPets do
		local PetModel = workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:FindFirstChild(PetId)

		if not PetModel then
			local PetInstance = Player.Data.Pets[PetId]
			local NewPet = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value]:Clone()
			NewPet.Name = PetId
			NewPet:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", Player.UserId)
			NewPet:SetAttribute("PetName", PetInstance.PetName.Value)
			NewPet:SetAttribute("PetInteractionState", "Follow")

			for _, Part in NewPet:GetChildren() do
				if Part:IsA("BasePart") then
					Part.Anchored = true
				end
			end

			local Billboard = script.BillboardGui:Clone()
			Billboard.PetName.Text = PetInstance.PetName.Value
			Billboard.PetRarity.Text = ReplicatedStorage.Pets[PetInstance.PetName.Value].Settings.Rarity.Value
			Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, NewPet.MainPart.Size.Y, 0)
			Billboard.Parent = NewPet

			local character = Player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then NewPet:PivotTo(root.CFrame) end
			NewPet.Parent = workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]
		end
	end

	for _,PlayerPet in workspace.PlayerPets[Player.Name]:GetChildren() do
		if not EquippedPets[tonumber(PlayerPet.Name)] then
			PlayerPet:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

function EquipPet(Player, Pet)
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then return end -- Already equipped
	if Multipliers.GetMaxPetsEquipped(Player) <= Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value then return end -- Too many pets equipped
	Pet.Equipped.Value = true
	PetMultipliers.AddPet(Player.Name, Pet)
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

function UnequipPet(Player, Pet)
	if not Pet or not Pet:IsDescendantOf(Player.Data.Pets) then return end
	if not Pet.Equipped.Value then return end
	Pet.Equipped.Value = false
	PetMultipliers.RemovePet(Player.Name, tonumber(Pet.Name))
	Player.NonSaveValues.PetsEquipped.Value = PetMultipliers.GetPetsEquipped(Player.Name)
end

function UnequipAll(Player)
	local pets = Player:FindFirstChild("Data") and Player.Data:FindFirstChild("Pets")
	if not pets then return end
	for _, Pet in pets:GetChildren() do
		if Pet:IsA("Folder") or Pet:IsA("Configuration") then
			UnequipPet(Player, Pet)
		end
	end
	LoadEquipped(Player)
end

function EquipAction(Player, Pet) -- this is the action for equipping a pet
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then
		UnequipPet(Player, Pet)
	else
		EquipPet(Player, Pet)
	end
end

function DeleteAction(Player, Pet) -- this is the action for deleting a pet
	if Pet.Equipped.Value then UnequipPet(Player, Pet) end -- unequip if it's equipped
	Pet:Destroy()
end

Remotes.Pet.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, Action, Parameter)
	if Action == "UnequipAll" then
		UnequipAll(Player)
		return
	end
	if type(Parameter) ~= "table" then -- so if this condition is true, then Parameter should be the id of the pet
		local Pet = Player.Data.Pets[Parameter]

		if Action == "Equip" then
			EquipAction(Player, Pet)
		elseif Action == "Delete" then
			DeleteAction(Player, Pet)
		end

		LoadEquipped(Player)
	else -- there are multiple ids
		if Action == "Equip" then -- equip all pets
			for _,PetId in Parameter do
				local Pet = Player.Data.Pets[PetId]
				EquipAction(Player, Pet)
			end

		elseif Action == "Delete" then -- delete all pets
			for _,PetId in Parameter do
				local Pet = Player.Data.Pets[PetId]
				DeleteAction(Player, Pet)				
			end
		end

		LoadEquipped(Player)
	end
end)

-- Egg
function RandomID(Folder)
	local Chance = math.random(1,10000)
	if Folder:FindFirstChild(Chance) then
		return RandomID(Folder) -- reroll if exists
	end
	return Chance
end

function ChooseRandomPet(Egg, LuckMultiplier)
	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs[Egg]
	local Pets, TotalWeight = {}, 0

	for _, Pet in EggInfo.Pets:GetChildren() do
		table.insert(Pets, {Pet.Name, Pet.Value})
	end

	table.sort(Pets, function(a,b)
		return a[2] > b[2]
	end)

	local BaseChance = Pets[1][2] -- this is the most common pet

	for _,v in Pets do
		local Chance = math.min(v[2] * LuckMultiplier, BaseChance) -- so if the easiest pet is 70%, all pets will go towards 70% 
		TotalWeight += Chance
		v[2] = Chance
	end

	local Chance = Random.new():NextNumber(0,TotalWeight)

	local Counter = 0
	for _,v in Pets do	
		Counter += v[2]

		if Counter >= Chance then
			return v[1]
		end
	end
end

Remotes.Egg.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Egg, Amount)
	if Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value then return end -- cooldown
	if #Player.Data.Pets:GetChildren() + Amount > Multipliers.GetMaxPetsStorage(Player) then return end -- max storage

	local EggInfo = ReplicatedStorage.Eggs:FindFirstChild(Egg)

	if not EggInfo then print(Egg.." does not exist!") return end -- egg does not exist!
	if EggInfo:FindFirstChild("ProductId") then return end -- robux egg

	if Amount == 3 and ReplicatedStorage.Gamepasses:FindFirstChild("TripleEgg") and not Player.Data.Gamepasses.TripleEgg.Value then
		return -- if this is true, it means the player is trying to open a triple egg while there is a gamepass which they don't own
	end

	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value >= EggInfo.Cost.Value * Amount then
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value -= EggInfo.Cost.Value * Amount
		Player.Data.PlayerData.EggsHatched.Value += Amount
		Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = true

		coroutine.wrap(function()
			task.wait(3)
			Player.NonSaveValues.IsOpeningEgg.Value = false
		end)()

		local Results = {}

		local LuckMultiplier = Multipliers.GetLuckMultiplier(Player)

		for i = 1, Amount do
			local PetName = ChooseRandomPet(Egg, LuckMultiplier) 

			if not Player.Data.AutoDelete[PetName].Value then -- auto delete
				local NewPet = game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.PetTemplate:Clone()
				NewPet.Name = RandomID(Player.Data.Pets)
				NewPet.PetName.Value = PetName
				NewPet.Parent = Player.Data.Pets
			end

			Results[i] = PetName
		end

		return Results
	end
end

--// Auto Delete
Remotes.AutoDelete.OnServerInvoke = function(Player, Pet)
	Player.Data.AutoDelete[Pet].Value = not Player.Data.AutoDelete[Pet].Value
	return Player.Data.AutoDelete[Pet].Value
end

--// Area
Remotes.Area.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player)
	if Cooldowns[Player.Name] == true then return end
	Cooldowns[Player.Name] = true

	coroutine.wrap(function()
		task.wait(0.08)
		Cooldowns[Player.Name] = false
	end)()

	local NextArea = ReplicatedStorage.Areas:FindFirstChild(Player.Data.PlayerData.BestZone.Value + 1)
	if not NextArea then return end


	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value < NextArea.Cost.Value then return end

	if NextArea.Cost.Value == -1 then return end -- max area

	Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency.Value -= NextArea.Cost.Value
	Player.Data.PlayerData.BestZone.Value = tonumber(NextArea.Name)
end)

--// Gemshop
Remotes.GemUpgrade.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(Player, Upgrade)
	if not ReplicatedStorage.GemShop:FindFirstChild(Upgrade) then return end

	local GemUpg = ReplicatedStorage.GemShop[Upgrade]
	local UpgradeTier = Player.Data.PlayerData["GemUpgrade"..Upgrade]

	if UpgradeTier.Value >= GemUpg.Max.Value then return end -- max

	local Cost = GemUpg.Price
	local Price

	if Cost.Exponential.Value then
		Price = Cost.DefaultPrice.Value * Cost.IncreasePer.Value ^ UpgradeTier.Value
	else
		Price = Cost.DefaultPrice.Value + Cost.IncreasePer.Value * (UpgradeTier.Value+1)
	end

	if Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value >= Price then
		Player.Data.PlayerData.Currency2.Value -= Price
		UpgradeTier.Value += 1
	end
end)

--!strict

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- SQUEEZE STUDIO
-- Roblox AI WebSync Plugin
-- Version: 6.0.0
--
-- MUST BE A REAL ROBLOX STUDIO PLUGIN SCRIPT.
--
-- Features:
--  • Toolbar button
--  • DockWidget
--  • Automatic connection
--  • HTTP permission test
--  • Script Injection / ScriptEditorService test
--  • Studio project information
--  • Script count
--  • Pending changes
--  • Sync All
--  • Script create/update/delete
--  • Instance create/update/delete
--  • Property changes
--  • ACK
--  • Verification
--  • Automatic reconnect
--  • Permission diagnostics
--
-- IMPORTANT:
-- Roblox permissions cannot be enabled programmatically.
-- The plugin can only trigger the required operation and
-- report that Studio is asking for permission.
----------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------
-- SERVICES
------------------------------------------------------------

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local ScriptEditorService = game:GetService("ScriptEditorService")
local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")

------------------------------------------------------------
-- CONFIG
------------------------------------------------------------

local CONFIG = {
	PLUGIN_NAME = "Squeeze",
	VERSION = "6.0.0",

	-- CHANGE THIS
	BACKEND_URL = "https://squeezeai.vercel.app/api/studio",

	-- Optional local bridge.
	-- Leave empty if you don't have one yet.
	LOCAL_BRIDGE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:32145",

	HEALTH_ENDPOINT = "/health",
	AUTO_CONNECT_ENDPOINT = "/auto-connect",
	HEARTBEAT_ENDPOINT = "/heartbeat",
	PULL_ENDPOINT = "/files/pull",
	ACK_ENDPOINT = "/ack",
	DISCONNECT_ENDPOINT = "/disconnect",
	SNAPSHOT_ENDPOINT = "/project/snapshot",

	HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL = 5,
	RECONNECT_INTERVAL = 5,
	PREVIEW_INTERVAL = 3,

	MAX_LOG_LINES = 300,

------------------------------------------------------------
-- TYPES
------------------------------------------------------------

type Change = {
	changeId: string?,
	eventId: string?,
	path: string?,
	source: string?,
	className: string?,
	action: string?,
	operation: string?,
	version: number?,
	name: string?,
	parentPath: string?,

	newParentPath: string?,

	value: any?,
	attribute: string?,

	attributes: {[string]: any}?,

type Session = {
	token: string,
	sessionId: string,
	projectId: string,
	projectName: string,

	status: string,
	connected: boolean,

	lastHeartbeat: number,
	lastSync: number,

	pendingChanges: number,

type Permissions = {

	httpLocalBridge: boolean,

	instanceWrite: boolean,

------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------
-- LOGS
------------------------------------------------------------

local logs = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")

logPadding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8)
logPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
logPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)
logPadding.Parent = logs

------------------------------------------------------------
-- LOG
------------------------------------------------------------

local function addLog(
	message: string,
	color: Color3?
)
	local count = 0

	for _, child in ipairs(logs:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
			count += 1
		end
	end

	if count >= CONFIG.MAX_LOG_LINES then
		for _, child in ipairs(logs:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
				child:Destroy()
				break
			end
		end
	end

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text =
		"[" .. os.date("%H:%M:%S") .. "] "
		.. message
	label.TextColor3 = color or COLORS.MUTED
	label.TextSize = 11
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.Parent = logs
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- STATUS
------------------------------------------------------------

local function setStatus(
	text: string,
	color: Color3
)
	session.status = text
	statusLabel.Text = "● " .. text
	statusLabel.TextColor3 = color
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- UI UPDATE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function updateUI()
	projectNameLabel.Text =
		session.projectName ~= ""
		and session.projectName
		or "Not connected"

	placeLabel.Text =
		"Place: "
		.. game.Name
		.. " / "
		.. tostring(game.PlaceId)

	local scriptCount = 0

	for _, object in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
			scriptCount += 1
		end
	end

	scriptsLabel.Text =
		"Scripts: "
		.. tostring(scriptCount)

	pendingLabel.Text =
		"Pending: "
		.. tostring(session.pendingChanges)

	if session.lastSync > 0 then
		syncLabel.Text =
			"Last sync: "
			.. os.date("%H:%M:%S")
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- HTTP REQUEST
------------------------------------------------------------

local function request(
	baseURL: string,
	method: string,
	endpoint: string,
	body: any?
): (boolean, any?)
	local url =
		baseURL
		.. endpoint

	local headers = {
		["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
		["X-Squeeze-Plugin"] = CONFIG.VERSION,
	}

	if session.token ~= "" then
		headers["Authorization"] =
			"Bearer " .. session.token
	end

	local encodedBody: string? = nil

	if body ~= nil then
		local encodeOK, encoded =
			pcall(function()
				return HttpService:JSONEncode(body)
			end)

		if not encodeOK then
			return false, {
				code = "JSON_ENCODE_FAILED",
				message = tostring(encoded),
			}
		end

		encodedBody = encoded
	end

	local requestOK, response =
		pcall(function()
			return HttpService:RequestAsync({
				Url = url,
				Method = method,
				Headers = headers,
				Body = encodedBody,
			})
		end)

	if not requestOK then
		return false, {
			code = "REQUEST_FAILED",
			message = tostring(response),
		}
	end

	if response.StatusCode == 401 then
		return false, {
			code = "UNAUTHORIZED",
			message = "HTTP 401 Unauthorized.",
		}
	end

	if response.StatusCode == 403 then
		return false, {
			code = "FORBIDDEN",
			message = "HTTP 403 Forbidden.",
		}
	end

	if not response.Success then
		return false, {
			code =
				"HTTP_"
				.. tostring(response.StatusCode),
			message =
				tostring(response.Body),
		}
	end

	if response.Body == nil
		or response.Body == ""
	then
		return true, {}
	end

	local decodeOK, decoded =
		pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(
				response.Body
			)
		end)

	if not decodeOK then
		return false, {
			code = "INVALID_JSON",
			message =
				"Backend returned non-JSON data.",
		}
	end

	return true, decoded
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PERMISSION TEST: HTTP BACKEND
------------------------------------------------------------

local function testBackendHTTP(): boolean
	addLog(
		"Testing HTTP access to backend...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
			"GET",
			CONFIG.HEALTH_ENDPOINT,
			nil
		)

	if not ok then
		permissions.httpBackend = false

		addLog(
			"✗ Backend HTTP permission/access failed: "
				.. tostring(
					data
					and data.message
					or "Unknown error"
				),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return false
	end

	permissions.httpBackend = true

	addLog(
		"✓ Backend HTTP access is working.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PERMISSION TEST: LOCAL BRIDGE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function testLocalBridgeHTTP(): boolean
	if CONFIG.LOCAL_BRIDGE_URL == "" then
		permissions.httpLocalBridge = false

		addLog(
			"Local Bridge disabled in configuration.",
			COLORS.MUTED
		)

		return false
	end

	addLog(
		"Testing localhost bridge...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.LOCAL_BRIDGE_URL,
			"GET",
			"/health",
			nil
		)

	if not ok then
		permissions.httpLocalBridge = false

		addLog(
			"Local Bridge unavailable.",
			COLORS.MUTED
		)

		return false
	end

	permissions.httpLocalBridge = true

	addLog(
		"✓ Local Bridge HTTP access is working.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PERMISSION TEST: SCRIPT EDITOR READ
------------------------------------------------------------

local function testScriptEditorRead(): boolean
	addLog(
		"Testing ScriptEditorService read access...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local temporaryScript: ModuleScript? = nil

	local success, err =
		pcall(function()
			local folder =
			Instance.new("Folder")

			folder.Name =
			CONFIG.PERMISSION_TEST_FOLDER

			folder.Parent =
			game:GetService("ServerStorage")

			local module =
			Instance.new("ModuleScript")

			module.Name =
			CONFIG.PERMISSION_TEST_SCRIPT

			module.Source =
			"return true"

			module.Parent =
			folder

			temporaryScript =
			module

			local result =
			ScriptEditorService:GetEditorSource(
				module
			)

			if typeof(result) ~= "string" then
				error(
					"GetEditorSource returned invalid value."
				)
			end
		end)

	if temporaryScript then
		temporaryScript.Parent = nil
		temporaryScript:Destroy()
	end

	local testFolder =
		game:GetService("ServerStorage")
		:FindFirstChild(
			CONFIG.PERMISSION_TEST_FOLDER
		)

	if testFolder then
		testFolder:Destroy()
	end

	if not success then
		permissions.scriptEditorRead = false

		addLog(
			"✗ ScriptEditorService read permission failed: "
				.. tostring(err),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return false
	end

	permissions.scriptEditorRead = true

	addLog(
		"✓ ScriptEditorService read access works.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PERMISSION TEST: SCRIPT EDITOR WRITE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function testScriptEditorWrite(): boolean
	addLog(
		"Testing Script Injection / ScriptEditor write access...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local folder: Folder? = nil
	local module: ModuleScript? = nil

	local success, err =
		pcall(function()
			folder =
			Instance.new("Folder")

			folder.Name =
			CONFIG.PERMISSION_TEST_FOLDER

			folder.Parent =
			game:GetService("ServerStorage")

			module =
			Instance.new("ModuleScript")

			module.Name =
			CONFIG.PERMISSION_TEST_SCRIPT

			module.Source =
			"return 1"

			module.Parent =
			folder

			local successUpdate =
			pcall(function()
				ScriptEditorService:UpdateSourceAsync(
					module :: ModuleScript,
					function()
						return "return 2"
					end
				)
			end)

			if not successUpdate then
				error(
					"ScriptEditorService:UpdateSourceAsync was rejected."
				)
			end
		end)

	if folder then
		folder:Destroy()
	end

	if not success then
		permissions.scriptEditorWrite = false

		addLog(
			"✗ Script Injection / ScriptEditor write permission failed: "
				.. tostring(err),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			"Open Plugins → Manage Plugins → Squeeze and allow Script Injection.",
			COLORS.YELLOW
		)

		return false
	end

	permissions.scriptEditorWrite = true

	addLog(
		"✓ Script Injection / ScriptEditor write access works.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- INSTANCE WRITE TEST
------------------------------------------------------------

local function testInstanceWrite(): boolean
	addLog(
		"Testing Studio DataModel write access...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local testPart: Part? = nil

	local success, err =
		pcall(function()
			local part =
			Instance.new("Part")

			part.Name =
			"__SQUEEZE_PERMISSION_PART__"

			part.Size =
			Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)

			part.Transparency = 1

			part.CanCollide = false

			part.Parent =
			game:GetService("Workspace")

			testPart = part

			part:SetAttribute(
				"SqueezePermissionTest",
				true
			)
		end)

	if testPart then
		testPart:Destroy()
	end

	if not success then
		permissions.instanceWrite = false

		addLog(
			"✗ Studio Instance write failed: "
				.. tostring(err),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return false
	end

	permissions.instanceWrite = true

	addLog(
		"✓ Studio DataModel write access works.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- CHANGE HISTORY TEST
------------------------------------------------------------

local function testChangeHistory(): boolean
	local success, err =
		pcall(function()
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint(
				"Squeeze Permission Check"
			)
		end)

	if not success then
		permissions.changeHistory = false

		addLog(
			"✗ ChangeHistoryService failed: "
				.. tostring(err),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return false
	end

	permissions.changeHistory = true

	addLog(
		"✓ ChangeHistoryService works.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PERMISSION SUMMARY
------------------------------------------------------------

local function updatePermissionUI()
	local function mark(value: boolean): string
		return value
			and "✓ ALLOWED"
			or "✗ NEEDS ATTENTION"
	end

	permissionText.Text =
		"HTTP Backend:       "
		.. mark(permissions.httpBackend)
		.. "\n"
		.. "HTTP Local Bridge:  "
		.. mark(permissions.httpLocalBridge)
		.. "\n"
		.. "Script Read:        "
		.. mark(permissions.scriptEditorRead)
		.. "\n"
		.. "Script Injection:   "
		.. mark(permissions.scriptEditorWrite)
		.. "\n"
		.. "Instance Write:     "
		.. mark(permissions.instanceWrite)
		.. "\n"
		.. "Change History:     "
		.. mark(permissions.changeHistory)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- RUN ALL PERMISSION CHECKS
------------------------------------------------------------

local function checkAllPermissions()
	if busy then
		return
	end

	busy = true

	setStatus(
		"Checking Permissions...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	addLog(
		"========== SQUEEZE PERMISSION CHECK ==========",
		COLORS.TEXT
	)

	testBackendHTTP()
	testLocalBridgeHTTP()
	testScriptEditorRead()
	testScriptEditorWrite()
	testInstanceWrite()
	testChangeHistory()

	updatePermissionUI()

	local allCore =
		permissions.httpBackend
		and permissions.scriptEditorRead
		and permissions.scriptEditorWrite
		and permissions.instanceWrite
		and permissions.changeHistory

	if allCore then
		setStatus(
			"All Core Permissions Ready",
			COLORS.GREEN
		)

		addLog(
			"✓ All required core capabilities are available.",
			COLORS.GREEN
		)
	else
		setStatus(
			"Permissions Needed",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			"Some permissions are missing.",
			COLORS.YELLOW
		)

		addLog(
			"Open Plugins → Manage Plugins → Squeeze.",
			COLORS.YELLOW
		)

		addLog(
			"Enable Script Injection for Squeeze if it is disabled.",
			COLORS.YELLOW
		)
	end

	busy = false
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- AUTO CONNECT
------------------------------------------------------------

local function autoConnect(): boolean
	if destroyed or busy then
		return false
	end

	busy = true

	setStatus(
		"Connecting...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	addLog(
		"Starting automatic Studio connection...",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
			"POST",
			CONFIG.AUTO_CONNECT_ENDPOINT,
			{
				placeId =
				game.PlaceId,

				universeId =
				game.GameId,

				placeName =
				game.Name,

				pluginVersion =
				CONFIG.VERSION,
			}
		)

	if not ok then
		setStatus(
			"Backend Connection Error",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			"Auto-connect failed: "
				.. tostring(
					data
					and data.message
					or "Unknown"
				),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		busy = false
		return false
	end

	if not data
		or data.success ~= true
	then
		setStatus(
			"Auto-connect Rejected",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			"Backend rejected this Studio session.",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		busy = false
		return false
	end

	session.token =
		tostring(
			data.token
			or ""
		)

	session.sessionId =
		tostring(
			data.sessionId
			or ""
		)

	session.projectId =
		tostring(
			data.projectId
			or ""
		)

	session.projectName =
		tostring(
			data.projectName
			or game.Name
		)

	session.pendingChanges =
		typeof(data.pendingChangesCount)
		== "number"
		and data.pendingChangesCount
		or 0

	session.connected = true
	session.lastHeartbeat = os.clock()

	setStatus(
		"Connected",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	addLog(
		"✓ Studio connected automatically.",
		COLORS.GREEN
	)

	addLog(
		"Project: "
			.. session.projectName,
		COLORS.TEXT
	)

	addLog(
		"Place ID: "
			.. tostring(game.PlaceId),
		COLORS.MUTED
	)

	updateUI()

	busy = false

	return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- HEARTBEAT
------------------------------------------------------------

local function startHeartbeat()
	if heartbeatRunning then
		return
	end

	heartbeatRunning = true

	task.spawn(function()
		while not destroyed
			and session.token ~= ""
		do
			task.wait(
				CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL
			)

			if destroyed then
				break
			end

			local ok, data =
				request(
					CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
					"POST",
					CONFIG.HEARTBEAT_ENDPOINT,
					{
						placeId =
						game.PlaceId,

						universeId =
						game.GameId,

						placeName =
						game.Name,

						pluginVersion =
						CONFIG.VERSION,
					}
				)

			if ok then
				session.connected = true
				session.lastHeartbeat = os.clock()

				if data
					and typeof(
						data.pendingChangesCount
					) == "number"
				then
					session.pendingChanges =
						data.pendingChangesCount
				end

				setStatus(
					"Connected",
					COLORS.GREEN
				)

				updateUI()
			elseif data
				and data.code == "UNAUTHORIZED"
			then
				session.token = ""
				session.connected = false

				setStatus(
					"Session Expired",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				addLog(
					"Session expired. Reconnecting...",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				break
			else
				session.connected = false

				setStatus(
					"Offline",
					COLORS.RED
				)

				addLog(
					"Heartbeat failed.",
					COLORS.RED
				)
			end
		end

		heartbeatRunning = false
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- RECONNECT
------------------------------------------------------------

local function startReconnectLoop()
	if reconnectRunning then
		return
	end

	reconnectRunning = true

	task.spawn(function()
		while not destroyed do
			task.wait(
				CONFIG.RECONNECT_INTERVAL
			)

			if destroyed then
				break
			end

			if not session.connected then
				local success =
					autoConnect()

				if success then
					startHeartbeat()
				end
			end
		end

		reconnectRunning = false
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PATH RESOLUTION
------------------------------------------------------------

local function cleanScriptName(
	name: string
): string
	return name
		:gsub("%.server%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.client%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.plugin%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.luau$", "")
		:gsub("%.lua$", "")
end

local function resolvePath(
	path: string
): Instance?
	local normalized =
		path:gsub("^/", "")

	local parts =
		string.split(
			normalized,
			"/"
		)

	local current: Instance = game

	for index, part in ipairs(parts) do
		if index == 1
			and part == "game"
		then
			continue
		end

		local name =
			cleanScriptName(part)

		local child =
			current:FindFirstChild(name)

		if not child then
			return nil
		end

		current = child
	end

	return current
end

local function resolveParent(
	path: string
): (Instance?, string)
	local normalized =
		path:gsub("^/", "")

	local parts =
		string.split(
			normalized,
			"/"
		)

	if #parts == 0 then
		return nil, ""
	end

	local name =
		cleanScriptName(
			parts[#parts]
		)

	local current: Instance = game

	for index = 1, #parts - 1 do
		local part = parts[index]

		if index == 1
			and part == "game"
		then
			continue
		end

		local child =
			current:FindFirstChild(
				cleanScriptName(part)
			)

		if not child then
			return nil, name
		end

		current = child
	end

	return current, name
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- SCRIPT READ/WRITE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function readScriptSource(
	scriptInstance: LuaSourceContainer
): (boolean, string?)
	local ok, source =
		pcall(function()
			return ScriptEditorService:GetEditorSource(
				scriptInstance
			)
		end)

	if not ok then
		return false, tostring(source)
	end

	return true, source
end

local function writeScriptSource(
	scriptInstance: LuaSourceContainer,
	source: string
): (boolean, string?)
	if not permissions.scriptEditorWrite then
		return false,
			"Script Injection / ScriptEditor write permission is not enabled."
	end

	local ok, err =
		pcall(function()
			ScriptEditorService:UpdateSourceAsync(
				scriptInstance,
				function()
					return source
				end
			)
		end)

	if not ok then
		return false, tostring(err)
	end

	return true, nil
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- APPLY SCRIPT
------------------------------------------------------------

local function applyScriptChange(
	change: Change
): (boolean, string?)
	local path =
		tostring(
			change.path
			or ""
		)

	local action =
		string.lower(
			tostring(
				change.operation
				or change.action
				or "update"
			)
		)

	local className =
		tostring(
			change.className
			or "Script"
		)

	local source =
		tostring(
			change.source
			or ""
		)

	local parent, name =
		resolveParent(path)

	if not parent then
		return false,
			"Parent not found: "
			.. path
	end

	local existing =
		parent:FindFirstChild(name)

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- DELETE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if action == "delete"
		or action == "deletefile"
	then
		if existing then
			existing:Destroy()
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- CLASS
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if className ~= "Script"
		and className ~= "LocalScript"
		and className ~= "ModuleScript"
	then
		return false,
			"Unsupported class: "
			.. className
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- CREATE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	local target:
		LuaSourceContainer

	if existing then
		if not existing:IsA(
			"LuaSourceContainer"
			) then
			return false,
				"Existing object is not a script."
		end

		if existing.ClassName
			~= className
		then
			return false,
				"Class mismatch."
		end

		target =
			existing :: LuaSourceContainer
	else
		local created =
			Instance.new(
				className
			)

		created.Name = name
		created.Parent = parent

		target =
			created :: LuaSourceContainer
	end

	ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint(
		"Squeeze Before Script Update"
	)

	local ok, err =
		writeScriptSource(
			target,
			source
		)

	if not ok then
		return false, err
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- VERIFY
	--------------------------------------------------------

	local readOK, actual =
		readScriptSource(target)

	if not readOK then
		return false,
			"Unable to read back script."
	end

	if actual ~= source then
		return false,
			"Script verification failed."
	end

	ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint(
		"Squeeze Script Updated"
	)

	return true, nil
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- INSTANCE OPERATION
------------------------------------------------------------

local function applyInstanceChange(
	change: Change
): (boolean, string?)
	if not permissions.instanceWrite then
		return false,
			"Studio Instance write permission is unavailable."
	end

	local operation =
		string.lower(
			tostring(
				change.operation
				or change.action
				or ""
			)
		)

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- CREATE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "createinstance" then
		local className =
			tostring(
				change.className
				or "Folder"
			)

		local name =
			tostring(
				change.name
				or ""
			)

		local parentPath =
			tostring(
				change.parentPath
				or "Workspace"
			)

		local parent =
			resolvePath(
				parentPath
			)

		if not parent then
			return false,
				"Parent not found: "
				.. parentPath
		end

		if name == "" then
			return false,
				"Instance name is required."
		end

		if parent:FindFirstChild(name) then
			return false,
				"Instance already exists: "
				.. parentPath
				.. "/"
				.. name
		end

		local ok, result =
			pcall(function()
				local instance =
				Instance.new(
					className
				)

				instance.Name =
				name

				if change.properties then
					for property, value in
						pairs(change.properties)
					do
						(instance :: any)[property] =
						value
					end
				end

				if change.attributes then
					for attribute, value in
						pairs(change.attributes)
					do
						instance:SetAttribute(
							attribute,
							value
						)
					end
				end

				instance.Parent =
				parent

				return instance
			end)

		if not ok then
			return false,
				tostring(result)
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- DELETE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "deleteinstance" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return true, nil
		end

		target:Destroy()

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- RENAME
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "renameinstance" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local newName =
			tostring(
				change.newName
				or change.name
				or ""
			)

		if newName == "" then
			return false,
				"New name is required."
		end

		target.Name =
			newName

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- MOVE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "moveinstance" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local parentPath =
			tostring(
				change.newParentPath
				or ""
			)

		local newParent =
			resolvePath(
				parentPath
			)

		if not newParent then
			return false,
				"New parent not found."
		end

		target.Parent =
			newParent

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- PROPERTY
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "setproperty" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local property =
			tostring(
				change.property
				or ""
			)

		if property == "" then
			return false,
				"Property is required."
		end

		local ok, err =
			pcall(function()
				(target :: any)[property] =
				change.value
			end)

		if not ok then
			return false,
				tostring(err)
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	--------------------------------------------------------
	-- ATTRIBUTE
	--------------------------------------------------------

	if operation == "setattribute" then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		local target =
			resolvePath(path)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Target not found."
		end

		local attribute =
			tostring(
				change.attribute
				or ""
			)

		if attribute == "" then
			return false,
				"Attribute is required."
		end

		target:SetAttribute(
			attribute,
			change.value
		)

		return true, nil
	end

	return false,
		"Unsupported Studio operation: "
		.. operation
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- VERIFY INSTANCE
------------------------------------------------------------

local function verifyChange(
	change: Change
): (boolean, string?)
	local operation =
		string.lower(
			tostring(
				change.operation
				or change.action
				or ""
			)
		)

	if operation == "deleteinstance"
		or operation == "delete"
	then
		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or ""
			)

		if resolvePath(path) == nil then
			return true, nil
		end

		return false,
			"Object still exists."
	end

	if operation == "createinstance" then
		local parentPath =
			tostring(
				change.parentPath
				or "Workspace"
			)

		local name =
			tostring(
				change.name
				or ""
			)

		local parent =
			resolvePath(
				parentPath
			)

		if not parent then
			return false,
				"Parent missing during verification."
		end

		local target =
			parent:FindFirstChild(name)

		if not target then
			return false,
				"Created instance was not found."
		end

		if change.className
			and target.ClassName
			~= change.className
		then
			return false,
				"Class verification failed."
		end

		return true, nil
	end

	local path =
		tostring(
			change.path
			or ""
		)

	local target =
		resolvePath(path)

	if not target then
		return false,
			"Target not found during verification."
	end

	return true, nil
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- ACK
------------------------------------------------------------

local function acknowledge(
	change: Change,
	success: boolean,
	errorMessage: string?
)
	local id =
		tostring(
			change.changeId
			or change.eventId
			or ""
		)

	request(
		CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
		"POST",
		CONFIG.ACK_ENDPOINT,
		{
			changeId = id,
			eventId =
				change.eventId
				or id,

			status =
				success
				and "applied"
				or "failed",

			verified =
				success,

			errorMessage =
				errorMessage,
		}
	)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- SYNC
------------------------------------------------------------

local function syncAll()
	if busy then
		return
	end

	if not session.connected
		or session.token == ""
	then
		addLog(
			"Studio is not connected. No changes were made.",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return
	end

	if not permissions.httpBackend then
		addLog(
			"Backend HTTP permission is not available.",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		return
	end

	busy = true

	setStatus(
		"Syncing",
		COLORS.YELLOW
	)

	syncButton.Text =
		"Syncing..."

	local ok, data =
		request(
			CONFIG.BACKEND_URL,
			"GET",
			CONFIG.PULL_ENDPOINT,
			nil
		)

	if not ok then
		addLog(
			"Queue request failed: "
				.. tostring(
					data
					and data.message
					or "Unknown"
				),
			COLORS.RED
		)

		busy = false
		syncButton.Text =
			"Sync All"

		return
	end

	local changes =
		data
		and data.changes

	if typeof(changes) ~= "table" then
		changes = {}
	end

	pendingChanges =
		changes :: {Change}

	session.pendingChanges =
		#pendingChanges

	updateUI()

	if #pendingChanges == 0 then
		addLog(
			"✓ Nothing pending.",
			COLORS.GREEN
		)

		setStatus(
			"Connected",
			COLORS.GREEN
		)

		busy = false
		syncButton.Text =
			"Sync All"

		return
	end

	local total =
		#pendingChanges

	local applied = 0
	local failed = 0

	addLog(
		"Found "
			.. tostring(total)
			.. " pending change(s).",
		COLORS.TEXT
	)

	for index, change in ipairs(
		pendingChanges
		) do
		local operation =
			string.lower(
				tostring(
					change.operation
					or change.action
					or ""
				)
			)

		local path =
			tostring(
				change.path
				or change.name
				or change.changeId
				or "Unknown"
			)

		addLog(
			string.format(
				"[%d/%d] %s",
				index,
				total,
				path
			),
			COLORS.MUTED
		)

		local success = false
		local errorMessage: string?

		if operation == "createinstance"
			or operation == "deleteinstance"
			or operation == "renameinstance"
			or operation == "moveinstance"
			or operation == "setproperty"
			or operation == "setattribute"
		then
			success, errorMessage =
				applyInstanceChange(
					change
				)
		else
			success, errorMessage =
				applyScriptChange(
					change
				)
		end

		if success then
			local verified,
				verifyError =
				verifyChange(
					change
				)

			if not verified then
				success = false
				errorMessage =
					verifyError
			end
		end

		acknowledge(
			change,
			success,
			errorMessage
		)

		if success then
			applied += 1

			addLog(
				"✓ Applied + verified: "
					.. path,
				COLORS.GREEN
			)
		else
			failed += 1

			addLog(
				"✗ Failed: "
					.. path
					.. " | "
					.. tostring(
						errorMessage
					),
				COLORS.RED
			)
		end
	end

	session.pendingChanges =
		math.max(
			0,
			total - applied
		)

	session.lastSync =
		os.clock()

	if failed == 0 then
		setStatus(
			"Connected",
			COLORS.GREEN
		)

		addLog(
			string.format(
				"✓ Sync completed: %d/%d verified.",
				applied,
				total
			),
			COLORS.GREEN
		)
	else
		setStatus(
			"Sync Error",
			COLORS.RED
		)

		addLog(
			string.format(
				"⚠ %d/%d applied. %d failed.",
				applied,
				total,
				failed
			),
			COLORS.YELLOW
		)
	end

	updateUI()

	syncButton.Text =
		"Sync All"

	busy = false
end

studioChanges.source:
--// Services

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Server Modules

local MainFolder = script.Parent
local Datastore = require(MainFolder.Datastore)
local Values = require(MainFolder.Datastore.Values)

if game.PrivateServerId ~= "" and game.PrivateServerOwnerId == 0 then return end

--// Player Join

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)		
	Datastore.LoadData(plr)
	
	task.wait(1)
	
	local Loaded = Instance.new("BoolValue")
	Loaded.Name = "Loaded"
	Loaded.Value = true
	Loaded.Parent = plr
end)

--// Save data when a player leaves
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(Datastore.SaveData)

--// Save data when the server closes
game:BindToClose(function()
	for _,v in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Datastore.SaveData(v)
	end
end)

--// Autosave
local AutoSaveTime = 240 -- change this if you want faster/slower autosaves!

while task.wait(AutoSaveTime) do
	for _, plr in (Players:GetChildren()) do
		if not plr:FindFirstChild("Loaded") or not plr.Loaded.Value then continue end

		pcall(function()
			Datastore.SaveData(plr, true)
		end)
		
		plr.Loaded.Value = true
	end
end

--!strict
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local CONFIG = {
	BaseSpeed = 16,
	SprintSpeed = 26,
	MaxStamina = 100,
	DrainRate = 25,
	RegenRate = 15,
	RegenDelay = 1.5,
}

export type StaminaState = {
	IsSprinting: boolean,
	CurrentStamina: number,
	LastDrained: number,
}

local StaminaSystem = {}
StaminaSystem.__index = StaminaSystem

function StaminaSystem.new(humanoid: Humanoid)
	local self = setmetatable({} :: StaminaState, StaminaSystem)
	self.IsSprinting = false
	self.CurrentStamina = CONFIG.MaxStamina
	self.LastDrained = 0

	local connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
		updateStamina(self, humanoid, dt)
	end)

	return self
end

function updateStamina(state: StaminaState, humanoid: Humanoid, dt: number)
	local isMoving = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0
	local isSprinting = state.IsSprinting and isMoving

	if isSprinting and state.CurrentStamina > 0 then
		state.CurrentStamina = math.max(0, state.CurrentStamina - (CONFIG.DrainRate * dt))
		state.LastDrained = tick()
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.SprintSpeed
	else
		if tick() - state.LastDrained > CONFIG.RegenDelay then
			state.CurrentStamina = math.min(CONFIG.MaxStamina, state.CurrentStamina + (CONFIG.RegenRate * dt))
		end
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = CONFIG.BaseSpeed
		if state.CurrentStamina <= 0 then
			state.IsSprinting = false
		end
	end
end

function StaminaSystem:HandleInput(input: InputObject, gameProcessed: boolean)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
		self.IsSprinting = (input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin)
	end
end

-- Example usage within a LocalScript:
-- local stamina = StaminaSystem.new(humanoid)
-- UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp) stamina:HandleInput(input, gp) end)
-- UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input, gp) stamina:HandleInput(input, gp) end)

return StaminaSystem

--!strict
-- ScreenEffects.lua
-- Full-screen visual effects: flash, vignette, chromatic aberration, color grade

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local ScreenEffects = {}
ScreenEffects.__index = ScreenEffects

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Effect container
local effectGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
effectGui.Name = "ScreenEffects"
effectGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
effectGui.DisplayOrder = 200
effectGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
effectGui.Parent = playerGui

-- Pool for flash frames
local flashPool = {}
local MAX_POOL = 10

local function getFlashFrame(): Frame
	for _, frame in flashPool do
		if not frame.Visible then
			frame.Visible = true
			return frame
		end
	end
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Parent = effectGui
	table.insert(flashPool, frame)
	return frame
end

local function returnToPool(frame: Frame)
	frame.Visible = false
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
end

-- Chromatic aberration frames
local chromaticFrames = {}
local function ensureChromatic()
	if #chromaticFrames > 0 then return end
	for _, color in {Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0), Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0), Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)} do
		local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
		frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		frame.BackgroundColor3 = color
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
		frame.Parent = effectGui
		table.insert(chromaticFrames, frame)
	end
end

local function returnChromatic()
	for _, frame in chromaticFrames do
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
	end
end

-- Vignette
local vignetteFrame = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
vignetteFrame.Name = "Vignette"
vignetteFrame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
vignetteFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
vignetteFrame.Image = "rbxassetid://5028857084" -- soft circle
vignetteFrame.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
vignetteFrame.ImageTransparency = 1
vignetteFrame.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
vignetteFrame.Parent = effectGui

-- Color correction (via Lighting)
local colorCorrection = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
colorCorrection.Name = "ScreenEffectsCC"
colorCorrection.Enabled = false
colorCorrection.Parent = game.Lighting

-- Public API
function ScreenEffects.Flash(color: Color3, duration: number, easingStyle: Enum.EasingStyle?)
	local frame = getFlashFrame()
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = color
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	
	local tween = TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(duration, easingStyle or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1
	})
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		returnToPool(frame)
	end)
end

function ScreenEffects.RadialFlash(position: Vector2, color: Color3, maxRadius: number, duration: number)
	local frame = getFlashFrame()
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = color
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
	frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(position.X, position.Y)
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	
	local corner = frame:FindFirstChild("UICorner") or Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	corner.Parent = frame
	
	local tween = TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(maxRadius * 2, maxRadius * 2),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1
	})
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		returnToPool(frame)
	end)
end

function ScreenEffects.ChromaticAberration(intensity: number, duration: number)
	ensureChromatic()
	local offset = intensity * 4
	
	for i, frame in chromaticFrames do
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.8
		local angle = (i - 1) * (2 * math.pi / 3)
		local targetPos = UDim2.fromOffset(math.cos(angle) * offset, math.sin(angle) * offset)
		
		local tween = TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.05, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
			Position = targetPos
		})
		tween:Play()
	end
	
	task.delay(duration, function()
		for _, frame in chromaticFrames do
			TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(duration * 0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
				Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1
			}):Play()
		end
	end)
end

function ScreenEffects.Vignette(intensity: number, duration: number, holdDuration: number?)
	vignetteFrame.ImageTransparency = 1 - intensity
	
	local tween = TweenService:Create(vignetteFrame, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
		ImageTransparency = 1
	})
	tween:Play()
	
	if holdDuration then
		task.delay(holdDuration, function()
			TweenService:Create(vignetteFrame, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
				ImageTransparency = 1
			}):Play()
		end)
	end
end

function ScreenEffects.ColorGrade(tintColor: Color3, saturation: number, contrast: number, duration: number,
